title: Census Tract-Level Power Outage Prediction and Sensitivity Analysis During Extreme Events
comment: The has been accepted for presentation at the 58th North American Power Symposium (NAPS 58)
summary: This paper develops a two-stage hurdle model for predicting power outage occurrence and severity at the census-tract level. The proposed framework is then used to assess the sensitivity of power outage to socioeconomic, demographic, and environmental factors during extreme events. Five heterogeneous data streams are integrated at the census tract level: 15-minute customer outage data, OpenMeteo hourly weather records, American Community Survey (ACS) socioeconomic indicators, Centers for Disease Control (CDC) social vulnerability indices (SVI), and Geographic Information System (GIS) derived vegetation coverage. The proposed framework is validated using a high-resolution power outage dataset covering 290 census tracts in the Detroit area over a period exceeding 14 months, with a temporal resolution of 15 minutes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种两阶段障碍模型，用于在人口普查区层面预测停电发生概率和严重程度，并评估社会经济、人口和环境因素对极端天气下停电的影响。该模型整合了5种异构数据源（15分钟停电数据、天气、ACS、CDC社会脆弱性指数、GIS植被覆盖率），在底特律290个普查区、超14个月的数据上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏在高时空分辨率下同时预测停电发生与严重程度的两阶段模型，且未充分整合多源异构数据（如社会经济、环境、气象等）来评估停电对多因素的敏感性，特别是在极端事件背景下。
AI.method: 构建两阶段障碍模型：第一阶段预测停电是否发生（二分类模型），第二阶段预测停电严重程度（给定发生条件下的回归模型）。整合五类数据源：15分钟客户停电数据、OpenMeteo小时级天气、ACS社会经济指标、CDC社会脆弱性指数、GIS植被覆盖度，并在普查区层面进行空间对齐。
AI.result: 模型在底特律290个普查区、超14个月、15分钟时间分辨率的数据上进行了验证，表明该框架能有效预测停电发生与严重程度，并量化了社会经济、人口和环境因素的敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 两阶段障碍模型能有效融合多源异构数据，在精细时空尺度上预测停电，并为理解极端事件下停电的社会敏感性提供了量化工具，有助于针对性提升电网韧性。

title: Drift-Aware Multi-Target Space Tug Logistics Using Natural Orbital Precession
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables. Accepted for presentation at the 77th International Astronautical Congress (IAC 2026), Antalya, Turkiye, 5-9 October 2026; paper IAC-26,D2,8,5,x115018
summary: Multi-rendezvous missions for active debris removal and in-orbit servicing incur prohibitive propellant costs when their targets differ in the orientation of their orbital planes, and classical mission design treats the nodal precession induced by Earth's oblateness as a perturbation to be cancelled. This paper presents a drift-aware trajectory optimisation framework that instead exploits that precession as a mission-design resource, benchmarked against the published winning solution to the European Space Agency's Kessler Run trajectory-optimisation competition as a trusted reference. Three methodological contributions are made. First, an enhanced drift orbit shapes the size, shape, and inclination of an intermediate orbit to tune the differential precession rate, substantially cheaper than the altitude-only designs of prior work in the Sun-synchronous regime, where inclination is the dominant lever. Second, a global per-leg time-budget optimiser makes explicit and resolves the coupling between drift-time allocation and downstream nodal geometry that defeats greedy allocation. Third, a sequence-recovery test independently re-derives a removal order consistent with the published reference from the debris catalogue alone. Applied to the full debris campaign on the published mission partition under the competition's transfer-time rules, the framework closely matches the published benchmark cost using only analytical transfer models and minutes of single-core computation. A cross-validation anchored to a widely used flight-dynamics tool quantifies the fidelity limits of the analytic model and bounds the cost of literal execution, and the constructive nature of the algorithm supports rapid in-orbit replanning after a missed manoeuvre.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用地球扁率引起的轨道进动作为资源的漂移感知轨迹优化框架，用于多会合主动碎片清除和在轨服务任务，显著降低了推进剂成本，并在ESA Kessler Run竞赛基准上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统方法将地球扁率引起的节点进动视为需要抵消的扰动，导致多目标任务的推进剂成本过高；本文旨在将进动转化为任务设计资源，降低多会合任务的燃料消耗。
AI.method: 提出了三项贡献：(1) 增强型漂移轨道，通过同时调整轨道尺寸、形状和倾角来调节差分进动率；(2) 全局每段时间预算优化器，显式解决漂移时间分配与节点几何之间的耦合；(3) 序列恢复测试，仅从碎片目录独立推导出与公开参考一致的清除顺序。
AI.result: 在ESA Kessler Run竞赛任务分区和转移时间规则下，使用分析转移模型和数分钟单核计算，结果与公布的基准成本高度吻合；通过交叉验证量化了分析模型的保真度极限和实际执行成本。
AI.conclusion: 该框架实现了接近基准的燃料成本，算法具有构造性，支持快速在轨重规划，为主动碎片清除任务设计提供了高效、经济的新范式。

title: Actuator-Aware Spatiotemporal Tube Synthesis for Temporal Reach-Avoid-Stay Tasks
summary: This work proposes an actuator-aware spatiotemporal tube (STT) synthesis framework to accomplish temporal reach-avoid-stay (T-RAS) tasks for an unknown nonlinear multi-input and multi-output (MIMO) system under actuator constraints. Existing STT synthesis methods address actuator saturation after the tube generation either through repeated online re-optimization or controller redesign. Instead, the proposed framework incorporates actuator constraints directly into the tube synthesis process. The STT centerline and width are parameterized using Bernstein polynomial basis functions, whose convex-hull property enables sample-free enforcement of geometric and derivative constraints. By analyzing the worst-case closed-loop error dynamics of an approximation-free prescribed performance controller (PPC) used for STT tracking, we derive a linear actuator feasibility constraint. The constraints are embedded directly in terms of the tubes' Bernstein control points into the STT synthesis optimization for actuator-feasible tube generation, eliminating the need for online re-optimization or controller redesign. A simulation study on an omnidirectional mobile robot performing a T-RAS task shows that the proposed framework adheres to the prescribed actuator limits throughout the task and reduces required control effort by approximately $50\%$ compared with an existing STT synthesis method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种考虑执行器约束的时空管合成框架，用于未知非线性MIMO系统的时域到达-避开-停留任务。该方法将执行器约束直接嵌入管合成过程，使用Bernstein多项式参数化管中心线与宽度，通过凸包性质实现无样本约束施加。仿真表明，相比现有方法，该框架能始终遵守执行器限制，并将控制能耗降低约50%。
AI.motivation: 现有时空管合成方法在执行器饱和问题上采用事后处理方式（在线重复优化或控制器重新设计），导致计算成本高且效率低。作者旨在将执行器约束直接融入管合成过程，消除在线重优化的需要。
AI.method: 1) 使用Bernstein多项式基函数参数化时空管中心线和宽度，利用凸包性质施加几何与导数约束；2) 分析无近似预设性能控制器（PPC）的闭环误差动力学，导出线性执行器可行性约束；3) 将约束直接以Bernstein控制点形式嵌入管合成优化中。
AI.result: 在全向移动机器人仿真中，该方法在整个T-RAS任务中始终遵守预设执行器极限，相比现有STT合成方法，控制能耗降低约50%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过将执行器约束前移到管合成阶段，有效解决了执行器饱和问题，避免了在线重优化或控制器重新设计，同时显著降低了控制能耗。

title: An Adjoint-Based Differentiable Physics Framework for Online Parameter Inversion in Closed-Brayton Gas-Cooled Reactor Digital Twins
summary: Digital twins for advanced reactors must invert physical parameters online from noisy, partial sensor streams while the plant is rarely at steady state. Gradient-based inversion is the natural tool for this task, but the forward models in routine use are seldom differentiable end to end, so practitioners fall back on derivative-free filters. We present an end-to-end-differentiable digital twin of a closed-Brayton gas-cooled reactor that propagates reverse-mode automatic differentiation through an implicit differential-algebraic plant model, exposing exact parameter sensitivities. The twin drives an AD-Hessian incremental 4D-Var estimator, benchmarked against ensemble, unscented, and finite-difference variational baselines over a two-by-two matrix that crosses steady with transient excitation and full with partial observation. No single estimator wins everywhere: the unscented filter keeps its best-linear-unbiased advantage on the controlled steady-state corner, while the proposed estimator attains the lowest mean error on the reflector coefficient on the other three corners --- reaching \SI{0.43}{\percent} under transient full observation, roughly an order of magnitude below the unscented filter, and matching the ensemble filter at low-to-moderate noise on the combined transient-partial corner. Every estimator's variance sits within a small factor of the Cramér--Rao bound, so the residual error reflects a deterministic bias floor from the twin's differentiability simplifications rather than statistical inefficiency, and the advantage is one of robustness to the resulting multi-modal loss landscape, which a component ablation localises by regime. Differentiating a first-principles plant model thus makes gradient-based inversion competitive with established filters across a reactor's operating range.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种端到端可微的闭式布雷顿气冷反应堆数字孪生模型，通过隐式微分代数方程传播反向模式自动微分，驱动AD-Hessian增量4D-Var估计器在线反演物理参数。在瞬态与稳态、全观测与部分观测的四象限基准测试中，该估计器在三个象限上取得最低误差（瞬态全观测下反射系数误差0.43%），优于无迹卡尔曼滤波等基线方法，且方差接近Cramér-Rao下界，证明了基于梯度的反演方法在反应堆全工况下的竞争力。
AI.motivation: 先进反应堆的数字孪生需要从含噪、非稳态的局部传感器流中在线反演物理参数，但常规正向模型通常不可端到端微分，导致实际中只能退而使用无导数滤波方法，限制了反演精度与效率。
AI.method: 构建一个端到端可微的数字孪生模型，通过隐式微分代数方程传播反向模式自动微分以暴露精确参数敏感性，并基于此提出AD-Hessian增量4D-Var估计器；在稳态/瞬态×全观测/部分观测的四象限矩阵中，与集合卡尔曼滤波、无迹卡尔曼滤波和有限差分变分基线进行系统比较。
AI.result: 提出的估计器在三个象限上取得最低均方误差：瞬态全观测下反射系数误差达0.43%，比无迹滤波低约一个数量级；在瞬态部分观测的低噪声区域与集合滤波持平。所有估计器方差均在Cramér-Rao下界的小倍数内，残差主要源于孪生模型可微性简化导致的确定性偏差。
AI.conclusion: 对一阶物理模型进行微分使得基于梯度的反演方法在反应堆全工况范围内与传统滤波方法具有竞争力，优势在于对可微性简化导致的多模态损失景观具有更强的鲁棒性。

title: The Fundamental Structure of Risk: From Characteristics to Covariance
summary: Estimating the covariance structure of financial assets typically relies on his- torical returns, making risk models dependent on noisy and asset-specific time se- ries. We propose the Characteristic-Driven Dynamic Factor Model (CD-DFM), a non-linear latent factor model that instead constructs a representation of the asset cross-section directly from observable firm characteristics, primarily company funda- mentals. The learned latent space jointly determines interpretable factor exposures and a forward covariance estimator, and is trained end to end on an objective that combines a Stein covariance loss with a factor reconstruction term, targeting the out-of-sample second moments used in risk management. Because the latent repre- sentation, i.e. the encoder depends only on characteristics, previously unseen assets can be embedded at inference time without retraining. Experiments on S&P 500 equities show that CD-DFM produces economically structured latent representa- tions, interpretable factor portfolios, and competitive covariance forecasts despite relying on substantially lower-frequency information than return-based approaches. Among the benchmarked methods, it is the only model that simultaneously combines characteristic-driven representations, factor interpretability, competitive covariance calibration, and zero-shot onboarding of unseen assets.

AI.tldr: 提出特征驱动动态因子模型(CD-DFM)，利用公司基本面特征而非历史收益率来学习资产协方差结构，实现零样本推理和可解释的因子组合。
AI.motivation: 传统协方差估计依赖历史收益率，受噪声和资产特异性时序影响，缺乏鲁棒性；希望利用横截面特征（公司基本面）替代时间序列信息来构建更稳健的风险模型。
AI.method: 构建非线性潜变量因子模型，编码器仅依赖可观测的公司特征，联合学习可解释因子暴露和协方差估计器；训练目标结合Stein协方差损失与因子重建项，端到端优化。
AI.result: 在S&P 500股票上验证，CD-DFM产生有经济含义的潜表征和可解释因子组合；协方差预测具有竞争力，且仅使用远低于收益率方法频率的信息；是唯一同时实现特征驱动表征、因子可解释性、协方差校准和零样本推理的模型。
AI.conclusion: 基于公司基本面的特征驱动方法可有效替代传统收益率驱动的协方差估计，兼顾可解释性与泛化能力。

title: Risk Aversion in the Small and in the Large: Beyond Arrow-Pratt A Wiener Chaos Hierarchy of Dynamic Risk Premia
summary: The Arrow-Pratt approximation is one of the cornerstones of expected utility theory, providing the classical local approximation of certainty equivalents and risk premia in terms of absolute risk aversion. Despite its widespread use, its mathematical scope and relationship to higher-order risk preferences remain only partially understood. This paper develops a new framework for the analysis of certainty equivalents and dynamic risk premia based on Malliavin calculus and Wiener chaos analysis. We first show that the classical Arrow-Pratt approximation is not asymptotically valid for arbitrary sequences of vanishing risks, thereby identifying precise limitations of the traditional theory. Motivated by this observation, we formulate certainty equivalents dynamically by considering the progressive revelation of uncertainty through a Brownian filtration. Combining Itô calculus, the Clark--Ocone representation and the Wiener chaos decomposition, we derive a complete hierarchy of higher-order dynamic risk premia and obtain explicit representations of the corresponding coefficients in terms of Malliavin derivatives. For mixed Wiener chaos expansions, higher-order preference measures, including prudence and temperance, emerge naturally through interactions between chaos components and are characterised using Bell polynomial representations. Explicit results for quadratic Gaussian functionals and the Vasicek interest-rate model illustrate the theory and identify a broad class of regular Wiener functionals for which the classical Arrow-Pratt approximation is recovered as the leading-order term. The results establish a unified framework linking expected utility theory, stochastic analysis and Wiener chaos expansions, opening a new perspective on higher-order certainty equivalents and the dynamic measurement of risk.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Malliavin微积分和Wiener混沌分析，发展了确定性等价与动态风险溢价的新框架，揭示了经典Arrow-Pratt逼近在任意消失风险序列下的渐近有效性局限，并导出了高阶动态风险溢价的完整层次结构及其显式表示。
AI.motivation: 尽管Arrow-Pratt逼近是期望效用理论的基石，但其数学适用范围及与高阶风险偏好的关系尚未被完全理解。本文旨在揭示该逼近在任意消失风险序列下并非渐近有效，并构建一个统一的动态分析框架来弥补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 结合Itô微积分、Clark-Ocone表示和Wiener混沌分解，利用Malliavin导数推导高阶动态风险溢价的显式系数；通过Bell多项式刻画不同Wiener混沌分量交互作用产生的高阶偏好度量（如谨慎、节制）。
AI.result: 经典Arrow-Pratt逼近在一般消失风险序列下并不渐近有效；建立了完整的高阶动态风险溢价层次；对于二次高斯泛函和Vasicek利率模型，证明了在正则Wiener泛函类中经典逼近可作为首阶项恢复。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了一个连接期望效用理论、随机分析与Wiener混沌展开的统一框架，为高阶确定性等价和动态风险度量提供了新视角。

title: Neural Network-Driven Volatility Drag Mitigation under Aggressive Leverage
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Published in ICAIF '25. Code: https://github.com/bongiornoc/RIEnet
summary: This paper introduces a compact reformulation of a modular end-to-end neural network for global minimum-variance portfolio optimization that decouples model complexity from both look-back window length and universe size. A five-parameter hyperbolic weighted moving average combined with a saturating exponential replaces the original 2,400-parameter lag-transformation layer, and a bidirectional gated-recurrent-unit eigencleaning module together with a streamlined marginal-volatility network reduce total learnable parameters from 39,586 to just 2,175. In out-of-sample tests against state-of-the-art nonlinear-shrinkage and risk-parity benchmarks, the compact network attains the lowest realized portfolio variance without compromising expected return. Under long-only constraints, the variance reduction supports substantially higher leverage while maintaining comparable drawdown control. Validation in a high-fidelity trading simulator that incorporates realistic margin-call dynamics confirms enhanced over-leverage resilience. These findings demonstrate that end-to-end variance-minimization architectures can achieve substantial parameter efficiency and robust capital-efficiency gains without sacrificing risk-adjusted performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种紧凑型端到端神经网络，用于全局最小方差投资组合优化，将可学习参数从39,586大幅压缩至2,175，同时在实际测试中实现了最低的样本外组合方差和更强的杠杆韧性。
AI.motivation: 传统端到端神经网络在投资组合优化中模型复杂度过高，参数数量随回溯窗口长度和资产数量增长，导致过拟合风险高、计算成本大。本文旨在解耦模型复杂度与数据规模，实现参数高效的最小方差优化。
AI.method: 采用五参数双曲加权移动平均与饱和指数函数替代原2,400参数的滞后变换层；使用双向GRU特征清理模块和简化边际波动率网络，将总参数量从39,586降至2,175。
AI.result: 在样本外测试中，紧凑网络相比非线性收缩和风险平价基准实现了最低的 realized variance；在仅做多约束下，方差降低支持更高杠杆且保持相当的跌幅控制；高保真交易模拟器验证了更强的过度杠杆韧性。
AI.conclusion: 端到端方差最小化架构可以实现显著的参数效率与稳健的资本效率提升，且不牺牲风险调整后收益。

title: TLRNet: Estimating Individual Treatment Effect based on Local Information and Single Learner Structure
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables. This is the author-accepted manuscript of the paper presented at the 2nd International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Software Engineering (AI-SOFT 2024), Shiraz University, Iran
summary: Causal inference has become a central issue across various fields, including computer science, statistics, economics, education, healthcare, and medicine. The broad applicability of this discipline has garnered increased research funding and attention. In recent years, the estimation of causal effects from observational data has gained traction due to the vast amounts of collected data and the lower costs compared to randomized controlled trials. Advances in causal effect estimation methods have enhanced service personalization tools. For instance, these tools can help identify the most effective type of treatment (considering both cost and success rate) for each patient among different medical service options. This paper proposes an innovative method for estimating the heterogeneity of treatment effects. The structure of the proposed model is based on a deep neural network and a pseudo-single learner. The proposed method has been compared with other state-of-the-art methods on the IHDP benchmark. Acceptable results have been obtained by using one estimator to estimate the potential outcomes of two treatment groups. Accordingly, this paves the way for further development and improvement of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于深度神经网络和伪单一学习器的异质性治疗效果估计方法，在IHDP基准上取得了可接受的结果，为因果效应估计提供了新思路。
AI.motivation: 因果推断在多个领域日益重要，观察性数据成本更低且数据量更大，现有方法需要更有效的异质性治疗效果估计手段来提升服务个性化水平。
AI.method: 提出基于深度神经网络和伪单一学习器（pseudo-single learner）的模型结构，用一个估计器同时估计两个治疗组的潜在结果。
AI.result: 在IHDP基准上与现有最先进方法对比，使用单一估计器估计两个治疗组的潜在结果，取得了可接受的结果。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为异质性治疗效果估计提供了新的发展方向，未来可进一步改进和扩展。

title: What should the encroaching supplier do?: A Stackelberg Game Approach
summary: Suppliers often encroach downstream by operating in-house production-units while continuing to supply independent production-units. We study the optimal configuration, including optimal pricing, for an encroaching supplier that balances these dual roles through a Stackelberg game. The integrated supplier determines the wholesale price charged to the outsourced production unit and the retail price of its own product, while the outsourced unit responds optimally. Customer demand-response incorporates both price-based substitutions (of the two production-units) and loyalty (towards individual units). With strong customer loyalty and luxury products, at the optimal choice for the coalition, both units co-exist profitably. In contrast, when the products become essential, the optimal strategy depends upon customer-fallback rates (fraction of the exiting production-unit's market that falls-back to other). Under low fallback, the coalition either sustains co-existence at maximum prices or disciplines the out-house to operate at break-even---with high fallback it is optimal to shut-down the in-house or eliminate the out-house---we derive two factors that identify the above. We further develop a numerical procedure to identify the optimal regime for any given set of parameters. Two surprising results are---higher market potential of the out-house can become a reason for it to operate at break-even---and the coalition may find it beneficial to operate its in-house at losses, particularly for products that are neither highly essential nor in the luxury category.

AI.tldr: 研究供应商向下游扩张时（既自营生产又供应独立生产单元）的最优定价与配置策略，通过Stackelberg博弈分析，发现客户忠诚度、产品类型（奢侈品vs必需品）及客户流失率共同决定最优策略，包括共存、盈亏平衡或关闭某一渠道。
AI.motivation: 供应商常既自营生产（内包）又供应独立生产单元（外包），形成双重角色冲突，现有文献未充分研究这种混合渠道的优化配置问题。
AI.method: 构建Stackelberg博弈模型：集成供应商先决定批发价（对外包单元）和零售价（对自营产品），外包单元再最优响应。需求函数同时考虑价格替代效应和客户忠诚度。
AI.result: 1）高客户忠诚度+奢侈品：两渠道共存盈利；2）必需品：低客户流失率时共存于最高价或外包盈亏平衡，高流失率时关闭某一渠道；3）两个反直觉发现：外包市场潜力大反而导致其盈亏平衡，内包可能亏损运营（非必需品非奢侈品的中端产品）。
AI.conclusion: 为供应商在混合渠道配置中提供了策略选择框架，识别了影响最优策略的关键因素（客户忠诚度、产品类别、流失率），并给出数值求解流程。

title: Approximation of stochastic insurer balance-sheet results using signatures of economic scenarios
summary: In the insurance industry, Asset and Liability Management (ALM) models are key tools for numerous applications, including Solvency Capital Requirement (SCR) computation and asset allocation optimization. However, their use often entails a significant computational cost, especially when a large number of sensitivities or stressed balance-sheet evaluations must be performed. In this work, we propose an approximation framework for the outputs of an ALM model, such as the Value In Force or the Best Estimate, based on the theory of path signatures. More precisely, the proposed approach consists of approximating ALM outputs by a linear combination of signature terms derived from input economic scenarios. We show that the resulting surrogate is easy to calibrate, essentially through regularized linear regression, and exhibits strong predictive performance while drastically reducing computational costs. We further investigate its robustness under changes in the distribution of economic scenarios by considering variations in the parameters of the underlying model of risk factors while the surrogate model is kept fixed. These results make the proposed approach particularly suitable for large-scale sensitivity analyses and fast balance-sheet evaluations in practical actuarial applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于路径签名理论的保险ALM模型输出近似框架，通过线性组合经济场景的签名项来替代高成本计算，在显著降低计算成本的同时保持强预测性能，并验证了对经济场景分布变化的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 保险业中ALM模型广泛应用于SCR计算和资产配置优化，但大量敏感性分析和压力测试场景评估导致计算成本过高，亟需高效的近似方法。
AI.method: 利用路径签名理论，将输入经济场景转化为签名特征，通过正则化线性回归拟合ALM模型输出（如内含价值或最佳估计），构建替代模型（surrogate）。
AI.result: 该替代模型易于校准（正则化线性回归），预测性能强，且大幅降低计算成本；在风险因子模型参数变化下仍保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架特别适用于大规模敏感性分析和快速资产负债表评估，为精算实务提供了高效且可靠的ALM近似方案。

title: A didactical-driven teacher assistant for a dimensional modeling course
summary: Educational chatbots powered by large language models (LLMs) show promising effects on learning outcomes, yet most systems delegate pedagogical decisions such as content selection and didactic structuring implicitly to the LLM, making tutoring strategies difficult to trace, evaluate, and reproduce. This paper presents a didactical-driven teacher assistant for a French-language university course on dimensional modelling, operating without commercial LLM budget or GPU infrastructure. The architecture formalises the instructor's pedagogical reasoning into deterministic modules that handle intent detection, concept linking, and didactic approach selection before any text is generated; the LLM acts solely as a linguistic executor. Evaluation on 195 authentic student questions addresses two research questions. First, we show that standard semantic retrieval alone does not reliably recover the pedagogically required content, thereby justifying the upstream orchestration strategy adopted in our architecture (RQ1). Second, compared to free-tier LLMs whose detection performance varies widely across models and which produce errors silently, the deterministic pipeline achieves high pair precision (73%) with full traceability and explicit abstention, though its limited coverage confirms that the detection strategy requires further refinement (RQ2).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种教学驱动的大语言模型助教系统，将教学决策从LLM中解耦为确定性模块，仅将LLM用作语言执行器。在195个真实学生问题上评估，确定性管道实现了73%的配对精度与完全可追溯性，但覆盖率有限。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的教育聊天机器人将内容选择和教学结构等教学决策隐式委托给LLM，导致教学策略难以追踪、评估和复现。作者希望在不依赖商业LLM预算或GPU基础设施的前提下，构建一个教学决策可解释、可追溯的系统。
AI.method: 架构将教师的教学推理形式化为确定性模块：意图检测→概念链接→教学方法选择，最后才由LLM执行语言生成。LLM仅作为语言执行器，不参与教学决策。评估使用195个真实学生问题，对比标准语义检索和多种免费LLM的检测性能。
AI.result: (RQ1) 标准语义检索无法稳定恢复教学所需内容，验证了上游编排策略的必要性。(RQ2) 确定性管道在配对精度上达到73%，具有完全可追溯性和明确的放弃机制；但覆盖率有限，检测策略仍需改进。相比之下，免费LLM的检测性能在不同模型间差异大且会静默产生错误。
AI.conclusion: 确定性教学决策与LLM语言生成相分离的架构是可行的，能提高可追溯性和可靠性，但需要在覆盖率和检测策略上进一步优化。

title: Optimal Investment with Switching Preferences
summary: Major life events can significantly increase individuals' risk aversion over a sustained period of time, as empirical studies reveal. How such an event-triggered shift of risk preferences impacts optimal investment is the focus of this paper. On a finite time horizon where a major life event may occur independently of the financial market, an investor aims to maximize her expected utility from terminal wealth while foreseeing a potential change in her risk aversion. We find that the associated Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman (HJB) equation involves the post-event optimal value function (under elevated but fixed risk aversion after the event's occurrence), and the Fenchel--Legendre transform fails to linearize this HJB equation: it yields a parabolic equation with a fully nonlinear term, induced precisely by the post-event optimal value function. Through a combination of fixed-point, compactness, and verification arguments, we establish the existence of a positive convex classical solution with suitable growth to the fully-nonlinear parabolic equation. The convex conjugate of this solution is shown to satisfy the HJB equation and coincides with the pre-event optimal value function. The optimal trading strategy is obtained by concatenating the optimal pre-event and post-event strategies -- the former is expressed in terms of the solution to the HJB equation and the latter is traditional Merton's ratio.

AI.tldr: 本文研究重大人生事件（如失业、疾病等）如何改变投资者的风险厌恶程度，并在此基础上推导最优投资策略。通过求解一个包含全非线性项的抛物型偏微分方程，作者证明了事件发生前后最优价值函数的存在性，并给出了将两者拼接的最优交易策略。
AI.motivation: 实证研究表明，重大人生事件会长期显著提升个体的风险厌恶水平。然而，这种由事件触发的风险偏好变化如何影响最优投资决策，理论上尚未得到充分探讨。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 在有限时间框架下，假设重大事件独立于金融市场发生，投资者预见到事件后风险厌恶程度将升高。建立HJB方程，发现其中包含事件后的最优价值函数。由于Fenchel-Legendre变换无法线性化该方程，转而求解一个全非线性抛物型偏微分方程。采用不动点、紧性和验证论证相结合的方法，证明该方程存在正凸经典解。
AI.result: 证明了全非线性抛物型方程存在具有适当增长性的正凸经典解；该解的凸共轭满足原HJB方程，即为事件前的最优价值函数。最优策略由两部分拼接而成：事件前策略（由HJB方程的解表达）和事件后策略（即经典的Merton比率）。
AI.conclusion: 本文为理解重大人生事件对投资者行为及最优资产配置的影响提供了理论框架，证明了即便风险厌恶发生结构性突变，最优投资策略仍可通过求解一个全非线性偏微分方程获得。

title: Concept-based Visual Counterfactual Explanations with Diffusion Models
comment: Accepted at the 4th World Conference on eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI 2026)
summary: Visual counterfactual explanations aim to answer "what minimal change to this image would flip the model's prediction?", and are increasingly important as vision models are deployed in safety-critical domains (e.g., medicine). Existing diffusion-based methods can produce realistic edits, but they rely on external classifiers that must work reliably on noisy images, which makes them fragile and hard to deploy for robust explanations. We introduce C-VCE, a new diffusion framework that builds the classifier directly into the generative model via a concept bottleneck layer, so that counterfactuals are guided by human-interpretable features (concepts) instead of a separate noise robust classifier that works with pixel-level edits. Our model lets users to toggle on/off semantic concepts during sampling, then minimally adjusts relevant image regions, while preserving the rest of the image, respecting feature correlations. To keep edits small and controlled, we add a simple probabilistic regularizer that balances "change the prediction" against "stay close to the original", plus a gradient-based mask that confines modifications to the most relevant regions. On benchmarks such as CelebA, C-VCE matches or improves flip rates while producing counterfactuals that are visually closer to the input and less distorted than baselines that depend on separate noisy-image classifiers. These properties make C-VCE a practical tool for vision systems where users need concrete "what-if" images without having to trust an additional, noise-robust classifier. More broadly, our results suggest that exposing and controlling an internal concept layer is a promising way to make powerful generative models easier to understand and safer to use.

AI.tldr: C-VCE是一种将分类器直接构建到生成模型中的扩散框架，通过概念瓶颈层引导反事实解释，无需依赖外部噪声鲁棒分类器，能够在保持图像整体结构的同时最小化编辑区域，产生视觉上更接近原始输入的反事实样本。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的反事实解释方法依赖外部分类器，但这些分类器需要在噪声图像上可靠工作，导致系统脆弱且难以部署。因此，作者希望构建一个不依赖外部噪声鲁棒分类器的反事实解释框架。
AI.method: 提出C-VCE框架，将分类器直接集成到生成模型中，通过概念瓶颈层（concept bottleneck layer）利用人类可解释的语义概念引导反事实生成。用户可在采样过程中开关语义概念，模型最小化调整相关区域。加入概率正则化项平衡"改变预测"与"接近原图"，并利用梯度掩码将修改限制在最相关的区域。
AI.result: 在CelebA等基准上，C-VCE在匹配或提高翻转率的同时，生成的反事实样本在视觉上更接近输入图像，失真度低于依赖外部噪声鲁棒分类器的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: C-VCE为视觉系统提供了一种实用的"假设"图像生成工具，无需依赖额外的噪声鲁棒分类器。更广泛地，暴露和控制内部概念层是使生成模型更易理解、更安全使用的有前景方向。

title: Semalith v1.4: A Calibrated 184M Safety Classifier Achieving State-of-the-Art Prompt-Injection Detection at 44x Fewer Parameters than Llama-Guard-3-8B
summary:
Deploying large language models in financial-services and agentic settings requires safety classifiers that simultaneously handle prompt injection, regulatory compliance, and general harm, a combination no existing open guardrail addresses in a single inference pass.
  Semalith v1.4 is a 184M-parameter DeBERTa-v3-base classifier performing simultaneous three-axis safety classification including prompt injection, general harm, and financial-services regulatory compliance, in a single forward pass. Its 22-class head (BENIGN, nine prompt-injection sub-types, general-harm, eleven BFSI labels) is trained with a 4-class auxiliary super-category head under jointly weighted loss, on a 76,204-row corpus mined from 49 public sources with SHA-1 deduplication against every held-out evaluation set, with 21 of 22 benchmarks at zero contamination (max 0.22%).
  Against Llama-Guard-3-8B on 22 held-out benchmarks, Semalith v1.4 wins every prompt-injection evaluation (7/7) and 11 of 18 benchmarks overall at 44x fewer parameters, with FPR = 0.000 on 208 benign agentic prompts vs 0.063 for Llama-Guard-3-8B. On general-harm benchmarks (WildGuardMix, HEx-PHI, HarmBench), Llama-Guard-3 leads; this complementary split is documented in Section 4. Six measured weak spots are disclosed in Section 6.
  Deployment guidance: v1.3 is recommended for conversational moderation deployments (ToxicChat F1 0.624); v1.4 is recommended when BFSI label coverage or zero-FPR on benign agentic prompts is the priority.

AI.tldr: Semalith v1.4是一个184M参数的DeBERTa-v3-base分类器，能在单次前向传播中同时进行提示注入、通用危害和金融监管合规三类安全分类，在22个基准测试中以44倍更少的参数击败Llama-Guard-3-8B的大部分指标。
AI.motivation: 金融服务和智能体场景需要同时处理提示注入、监管合规和通用危害的安全分类器，但现有开源方案无法在一次推理中完成这三类任务。
AI.method: 基于DeBERTa-v3-base（184M参数）构建22类分类头（含BENIGN、9种提示注入子类、通用危害、11种BFSI标签），辅以4类辅助超类别头，采用联合加权损失训练。数据来自49个公开来源的76,204条语料，对所有留出评估集进行SHA-1去重。
AI.result: 在22个留出基准上，以44倍少的参数在7/7提示注入评估中全胜，总体18个基准中胜11个。良性智能体提示FPR=0.000（vs Llama-Guard的0.063）。通用危害任务上Llama-Guard领先，形成互补格局。
AI.conclusion: v1.4适用于BFSI标签覆盖或对良性智能体提示零误报优先场景；v1.3适合对话审核部署。论文披露了6个已识别的弱点。

title: Explaining GAND: A Resource on Gender-Ambiguous Natural Data & Contrastive Attribution
summary: Machine translation (MT) systems continue to produce gender-biased translations. In a time where self-expression is paramount, mistranslations based on default behaviour and stereotyping can lead to harm for users of these systems. To better understand how these systems translate gender in the absence of clear gender cues, we need benchmarking resources that reflect gender-ambiguous scenarios in a natural way. To this end, we present GAND, a gender-ambiguous natural data benchmarking resource for MT consisting of English source sentences, specifically designed to analyse the influence of contextual cues on gender in translation. We leverage GAND to conduct an interpretability analysis: we translate a subset of GAND into two grammatical gender languages and extend these with manually crafted contrastive translations. A following feature attribution analysis reveals source words in context that inform the gender translation of an ambiguous referent entity in the target translation.

AI.tldr: 提出了GAND数据集，用于评估机器翻译系统在性别模糊场景下的性别翻译偏差，并通过可解释性分析揭示了影响性别翻译的源语言上下文线索。
AI.motivation: 机器翻译系统存在性别偏见，在缺乏明确性别线索时倾向于基于默认行为和刻板印象进行翻译，这会对用户造成伤害，因此需要能够自然反映性别模糊场景的基准测试资源。
AI.method: 构建了GAND（性别模糊自然数据基准资源），包含英文源句子，设计用于分析上下文线索对翻译中性别的影响。将GAND子集翻译成两种语法性别语言，并扩展了人工对照翻译，随后进行特征归因分析以识别影响目标翻译中性别翻译的源词。
AI.result: 通过特征归因分析，揭示了在上下文中影响模糊指代实体性别翻译的源语言词语。
AI.conclusion: GAND数据集能够有效评估机器翻译中的性别偏见，上下文线索对性别翻译有显著影响，特征归因分析有助于理解性别翻译决策过程。

title: Embedded Firmware Development for Flight Control, Telemetry, and Video Streaming for DIY UAV Research
summary: This paper presents the design and optimization of quadcopter firmware for a low-cost UAV based on the dual-core ESP32-S3 microcontroller, targeting real-time flight control, telemetry, and video transmission within stringent embedded resource constraints. The firmware leverages dedicated task allocation across the two cores: 400Hz control loop on Core 1 implements sensor fusion with a Madgwick filter, a hybrid fixed-point PID controller enhanced by selective derivative scaling and feedforward braking. Core 2 handles 50 Hz telemetry encoding and UDP-based video and data streaming at 25FPS VGA frames, ensuring separation of control and communication workloads to prevent latency interference. Inter-core communication employs zero-copy buffers with mutex protection for minimal overhead and deterministic execution. Custom event-driven threading and RTOS-inspired static scheduling guarantee real-time responsiveness and jitter-free operation despite ESP32-S3's limited memory and floating-point performance. Experimental evaluation confirms that this firmware architecture provides precise, stable flight stabilization and robust telemetry support, enabling resource-constrained ESP32-S3 platforms to handle DIY projects and research with minimal investment and full customization capability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于双核ESP32-S3微控制器的低成本四轴飞行器固件设计与优化方案，通过双核任务分配、零拷贝通信和实时调度，在资源受限条件下实现了400Hz控制环、50Hz遥测和25FPS视频传输，实验验证了其稳定飞行和可靠遥测能力。
AI.motivation: 现有低成本无人机平台在资源受限的嵌入式环境下难以同时满足实时飞行控制、遥测和视频传输的需求，亟需一种高效的固件架构来充分利用双核微控制器的性能。
AI.method: 采用双核任务分配：Core 1运行400Hz控制环，集成Madgwick滤波器的传感器融合、混合定点PID控制器（含选择性导数缩放和前馈制动）；Core 2处理50Hz遥测编码和25FPS UDP视频流。核间通信使用带互斥锁保护的零拷贝缓冲区，配合事件驱动线程和RTOS静态调度确保实时性。
AI.result: 实验表明该固件架构实现了精准稳定的飞行控制和可靠的遥测支持，在ESP32-S3有限资源下无抖动运行，验证了方案的可行性和实用性。
AI.conclusion: 该固件设计使得资源受限的ESP32-S3平台能够胜任DIY项目和研究用途，成本低且具备完全定制能力，为低成本无人机开发提供了可行方案。

title: AI Strategy: How to Choose What AI Product to Implement
comment: 27 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Submitted to Big Data (SAGE)
summary: Firms struggle to choose AI projects that pay off: two projects can look equally promising to smart, motivated stakeholders and yet deserve opposite decisions. At the residential real-estate brokerage Compass, one AI product (Likely-to-Sell recommendations) flagged sales outreach opportunities and went on to account for nine figures in annual gross commission revenue. Another championed AI product (a Time-on-Market pricing tool) was rightly shelved. A simple ROI estimate could not distinguish the two. We present expected ROI (eROI), a framework that decomposes each bet into three components and rates them separately: Value if Successful, Likelihood of Success, and Investment Required. Each maps to a question executives can answer before building: How valuable would it be if it worked? How likely is it to work? And what would it cost to implement? Separating the three breaks a common catch-22: teams cannot estimate ROI until they know whether a project will work, yet cannot know whether it will work without building it. Judging Value if Successful on its own dissolves the loop, letting a team argue that a product would be valuable if it worked while it weighs how likely that is. The framework also asks, before ranking anything, whether there are enough good ideas on the table. After ranking, it guides assembling a portfolio of bets rather than funding only the single top-ranked project. We illustrate eROI on Compass's candidate AI products. Precise ROI estimates are hard to make given the inherent uncertainty of AI projects. Coarse business-level ratings of the three components are enough to tell strong bets from weak ones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出eROI（预期投资回报率）框架，将AI项目评估分解为三个独立维度：成功后的价值、成功可能性和所需投资，帮助企业在不确定条件下区分优质与劣质AI项目，并以Compass公司案例验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 企业在选择AI项目时面临困境：两个看似同样有前景的项目可能导致截然不同的结果（如Compass的Likely-to-Sell项目成功而Time-on-Market工具被搁置），简单的ROI估算无法区分优劣，且存在"必须先知道项目能否成功才能估算ROI"的死循环。
AI.method: 提出eROI框架，将AI项目评估拆解为三个独立组件：1）Value if Successful（成功后的价值），2）Likelihood of Success（成功可能性），3）Investment Required（所需投资）。每个组件对应一个可在构建前回答的问题。通过独立评估价值打破传统ROI估算的死循环，并在排序前确保有足够多的好创意，排序后构建投资组合而非仅资助单一项目。
AI.result: 以Compass公司案例说明：Likely-to-Sell推荐系统带来九位数年佣金收入（成功项目），而Time-on-Market定价工具被正确搁置（失败项目）。粗粒度的业务层面评分足以区分强弱项目。
AI.conclusion: 鉴于AI项目固有的不确定性，精确的ROI估算难以实现；但通过对三个组件的粗粒度业务评级，可以有效区分值得投资的项目与应放弃的项目。eROI框架为企业在不确定性下进行AI项目投资决策提供了实用工具。

title: Amortized Bayesian Causal Discovery of Extended Factor Graphs
summary: Learning causal graphs from interventional data is a challenging problem with broad applications. In molecular biology, for example, a central goal is to uncover gene regulatory networks from large-scale perturbation data. An ideal algorithm for this task should scale to thousands of nodes, incorporate interventions even when their targets are unknown, quantify uncertainty, and provide identifiability guarantees. However, existing approaches---e.g. approaches using score-based optimization or approximate Bayesian inference---often fail to meet all of these criteria. To address these limitations, we develop Amortized Bayesian Causal Discovery of Extended Factor Graphs (ABCDEFG). Our method guarantees exact acyclicity, scales to graphs with thousands of nodes, and naturally handles interventions even when their targets are unknown. Additionally, ABCDEFG estimates a posterior distribution whose maximum a posteriori estimate provably identifies the true causal graph up to an equivalence class. On simulated datasets, ABCDEFG achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, producing a well-calibrated posterior distribution while outperforming previous score-based and approximate Bayesian methods. Applied to large-scale single-cell perturbation data, ABCDEFG identifies both established and novel gene targets of growth factors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ABCDEFG方法，一种用于因果图发现的可扩展贝叶斯方法，能够处理节点数上千的图、未知目标的干预，提供后验估计和可辨识性保证，在模拟数据和单细胞扰动数据上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有因果图发现方法（如基于分数的优化或近似贝叶斯推断）无法同时满足可扩展性、处理未知目标干预、量化不确定性以及提供可辨识性保证等需求，因此需要一种更全面的方法。
AI.method: 开发了Amortized Bayesian Causal Discovery of Extended Factor Graphs (ABCDEFG)，该方法保证严格的非循环性，可扩展到数千节点，自然处理目标未知的干预，并估计后验分布，其最大后验估计能可证明地识别真实因果图（直到等价类）。
AI.result: 在模拟数据集上达到最先进精度，生成校准良好的后验分布，优于基于分数的和近似贝叶斯方法；应用于大规模单细胞扰动数据时，成功识别了已知和新的生长因子基因靶点。
AI.conclusion: ABCDEFG方法在可扩展性、处理未知干预、不确定性量化与理论保证方面取得了较好平衡，在生物网络推断等应用中具有实用价值。

title: Attenuated Heterogeneity in Fixed-Effects Causal Forests, and a Cross-Fitted Correction
summary: Causal forests that estimate conditional average treatment effects by averaging honest leaf-level effects across trees are widely used in fixed-effects panel settings. We show that this averaging systematically attenuates the estimated heterogeneity: the raw prediction behaves like a + b*tau(x) with slope b < 1, so the spread of the CATEs is compressed toward the average effect, and the additive recentering used to report an unbiased average treatment effect does not fix it. Benchmarking against a similarity-weight generalized random forest on the same within-transformed signal, we find both estimators attenuate but the leaf-averaging construction attenuates materially more. We characterize how b moves with the design, worsening with lower signal-to-noise, smaller panels, and higher dimension; this diagnosis is our main contribution. As a remedy we adapt the best-linear-predictor calibration of Chernozhukov et al., estimating the de-attenuation slope out-of-bag so that it is self-contained within the observational panel and asymptotically inert under a homogeneous effect. In simulations the correction cuts CATE mean-squared error by 25-42% relative to the recentering default; on a standard county minimum-wage panel the attenuation is present but mild and the correction restores the imposed spread. We ship the method in the causalfe Python package.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了因果森林在固定效应面板中估计条件平均处理效应时存在系统性衰减问题（预测斜率b<1），并提出了基于最佳线性预测的校准方法，可将CATE均方误差降低25-42%。
AI.motivation: 现有因果森林在面板数据分析中被广泛使用，但其叶均值平均化构建方式会导致CATE异质性被系统性压缩（衰减），这个问题尚未被充分认识和解决。
AI.method: 理论分析衰减机制（b如何随信噪比、面板规模、维度变化）；对比相似性加权广义随机森林；采用Chernozhukov等人的最佳线性预测校准，通过袋外估计解衰减斜率，且在同质效应下渐进无害。
AI.result: 校正方法使CATE均方误差比默认重中心化方法降低25-42%；在县级最低工资面板数据中，衰减存在但轻微，校正恢复了应有的异质性分布。
AI.conclusion: 因果森林的叶平均化构建会导致CATE估计的系统性衰减，所提出的校准方法能有效缓解该问题，方法已集成到causalfe Python包中。

title: The Fallacy of Sustainable Generative AI: Limitations in EU Environmental Regulation of Data Centres and Paths Forward
summary: In the age of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Large Language Models, Generative AI and larger frontier AI models, data centres create a significant environmental burden on electricity grids and fresh water resources. Requiring data centre operators and Big Tech under the recast Energy Efficiency Directive (recast EED) to quantify, report and disclose the facility-level energy and water impacts seems to be a step into the right direction towards more transparency and accountability. Yet when two recast EED approved benchmarks - the Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) and Water Usage Effectiveness (WUE) - can be skewed to create a false sense on efficiency gains, current EU policy pushing for sustainable hyperscale data centre expansion appears misplaced. This paper argues that current PUE and WUE reporting frameworks illustrate what we term the "efficiency paradox," according to which positive scores require retrofitting larger AI data centres at the expense of energy supply and people's water access. Countering this efficiency paradox requires a new strategy for data centre operators and the EU Commission to demonstrate the ecological gains of optimising for efficiency through individual reporting and additional policy interventions. We make three policy proposals to show how this strategy can be formalised in practice: (i) measures to reveal and certify efficiency improvements, (ii) documentation of trade-offs in PUE and WUE improvements and, (iii) a monitoring framework of their diminishing returns and countereffects over time. Implementing these measures will ensure that the recast EED common rating scheme is fit-for-purpose, balancing sustainability with AI innovation for local communities.

AI.tldr: 本文指出欧盟《能效指令修订版》中使用的PUE和WUE指标存在“效率悖论”——优化这些指标反而可能加剧能源供应和淡水资源的压力。作者提出三项政策建议，包括认证效率改进、记录权衡效应以及监测边际效益递减，以平衡AI数据中心扩张与可持续性。
AI.motivation: AI和大语言模型等技术的快速发展导致数据中心对电力和淡水资源的消耗急剧增加。欧盟虽要求数据中心报告PUE和WUE指标以提升透明度，但这些指标可能被操纵，产生虚假的效率提升假象，反而助长不可持续的超大规模数据中心扩张。
AI.method: 本文通过分析PUE和WUE指标的内在缺陷，提出“效率悖论”概念，并从政策层面提出三项具体干预措施：(i) 认证效率改进的透明度机制；(ii) 记录PUE/WUE改进中的生态权衡；(iii) 建立对边际效益递减和反效果的长期监测框架。
AI.result: 揭示了当前效率指标（PUE/WUE）的误导性：优化这些指标可能以牺牲能源供应和居民用水为代价。现有报告框架无法真实反映数据中心的环境负担，反而已成为扩大规模的正当化工具。
AI.conclusion: 为让修订版EED的评级体系真正有效，需要将效率指标与更全面的环境影响评估结合，并通过认证、权衡记录和长期监测三项政策机制，在AI创新与可持续发展之间取得平衡，保护当地社区利益。

title: A uniqueness result for finite-state mean field games with non-separable Hamiltonian
summary: We study a class of continuous-time mean field games on a finite state space with transition rates depending on the population distribution, leading to a non-separable Hamiltonian. In this setting, classical Lasry--Lions monotonicity arguments do not apply directly. We establish a new uniqueness result on arbitrary time horizons under a combination of strong monotonicity assumptions on the costs and quantitative bounds on the interaction term in the dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限状态空间上转移率依赖人口分布的连续时间平均场博弈，在哈密顿量不可分离且经典单调性方法失效的情况下，通过结合成本强单调性和动力学交互项的定量界，建立了任意时间区间上的新唯一性结果。
AI.motivation: 现有平均场博弈理论中，Lasry-Lions 单调性论证无法直接应用于哈密顿量不可分离的情形，因此需要新的理论工具来保证解的唯一性。
AI.method: 在有限状态空间上考虑连续时间平均场博弈，允许转移率依赖人口分布（即非可分哈密顿量）。通过引入成本函数的强单调性假设，并辅以动力学交互项的定量上界，建立了唯一性结果。
AI.result: 成功证明了在任意时间区间上，即使经典单调性条件不满足，在组合假设下仍存在唯一性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作拓展了平均场博弈唯一性理论的适用范围，为非可分哈密顿量的情形提供了新的分析工具。

title: SeT-Diff: Towards Semantic Foundation Models for HPC Telemetry and Time-Series
summary: Data centers and their compute nodes require accurate and flexible digital twins capable of modeling the complex interplay of workloads, environmental parameters, and physical metrics. Current machine learning approaches for HPC and its telemetry typically rely on a static subset of anonymous, fixed-position sensor variables tailored to single tasks. Consequently, these models become obsolete when target tasks change or sensor metrics vary. We propose SeT-Diff, the first foundational model for compute node telemetry and time-series. Unlike rigid architectures, our diffusion-based approach conditions the generative process on each sensor's semantic description, decoupling the system dynamics from the structure of the dataset. Experiments on a real-world supercomputer dataset demonstrate a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.0470 on reconstruction tasks. SeT-Diff exhibits zero-shot permutation stability, maintaining accuracy with negligible degradation even when sensors are shuffled. A single pre-trained model effectively performs data imputation, forecasting, and virtual sensing - achieving a 0.033 MAE in thermal inference - making SeT-Diff an effective data-driven digital twin for HPC systems.

AI.tldr: 提出SeT-Diff，首个面向计算节点遥测时间序列的基础模型。通过扩散模型+传感器语义描述，解耦系统动态与数据集结构，在重构、插补、预测、虚拟感知等任务上表现优异，可作为HPC系统的数据驱动数字孪生。
AI.motivation: 现有HPC机器学习方法依赖静态传感器变量子集，针对单一任务训练，任务变更或传感器变化时模型失效。需要一种能灵活适应不同任务和传感器配置的通用基础模型。
AI.method: 基于扩散模型，将生成过程条件化为每个传感器的语义描述，从而将系统动力学与数据集结构解耦。模型不依赖固定的传感器位置或数量，支持零样本迁移。
AI.result: 在真实超算数据集上，重构任务MAE为0.0470；具备零样本排列稳定性（传感器打乱后性能几乎无降级）；单个预训练模型可完成数据插补、预测和虚拟感知，热推断MAE达0.033。
AI.conclusion: SeT-Diff作为首个计算节点遥测基础模型，通过语义条件扩散实现灵活的数字孪生，为HPC系统的监控、预测和管理提供统一数据驱动方案。

title: CORVUS: Context Optimization and Reduction Via Underlying Synchronization for LLM Coding Agents
summary: LLM coding agents operate by constructing trajectories that accumulate reasoning, tool calls, and results to enable multi-step decision-making. However, the conventional append-only trajectory architecture found in practice tightly couples file-read actions with their observations, capturing snapshots that become permanently fixed in the chronological history. As files change through agent edits or concurrent human modifications, these snapshots become stale, causing reasoning errors and causing agents to redundantly re-read files, with each re-read appending yet another copy to the trajectory. To mitigate this, we propose CORVUS, a novel trajectory architecture that decouples file-read actions from their observations by maintaining a synchronized registry of relevant files and injecting only their current contents at each reasoning cycle. This structural change produces significantly lighter-weight trajectories that remain synchronized with the actual codebase state by construction, eliminating redundant file copies and stale snapshots that bloat conventional trajectories. We evaluated CORVUS on SWE- POLYBENCH_VERIFIED and SWE-BENCH PRO across four LLMs, achieving 9-50% reduction in average input tokens per task, 15-32% shorter final prompts, and up to 37% fewer reasoning cycles while maintaining comparable pass rates.

AI.tldr: CORVUS是一种新型轨迹架构，通过将文件读取操作与观察结果解耦，维护文件注册表并仅注入当前内容，显著减少了LLM编码代理的输入令牌（9-50%）、最终提示长度（15-32%）和推理循环（最高37%），同时保持相当的通过率。
AI.motivation: 传统追加式轨迹架构将文件读取操作与其观察结果紧密耦合，导致文件被编辑或并发修改后快照过时，引发推理错误并迫使代理重复读取文件，每次读取又追加新的副本到轨迹中，使轨迹臃肿不堪。
AI.method: CORVUS通过维护一个同步的文件注册表，将文件读取动作与观察结果解耦，在每个推理周期仅注入文件的当前内容，从而消除冗余文件副本和过时快照。
AI.result: 在SWE-POLYBENCH_VERIFIED和SWE-BENCH PRO上，平均输入令牌减少9-50%，最终提示缩短15-32%，推理循环减少最多37%，通过率与基线相当。
AI.conclusion: CORVUS的结构性改进有效解决了轨迹膨胀问题，使编码代理的轨迹更轻量、与代码库状态保持同步，同时不牺牲任务完成质量。

title: MioFFAn: an Annotation Software for Formula Formalization with LLM Automation Capabilities
comment: Presented in the 3rd International Workshop on Natural Scientific Language Processing (NSLP 2026), co-located at LREC2026
summary: The automatic translation of mathematical expressions in scientific literature into executable symbolic code (a process we refer to as Formula Formalization) is hindered by a severe scarcity of high-quality, ground-truth datasets specialized for technical scientific domains. In this paper, we present MioFFAn, an open-source, document-centric, and customizable framework designed to facilitate rapid annotation for this task. Building upon the MioGatto architecture, we extend existing features to overcome structural limitations and pivot its scope by introducing specific functionalities for Formula Formalization, such as selection of equations of interest and aided symbolic code specification. By allowing users to configure custom taxonomies and properties for identified symbols, and compatible symbolic operators, we ensure the framework is adaptable to diverse specialized scientific fields. Furthermore, MioFFAn is designed to incorporate partial automation via Large Language Models. By defining a modular set of automated sub-tasks with strict output formats, we enable researchers to iteratively refine automation capabilities and evaluate competing strategies using standard NLP metrics. We specify the current automation methodology and perform a preliminary evaluation that demonstrates to efficacy of this human-in-the-loop approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MioFFAn，一个基于MioGatto架构的开源框架，用于将科学文献中的数学表达式自动翻译成可执行符号代码（公式形式化）。该框架支持自定义分类法和属性、兼容符号运算符，并集成LLM实现半自动化，通过人机协同方式解决该领域高质量标注数据稀缺的问题。
AI.motivation: 科学文献中数学表达式自动翻译为可执行符号代码（公式形式化）面临严重的高质量标注数据稀缺问题，特别是技术科学领域缺乏专业数据集。
AI.method: 基于MioGatto架构扩展功能，设计面向文档的定制化框架MioFFAn，支持自定义符号分类法和属性、兼容符号运算符；通过模块化子任务和严格输出格式集成大语言模型（LLM）实现部分自动化，采用人机协同（human-in-the-loop）方式迭代优化。
AI.result: 初步评估表明该人机协同方法有效，能够利用标准NLP指标评估不同自动化策略。
AI.conclusion: MioFFAn为公式形式化任务提供了一个灵活、可扩展的标注框架，通过自定义配置适应多样化的科学领域，并且LLM辅助的自动化方案具有实用价值。

title: Sensitivity Analysis of Dynamic Line Rating for ACSR Conductors using IEEE-738
summary: Dynamic Line Rating (DLR) is a novel technique that enhances the utilization of transmission line capacity. It is nevertheless unclear how much measurement uncertainty in important environmental parameters affects the DLR calculation. Using the IEEE-738 standard, this paper presents a systematic parametric sensitivity analysis of DLR for a 795 kcmil ACSR Drake conductor. The DLR computation encompasses 832 operating points which includes daytime/nighttime solar scenarios, clear/non-clear atmospheric clearness conditions, wind speeds ranging from 0 to 15.25 m/s, and ambient temperatures between 15 and 50 degrees Celsius. According to sensitivity analysis, wind sensitivity tends to decrease at higher ambient temperatures, whereas temperature sensitivity tends to increase with wind speed. Pearson correlation analysis indicates a strong negative linear association between DLR and ambient temperature, and a strong positive linear association with wind speed. A regression model incorporates both individual and interactive effects of wind and temperature, and explains over 93% of the observed DLR variability across all cases. Finally, the observations serve as a guide for operational planning and uncertainty assessment in DLR-based transmission systems.

AI.tldr: 本文基于IEEE-738标准，对795 kcmil ACSR Drake导体的动态线路额定值（DLR）进行了系统的参数敏感性分析，覆盖832个运行点。研究发现风速敏感性随环境温度升高而降低，温度敏感性随风速增大而增强；皮尔逊相关分析显示DLR与环境温度强负相关、与风速强正相关；所建回归模型可解释93%以上的DLR变异。研究结果为DLR输电系统的运行规划和不确定性评估提供了指导。
AI.motivation: DLR技术可提升输电线路容量利用率，但关键环境参数的测量不确定性对DLR计算的影响尚不明确，亟需系统的敏感性分析来量化这种影响。
AI.method: 基于IEEE-738标准，对795 kcmil ACSR Drake导体进行参数敏感性分析；覆盖832个运行点（含日夜太阳场景、晴/非晴大气条件、风速0-15.25 m/s、温度15-50°C）；采用皮尔逊相关分析和回归模型（含交互效应）量化变量关系。
AI.result: 风速敏感性随温度升高而降低，温度敏感性随风速增大而增强；DLR与环境温度强负相关、与风速强正相关；回归模型解释超过93%的DLR变异。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果可为DLR输电系统的运行规划和不确定性评估提供实用指导。

title: Modeling Memory-Dependent Reliability of LLMs: A Hidden Markov Model
summary: Reliability assessment of large language models (LLMs) seeks to estimate the probability that a model produces correct responses under a specified operational profile. Conventional benchmark-based evaluation, often summarized by aggregate accuracy, provides a point estimate of performance but does not characterize the uncertainty associated with reliability claims. Currently, statistical inference methods for LLM reliability assessment are emerging. However, a key assumption underlying these models is that test outcomes can be treated as independent repeated trials. This assumption may be inappropriate in sequential settings, where later responses depend on earlier interactions through retained context, error propagation, or an evolving interaction state. We extend a hierarchical Bayesian framework for LLM reliability assessment by relaxing the assumption of independent task outcomes and introducing a Hidden Markov Model to capture sequential dependence in benchmark-constructed interaction sessions. In this formulation, outcomes are generated from a latent interaction state evolving according to a first-order Markov process, capturing changes in interaction context. Through experiments using Anthropic Claude and OpenAI on four datasets, we demonstrate the potential impact of sequential dependence on reliability assessment. The results suggest that ignoring sequential dependence may lead to overconfident reliability estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于隐马尔可夫模型的层次贝叶斯框架，用于评估大语言模型在连续交互任务中的可靠性，解决了传统评估忽略序列依赖导致置信度过高的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM可靠性评估方法假设测试结果为独立重复试验，但这一假设在连续交互场景（上下文保留、错误传播、状态演化）中不成立，可能导致可靠性估计过于乐观。
AI.method: 扩展层次贝叶斯框架，引入隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）建模序列依赖：将观测结果视为由一阶马尔可夫过程演化的潜在交互状态生成，从而捕获交互上下文的变化。
AI.result: 使用Anthropic Claude和OpenAI模型在四个数据集上的实验表明，忽略序列依赖会导致过度自信的可靠性估计。
AI.conclusion: 在连续交互场景下，必须考虑序列依赖才能获得准确的LLM可靠性评估；提出的HMM框架能有效捕获这种依赖关系。

title: Do decisions about outliers and influential effects matter? Evidence from 358 behavioral science meta-analyses
comment: 16 pages, 4 tables. Pre-registered study. Online appendix: https://meta-analysis.cz/outliers
summary: Meta-analysts routinely face estimates that look too large or extreme. Yet, how to handle them is left to the reviewer's judgment. The methods for detecting such estimates are well known. What is missing is an informed assessment of how much alternative handling choices might change a meta-analysis' conclusions. We fill this gap by analyzing the effects of four pre-registered handling treatments across 358 behavioral science meta-analyses with at least ten estimates. Each outlier handling treatment is estimated by two estimators (random effects and unrestricted weighted least squares), and compared to the 'do-nothing' baseline on three outcomes: the pooled effect, statistical significance, and whether the effect reaches the smallest effect size of interest (|d| >= 0.20). Our entire analysis and comparison pipelines were pre-registered. Alternative outlier handling treatments have little effect on the meta-analysis mean as the median absolute change in Cohen's d is at most 0.047 and often much less. Yet, at least one of these four treatments in combination with one of these estimators reverses the statistical significance of 11.5% of meta-analyses and the smallest-effect-of-interest assessment in 15.9%. Winsorizing has the least effect and DFBETAS the most. Categorical changes are found almost entirely among results already close to the decision boundary; strongly significant results essentially never change. These findings give applied meta-analysts, methods specialists, and reviewers a reference point for how much this under-reported choice matters and provide yet another reason for meta-analysts to publicly pre-specify their methods and handling treatments.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了358项行为科学元分析中四种异常值处理方式的影响，发现这些处理对元分析均值影响很小（Cohen's d中位数变化最多0.047），但可改变11.5%元分析的统计显著性和15.9%的最小效应量判断，变化几乎仅发生在决策边界附近的结果上。
AI.motivation: 元分析中常遇到极端估计值，但如何处理这些异常值缺乏标准化指导，现有检测方法已知但缺乏对处理选择如何影响结论的系统评估。
AI.method: 对358项行为科学元分析（每项至少10个估计值）应用四种预先注册的异常值处理（Winsorizing、DFBETAS等），使用随机效应和未加权最小二乘两种估计器，与"不做处理"基线比较三个结果：合并效应量、统计显著性和最小效应量（|d|>=0.20）判定。
AI.result: 异常值处理对元分析均值影响微小（Cohen's d中位数变化最多0.047），但可改变11.5%元分析的统计显著性判定和15.9%的最小效应量判定；Winsorizing影响最小，DFBETAS影响最大；变化几乎仅发生在接近决策边界的元分析中，强显著结果基本不受影响。
AI.conclusion: 异常值处理这一未经充分报告的选择对元分析结论有不可忽视的影响，研究者应预先公开说明其方法和处理策略。

title: Socioeconomic Inference in LLM Medical Triage: Same Symptoms, Different ZIP Code
comment: 8 pages, 4 tables. Code, prompts, and raw results: https://github.com/wongqihan/triagebench
summary: We investigate whether large language models alter medical triage recommendations for identical symptoms when only the patient's socioeconomic status (SES) varies. Using three deployment-tier models (Gemini 3.5 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4-mini), we hold a single neurological symptom profile fixed and vary the SES signal along two channels: explicit (insurance status, occupation, housing) and implicit (a US ZIP code, with no other socioeconomic information). All three models raise their emergency-room (ER) referral rate for lower-SES patients given the explicit signal (spreads of 13-50 percentage points). The effect is in the protective direction: lower-SES patients are sent to the ER more often, not less. The model's stated reasoning stays clinically near-identical across conditions, so the shift is invisible to a reasoning-trace audit. Critically, sensitivity to the implicit ZIP-code signal is model-dependent: Gemini infers SES from geography alone, shifting its ER rate by a pooled 11.4 points across six US ZIP-code pairs (p = 1.4e-7, same direction in 6/6 pairs), while Claude Sonnet 4.6 stays flat (-0.1 points) and GPT-5.4-mini shows only a small difference that is not sign-consistent (2.0 points, predicted direction in just 2 of 6 pairs), neither a reliable ZIP-code effect, despite both responding to the explicit signal. This reveals an explicitness gradient in the signal: every model acts on socioeconomic status when it is stated outright, but only Gemini Flash acts on it when it must be inferred from a proxy as thin as five digits. We read this as a model-specific difference rather than a size or cost effect. A single-sentence system-prompt instruction reduces but does not eliminate the effect (Gemini's gap between low- and high-income ZIPs falls from 11.4 to 5.8 points). We release all code, prompts, and raw results.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型在面对相同神经症状时，会因患者的社会经济地位（SES）不同而改变医疗分诊建议——明确SES信号（保险、职业、住房）使三个模型均提高低SES患者的急诊转诊率（保护性偏移）；但隐含信号（仅邮编）只有Gemini Flash表现出显著差异（11.4个百分点），且系统提示仅能部分缓解。
AI.motivation: 探究大型语言模型在医疗分诊决策中是否仅因患者社会经济地位不同而产生系统性偏差，以及这种偏差在显式与隐式SES信号下的表现差异，填补AI医疗公平性研究中关于"信息显式性梯度"的空白。
AI.method: 固定同一神经症状描述，通过两条通道（显式：保险/职业/住房；隐式：仅美国邮编）变化SES信号，测试三个部署级模型（Gemini 3.5 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.4-mini）的急诊转诊率变化，并检验系统提示的缓解效果。
AI.result: 显式信号下三个模型均显著提高低SES患者急诊转诊率（13-50个百分点），但推理文本几乎相同；隐式邮编信号下仅Gemini Flash产生显著差异（11.4点，p=1.4e-7），Claude和GPT无效；系统提示将Gemini的邮编效应从11.4降至5.8点，但未消除。
AI.conclusion: 模型对SES信号存在"显式性梯度"：所有模型对直白SES信息均有反应，但只有部分模型能从邮编这类极薄代理变量中推断SES并影响决策；这种差异是模型特有的，不可归因于规模或成本；简单的系统提示不足以根治问题，需更严谨的公平性审计机制。

title: Low-Rank KKT Updates and a Parallel Flipping Mechanism for Model-Based Derivative-Free Optimization
summary: Model-based derivative-free optimization relies on quadratic interpolation, but maintaining these models typically requires $\mathcal{O}(m^3)$ linear system solves. We show that for the least Frobenius norm updating model, the associated KKT matrix possesses a fixed inner-product structure. Both single-point replacements and a proposed coordinate-axis flipping operation induce exact Rank-2 perturbations to this matrix. Using this structure, we derive an $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$ update formula for the KKT inverse, eliminating costly refactorizations at each iteration. We integrate the update into a parallel trust-region algorithm where workers independently flip interpolation axes, refresh local models, and synchronize the best configuration. Tests on 530 benchmark problems show the method reduces model-maintenance overhead and achieves higher success rates under tight function-evaluation budgets compared to standard solvers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于KKT矩阵内积结构的$\mathcal{O}(n^2)$更新公式，用于无导数优化中的最小Frobenius范数插值模型维护，大幅降低每次迭代的线性系统求解开销。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于插值模型的DFO方法每次迭代需$\mathcal{O}(m^3)$的线性系统求解，计算成本过高，制约了在大规模问题上的应用。
AI.method: 发现最小Frobenius范数更新模型的KKT矩阵具有固定内积结构；单点替换和坐标轴翻转操作均引入精确的秩二扰动；利用该结构推导出$\mathcal{O}(n^2)$的KKT逆更新公式；集成到并行信赖域算法中，工作节点独立翻转插值轴并同步最优配置。
AI.result: 在530个基准问题上测试，该方法显著降低了模型维护开销，在紧函数评估预算下取得了比标准求解器更高的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用KKT矩阵的结构化秩二扰动特性，实现了高效的模型更新，为大规模无导数优化提供了一种计算上更可行的方案。

title: QFoldAgent: An Autonomous Quantum Optimization Multi-Agent System for Protein Structure Prediction
summary: Hybrid quantum-classical protein structure prediction depends strongly on Hamiltonian penalty weights, yet existing lattice-based workflows typically fix these coefficients by hand and evaluate only very short fragments in simulation. We present QFoldAgent, a closed-loop multi-agent framework for 5-residue tetrahedral-lattice folding in which a design agent proposes sequence-conditioned penalties, a VQE-based quantum-classical pipeline optimizes the resulting Hamiltonian under Qiskit Aer noise, and a feedback agent uses energy-landscape diagnostics and MolProbity validation signals to refine penalties across cycles. Ground-truth metrics such as RMSD are never exposed to the agents and are used only for evaluation. We study the framework on two complementary datasets: 55 QDockBank-derived fragments with known structures and 100 coverage-optimized unseen sequences. On the QDockBank benchmark, QFoldAgent reduces median RMSD from 3.64 Å to 3.20 Å, with the largest gains on the hardest targets. On unseen sequences, the closed loop raises structural validity from 87.5% to 98.7%, recovers 87% of initially invalid cases, and the strongest controller improves cycle-3 energy on 87% of sequences while maintaining 96% Ramachandran-favored geometry. These results show that iterative agent control can systematically improve optimization behavior and reduce failure cases in a 5-residue quantum setting.

AI.tldr: QFoldAgent是一种闭环多智能体框架，通过设计、优化和反馈三个智能体迭代调整哈密顿量惩罚权重，在5-残基四面体晶格量子蛋白质折叠任务中，将中位RMSD从3.64Å降至3.20Å，结构有效性从87.5%提升至98.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于晶格的量子-经典蛋白质结构预测工作流通常手动固定哈密顿量惩罚系数，且仅在模拟中评估很短的多肽片段，缺乏系统性优化惩罚权重的机制。
AI.method: 提出QFoldAgent闭环多智能体框架：(1) 设计智能体提出序列条件惩罚权重；(2) VQE量子-经典管道在Qiskit Aer噪声下优化哈密顿量；(3) 反馈智能体利用能量景观诊断和MolProbity验证信号迭代调整惩罚权重。仅使用RMSD等指标进行最终评估，不参与智能体优化过程。
AI.result: 在QDockBank基准上，中位RMSD从3.64Å降至3.20Å，最难目标提升最大。在未见序列上，结构有效性从87.5%提升至98.7%，87%的初始无效案例被修复，最强控制器在87%序列上优化了能量，同时维持96%的Ramachandran偏好几何。
AI.conclusion: 迭代式智能体控制能够系统性地改善量子设置下的优化行为并减少失败案例，证明了闭环多智能体框架在5-残基量子蛋白质折叠中的有效性。

title: CausalGate: Causal Importance Distillation for Transformer Module Pruning
summary: Existing adaptive inference methods for Large Language Models rely on observational heuristics, such as hidden-state similarity or activation magnitudes, to drop redundant modules. However, these correlation-based metrics often fail to capture subtle, non-linear structural computations vital for semantic accuracy. We introduce CausalGate, an intervention-guided framework for compute-efficient transformer inference. During a calibration phase, CausalGate isolates individual Attention and MLP sub-layers, zeros out their respective outputs, and measures the exact semantic damage via the Kullback-Leibler divergence of the final logit distribution. To eliminate runtime routing overhead, this structural importance hierarchy is distilled into a global set of static, lightweight scalar gates using an Exponential Moving Average smoothing objective paired with a differentiable pairwise ranking loss. Evaluated on TinyLlama-1.1B, Qwen2.5-3B, and Llama-3.1-8B across language modeling and commonsense reasoning benchmarks, CausalGate consistently outperforms prominent dynamic routing and layer-skipping baselines, translating theoretical compute savings into concrete hardware latency reductions with zero operational overhead.

AI.tldr: CausalGate提出了一种基于因果干预的框架，通过在校准阶段对注意力层和MLP子层进行零化干预，精确衡量其对最终语义的影响，并将重要性层级蒸馏为静态标量门控，在不增加运行时开销的情况下实现高效推理。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应推理方法依赖隐藏状态相似度或激活幅度等观测性启发式指标来丢弃冗余模块，但这些基于相关性的度量无法捕捉对语义精度至关重要的非线性结构计算，导致模型性能下降。
AI.method: 在校准阶段，对每个Attention和MLP子层进行独立的输出置零干预，通过最终logit分布的KL散度精确衡量语义损伤；随后使用指数移动平均（EMA）平滑目标和可微分的成对排序损失，将结构重要性层级蒸馏为一组全局静态轻量标量门控。
AI.result: 在TinyLlama-1.1B、Qwen2.5-3B和Llama-3.1-8B三个模型上，针对语言建模和常识推理基准测试，CausalGate在性能上持续优于动态路由和跳层基线方法，将理论计算节省转化为实际的硬件延迟降低，且零运行时开销。
AI.conclusion: 基于因果干预而非相关性启发式的方法能更准确地识别冗余模块，静态门控策略可消除运行时路由开销，为大规模语言模型的高效推理提供实用解决方案。

title: Evaluating the Impact of Reviewer Guideline Design on LLM-Based Automated Peer Review
summary: Peer review is an essential process in scientific research, yet the growing workload has made its automation increasingly necessary. In this study, we analyze how different types of reviewer guidelines, such as official conference guidelines and reviewer-imitating ones generated from high-quality human reviews using LLMs, affect automated peer review. Our experiments show that official conference guidelines produce review results most consistent with human judgments, suggesting that evaluation criteria refined through conference practice serve as effective guidance for automated reviewing as well. In contrast, reviewer-imitating guidelines were generally less effective than official conference guidelines. Furthermore, enforcing strict rubric-style scoring consistently degraded performance, highlighting the importance of allowing subjective and holistic scoring.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了不同类型的审稿指南（如官方会议指南和基于高质量人类审稿生成的模仿性指南）对自动化同行评审的影响，发现官方会议指南产生的评审结果与人类判断最一致，而严格遵循评分标准反而会降低性能。
AI.motivation: 同行评审在科研中至关重要，但日益增长的工作量使得自动化评审变得必要，因此需要探索如何有效引导自动化评审系统。
AI.method: 对比分析官方会议指南与基于LLM从高质量人类审稿生成的模仿性指南，并测试严格评分标准与主观整体评分两种策略对自动化评审效果的影响。
AI.result: 官方会议指南生成的评审结果与人类判断最一致；模仿性指南效果不如官方指南；严格的评分标准持续降低评审性能。
AI.conclusion: 经过会议实践检验的评价标准能够有效指导自动化评审，而严格的结构化评分会损害效果，保留主观和整体评分空间至关重要。

title: Optimal Microgrid Operation with Open-cycle Ocean Thermal Energy Conversion for Islands
comment: 10 pages, 8 figures, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Smart Grid
summary: Ocean thermal energy conversion (OTEC) is a zero-carbon technology that harnesses the ocean's thermal gradient to generate electricity. Among OTEC variants, open-cycle OTEC is particularly attractive to island communities, as it can co-generate electricity and freshwater. This paper develops an integrated model that captures both the thermodynamic process of open-cycle OTEC and its operational role in an island microgrid. A two-stage robust scheduling model is formulated for the island microgrid, with a budget uncertainty set to capture the renewable output deviations. The resulting model is solved via an inexact column-and-constraint generation algorithm, which accelerates convergence by permitting inexact solutions of the first-stage problem in early iterations. Numerical experiments demonstrate that open-cycle OTEC can fully substitute for conventional generators on island microgrids and provide more reliable and dispatchable output than volatile renewable sources.

AI.tldr: 本文为岛屿微电网建立了开放循环海洋热能转换（OTEC）的两阶段鲁棒调度模型，采用不精确列与约束生成算法求解，实验表明OTEC可完全替代传统发电机，比可再生能源更可靠可控。
AI.motivation: 开放循环OTEC既能发电又能产淡水，对岛屿社区极具吸引力，但现有研究缺乏将其热力学过程与微电网运行相结合的集成模型，亟需填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建开放循环OTEC的热力学-微电网集成模型；提出两阶段鲁棒调度模型，采用预算不确定集刻画可再生能源出力偏差；利用不精确列与约束生成算法加速求解收敛。
AI.result: 开放循环OTEC可完全替代岛屿微电网中的传统发电机；其出力比可再生能源更可靠、可调度性更强。
AI.conclusion: 开放循环OTEC是岛屿微电网实现零碳且可靠供电的有效技术方案，所提模型和算法为实际部署提供了理论支撑。

title: Variable Importance Identification Through Lazy Training for Binary Classification
summary: Deep neural networks have been widely used in many applications (e.g., computer vision and natural language processing); however, understanding their explainability remains a challenging task. Recently, substantial research has been devoted to improving the explainability of deep neural networks, with most of this work focusing on the regression framework. In this paper, we instead focus on the binary classification framework and adopt a variable-importance framework combined with the idea of lazy training to propose an efficient algorithm for identifying important features. From a theoretical perspective, our method relies on only a minimal set of assumptions and achieves well-controlled error rates. The validity of the proposed method and algorithm is examined through extensive simulation studies and real-data applications.

AI.tldr: 本文针对二元分类问题，提出了一种结合变量重要性框架和懒训练思想的高效算法，用于识别深度神经网络中的重要特征，该方法假设条件少且错误率可控，并通过仿真和真实数据验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习可解释性研究大多聚焦于回归框架，而二元分类框架下的可解释性研究相对不足，且现有方法往往依赖较多假设。
AI.method: 采用变量重要性框架，结合懒训练（lazy training）思想，设计高效算法来识别二元分类模型中重要特征。
AI.result: 该方法仅需最小化假设条件即可实现良好控制的错误率，并通过大量仿真研究和真实数据应用验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提算法在二元分类场景下能有效识别重要特征，为理解深度神经网络的可解释性提供了新视角。

title: Systemic Methodological Dysfunction in Statistical Research for Clinical Decisions
summary: I critique a set of entrenched methodological conventions that collectively create systemic dysfunction in statistical research for clinical decisions. These include: (1) the prevalent use of hypothesis tests to compare treatments, (2) remoteness from patient care of the methods used to evaluate the accuracy of predictions of patient outcomes, (3) poor practice of meta-analysis to combine findings across studies, and (4) widespread research with incredible certitude. It appears that the dysfunction is held in place by three factors: (i) rudimentary instruction in statistical methodology received by medical students and residents, (ii) reliance of clinical researchers on consulting biostatisticians, wo act as statistical gatekeepers in evaluation of grant proposals and paper submissions, and (iii) institutional practices of research funding agencies, medical journals, and governmental bodies that regulate medical treatment. I conjecture that systemic changes are necessary to break the existing impasse, moving statistical research to a better equilibrium.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了临床决策统计研究中根深蒂固的方法论惯例，指出假设检验、预测准确性评估方法脱离临床、荟萃分析实践不良以及过度自信研究等四大问题，认为统计教育不足、生物统计学家充当"守门人"以及机构制度惯性是维持功能障碍的三大因素，呼吁进行系统性变革。
AI.motivation: 揭示当前临床统计研究中普遍存在的方法论问题及其制度性成因，呼吁打破系统性功能障碍，推动统计研究走向更优的均衡状态。
AI.method: 采用批判性分析方法，系统梳理了四项方法学惯例问题，并识别了三项维持该功能障碍的制度性因素。
AI.result: 指出四大方法论问题（假设检验主导、预测评估脱离临床、荟萃分析不规范、过度自信研究）和三大制度性成因（统计教育薄弱、生物统计学家"守门人"角色、机构制度惯性）。
AI.conclusion: 必须进行系统性变革才能打破现有僵局，将统计研究推向更好的均衡状态。

title: Auditing Institutional Heterogeneity for Generative AI in Patient Education: A Large-Scale Study of 102 US Transplant Handbooks
summary: Health systems are rapidly deploying generative AI assistants that answer patient questions from institution-authored education materials, on the premise that grounding in local content yields consistent guidance. Whether it does depends on a question not previously measured at scale: do the underlying documents themselves agree? We use a structured-output large language model judge to audit 5,730,465 pairwise comparisons across 102 patient-education handbooks from 23 US solid-organ transplant centers, paired with 1,115 patient-derived questions (TransplantQA). Four findings bear directly on deployment: (1) institutional editorial voice statistically transcends organ-type boundaries, with same-center handbooks agreeing across organs more than same-organ handbooks across centers (p = 0.0056); (2) information gaps fall disproportionately on topics central to underrepresented subgroups, with reproductive health showing double jeopardy: it is the single most-silent topic (82% absent) and the highest judge-rated clinical significance when present (86% high-significance disagreements); (3) divergence themes cluster into 991 topics, with immunosuppression and pregnancy timing among the highest-stakes themes; and (4) per-pair disagreement is predictable from question framing alone (AUC = 0.77). We discuss implications for deploying patient-facing generative AI in transplant care.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对23个美国器官移植中心的102本患者教育手册进行系统性分析，发现不同机构间的患者教育材料存在显著不一致，尤其在生殖健康等对弱势群体重要的话题上存在信息空白和分歧，这直接影响生成式AI在患者问答中的可靠部署。
AI.motivation: 医疗系统正在快速部署基于本地教育材料的生成式AI助手来回答患者问题，其前提假设是本地化内容能提供一致的指导。但这一假设是否成立取决于一个此前未被大规模测量的问题：底层文档本身是否一致。本研究旨在量化和分析患者教育材料间的一致性问题，为AI部署提供依据。
AI.method: 使用结构化输出的大语言模型作为裁判，对来自23个美国实体器官移植中心的102本患者教育手册进行了5,730,465次成对比较，并结合1,115个患者提问（TransplantQA）进行分析。
AI.result: (1)同一中心的手册在不同器官类型间的一致性显著高于同一器官类型在不同中心间的一致性(p=0.0056)；(2)生殖健康话题存在双重问题：82%缺失且86%存在高显著性分歧；(3)分歧主题聚类为991个主题，免疫抑制和妊娠时机是最高风险的主题；(4)成对分歧可仅从问题框架预测(AUC=0.77)。
AI.conclusion: 患者教育材料在跨机构间存在显著不一致性，尤其是在对少数群体重要的话题上，这为部署面向患者的生成式AI系统带来了重要挑战。需要在部署前仔细评估底层文档的一致性。

title: Comparing Optimization Models for Radiotherapy Scheduling
summary: The Radiotherapy Scheduling Problem (RTSP) involves determining an optimal schedule for patients undergoing radiation treatments, a task that has a massive impact on clinical outcomes given the central role of radiotherapy in cancer care. The daily batch approach--which consists of scheduling all the newly arrived patients together at the end of each day--modelled with Integer Linear Programming, is currently one of the most effective methods for the RTSP. However, this kind of formulation requires substantial computational resources in terms of time and memory. Here, we address these limitations by developing two novel greedy heuristics (named RTSP First Fit and RTSP Best Fit) and use them as constructive heuristics for a Simulated Annealing (SA) approach to optimize the scheduling. The proposed methods--the heuristics alone and their combination with SA--are evaluated on a publicly available dataset against an integer linear program formulation solved with two different state-of-the-art exact solvers. Evaluation metrics include six scheduling objectives capturing patient waiting times, preference satisfaction, and changes in linear accelerator assignment (aggregated in four different weight configurations), solving time, and memory consumption. The results show that the novel heuristics achieve solutions close to those of exact methods, while dramatically reducing runtime and memory usage; furthermore, when combined with SA, they further improve the solution quality while maintaining low runtime and memory usage.

AI.tldr: 针对放射治疗调度问题（RTSP），本文提出了两种贪心启发式算法（RTSP First Fit和RTSP Best Fit），并将其与模拟退火（SA）结合，在显著降低计算时间和内存消耗的同时，达到了接近精确方法的解质量。
AI.motivation: 放射治疗调度问题对临床结果影响重大，现有基于整数线性规划的每日批次方法虽然有效，但需要大量计算资源和内存，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 提出两种贪心启发式（First Fit和Best Fit），并作为SA的构造启发式；在公开数据集上与两种精确求解器求解的ILP进行对比。
AI.result: 新启发式方法在运行时间和内存使用上大幅降低，解质量接近精确方法；结合SA后进一步提升了解质量，同时保持低时间和内存开销。
AI.conclusion: 贪心启发式及其与SA的组合在RTSP上展现了良好的效率与效果平衡，是计算资源受限场景下的可行替代方案。

title: Same Question, Different Answers: Evaluating LLM Reliability Beyond Accuracy
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often achieve strong accuracy on benchmarks, yet it remains unclear how reliably they apply this knowledge when the same question is phrased in different but equivalent ways. In this work, we study how model answers change under meaning-preserving paraphrases across factual question answering and mathematical reasoning tasks. Across four benchmarks and 13 models, we find that model outputs frequently depend on the exact wording of the prompt. While overall accuracy typically changes only modestly across paraphrases, instance-level behavior is far less stable: for many questions, models alternate between correct and incorrect answers depending on phrasing, with mismatch rates reaching more than 23%. Conditioning on questions that are answered correctly in their original form reveals even larger failures measured by answer flip rates, showing that single-prompt correctness is often a poor indicator of reliability. At the same time, we find that models often produce a correct answer for at least one paraphrase of a question, suggesting that the underlying knowledge is present but inconsistently retrieved. Building on this observation, we show that a simple self-paraphrasing strategy can partially recover this latent knowledge and improve performance at inference time. Together, these findings suggest that standard accuracy metrics can mask substantial instability, and that evaluating consistency across equivalent inputs provides a clearer picture of LLM reliability.

AI.tldr: LLM在等价改写下的答案不稳定，虽总体准确率变化不大，但单题层面频繁正误切换（失配率超23%），自改写策略可部分恢复潜在知识。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM在等价改写（同义改写）下答案的稳定性，揭示标准准确率指标可能掩盖的可靠性问题。
AI.method: 在4个基准、13个模型上，对事实问答和数学推理任务进行保持语义的改写，比较模型在原始问题和改写问题上的答案一致性。
AI.result: 总体准确率变化不大，但实例级行为不稳定；单题正误切换率超23%；原始回答正确的题目仍存在高翻转率；多数问题至少在一个改写下回答正确。
AI.conclusion: 标准准确率指标掩盖了严重的不稳定性，评估等价输入下的一致性才能更真实反映LLM可靠性，自改写策略可部分缓解此问题。

title: Progress-conditioned Group Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
summary: Group-based policy optimization has been increasingly used to train large language model (LLM) agents from sparse outcome rewards by comparing trajectories or steps within a group. However, on difficult long-horizon tasks, this comparison can suffer from a sampling imbalance: repeated or low-effect actions dominate the high-probability region of the policy while useful state-changing actions remain under-sampled. This imbalance produces many all-failed rollout groups, where outcome rewards provide no direction for correcting the policy. Together, these effects can form a self-reinforcing credit trap: failure-dominated sampling yields no outcome-based correction, allowing repeated low-effect actions to persist. To break this loop, we propose Progress-conditioned Group Policy Optimization (ProGPO), which uses first-visit observation coverage only when all samples in a group receive zero outcome reward. Specifically, within such groups, ProGPO assigns higher relative advantages to trajectories or steps that visit more new states since reaching new observations is a prerequisite for task success. Experiments on two challenging agentic benchmarks, ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5/7B-Instruct, show that ProGPO consistently improves over group-based baselines, with particularly large gains on hard tasks.

AI.tldr: ProGPO通过引入首次访问状态覆盖率作为零奖励组内的相对优势信号，打破了基于组策略优化在长程任务中因采样不平衡导致的信用困境，在ALFWorld和WebShop基准上显著优于现有组策略方法。
AI.motivation: 现有组策略优化（如GRPO）在长程复杂任务中面临严重采样不平衡问题：重复或低效动作主导高概率区域，而关键状态转换动作采样不足，导致大量全失败组出现，结果奖励无法提供有效策略修正方向，形成自强化信用困境。
AI.method: 提出Progress-conditioned Group Policy Optimization (ProGPO)，核心思想是在组内所有样本均获得零结果奖励时，利用首次访问观测覆盖率作为替代奖励信号，为探索更多新状态的轨迹或步骤分配更高的相对优势，从而在结果奖励完全无信息的情况下提供学习信号。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop两个具有挑战性的智能体基准上，以Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct为基础模型，ProGPO始终优于组策略基线方法，尤其在困难任务上提升显著。
AI.conclusion: ProGPO通过引入进展驱动的替代优势信号，有效解决了组策略优化在长程任务中的信用分配问题，为在稀疏奖励场景下训练LLM智能体提供了实用且高效的改进方案。

title: Learning When to Reason for Text-to-SQL via SFT and DPO
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures. Model checkpoints are available at https://huggingface.co/autothinksql
summary: Recent Text-to-SQL methods rely heavily on reasoning-centric paradigms such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT), achieving substantial gains on complex benchmarks at the cost of high inference-time overhead. However, a large fraction of real-world queries are simple lookups or aggregations that can be resolved without multi-step deduction, making forced reasoning wasteful. Thus, we propose AutoThinkSQL, a framework that integrates an auto-thinking mechanism into both Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) on Text-to-SQL. Our approach enables the model to dynamically bypass reasoning for simple queries while invoking deep CoT for complex queries. On Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B, our method achieves consistent gains compared to the best counterpart baseline on both Spider and BIRD benchmarks while simultaneously reducing average output tokens by 24.6% and 18.3%, and average latency by 17.1% and 11.5% compared to CoT-only generation. Further analysis indicates that the model learns to align its reasoning decisions with query difficulty.

AI.tldr: AutoThinkSQL提出一种自动思考机制，让Text-to-SQL模型在简单查询时跳过推理、复杂查询时使用深度思维链，在保持性能的同时大幅降低输出令牌数和推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有基于思维链的Text-to-SQL方法对所有查询都强制进行多步推理，但大部分真实查询是简单操作，这种"一刀切"的推理方式造成了不必要的计算开销和推理延迟。
AI.method: 将自动思考机制集成到SFT和DPO训练中，让模型动态决定：简单查询直接生成SQL、复杂查询才调用深度CoT推理。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B上，相比最强基线，在Spider和BIRD两个基准上性能一致提升，同时平均输出令牌减少24.6%和18.3%，平均延迟降低17.1%和11.5%。
AI.conclusion: 模型能够学会根据查询难度自适应调整推理策略，实现了效率与效果的平衡。

title: Observer-Assisted Relative-Velocity Compensation with LPV-$H_\infty$ Robust Correction for 3D Trajectory Tracking of Underactuated Non-Minimum-Phase AUVs under Ocean Currents
summary: This paper develops an observer-assisted control architecture for 3D trajectory tracking of torpedo-type underactuated AUVs with non-minimum-phase sway/heave dynamics under unknown ocean currents. A three-stage state-current observer provides relative-velocity estimates to a nonlinear feedforward term for dominant current rejection and to an LMI-certified LPV-$\mathcal{H}_\infty$ correction layer. Feedback-linearising cancellation yields a constant input matrix, enabling convex synthesis without pairwise cross terms. A residual-level break-even law shows that the effective surge disturbance depends on current-estimation error, while a singular-perturbation analysis proves local practical uniform ultimate boundedness on the embedded LPV model.
