REMUS simulations over three trajectories and four current scenarios show 89-96% current-estimation reduction, about 99% translational residual reduction, and RMS tracking-error reduction from 4.04 m to 0.24 m.

AI.tldr: 本文针对非最小相位欠驱动鱼雷型AUV在未知洋流下的3D轨迹跟踪问题，提出了一种观测器辅助控制架构。通过三阶段状态-洋流观测器提供相对速度估计，结合非线性前馈项和LMI认证的LPV-ℋ∞校正层，实现了显著的控制精度提升。REMUS仿真显示，洋流估计误差降低89-96%，平移残差降低约99%，均方根跟踪误差从4.04米降至0.24米。
AI.motivation: 解决欠驱动AUV在未知洋流环境中的3D轨迹跟踪难题，特别是非最小相位横摇/垂荡动力学带来的控制挑战。
AI.method: 三阶段状态-洋流观测器 + 非线性前馈项（抑制主要洋流干扰）+ LMI认证的LPV-ℋ∞校正层。通过反馈线性化消去得到恒定输入矩阵，实现凸优化综合。采用残差级盈亏平衡定律和奇异摄动分析证明有界性。
AI.result: REMUS仿真：洋流估计误差降低89-96%，平移残差降低约99%，RMS跟踪误差从4.04米降至0.24米。
AI.conclusion: 所提架构有效解决了非最小相位AUV在未知洋流下的3D轨迹跟踪问题，具有显著的实际应用价值。

title: Robust Conformalized Selection with Noisy Responses
summary: Conformalized selection has been widely applied to select high-quality candidates from large datasets with rigorous uncertainty quantification, such as reliable labeling, drug discovery, and the alignment of large language models. Nevertheless, existing methods assume clean responses on calibration data, an assumption that rarely holds in practice. In this paper, we formulate the above tasks as selecting candidates with true predicted labels or with responses exceeding certain values. We demonstrate that existing conformal selection methods fail to control the false discovery rate (FDR) or suffer from severe power loss under contaminated calibration data. To that end, we propose Robust Conformalized Selection (RCS), a unified framework for selective classification with valid FDR control under general label contamination. The key insight of RCS lies in a novel statistical reduction: by separately conditioning on different classes, we translate the intractable label noise into a localized covariate shift problem, which then enables a covariate-adjusted empirical-Bayes-type estimate of the number of false selections. Statistical properties such as the asymptotic FDR control, power optimality, and robustness of RCS are established. We further develop an instantiation of RCS under randomized response model, and also apply RCS to the task of selecting candidates with large response values. Extensive experiments on both simulated and real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of RCS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出鲁棒共形选择（RCS）框架，解决校准数据存在标签污染时共形选择方法无法控制错误发现率（FDR）或功效严重下降的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有共形选择方法假设校准数据中的响应是干净的，但这一假设在实际中很少成立；标签污染会导致FDR失控或功效大幅损失。
AI.method: RCS通过分别对不同类别进行条件化处理，将棘手的标签噪声转化为局部协变量偏移问题，然后利用协变量调整的经验贝叶斯估计来估计错误选择的数量。
AI.result: 理论层面证明了RCS的渐近FDR控制、功效最优性和鲁棒性；在模拟和真实数据集上的实验验证了RCS的有效性。
AI.conclusion: RCS是一个统一的选择性分类框架，能在通用标签污染下实现有效的FDR控制，并适用于高响应值候选选择等任务。

title: Robust estimation of the autocorrelation function via forward ratios
summary: It is obvious to say that an adequate estimation of the autocorrelation function is central in time series analysis. In this paper, we propose three new robust estimators based on ratios of observations, which offer strong resistance against outliers. While the first estimator, which is based on the median, is not efficient, the second is a Quasi Maximum Likelihood (QML) estimator with better efficiency properties. The third estimator is a plug-in estimator, which does not require numerical optimization and, consequently, is extremely simple from a computationally point of view, having similar efficiency to that of the ML estimator. We derive the asymptotic distribution of the first two estimators, when the true autocorrelations are zero. Furthermore, we also show that the asymptotic distribution of the plug-in estimator is rather close to that of the QML estimator, allowing for inference and, in particular, for the construction of point-wise significance bands for the autocorrelations. Using Monte Carlo simulations, we analyse the finite sample properties of the proposed estimators and compare them with those of the sample autocorrelations and alternative extant robust estimators based on ranks. Although the proposed estimators have larger dispersion than the sample autocorrelations in uncontaminated time series, they are highly robust in the presence of outliers. Also, they have better properties than popular alternative robust estimators based on ranks when estimating autocorrelations of order larger than one. The results are illustrated by estimating the correlogram of daily IBEX35 returns, quarterly US economic growth and monthly US inflation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三种基于观测值比率的自相关函数鲁棒估计量：中位数估计量（低效）、拟极大似然估计量（高效）以及无需数值优化的即插即用估计量（计算简单且效率接近MLE）。在零自相关下推导了前两者的渐近分布，并证明即插即用估计量的渐近分布与QML相近。模拟显示在异常值存在时鲁棒性很强，且优于基于秩的估计量。
AI.motivation: 自相关函数估计是时间序列分析的核心，但传统样本自相关易受异常值影响，而现有鲁棒估计量（如基于秩的估计量）在高阶自相关估计中表现不佳，因此需要更鲁棒且高效的估计方法。
AI.method: 提出三种基于观测值比率的鲁棒估计量：1）基于中位数的估计量；2）拟极大似然（QML）估计量；3）即插即用（plug-in）估计量，无需数值优化。推导了前两者在零自相关下的渐近分布，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟比较有限样本性质。
AI.result: 所提估计量在无污染时间序列中离散度略大于样本自相关，但在异常值存在时鲁棒性极强；在高阶自相关估计中优于基于秩的鲁棒估计量；即插即用估计量的渐近分布与QML相近，可用于推断和显著性检验。
AI.conclusion: 基于观测值比率的鲁棒估计量是传统样本自相关的有效替代方案，尤其适用于存在异常值的场景。即插即用估计量兼顾计算简便性与统计效率，具有实际应用价值。通过IBEX35收益率、美国经济增长率和通胀率数据验证了方法的实用性。

title: The Clinical Trial Pipeline Reveals the Next Wave of Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare: A Multidimensional Analysis of 8,532 Registered Studies
summary: The prospective clinical evaluation of artificial intelligence in medicine has expanded rapidly, but the global AI clinical trial landscape remains incompletely characterized. We systematically identified AI-related trials registered in ClinicalTrials.gov using a broad keyword search followed by an LLM-based classifier. Each trial was classified across seven dimensions: clinical function, data modality, specialty, AI integration and autonomy, workflow position, translational maturity, and epistemic role. We identified 8,532 AI clinical trials across 32 specialties, with 80% registered from 2019 onward and 30.5% using a randomized controlled design. Imaging-based AI was the largest modality, with 2,475 trials (29%), while clinical text and NLP trials increased seven-fold between 2018 and 2025. Prognostic AI (4,324 trials) slightly exceeded diagnostic AI (3,828 trials), suggesting a shift from disease detection toward risk stratification and trajectory prediction. Treatment recommendation remained less developed, with 768 trials (9%). Translational maturity remained limited: 3,259 trials (38%) were retrospective validation studies and 1,802 (21%) were silent prospective evaluations, indicating that much of the pipeline still produces algorithmic rather than clinical evidence. Only 184 trials involved Level 4 semi-autonomous or closed-loop AI, 68% of which focused on glucose management. Multimodal AI accounted for 33.6% of trials, mainly combining imaging, omics, physiological signals, and wearable data. These findings indicate that clinical AI has moved from retrospective development to prospective evaluation, but not yet to adequately powered, geographically representative, long-term outcome trials. Future progress will depend on closing gaps in trial scale, specialty coverage, geographic representation, and translational maturity.

AI.tldr: 通过对ClinicalTrials.gov中8,532项AI临床试验的系统分析，发现临床AI已从回顾性开发转向前瞻性评估，但大多数试验仍缺乏足够的统计效力、地理代表性和长期随访，翻译成熟度有限，仅有少数试验达到半自主或闭环AI水平。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI在医学中的前瞻性临床评估迅速增长，但全球AI临床试验的整体格局尚未得到充分刻画，缺乏系统性、多维度的全景分析。
AI.method: 在ClinicalTrials.gov中通过广泛关键词搜索结合LLM分类器识别AI相关试验，并从临床功能、数据模态、专业领域、AI集成与自主性、工作流位置、翻译成熟度和认识论角色七个维度进行分类分析。
AI.result: 识别出8,532项AI临床试验，覆盖32个专业领域，80%注册于2019年后，30.5%采用随机对照设计。影像AI最多（29%），临床文本和NLP试验增长7倍。预后AI（4,324项）略超诊断AI（3,828项）。治疗推荐仅768项（9%）。38%为回顾性验证，21%为静默前瞻性评估。仅184项涉及半自主或闭环AI。多模态AI占33.6%。
AI.conclusion: 临床AI已从回顾性开发迈向前瞻性评估，但尚未达到充分统计效力、地理代表性和长期结局试验的水平。未来需在试验规模、专业覆盖、地理代表性和翻译成熟度方面弥补差距。

title: Multi-Path Routing in Decentralized Exchange Networks: Convex Allocation and an Improving-Path Certificate
summary: We present a graph-theoretic and convex optimization framework for multi-path routing in decentralized exchange networks, together with its implementation and empirical evaluation on Ethereum mainnet. The framework models the market as a directed token multigraph whose arcs carry AMM exchange functions. Routing is decomposed into two implemented layers: candidate path generation via gas-aware marginal k-shortest-path enumeration, where edge scores embed expected execution cost directly into graph traversal with an explicit pool-simple constraint tracked during path construction, and continuous flow allocation over the selected candidates solved as a concave maximization over a simplex with a per-pool price-impact cap. Under standard concavity and monotonicity assumptions, the KKT conditions imply marginal-output equalization across active paths. The central technical contribution is an improving-path certificate: after solving the allocation on k=20 candidate paths, the KKT multiplier is used as a threshold to determine via a single shortest-path query whether any omitted pool-simple path could improve the current solution; in our implementation the certificate confirms sufficiency in the majority of epochs. Execution is protected by an on-chain slippage tolerance enforced at the smart-contract level. We evaluate the implemented engine against four production DEX aggregators on repeated WETH-USDT quote observations across six trade sizes on Ethereum mainnet: median shortfall is below 5 bps across all sizes and top-3 quote rank exceeds 57% of epochs.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于去中心化交易所网络多路径路由的图论与凸优化框架，包含两个实现层：基于gas感知的边际k最短路径枚举（候选路径生成）和基于凹最大化与价格影响上限的连续流分配（路径选择）。核心贡献是改进路径证书——通过KKT乘子阈值判定解的最优性。在以太坊主网上的评估显示，相比四个生产级DEX聚合器，中位差额低于5个基点，前三报价排名超过57%的epoch。
AI.motivation: 去中心化交易所（DEX）聚合器面临多路径路由问题，需要在多个流动性池之间分配交易量以优化执行价格，同时考虑gas成本和价格影响。现有方法缺乏对解的最优性保证和高效验证机制。
AI.method: 将市场建模为有向代币多重图（AMM交易函数作为弧），路由分解为两层：1）候选路径生成层——通过gas感知的边际k最短路径枚举，边分数嵌入预期执行成本，并施加严格的池简单约束；2）流分配层——在具有每池价格影响上限的单纯形上求解凹最大化问题。理论贡献包括KKT条件导出边际产出均等化，以及改进路径证书：基于k=20条候选路径求解后，用KKT乘子作为阈值，通过单次最短路径查询判定是否存在被遗漏的池简单路径可改进当前解。
AI.result: 在以太坊主网上，针对WETH-USDT交易对、六种交易规模，与四个生产级DEX聚合器对比：所有规模的中位差额低于5个基点（bps），前三报价排名超过57%的epoch。实施中，改进路径证书在大多数epoch中确认了最优性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的图论-凸优化框架能够高效解决DEX多路径路由问题，改进路径证书提供了一种计算代价低廉的最优性验证机制。实际部署表明该方案在报价质量和执行保护（链上滑点容忍）方面具有竞争力。

title: DeepLens Diagnosis Agent: Agentic Workflow Design Lets a Small Reasoning Model Compete with Frontier LLMs
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Technical report, John Snow Labs
summary:
Medical diagnosis is a multi-stage process: extract facts, consult knowledge, generate a differential analysis, and select the best diagnosis with explanations. Frontier LLMs are strong generalists, but single-shot prompting often yields brittle diagnostic reasoning. We present the DeepLens Diagnosis Agent, a five-stage harnessing pipeline (combining model capabilities with disciplined process constraints) centered on a small medical reasoning model (JSL Medical Small 7B v2) and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). The pipeline enforces structured clinical extraction, disciplined retrieval, constrained candidate generation, explicit evidence triangulation, and an auditable final decision. On the 915-case DiagnosisArena benchmark, the agent achieved 60.14% top-1 diagnostic accuracy, the highest among small and medium-sized models. The same model without the agent workflow achieved 23.99%, a +36-point gain from workflow design alone, despite 88.2% on standard medical benchmarks, showing that diagnostic reasoning under uncertainty requires more than knowledge recall. The agent costs USD 0.0072 per case (24K tokens on A100) with 24-second latency, 35-45% cheaper than Claude Sonnet 4.5 (USD 0.0110) and Gemini 3.1 Pro (USD 0.0128) while outperforming them by +9.70pp and +9.17pp. Harnessing can also correct frontier model failures; workflow constraints can outweigh parameter count or API cost.
  Beyond aggregate accuracy, the pipeline produces structured intermediate artifacts that make each stage inspectable and support error localization. These properties support high-stakes settings where traceability, reproducibility, and auditable evidence matter alongside benchmark performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeepLenz诊断智能体，通过五阶段流水线（结构化临床提取、检索增强生成、约束候选生成、证据三角验证、可审计决策）将小模型（JSL Medical Small 7B v2）的诊断准确率从23.99%提升至60.14%，超越Claude和Gemini等大模型，且成本更低（每例$0.0072），强调流程约束比模型参数更重要。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在单次推理中诊断推理脆弱，而医学诊断本质是多阶段过程（事实提取→知识查询→鉴别分析→选择诊断+解释），现有方法缺乏结构化流程约束。
AI.method: 五阶段流水线：1) 结构化临床提取；2) 基于RAG的约束检索；3) 受限候选诊断生成；4) 显式证据三角验证；5) 可审计最终决策。核心使用小模型JSL Medical Small 7B v2。
AI.result: 在DiagnosisArena基准上Top-1准确率60.14%，比无流程的同一模型(+36pp)和Claude(+9.70pp)、Gemini(+9.17pp)更高，成本降低35-45%，延迟24秒/例。
AI.conclusion: 流程设计约束比模型参数量/API成本更重要；结构化中间产物支持可审计、可复现、可定位错误，适用于高风险医疗场景。

title: QFedPolyp: A Communication- and Inference-Efficient Federated Learning Framework for Polyp Segmentation
summary:
Background and Objective: Automatic polyp segmentation supports computer-aided diagnosis and early colorectal cancer detec- tion. Centralized deep learning requires hospitals to share sensitive medical data, while federated learning preserves privacy but introduces high communication costs through repeated transmission of full-precision model parameters. We propose QFedPolyp, a communication- and inference-efficient federated learning framework for collaborative polyp segmentation.
  Methods: QFedPolyp combines quantization-aware training with low-precision model communication. Each hospital locally trains a lightweight U-Net on private data while simulating quantization during training. Clients transmit quantized model parameters to a central server, where they are reconstructed and aggregated using Federated Averaging. Evaluation is performed on Kvasir-SEG, CVC-ClinicVideoDB, PolypGen, and BKAI-IGH NeoPolyp.
  Results: Full-precision federated training achieves Dice scores of 0.910 on Kvasir-SEG and 0.930 on CVC-ClinicVideoDB. Uni- form 8-bit communication reduces transmission cost by approximately 4 times while preserving competitive segmentation accuracy. Quantized models also achieve up to 1.5 times faster inference than full-precision models.
  Conclusions: QFedPolyp enables privacy-preserving collaborative polyp segmentation with reduced communication overhead and faster inference. The resulting lightweight models are suitable for real-time clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: QFedPolyp 提出了一种结合量化感知训练与低精度模型通信的联邦学习框架，用于医学图像中的息肉分割。该方法在保持隐私的同时，将通信成本降低约4倍，并将推理速度提升最多1.5倍，且分割精度几乎无损。
AI.motivation: 集中式深度学习需要医院共享敏感医疗数据，存在隐私风险；传统联邦学习虽能保护隐私，但反复传输全精度模型参数导致通信开销巨大。因此，本文旨在设计一种兼具通信高效与推理高效的联邦学习框架，用于协作式息肉分割。
AI.method: 提出 QFedPolyp 框架，核心包括：1) 量化感知训练（QAT），各医院在本地训练轻量U-Net时模拟量化过程；2) 客户端传输量化后的低精度模型参数至中央服务器；3) 服务器使用联邦平均（Federated Averaging）对参数进行重构与聚合。在四个公开数据集上评估。
AI.result: 全精度联邦训练在Kvasir-SEG和CVC-ClinicVideoDB上分别达到0.910和0.930的Dice分数；采用8-bit均匀量化通信，传输成本降低约4倍，分割精度基本保持；量化模型推理速度提升最多1.5倍。
AI.conclusion: QFedPolyp 在保护隐私的前提下，实现了低通信开销、快推理速度的协作式息肉分割，生成的轻量模型适合临床实时部署。

title: Between Suppression and Collapse: Evaluating Narrative Unlearning with LENS
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) can reproduce disinformation-aligned narrative frames as plausible explanations, raising the question of whether existing machine-unlearning algorithms can suppress this behavior. We introduce Level-based Evaluation of Narrative Suppression (LENS), a contextualization based evaluation protocol for testing target narrative reproduction across direct, attributed, contrastive, and abstract resistance levels. We evaluate two source-grounded narratives: one framing Russia's war against Ukraine as forced by NATO expansion, and one framing the United States as exploiting or abandoning Taiwan. The experiments cover four near-12B multilingual instruction models: Lapa LLM, Gemma-12B, Qwen-14B, and TAIDE-Gemma.
  We introduce the Suppression-Collapse Efficiency (SCE) score as a checkpoint selection summary that rewards target-narrative suppression while penalizing degraded outputs. Our results shows that selected checkpoints can reduce narrative reproduction and suppression may transfer beyond direct forget prompts. We also report entity recovery as a separate side effect: abstract A/B/C prompts can cause models to recover the real-world actors associated with the target frame after unlearning. These findings demonstrate that LENS is a successful diagnostic protocol for both reporting and guiding the further study of the deeper structure of narrative unlearning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LENS评估协议，用于检测LLM在机器遗忘后是否会再现特定叙事框架（如俄乌战争与美国对台叙事），并引入SCE评分作为检查点选择指标。实验表明，遗忘可以降低叙事再现，但存在实体恢复副作用。
AI.motivation: LLM能够再现符合虚假信息的叙事框架，现有机器遗忘算法是否能抑制这种行为尚不清楚，因此需要系统的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出LENS评估协议，在直接、归因、对比和抽象四个层次上测试目标叙事再现；引入SCE评分权衡抑制效果与输出质量；对四种多语言指令模型进行实验。
AI.result: 选定的检查点能够减少叙事再现，抑制效果可迁移至直接遗忘提示之外；但出现了实体恢复的副作用，即抽象提示可使模型在遗忘后重新识别目标框架中的真实参与者。
AI.conclusion: LENS是一个成功的诊断协议，可用于报告和指导叙事遗忘的深层结构研究。

title: Outcome-Fair Restless Multi-Armed Bandits for Stochastic Deadline Scheduling
summary:
We study a restless multi-armed bandit (RMAB) problem for a stochastic deadline scheduling application. RMAB problems are solved using the Whittle index policy. The goal in RMAB is to maximize the expected cumulative discounted reward maximization. The Whittle index policy maximizes reward, but is not fair among two classes. In this paper, we introduce fairness criteria and study an outcome-fair model for RMAB which allows fairness for jobs and users structurally disadvantaged demographic classes. We formulate an outcome fair stochastic deadline scheduling problem as RMAB, and we develop the outcome fair Whittle index policy. We define a virtual queue mechanism that dynamically enforces long-term completion rate guaranties across demographic groups.
  We analyze a standard Whittle index policy and the outcome-fair index policy. We demonstrate the performance of our algorithms with numerical examples. We compare policies---Whittle index policy (no fairness), input-fairness Whittle index policy, outcome fair Whittle index policy. We observe that the outcome-fair Whittle index policy provides better fairness among classes compared to other policies. We demonstrate a trade off between fairness and profit. This decreases as the server capacity increases.

AI.tldr: 本文研究 restless multi-armed bandit (RMAB) 框架下的随机截止时间调度问题，提出了一种面向结果公平的 Whittle 指数策略，通过虚拟队列机制在不同人口群体间动态执行长期完成率保证，在兼顾公平性与收益之间进行权衡。
AI.motivation: 标准的 Whittle 指数策略虽然能最大化累积折扣奖励，但在不同类别（如不同人口群体）之间缺乏公平性。作者希望为 RMAB 引入公平性标准，尤其是让结构上处于弱势的群体获得公平的调度结果。
AI.method: 将随机截止时间调度问题建模为 RMAB；提出 outcome-fair Whittle 指数策略；引入虚拟队列机制以动态保证跨群体的长期完成率公平性。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，outcome-fair Whittle 指数策略在群体间公平性上优于无公平策略和输入公平策略；存在公平性与收益之间的权衡，且该权衡随服务容量增加而减小。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的 outcome-fair Whittle 指数策略能有效提升跨群体公平性，但需以一定收益损失为代价，该代价在高容量场景下可被缓解。

title: Covariance-Boosted Gaussian Processes for Spatiotemporal Irregularities
summary: Nonstationary Gaussian process (GP) models are powerful tools for capturing input-dependent variability by adapting to observed data. However, with limited sampling and highly parameterized covariance structure, they are often prone to overfitting and overconfident uncertainty estimates, potentially leading to misleading predictions in safety-critical applications. Motivated by ionospheric modeling for satellite-based augmentation systems (SBAS), this paper proposes a Covariance-Boosted Gaussian Process (CBGP) framework centered upon boosting covariance priors to discover nonstationary latent functions for signal and observation variation that capture irregularities in the input domain. An additional layer of GP modeling of "partially-whitened" observations guides latent function relative error estimation that is used to iteratively update weak priors in a gradient descent-like procedure. Following boosting, restrictions are imposed upon prior covariances to prevent overfitting while posterior uncertainties are inflated to prevent model overconfidence. CBGP model efficacy and robustness are demonstrated through out-of-sample testing of both simulated and real-world applications that meet a three-nines integrity standard. The modeling of an extensive ionospheric storm dataset over South America suggests accurate and reliable means to compute SBAS ionospheric corrections in the most challenging space weather environment using regional models that are more informed and responsive than local fitting performed by currently-operating SBAS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种协方差增强高斯过程（CBGP）框架，通过迭代提升协方差先验来发现非平稳潜在函数，并引入部分白化观测和不确定性膨胀机制，在避免过拟合和过度自信的同时，有效建模电离层等复杂非平稳过程，满足三九完整性标准。
AI.motivation: 非平稳高斯过程模型虽然能捕捉输入依赖的可变性，但在有限采样和高参数化协方差结构下容易过拟合和给出过度自信的不确定性估计，这在安全关键应用（如卫星增强系统SBAS的电离层建模）中可能导致误导性预测。
AI.method: 提出CBGP框架：1）通过提升协方差先验发现非平稳潜在信号和观测变化函数；2）利用部分白化观测的额外GP层引导潜在函数相对误差估计，以类似梯度下降的方式迭代更新弱先验；3）提升后对先验协方差施加限制防止过拟合，并膨胀后验不确定性防止模型过度自信。
AI.result: 在模拟和真实数据（包括南美电离层风暴数据集）的样本外测试中，CBGP满足三九完整性标准，展现了有效性和鲁棒性，能比当前运行的SBAS局部拟合方法更准确、可靠地计算电离层校正。
AI.conclusion: CBGP框架为安全关键应用中的非平稳GP建模提供了一种鲁棒的解决方案，特别是在最具挑战性的空间天气环境下，通过更具信息量的区域模型实现更可靠的电离层校正。

title: Debiased Machine Learning: Identification, Estimation, and Shape Constraints
summary: We develop a general framework of identification and estimation for automatic debiased machine learning (DML) where the parameter of interest $θ_0$ is identified by a moment condition involving a nuisance $γ_0$ that may be high dimensional. DML leverages machine learning to estimate $γ_0$ while correcting for regularization and overfitting biases that may otherwise transmit to biased estimation of $θ_0$. We establish conditions under which the Riesz representer $α_0$, which is at the core of DML, is identified, and show that the identification occurs precisely when $α_0$ uniquely optimizes a quadratic functional. This characterization enables us to develop a general estimation procedure for $α_0$ that allows for generic $γ_0$ including those defined by models with endogeneity and encompasses both classical sieves and modern architectures such as deep neural networks. To improve estimation precision and mitigate the curse of dimensionality, we incorporate shape constraints on $γ_0$ by embedding them into a possibly nonlinear parameter space. We illustrate our estimation procedure through simulations and empirical applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自动去偏机器学习（DML）的通用识别与估计框架，通过Riesz表示子的识别与优化，结合形状约束，解决了高维 nuisance 参数估计中的正则化与过拟合偏差问题。
AI.motivation: 在利用机器学习估计高维 nuisance 参数时，正则化与过拟合会导致目标参数θ₀的估计产生偏差。现有DML方法依赖Riesz表示子α₀，但其识别条件尚不清晰，且缺乏适用于一般nuisance参数（包括内生性模型）的通用估计程序。
AI.method: 1. 证明α₀的识别等价于其唯一优化一个二次泛函；2. 基于此特征建立通用估计程序，支持经典筛法和深度神经网络；3. 将形状约束嵌入（可能非线性的）参数空间以缓解维度诅咒、提升精度。
AI.result: 通过模拟和实证应用验证了所提估计程序的有效性，展示了其在应对高维nuisance参数、内生性模型及形状约束下的表现。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架为DML中Riesz表示子的识别与估计提供了理论基础与通用方法，形状约束的引入有效提升了估计精度，拓展了DML在复杂模型（如内生性场景）中的应用范围。

title: Revitalizing Public Urban Places through Cultural and Political Memory: A Technological Approach with LLMs and Augmented Reality
summary:
This paper explores the intersection of memory, place, and identity, examining how new technologies, particularly Apple Vision Pro, can illuminate this nexus. Leveraging digital twins and virtual reality, it investigates how memory is woven into landscapes and urban environments of cultural and historical significance, identifying visual elements that evoke memory and heritage.
  Applications such as Apple Vision Pro can facilitate image extension to define place identity, informing viewers about cultural and political entities across timelines. Visual storytelling can showcase the evolution of landscapes and the preservation of cultural heritage, while Virtual Reality (VR) enables the recreation of historical landscapes and urban-scapes. This immersive approach invites users to transcend temporal boundaries and experience the past dynamically. Semantic Image Search can support research by uncovering images related to monuments, tradition, or cultural identity.
  This research introduces a methodology to connect digital twins and virtual environments with urban and non-urban landscapes to illustrate cultural, historical, and environmental sustainability. Central to this approach is defining the resilience of the current state, its future evolution, and the significance of the past. These technologies facilitate a historical and cultural embrace while evoking the feeling of returning to a specific place years later. The methodology outlines the integration of technologies needed to revitalize public urban places through cultural and political memory.
  Through these applications, this paper contributes to research on digital twins of spaces, urban transformation, and cultural heritage preservation. By offering insights into the relationship between memory, place, and identity in the digital age, it supports a deeper understanding of our collective past and its impact on the present.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了记忆、场所与身份认同的交汇点，研究新技术（尤其是Apple Vision Pro）如何通过数字孪生、虚拟现实和语义图像搜索，将记忆编织进具有文化和历史意义的景观与城市环境中，以增强文化遗产保护、场所认同感及历史沉浸体验。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于探索如何利用新兴技术（如Apple Vision Pro）连接记忆、场所与身份认同，揭示视觉元素如何唤起文化遗产记忆，并推动城市与自然景观的文化、历史与环境可持续性。
AI.method: 提出一种方法论，将数字孪生、虚拟环境与城市/非城市景观相结合，通过图像扩展、视觉叙事、VR历史景观重建以及语义图像搜索等技术，定义场所的韧性、未来演变及历史意义。
AI.result: 研究表明，Apple Vision Pro等应用能够通过视觉叙事展示景观演变与文化遗产保护；VR可动态重现历史场景；语义图像搜索助力文化遗产研究；整体方法有助于通过文化与政治记忆复兴公共城市空间。
AI.conclusion: 该论文为数字孪生空间、城市转型和文化遗产保护研究做出了贡献，深化了对数字时代中记忆、场所与身份认同关系的理解，强调集体历史对当下的影响。

title: SDE Guided Monte Carlo Reinforcement Learning: A Stochastic Maximum Principle Approach for Robust Decision Making in Noisy Environments
summary: This work investigates whether the qualitative optimality conditions of the SMP can serve as guiding heuristics for designing robust tabular RL algorithms. We propose the \textbf{SDE-MC-AC} framework, which establishes a set of SMP-inspired correspondences: the potential field gradient is mapped to potential-based reward shaping, the diffusion coefficient to a softmax temperature, and the value function gradient magnitude to the episode-averaged absolute temporal-difference (TD) error. Crucially, we derive an SMP-motivated adaptive temperature schedule that scales exploration stochastically in response to local value uncertainty. The resulting Monte Carlo Actor-Critic agent integrates potential-shaped rewards, entropy regularization, and adaptive temperature control within episodic updates. We conduct a set of five principled experiments in a minimal, fixed maze testbed under three canonical noise regimes (perceptual, dynamic goal, action) to test five falsifiable hypotheses derived from the SMP. Our results provide evidence for (i) an inverted-U optimal stochasticity curve, (ii) the robust failure prevention of the adaptive schedule under non-stationary noise, (iii) convergence acceleration by potential field guidance, (iv) cross-noise generalization, and (v) the indispensability of the combined SDE components through systematic ablation. Trajectory visualizations reveal a characteristic ``macroscopically deterministic, microscopically stochastic'' navigation pattern consistent with the SDE model. The study demonstrates that even a heuristic transposition of the SMP into a discrete MDP can yield significant empirical gains, thereby opening a bridge between rigorous stochastic optimal control and practical robust reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SDE-MC-AC框架，将随机极大值原理(SMP)的定性最优性条件启发式地迁移到离散表格型强化学习中，通过势场奖励塑形、熵正则化和自适应温度调度，在噪声环境下实现宏观确定、微观随机的鲁棒导航策略。
AI.motivation: 探索SMP的最优性条件能否作为设计鲁棒表格型RL算法的启发性准则，弥合随机最优控制理论与实用强化学习之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出SDE-MC-AC框架：将势场梯度映射为势能奖励塑形，扩散系数映射为softmax温度，值函数梯度幅值映射为时序差分误差。推导SMP驱动的自适应温度调度，根据局部值函数不确定性随机调节探索强度。在固定迷宫测试床上，设置三种噪声 regime（感知、动态目标、动作），开展五个可证伪假设的实验验证。
AI.result: 五个假设均获验证：(i) 倒U型最优随机性曲线，(ii) 自适应调度在非平稳噪声下鲁棒防失效，(iii) 势场引导加速收敛，(iv) 跨噪声泛化能力，(v) 消融实验证实SDE各组件的不可或缺性。轨迹可视化呈现"宏观确定性、微观随机性"的导航模式。
AI.conclusion: SMP的启发性迁移到离散MDP能带来显著的实证增益，为连接随机最优控制与鲁棒强化学习开辟了桥梁。

title: MIITA: Memory-Induced Inference-Time Adaptation for Continual Learning with Small Language Models
summary: Continual learning (CL) is essential for small language models (SLMs) to adapt to evolving real-world needs in resource-constrained deployments. However, directly updating their limited parameter space causes catastrophic forgetting. While memory-based methods naturally address this by decoupling knowledge retention from parameters, existing approaches designed for large language models (LLMs) rely on abundant storage and strong in-context reasoning that SLMs lack. To address these challenges, we propose MIITA, a Memory-Induced Inference-Time Adaptation framework for supervised CL under constrained storage. MIITA stores supervised experiences as compact correction-direction prototypes with semantic anchors, and retrieves them at inference time using semantic and uncertainty-based cues. The retrieved directions are applied through gated temporary hidden-state adaptation, enabling non-destructive reuse of past supervision without backbone updates, prompt extensions, or test-time backpropagation. A local theoretical analysis links this design to first-order loss reduction, uncertainty-guided retrieval, and directional coverage for retaining old-stage knowledge. Extensive experiments across diverse supervised CL settings show that MIITA consistently improves final performance and mitigates forgetting under fixed memory budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出MIITA框架，通过存储修正方向原型并在推理时隐状态门控适配，实现小语言模型在资源受限下的持续学习，无需更新主干网络或扩展提示。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型参数空间有限，直接更新会导致灾难性遗忘；而现有针对大语言模型的记忆方法依赖充足存储和强上下文推理能力，小语言模型不具备这些条件。
AI.method: MIITA将监督经验存储为带语义锚点的紧凑修正方向原型，推理时基于语义和不确定性线索检索，通过门控临时隐状态适配实现非破坏性知识复用，无需主干更新、提示扩展或测试时反向传播。
AI.result: 在多种监督持续学习设置下，固定存储预算中MIITA持续提升最终性能并有效缓解遗忘。
AI.conclusion: MIITA通过内存诱导的推理时适配，为小语言模型在资源受限环境下提供了一种有效的持续学习方案，理论上与一阶损失降低、不确定性引导检索和方向覆盖建立了联系。

title: Learning to Access Computation: Accessibility Plasticity as a Principle of Adaptive Intelligence
summary: Modern neural networks primarily adapt through parameter modification within predefined computational structures. While recent methods introduce modularity, conditional computation, and parameter-efficient adaptation, they generally do not distinguish computational capability from computational accessibility as separate adaptive variables. This work introduces Accessibility Plasticity, a principle of adaptive computation in which systems adapt not only by changing what computation exists, but also by reorganizing which existing computations can interact and participate. We formalize Accessibility Plasticity through a relationship-based operational realization and establish a reuse-first hierarchy of adaptation, where accessibility modification precedes more costly capability and structural changes. A proof-of-concept evaluation on sequential learning tasks shows that accessibility adaptation can reduce capability modification while maintaining comparable task performance. These results suggest accessibility as a distinct adaptive dimension and provide a foundation for future dynamic neural systems whose computational relationships evolve with changing environments.

AI.tldr: 提出"可访问性可塑性"(Accessibility Plasticity)原则，将计算的可访问性作为独立于计算能力的自适应维度，并通过关系型操作实现，在序列学习任务中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现代神经网络主要通过修改参数来适应，虽然引入了模块化、条件计算等方法，但未区分"计算能力"与"计算可访问性"作为独立的自适应变量。作者旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 形式化了Accessibility Plasticity原则：通过关系型操作(关系重组)实现，建立"重用优先"的自适应层级(可访问性修改优先于能力修改和结构修改)。在序列学习任务上进行概念验证评估。
AI.result: 可访问性自适应能在保持相当任务性能的同时，减少能力修改。证明可访问性是一个独立的自适应维度。
AI.conclusion: 可访问性是神经网络中一个被忽视的自适应维度，为未来计算关系随环境动态演化的动态神经系统奠定基础。

title: PatiGonit22K: A Comprehensive Dataset for Solving Complex Bengali MWPs
summary: Mathematical Word Problems (MWPs) are an important benchmark for evaluating natural language understanding and quantitative reasoning. Despite recent progress in high resource languages, Bengali remains underexplored due to the limited availability of large scale annotated datasets. In this work, we introduce PatiGonit22K, an expanded Bengali MWP dataset containing 22,441 problems, developed by extending the original PatiGonit dataset with a substantially larger collection of complex mathematical problems. The dataset includes both simple and multi operation equations, providing a balanced benchmark for evaluating mathematical reasoning across different difficulty levels. Each problem is carefully translated, annotated, culturally adapted, and verified to ensure linguistic consistency and mathematical correctness. By increasing both the scale and complexity of Bengali MWPs, PatiGonit22K provides a more comprehensive resource for future research on mathematical reasoning and educational NLP applications in low resource languages.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了PatiGonit22K，一个包含22,441道孟加拉语数学应用题的大规模扩展数据集，旨在解决低资源语言中数学推理研究的数据稀缺问题。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉语等低资源语言缺乏大规模、高质量的数学应用题标注数据集，限制了相关语言的自然语言理解和数学推理研究。
AI.method: 在原有PatiGonit数据集基础上扩展，收集了22,441道包含简单和复杂多步骤运算的数学问题，经过翻译、标注、文化适配和验证，确保语言一致性和数学正确性。
AI.result: 构建了PatiGonit22K数据集，规模达到22,441道题目，涵盖多种难度级别，成为孟加拉语数学推理领域最全面的公开资源之一。
AI.conclusion: PatiGonit22K为低资源语言（尤其是孟加拉语）的数学推理和NLP教育应用研究提供了重要的基准资源，有助于推动该方向的进一步发展。

title: B-spline shaping for low-thrust interplanetary rendezvous
summary: Rapid preliminary design of low-thrust interplanetary rendezvous trajectories requires parameterizations that combine computational efficiency, flexibility, and sufficient solution quality. This work presents a shape-based method in which the heliocentric cylindrical coordinates are parameterized using clamped B-splines. The differential flatness of the low-thrust cylindrical dynamics is exploited to recover the control acceleration algebraically from the shaped trajectory and its derivatives. The clamped B-spline parameterization satisfies the endpoint position and velocity conditions analytically, reducing the original fixed-time, minimum delta-v problem to a finite-dimensional nonlinear program in the free interior B-spline control points. The formulation therefore requires no numerical propagation of the equations of motion; numerical quadrature is used only to evaluate the objective function. Numerical campaigns are conducted for low-thrust rendezvous transfers from Earth to Mars, Mercury, the near-Earth asteroid 1989 ML, and comet Tempel 1, and the results are compared with high-order hodographic shaping. Across the tested fine-grid campaigns and among the finite solutions retained, all B-spline configurations reduce the mean, median, and minimum accumulated velocity increment relative to the hodographic benchmark. In particular, a ten control-point quintic B-spline is identified as a favorable compromise between solution quality and computational efficiency, while higher-dimensional parameterizations are effective for refining selected transfer opportunities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于夹紧B样条的形状方法，用于低推力星际交会轨迹的快速初步设计。该方法利用圆柱坐标系的微分平坦性，将控制加速度从轨迹及其导数中代数恢复，无需数值传播运动方程。在多种星际转移任务中，该方法相比高阶全息成形均降低了累积速度增量。十控制点五次B样条在解质量和计算效率间达到最佳平衡。
AI.motivation: 低推力星际交会轨迹的快速初步设计需要结合计算效率、灵活性和足够解质量的参数化方法，现有方法在这几方面难以兼顾。
AI.method: 采用夹紧B样条参数化日心圆柱坐标，利用低推力圆柱动力学的微分平坦性从成形轨迹及其导数中代数恢复控制加速度，将固定时间最小Δv问题转化为有限维非线性规划，无需数值传播运动方程，仅用数值积分评估目标函数。
AI.result: 在地球到火星、水星、近地小行星1989 ML和坦普尔1号彗星的数值实验中，所有B样条配置在平均、中位数和最小累积速度增量方面均优于高阶全息成形基准。十控制点五次B样条在解质量与计算效率间表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 夹紧B样条参数化方法能有效降低低推力星际转移所需的速度增量，十控制点五次B样条是实用场景下的推荐配置，更高维度的参数化适合用于精化特定转移机会。

title: Operator Neural Jump ODEs: $L^2$-optimal prediction in function spaces
summary: In this paper, we study the extension of Neural Jump ODEs to infinite-dimensional function spaces. In particular, the underlying process $X$ now takes values in $L^2(Ξ, \mathbb{R}^{d_X})$ instead of $\mathbb{R}^{d_X}$ and the Operator NJ-ODE approximates the optimal predictor of this process by producing a representative of the conditional expectation. The NJ-ODE model is a framework for online learning the optimal prediction of continuous-time stochastic processes, given discrete, possibly irregular and incomplete past observations. In a series of works, this model has been extended to deal with generic path-dependent processes, with observation noise and dependent observations, with long-term predictions, and with input-output systems. However, throughout all of these works, the underlying processes were restricted to be finite-dimensional. In particular, function-valued problems, like yield curve or volatility surface predictions, could only be handled through discretization, which inherently leads to a loss of information. In this work, we build on ideas from Neural Operator methods that allow us to extend the NJ-ODE framework to an infinite-dimensional output process. To prove convergence of the NJ-ODE to the optimal prediction process, we develop a new approximation strategy that also generalizes previous works in the finite-dimensional setting by considerably weakening the assumptions.

AI.tldr: 本文将神经跳跃常微分方程（NJ-ODE）从有限维扩展到无限维函数空间，使得输出过程取值于$L^2$空间而非$\mathbb{R}^{d_X}$，并提出了新的近似策略来证明收敛性，同时放宽了有限维情形下的假设条件。
AI.motivation: 已有的NJ-ODE框架在处理函数值问题（如收益率曲线、波动率曲面预测）时只能通过离散化处理，导致信息损失。本文旨在将NJ-ODE扩展到无限维输出过程，避免离散化带来的问题。
AI.method: 借鉴神经算子方法的思想，将NJ-ODE框架扩展到无限维输出过程。提出新的近似策略来证明NJ-ODE收敛到最优预测过程，该策略同时推广了有限维情形下的工作并大幅放宽了假设条件。
AI.result: 成功将NJ-ODE扩展至无限维函数空间，使得算子NJ-ODE能够直接处理函数值过程（如$L^2$空间中的随机过程），无需离散化。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了无限维NJ-ODE的理论基础，证明了其在更宽松假设下的收敛性，为函数值时间序列的在线最优预测提供了新框架。

title: Bitcoin Price Direction Prediction via Regime-Aware Multi-Modal Fusion of Social Sentiment and Technical Features
summary: Bitcoin price prediction on sub-daily timescales is a hard open problem in computational finance. Bitcoin exhibits fat-tailed returns, non-stationary dynamics, and a price discovery process influenced by social discourse on Reddit and Twitter. Conventional approaches fuse OHLCV technical features with sentiment via static concatenation, applying identical fusion weights regardless of market state. This is inconsistent with the behavioural finance literature, which shows that retail sentiment is most predictive during volatile periods and noisy during calm ones. This paper proposes Regime-Aware Multi-Modal Learning (RAML), which conditions fusion of sentiment and price features on a dynamically detected binary market regime. Rolling 24-hour volatility partitions observations into stable and volatile regimes; a learnable sigmoid gate adjusts the weight of the sentiment embedding relative to the price embedding, trusting sentiment more during volatility and price dynamics more during stable phases. The system is evaluated on 3,491 hourly observations (July 2024-September 2025), combining Bitcoin OHLCV data with Reddit /r/Bitcoin FinBERT sentiment. Four models are compared - price-only BiLSTM, sentiment-only classifier, static-concatenation BiLSTM, and RAML - across 3-hour and 6-hour horizons, with an ablation study isolating the sentiment branch, regime detection, and adaptive fusion. RAML achieves macro-F1 of 0.5474 (3h) and 0.5513 (6h), with the highest AUC at 3 hours (0.5084), indicating better calibration. Ablation confirms every component is necessary, and replacing adaptive weighting with concatenation causes recall collapse at 6 hours (F1: 0.14). These results establish regime-conditioned adaptive fusion as a necessary design principle for multi-modal financial forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAML框架，根据市场波动状态动态调整情感特征与价格特征的融合权重，在比特币价格预测任务上优于静态融合方法，验证了状态感知融合是多模态金融预测的必要设计原则。
AI.motivation: 传统方法使用静态拼接融合情感与价格特征，忽略了行为金融学中零售情感仅在波动期具有预测力、在平静期充满噪声的规律，因此需要一种根据市场状态动态调整融合权重的方案。
AI.method: 基于滚动24小时波动率将观测划分为稳定与波动两种状态，通过可学习的sigmoid门控机制动态调整情感嵌入相对于价格嵌入的权重，在波动期赋予情感更大权重，在稳定期更依赖价格动态。
AI.result: RAML在3小时和6小时预测窗口上分别达到0.5474和0.5513的macro-F1，3小时AUC为0.5084（最佳校准性能）。消融实验表明所有组件均不可或缺，静态拼接在6小时窗口上F1降至0.14。
AI.conclusion: 状态感知的自适应融合是多模态金融预测的必要设计原则，为融合价格与情感特征提供了行为金融学视角下的有效方案。

title: Balancing Bits and Drops: Stress-Adjusted Water Management for Data Centers
summary: Data centers are critical to today's digital economy, but are also among the largest industrial consumers of freshwater. Beyond the sheer volume of water use, the environmental impact of data center water consumption varies significantly across locations and seasons, depending on local and regional water stress. However, prior research has largely focused on reducing total water use, overlooking that the same unit of water can have drastically different environmental consequences depending on when and where it is consumed. In this paper, we introduce a stress-adjusted water framework that quantifies the true sustainability impact of data center water consumption by incorporating both spatial and temporal water stress. Using the AWARE-US model, we capture county-level monthly variations in water availability and extend this framework to account for the off-site water footprint of electricity generation. Based on this stress-aware accounting, we analyze stress-adjusted water-computing strategies spanning both the software and infrastructure layers. Specifically, we study workload scheduling policies that jointly optimize water and carbon efficiency, evaluate the potential of rainwater harvesting as a supplemental water source, and investigate the feasibility of dry cooling as a water-free alternative to evaporative cooling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出压力调整水框架，结合时空水资源压力，量化数据中心的真实水消耗环境影响，并探讨了工作负载调度、雨水收集和干式冷却等策略。
AI.motivation: 现有研究只关注总用水量，忽略了水消耗的环境影响因地点和季节而异，同一单位水在不同时间地点有迥异的环境后果。
AI.method: 引入AWARE-US模型捕捉县级月度水资源变化，构建压力调整水框架，结合水电离线的水足迹，研究软件（工作负载调度）和基础设施（雨水收集、干式冷却）层面的策略。
AI.result: 提出了压力感知的水资源核算方法，并分析了联合优化水效与碳效的调度策略、雨水收集的潜力以及干式冷却的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 数据中心的可持续性评估需要纳入水资源的时空压力因素，压力调整框架可指导更精准的环保决策。

title: A Hybrid Matheuristic Framework for the Chinese Postman Problem with Load-Dependent Costs
summary: The Chinese Postman Problem with load-dependent costs (CPP-LC) arises in real-world logistics and transportation systems where travel costs depend on vehicle load and energy consumption. In this work, we propose a hybrid optimization framework that integrates metaheuristic search with mathematical programming to efficiently solve CPP-LC. The proposed method combines local search procedures with reduced mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) models to balance exploration and intensification. In addition, we develop an Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) algorithm to enhance scalability on large instances. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently achieves high-quality solutions and outperforms existing approaches in solution quality, while maintaining competitive computational efficiency. These results highlight the effectiveness of hybrid optimization strategies for complex, load-dependent routing problems in practical applications. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/HySonLab/MatCPP

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合优化框架（结合元启发式搜索与数学规划），用于解决负载相关成本的中国邮差问题（CPP-LC），在基准测试中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现实物流系统中，车辆负载会影响能耗和运输成本，但传统中国邮差问题未考虑负载相关成本，导致成本估计不准确。
AI.method: 混合优化框架：将局部搜索与缩减的混合整数线性规划（MILP）模型结合，平衡探索与强化；并开发了蚁群优化（ACO）算法以增强大规模实例的可扩展性。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上，所提框架持续获得高质量解，在解质量上优于现有方法，同时保持有竞争力的计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 混合优化策略对于复杂、负载相关的路径规划问题（如CPP-LC）是有效的，且代码已开源。

title: Codifying the Judge: Scalable Evaluation via Program Distillation
summary: LLM-as-a-judge has become the standard for automated evaluation, but it suffers from high cost, significant latency, and opaque decisions -- limitations that undermine its scalability and reliability. We address these with a simple, efficient alternative: program distillation. Instead of prompting an LLM at the evaluation time, we distill its decision logic into a committee of programs that score candidates directly. These programmatic judges offer transparency, are easily inspected or edited, and eliminate per-sample API costs. Building on this notion, we introduce PAJAMA, a system that synthesizes programs as judges, aggregates their decisions into a joint verdict, and incorporates a fallback mechanism to selectively escalate low-confidence cases to an LLM. Across five datasets and four model families, we show that programmatic judges can match the performance of a 13B-size LLM judge. When using program outputs as routing signals, PAJAMA improves both accuracy and throughput and advances the Pareto frontier. Beyond evaluation, programmatic judges produce cheap and effective reward signals: on RewardBench, a reward model distilled from programs' verdicts outperforms one trained on a proprietary LLM's labels at two orders of magnitude lower API cost.

AI.tldr: 提出程序蒸馏方法，用程序委员会替代大模型作为评判标准，在保持性能的同时大幅降低成本与延迟。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-judge成本高、延迟大、决策不透明，限制了其可扩展性和可靠性。
AI.method: 将LLM的决策逻辑蒸馏为程序委员会（PAJAMA系统），程序直接评分，聚合判决，低置信度时回退到LLM。
AI.result: 在5个数据集和4个模型族上，程序评判性能匹配13B规模的LLM评判；作为奖励信号时，训练出的奖励模型在RewardBench上超越基于专有LLM标签的模型，API成本降低两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 程序式评判是高效、透明、低成本的评估替代方案，在评价和奖励信号领域均有出色表现。

title: Hierarchical Grading in Large Language Models
summary:
We introduce Graded Large Language Models (GLLMs), an algebraic framework that equips the representation space of a transformer with a grading and propagates the induced weighted scalar action through embeddings, self-attention, and the training objective. The construction extends the theory of graded neural networks and graded transformers to autoregressive language models while preserving expressive power, asymptotic computational complexity, and inference cost.
  The governing geometric picture is that of geometric invariant theory. The benefit of a grading is expressed by a Kempf--Ness functional on the grading torus; the grades that improve upon the uniform architecture form an open convex cone whose membership is decided by a Hilbert--Mumford-type criterion pairing a grade direction against two measurable profiles of the target and the data; the optimal grades are the coincidence point of two moment maps, given in closed form; and the ordinary transformer appears as a semistable isotropic point on the boundary of the cone: one member of a larger graded family rather than a distinguished optimum.
  Separately, for level-stratified targets we prove a minimax separation between the graded prior and its absence: over all estimators the risks of the graded and uniform target classes separate throughout an explicit window of sample sizes, by a factor that decays exponentially in the number of levels under geometric stratification. Both profiles are estimable offline, so the optimal grades solve a convex program certified before training begins. Because the grading is absorbed into the learned parameters after training, every GLLM compiles to a standard transformer of identical architecture and inference complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分级大语言模型（GLLMs），通过代数框架为Transformer表示空间赋予分级结构，并证明其在不增加计算复杂度和推理成本的前提下，能显著提升分层目标数据的估计效率。分级优化可通过凸规划在训练前求解，且训练后的模型可编译回标准Transformer架构。
AI.motivation: 标准Transformer对所有特征维度一视同仁，缺乏对数据内在层级结构的利用。作者希望借助几何不变量理论，为语言模型引入一种代数分级结构，使其能更好地捕捉目标与数据中的层次化模式。
AI.method: 构建GLLM代数框架：在Transformer的嵌入层、自注意力机制和训练目标中引入分级结构；通过Kempf-Ness泛函和Hilbert-Mumford准则刻画最优分级；利用矩映射给出最优分级闭式解；通过凸规划实现训练前离线优化。
AI.result: 对于分层目标数据，分级先验与无分级先验之间存在极小极大分离，风险差距随层级数呈指数衰减；最优分级可通过凸规划在训练前求解；训练后的GLLM可无损编译为标准Transformer。
AI.conclusion: 分级结构为Transformer提供了一种理论严谨且实用的增强手段，在不增加任何计算开销的前提下显著提升分层数据上的学习效率。普通Transformer仅是分级族中的一个边界特例，而非最优选择。

title: CHiPS: Character Histograms and Positional Signals for Lightweight Authorship Attribution in Romanian Texts
summary: We propose CHiPS, a lightweight character-level authorship attribution method for Romanian texts. All reported experiments are closed-set: the true author is one of the candidate authors in the training data. CHiPS studies two complementary fingerprints of writing style: CH-SVM, a character-histogram classifier based on one-character marginal distributions, and FFT12-LR, a positional-signal classifier that represents selected characters and punctuation classes as impulse trains (binary indicator sequences over character positions) and extracts Fourier/Welch spectral descriptors. We also report CHiPS-F, a leakage-safe decision-level fusion variant, and an optional top-5 listwise reranker trained only on out-of-fold predictions. The method requires no tokenization, syntactic analysis, pretrained language model, or transformer fine-tuning, and it avoids character $n$-gram features with $n \geq 2$ in the histogram component. On a locked grouped ROST split comprising 400 files from 392 source-text groups, written by 10 authors, with source-text-level evaluation and grouped five-fold model selection, CHiPS-F reaches 0.9310 accuracy and 0.9341 macro-F1. A matched but unrestricted character 2--5-gram TF--IDF SVM comparator reaches 1.0000 accuracy and macro-F1 on the same held-out groups, so the contribution is not a claim of best possible classification accuracy. Instead, the experiments ask how far restricted, transparent character evidence can go under strict leakage control. On ROSTories-cleaned, a secondary ROST-overlapping corpus comprising 1,248 files from 1,240 source-text groups, written by 19 authors, the same protocol gives 0.8919 accuracy and 0.8708 macro-F1 for CHiPS-R.

AI.tldr: CHiPS是一种轻量级的罗马尼亚语作者归属方法，通过字符级特征（直方图+位置信号）实现，在严格泄漏控制下达到约93%准确率，但相比n-gram方法仍有差距。
AI.motivation: 探究在严格泄漏控制下，仅使用受限的、透明的字符级特征（而非复杂模型或n-gram）能达到怎样的作者归属准确率，明确不追求SOTA。
AI.method: 提出CHiPS框架，包含两个互补特征：CH-SVM（单字符直方图分类器）和FFT12-LR（基于傅里叶/韦尔奇谱的字符位置信号分类器）。融合变体CHiPS-F包括决策级融合和top-5重排序器。避免分词、句法分析、预训练模型和n≥2的字符n-gram。
AI.result: 在ROST数据集（400文件，10作者）上CHiPS-F达0.9310准确率，在ROSTories-cleaned（1248文件，19作者）上CHiPS-R达0.8919准确率；而对比的n-gram基线达1.0000准确率。
AI.conclusion: 受限的字符级特征在严格泄漏控制下能达到可观的作者归属性能，但远不及n-gram方法；本工作的贡献在于透明性和可控性，而非追求最高准确率。

title: Flight Envelope Protection for a Hypersonic Glide Vehicle Using Adaptive Safety-Critical Control
summary: This paper presents an adaptive safety-critical control framework for flight envelope protection (FEP) of hypersonic glide vehicles (HGVs) under model uncertainty. The proposed architecture treats input and state constraints through two complementary but distinct mechanisms. At the input end, an adaptive controller with a calibrated closed-loop reference model (CCRM) is designed to accommodate magnitude-limited control inputs and the effects of actuator saturation. Building on this input-constrained adaptive control architecture, flight envelope state constraints are enforced at the state end by an error-based safety filter (EBSF) based on control barrier functions (CBFs). The EBSF modifies the reference command and adapts the admissible safe set online using the measured mismatch between the reference model and the uncertain plant, thereby preserving forward invariance during transient adaptation. Simulation results for the DLR generic hypersonic glide vehicle 2 (GHGV-2) demonstrate stable, high-performance tracking under magnitude-limited control inputs while maintaining flight envelope constraints in the presence of model uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文针对高超声速滑翔飞行器在模型不确定性下的飞行包线保护问题，提出了一种自适应安全关键控制框架，结合自适应控制器与基于控制障碍函数的误差安全滤波器，实现了输入约束和状态约束的双重保障。
AI.motivation: 高超声速滑翔飞行器在存在模型不确定性时，需要同时应对输入饱和约束和飞行包线状态约束，现有方法难以有效兼顾两者。
AI.method: 提出双互补机制：1）输入端采用带校准闭环参考模型的自适应控制器处理幅值受限控制输入和作动器饱和；2）状态端采用基于控制障碍函数的误差安全滤波器，利用参考模型与不确定被控对象间的测量失配在线调整安全集并修正参考指令。
AI.result: 在DLR通用高超声速滑翔飞行器2模型上的仿真结果表明，该方法在模型不确定性下，能在输入受限条件下实现稳定的高性能跟踪，同时维持飞行包线约束。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的框架有效解决了高超声速滑翔飞行器在模型不确定性下的输入与状态双重约束问题，为安全关键自适应控制提供了可行方案。

title: Adaptive Multi-Scale Forecasting and Gate-Localized Conformal Prediction for Multivariate Nonstationary Time Series
summary: We propose ABF-T-GLCP, a model-agnostic framework for forecasting and uncertainty quantification in nonstationary multivariate time series. The central idea is to learn an adaptive predictive state representation for point forecasting and reuse it for conformal calibration. The forecasting module combines horizon-specific temporal experts through a learned gate and refines predictions using sparse predictive transfer across related series. The uncertainty module, Gate-Localized Conformal Prediction (GLCP), uses the learned gate state, together with temporal recency, to select locally relevant calibration residuals, thereby coupling uncertainty calibration to the predictive regimes used by the forecasting model. This shared representation allows point forecasts and prediction intervals to adapt consistently under evolving temporal dynamics while retaining the model-agnostic nature of conformal prediction and yielding approximate local coverage under mild stability conditions. Experiments on a large-scale high-frequency commodity forecasting benchmark show consistent gains in point forecasting accuracy and substantially narrower prediction intervals with empirical coverage close to the nominal level. Additional results indicate that the framework extends beyond the motivating financial application.

AI.tldr: 提出ABF-T-GLCP框架，通过共享自适应预测状态表示，同时提升非平稳多元时间序列的点预测精度和不确定性量化效果，在商品预测基准上取得一致改进。
AI.motivation: 非平稳多元时间序列的预测和不确定性量化面临挑战，现有方法难以在点预测和置信区间之间保持一致的适应性。
AI.method: 学习自适应预测状态表示用于点预测，并将其复用于共形校准；点预测模块使用时域专家门控和稀疏预测转移，不确定性模块GLCP利用门控状态和时域近邻选择局部校准残差。
AI.result: 在商品高频预测基准上，点预测精度一致提升，预测区间显著更窄且经验覆盖接近名义水平。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在保持共形预测模型无关特性的同时，实现了点预测与置信区间在时变动态下的一致适应，且具有跨领域泛化能力。

title: How to Catch a GPU: A Taxonomy of Verification and Enforcement Mechanisms for International AI Agreements
comment: 20 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at International Conference on Large-Scale AI Risks 2026 at KU Leuven
summary:
Several international agreements have been proposed to regulate frontier AI development in response to catastrophic risks. However, there is no structured way to evaluate whether these proposals are enforceable, to assess where they might fail in practice, or to determine which combination of policies is most effective.
  We propose a taxonomy based on the principle that wherever sufficient capacity exists to violate an agreement, it must be under a control regime. This decomposes the problem of ensuring compliance with the agreement into preventing uncontrolled resource acquisition, detecting all capacity outside the control regime, and preventing escape from the control regime. Existing proposals consist of individual policies that address one or more of these sub-problems. Because the compute required for dangerous capabilities may decrease over time, more actors can violate an agreement and enforcement of these policies becomes harder. We define the enforcement breaking point as the FLOP-threshold or equivalent metric at which a policy loses its effectiveness in solving the sub-problem, and introduce a set of factors to assess how and why this breakdown occurs. This reveals which of the three sub-problems any given proposal adequately addresses, and where enforceability breaks down first.
  Applying this taxonomy to existing proposals reveals that more focus is placed on preventing escape from the control regime, while preventing resource acquisition and detecting all capacity outside the control regime receive less attention. By making these gaps explicit, this taxonomy can help researchers and policymakers prioritize future enforcement and verification efforts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于“能力必须受控”原则的分类法，将AI协议可执行性问题分解为三个子问题，并引入“执行断裂点”概念，用于评估现有政策组合的有效性及其失效边界。
AI.motivation: 当前虽有多个国际协议提案试图规范前沿AI发展，但缺乏结构化方法来评估这些提案是否可执行、在何处失效，以及哪些政策组合最有效。
AI.method: 提出分类法：将确保协议合规分解为三个子问题——防止不受控的资源获取、检测控制体系外的所有能力、防止从控制体系中逃脱。引入“执行断裂点”（以FLOP阈值或其他等效指标定义）及一组评估因素，分析政策何时何地失效。
AI.result: 应用该分类法分析现有提案发现：大多数提案更关注防止从控制体系逃脱，而对防止资源获取和检测体系外能力关注不足。
AI.conclusion: 该分类法通过明确现有政策的执行缺口，帮助研究者和政策制定者优先安排未来的执行和验证工作。

title: Route Based Map Matching via a Structured Codebook and Token Sequence Decoding
summary: This study proposes an efficient and computationally light route based map matching method for GPS track data on urban expressway networks. The key idea is to exploit a symbolic structure of named lines and named junctions that link level map matching leaves unused. We represent each candidate route as a sequence of line and junction names, take the set of such sequences as a route codebook, and formulate map matching as scored alignment of a probe trajectory against members of the codebook. Probes become token sequences via a mesh quantizer, a precomputed grid mapping each coordinate to a line or junction token, and the decoder returns a member of the codebook by construction. The codebook is indexed by a DAFSA $\times$ Levenshtein automaton, a fuzzy lookup technique from approximate string matching and speech recognition; the per query decoding cost is orders of magnitude lower than a brute force scan. We evaluate the method on a deformed replica of the Tokyo Metropolitan Expressway topology. The method recovers the exact route at moderate GPS noise and continues to identify the line and junction sequence under heavy noise; a sensitivity analysis maps the mesh resolution operating range. Real probe evaluation, channel model calibration, and a head to head HMM comparison are left to a forthcoming version.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于路线编码本的轻量级地图匹配方法，将GPS轨迹对齐到城市快速路网的符号路线（命名道路和交叉口序列），利用DAFSA×Levenshtein自动机实现模糊匹配，显著降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有地图匹配方法计算量大，且未充分利用道路网络中命名线路和命名交叉口这类符号结构信息。
AI.method: 将每条候选路线表示为线路名和交叉口名序列形成路线编码本；利用网格量化器将GPS探针转换为令牌序列；通过DAFSA×Levenshtein自动机（近似字符串匹配技术）在编码本中模糊查找最优匹配路线。
AI.result: 在东京都市圈高速路网的变形拓扑上测试，中等GPS噪声下可恢复精确路线，强噪声下仍能识别线路和交叉口序列；每查询解码成本比暴力扫描低数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该方法计算轻量、鲁棒性好，适合城市快速路网的GPS地图匹配；后续将进行真实探针评估、信道模型校准及与HMM的对比。

title: SF-AMS: Strategic Forgetting for Structured Memory in LLM Agent
summary: Managing long-context dependencies remains a primary bottleneck in LLM agents, as redundant and irrelevant information can degrade multi-step reasoning. Strategic Forgetting for Agent Memory Systems (SF-AMS) is proposed as a framework for maintaining compact high-utility memory by modeling the long-term importance of memory units. SF-AMS replaces static retrieval and heuristic decay with a utility-driven survival mechanism that updates memory importance from usage redundancy and temporal signals, inducing a hierarchical memory structure that prioritizes stable entity-consistent information while filtering noise. On top of this, Composite Importance Scoring integrates semantic and entity level signals to improve retrieval robustness. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-s show consistent gains over strong state of the art baselines including LightMem MemO and A-Mem. The largest improvement appears in multi-hop reasoning under Qwen2.5-7B where SF-AMS achieves plus 9.65 F1 over the strongest baseline followed by temporal reasoning under GPT-4o-mini plus 6.91 F1 and open-domain tasks plus 6.53 F1 demonstrating strong cross backbone generalization. These results show that modeling memory importance as a dynamic utility signal is critical for reliable long-context reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出SF-AMS框架，通过效用驱动的记忆生存机制替代静态检索和启发式衰减，实现长上下文Agent的高效记忆管理，在多跳推理、时序推理和开放域任务上均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 长上下文依赖是LLM Agent的主要瓶颈，冗余和无关信息会降低多步推理性能，现有静态检索和启发式衰减方法难以有效维护高价值的记忆。
AI.method: 提出SF-AMS框架，包含效用驱动的生存机制（基于使用冗余度和时间信号更新记忆重要性）、层次化记忆结构（优先保留稳定的实体一致性信息）、以及复合重要性评分（融合语义和实体层面信号）来增强检索鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-s上超越LightMem、MemO、A-Mem等基线。Qwen2.5-7B多跳推理F1提升+9.65，GPT-4o-mini时序推理F1提升+6.91，开放域任务F1提升+6.53，展现出强跨骨干网络泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆重要性建模为动态效用信号对于可靠的长上下文推理至关重要。

title: An Integrated Deep Learning and Statistical Framework for Whole-Network Gene--Environment Association with Leaf Vascular Architecture
summary: Leaf veins exhibit remarkable diversity in architecture and patterning, yet existing gene--environment association studies have primarily quantified leaf venation using a small collection of low-dimensional summary traits, thereby discarding most of the structural information contained in the original images. We propose an integrated deep learning and statistical framework. The proposed framework achieves four methodological advances. First, it represents the complete leaf vascular architecture as a whole-network image phenotype. Second, it fine-tunes the deep learning-based Edge Detection with Transformers (EDTER) model to accurately extract whole-network leaf vascular architecture from RGB images by jointly learning local and global contextual features. Third, it constructs a new annotated leaf image database by integrating edge maps generated by DiffusionEdge with the Berkeley Segmentation Database (BSDS500). Fourth, it applies Semiparametric Sparse Canonical Correlation Analysis (SSCCA) to perform variable selection and model associations between repeatedly measured high-dimensional Bivariate image responses and high-dimensional predictors while simultaneously accommodating sparse, zero-inflated data represented by edge maps through a truncated latent Gaussian copula model. Two simulation studies demonstrate the performance of the proposed framework under increasing levels of complexity. Application to a real \emph{Populus} dataset identifies three significant gene--geography interactions associated with leaf vascular architecture, providing new biological insights and establishing a broadly applicable methodological framework for high-dimensional complex image phenotypes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个整合深度学习和统计学的框架，利用Edge Detection with Transformers (EDTER)模型从RGB图像中完整提取叶脉网络，并通过Semiparametric Sparse Canonical Correlation Analysis (SSCCA)进行高维图像表型与基因-环境关联分析，在杨树数据集中识别出三个显著的基因-地理交互作用。
AI.motivation: 现有的基因-环境关联研究仅使用少量低维摘要特征来量化叶脉，丢弃了原始图像中大部分结构信息，迫切需要一种能够保留完整叶片脉管架构信息的方法。
AI.method: 1) 将完整叶脉网络作为全网络图像表型；2) 微调EDTER模型，联合学习局部和全局上下文特征，从RGB图像中精确提取叶脉网络；3) 整合DiffusionEdge边缘图与BSDS500构建新标注数据集；4) 应用SSCCA进行变量选择和模型关联，通过截断潜高斯copula模型处理高维二元图像响应中的稀疏、零膨胀数据。
AI.result: 两个模拟实验验证了框架在不同复杂度下的性能。在真实杨树数据集中，识别出三个与叶脉结构相关的显著基因-地理交互作用。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为高维复杂图像表型提供了广泛适用的分析方法，并揭示了叶脉结构的新生物学见解。

title: Simple Language Normalization Wins: Cross-Lingual Speaker Verification for the TidyVoice 2026 Challenge
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures (submitted to the TidyVoice challenge colocated with Interspeech2026)
summary: Cross-lingual mismatch remains a key source of overall degradation in modern speaker verification. The TidyVoice2026 Challenge targets this setting with text-independent verification, comprising 3,666 training and 808 development speakers in 40 languages and 2,200 evaluation speakers in 38 unseen languages, without language labels at test time. Starting from the official SimAM-ResNet34 baseline pretrained on VoxBlink2 and VoxCeleb2 and fine-tuned on TidyVoice, we revisit Nuisance Attribute Projection (NAP) as a simple language-normalization step in the embedding space. We estimate a compact language subspace from cross-language same-speaker differences and project embeddings onto its orthogonal complement before cosine scoring with Adaptive Symmetric score normalization. This reduces development EER from 2.97\% with cosine and 2.70\% with AS-Norm to 2.18\% and yields a Codabench evaluation score of 8.40, showing that simple back-end language normalization can rival more complex systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用 nuisance attribute projection (NAP) 进行语言归一化，在跨语言说话人验证中，将开发集 EER 从 2.97% 降至 2.18%，在 TidyVoice2026 挑战赛中获得 8.40 的评估分数。
AI.motivation: 跨语言不匹配是说话人验证性能下降的主要原因，现有系统在无语言标签的跨语言场景下表现不佳。
AI.method: 在 SimAM-ResNet34 基线模型基础上，使用 NAP 从跨语言同说话人差异中估计紧凑的语言子空间，将嵌入投影到其正交补空间，再结合 Adaptive Symmetric score normalization 进行余弦评分。
AI.result: 开发集 EER 从余弦的 2.97% 和 AS-Norm 的 2.70% 降至 2.18%，Codabench 评估分数为 8.40。
AI.conclusion: 简单的后端语言归一化方法（NAP）能够媲美更复杂的系统，有效缓解跨语言说话人验证中的语言不匹配问题。

title: Bound-Optimized Task Choice for Path Integral Control
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, to be published in CDC 2026
summary: Path Integral (PI) control is a powerful sampling-based method for stochastic optimal control, but it requires a restrictive coupling between the noise covariance and the control cost matrix that is rarely satisfied in practice, particularly in aerospace and cyber-physical systems. We propose Bound-Optimized Task Choice (BOTC), a framework that optimizes over the entire space of valid approximations, termed tasks, satisfying the PI coupling constraint. We prove that every task provides an upper bound on the true cost-to-go and that BOTC minimizes this bound. We derive a change-of-measure formulation that enables evaluation of all candidate tasks from a single set of Monte Carlo samples, eliminating the need to resample for each candidate task. The resulting optimization is parameterized by a positive semi-definite matrix. Furthermore, we propose a novel Normal-Inverse-Wishart distribution-based importance sampling scheme to improve global optimization. We validate BOTC on a finite-horizon stochastic linear-quadratic regulator problem, demonstrating that it tracks the constrained optimum.

AI.tldr: 提出BOTC框架，通过在满足PI耦合约束的近似任务空间中优化，解决了Path Integral控制中噪声协方差与控制成本矩阵必须严格耦合的限制。该框架为每个任务提供真实代价的上界，并利用单次蒙特卡洛采样评估所有候选任务，避免重复采样。
AI.motivation: Path Integral控制虽强大，但其要求噪声协方差与控制成本矩阵之间存在严格耦合条件，这在航空航天和物理信息系统等实际应用中很少满足，限制了PI方法的实用性。
AI.method: 提出BOTC框架，在满足PI耦合约束的整个近似任务空间中进行优化；推导测度变换公式，实现单一蒙特卡洛样本集评估所有候选任务；提出基于Normal-Inverse-Wishart分布的重要性采样方案以改进全局优化。
AI.result: 在有限时域随机线性二次型调节器问题上验证了BOTC的有效性，表明该方法能够追踪约束最优解。
AI.conclusion: BOTC通过放宽PI控制的严格耦合约束，扩展了其适用范围，同时保证提供真实代价的严格上界，且计算效率高。

title: Beyond ICA: Identifiability by Symmetry Breaking
summary: We prove the identifiability of deep generative models (DGMs) with piecewise-affine (PWA) decoders and Gaussian mixture model (GMM) priors, in a purely unsupervised setting. We introduce three algebraic contrast principles for symmetry breaking: domain contrast, which trivializes the mixture symmetry group; mechanism contrast, which ensures every decoder branch is witnessed by a unique boundary; and interaction contrast, which forbids parameter conspiracies between latent components and decoder branches. Together they exploit the interplay between the discrete combinatorics of the PWA map and the continuous symmetry structure of the latent GMM. Continuity is replaced by algebraic symmetry conditions; injectivity is decoupled from structural identification and required only for pointwise inversion. Our results form a hierarchy: from law identifiability (LID; latent distribution up to a global affine map) through map identifiability (MID; decoder up to the same map) to posterior and pointwise identifiability. The ICA-form ambiguity emerges under conditions on diagonal component covariances. Assumptions are only on the data-generating process, not on learning methods, except for the interaction contrast. To our knowledge this is the first to make algebraic symmetry-breaking the engine of nonlinear identifiability, the first to admit discontinuous decoders, and the first to handle fully non-injective decoders, where every observation admits multiple latent codes.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了具有分段仿射解码器和高斯混合模型先验的深度生成模型在纯无监督设置下的可辨识性，通过三种代数对比原理打破对称性，建立了从分布到映射再到后验的可辨识层级。
AI.motivation: 现有的非线性可辨识性工作大多依赖连续性、单射性或特定学习算法，缺乏处理非连续、非单射解码器的通用理论框架。本文旨在用纯代数对称性破缺方法填补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出三种代数对比原理：领域对比（打破混合对称性）、机制对比（确保每个解码分支由唯一边界见证）、交互对比（禁止潜变量与解码分支间的参数共谋）；利用PWA映射的离散组合结构与潜GMM连续对称性之间的相互作用。
AI.result: 建立了可辨识性层级：定律可辨识（LID）→ 映射可辨识（MID）→ 后验与逐点可辨识；ICA形式的歧义在分量协方差对角化条件下出现；证明了方法对非连续和非单射解码器的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次将代数对称性破缺作为非线性可辨识的核心机制，首次处理非连续解码器，首次处理完全非单射解码器（每个观测对应多个潜在编码），且假设仅针对数据生成过程而非学习方法。

title: AI-Assisted Causal Inference and Mediation Analyses of Environmental and Psychosocial Determinants of Subjective Cognitive Difficulties in the All of Us Research Program
summary: Short-term environmental exposures have been linked to cognitive and behavioral outcomes, although many reported associations may reflect broader geographic and contextual differences. Using longitudinal data from the All of Us Research Program (2018--2024), we linked daily weather and air-pollution exposures to repeated attention-related and subjective cognitive outcomes. Associations were evaluated using pooled, fixed-effects, lagged, and event-study analyses. Additional machine-learning analyses were conducted to explore potential heterogeneity and latent psychosocial structure. Replication analyses were performed using the 2024 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS). Several environmental exposure measures showed small associations with cognitive outcomes in pooled analyses, but most attenuated substantially after accounting for within-location temporal variation. Mediation, sensitivity, and machine-learning analyses yielded similar conclusions. In contrast, mental-health burden, loneliness, and social functioning were consistently associated with subjective cognitive difficulty and exhibited substantially larger effect sizes than environmental exposures. Similar patterns were observed in BRFSS. Exploratory AI-assisted analyses yielded findings broadly consistent with the primary longitudinal analyses. These findings suggest that short-term environmental perturbations may have limited associations with cognitive outcomes after accounting for within-location variation, whereas psychosocial factors appear to be more consistently associated with subjective cognitive burden.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用All of Us研究计划和BRFSS数据，发现短期环境暴露（天气、空气污染）与认知功能的关联在控制地理和时间变异后大幅减弱，而心理社会因素（心理健康、孤独感、社会功能）与认知困难的关联更强且更稳健。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明短期环境暴露与认知行为结果相关，但许多关联可能反映了更广泛的地理和情境差异，而非因果效应。亟需更严谨的方法来区分真实环境效应与混杂因素。
AI.method: 采用纵向数据（All of Us, 2018-2024），将每日天气和空气污染暴露与重复测量的注意力和主观认知结果关联。使用合并分析、固定效应、滞后分析和事件研究等多种方法，辅以机器学习探索异质性和潜在心理社会结构，并在BRFSS（2024）中进行了复制验证。
AI.result: 合并分析中环境暴露与认知结果有微弱关联，但控制地点内时间变异后多数关联大幅减弱。中介、敏感性和机器学习分析得出相似结论。相反，心理健康负担、孤独感和社会功能与主观认知困难持续相关，效应量远大于环境暴露。BRFSS复制分析结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 短期环境扰动对认知结果的关联有限，控制地点内变异后关联消失；心理社会因素与主观认知负担的关联更为一致且效应更强。

title: Learning to Optimize at Scale: A Benders Decomposition-TransfORmers Framework for Stochastic Combinatorial Optimization
summary: We propose a learning-augmented Benders decomposition framework to solve large-scale two-stage stochastic mixed-integer programs. We focus on the two-stage stochastic capacitated lot-sizing problem (TSSCLSP) under demand uncertainty. Our method accelerates the convergence of the decomposition by using a pre-trained TransfORmer model to rapidly generate high-quality approximate solutions for the scenario subproblems. This hybrid strategy uses the TransfORmer predictions to generate strong optimality and feasibility cuts, effectively guiding the Benders master problem. Our framework includes a novel expandable generation mechanism, allowing a model trained on a fixed horizon to solve instances of arbitrary length. For the test set considered, our method solves instances up to T = 270, a scale previously intractable for this approach, while maintaining zero infeasibility in the generated subproblem solutions. This demonstrates the potential of TransfORmers as powerful surrogate solvers embedded within classical decomposition algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种学习增强的Benders分解框架，利用预训练Transformer模型为两阶段随机带容量约束批量问题（TSSCLSP）快速生成高质量近似解，从而加速Benders分解收敛。该框架包含可扩展生成机制，使固定视界训练的模型能求解任意长度的实例。在测试集上成功求解T=270的实例，且子问题解零不可行。
AI.motivation: 大规模两阶段随机混合整数规划问题求解困难，传统Benders分解方法收敛缓慢，难以处理长视界实例。
AI.method: 提出学习增强的Benders分解框架：使用预训练Transformer模型快速生成场景子问题的高质量近似解；利用这些预测生成强最优性割和可行性割来引导Benders主问题；设计可扩展生成机制，使固定视界训练的模型能处理任意长度实例。
AI.result: 在测试集上成功求解T=270的实例，达到此前该方法无法处理的规模，且子问题解零不可行。
AI.conclusion: Transformer作为强大的替代求解器嵌入经典分解算法具有巨大潜力，能够显著扩展Benders分解的求解规模。

title: Synthetic Scenario Generation for Evaluation of Industry 4.0 Agents
summary: Industrial agent benchmarks require realistic evaluation scenarios that integrate telemetry, failure modes, maintenance records, and domain standards. However, existing benchmarks such as AssetOpsBench rely on manually authored scenarios and cover a limited set of asset classes. We extend AssetOpsBench with a Smart Grid Transformer asset class and four IEC-grounded diagnostic tools for health-index prediction, dissolved-gas analysis, winding-temperature assessment, and load-profile assessment. We further introduce ScenarioGeneratorAgent, a pipeline for synthetic industrial-agent scenario generation. The pipeline constructs evidence-grounded asset profiles, allocates coverage-aware scenario budgets across operational domains, and generates candidates through a hybrid validation-and-repair loop that enforces schema validity, tool reachability, physical plausibility, standards alignment, and deduplication. To improve scalability, we apply two-level caching, parallel focus-group generation, thread-pool offloading, batched LLM calls, and early rejection filtering. On Smart Grid Transformer scenario generation, these optimizations reduce end-to-end runtime by $8\times$ for 50 scenarios while preserving quality, achieving a composite quality score of $74.2 \pm 1.9$ compared with $73.8 \pm 3.0$ for the unoptimized baseline. These results show that standards-grounded synthetic scenario generation can efficiently expand industrial-agent benchmarks without sacrificing scenario quality.

AI.tldr: 本文针对工业Agent基准测试场景不足的问题，提出ScenarioGeneratorAgent流程，通过合成数据生成方式扩展了AssetOpsBench基准，新增智能电网变压器资产类和四个IEC诊断工具，并采用多种优化使场景生成速度提升8倍，同时保持场景质量。
AI.motivation: 现有工业Agent基准测试（如AssetOpsBench）依赖手动编写场景，覆盖资产类别有限，难以满足真实工业评估需求，因此需要可扩展的自动化场景生成方法。
AI.method: 提出ScenarioGeneratorAgent管道，包含证据驱动的资产画像构建、覆盖感知的场景预算分配、混合验证与修复循环（确保模式有效性、工具可达性、物理合理性、标准对齐和去重），并采用两级缓存、并行焦点组生成、线程池卸载、批量LLM调用和早期拒绝过滤等优化策略。
AI.result: 在智能电网变压器场景生成中，优化后端到端运行时间减少8倍（50个场景），复合质量分数为74.2±1.9，与未优化基线（73.8±3.0）相当。
AI.conclusion: 基于标准约束的合成场景生成方法能够高效扩展工业Agent基准测试，在不牺牲场景质量的前提下大幅提升可扩展性。

title: Beyond Shapley: An Influence-Based Data Auditing Pipeline for LLM Alignment and Evaluation
summary: The alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly bottlenecked by data quality. As datasets scale, massive preference and instruction-tuning corpora inevitably accumulate hidden structural contradictions, safety risks, and systemic human annotation errors. Standard dataset auditing methods, such as semantic deduplication or LLM-as-a-judge, struggle to capture the actual predictive impact of individual records and often miss deep functional rule clashes. To address this, we introduce a scalable, inference-only data valuation pipeline that approximates the Shapley value without iterative model retraining. By mapping semantic k-NN neighborhoods into a directed graph, our framework evaluates data utility directly through a reference LLM's probability distribution using zero-shot and one-shot conditional log-likelihood shifts. Our pipeline then translates these predictive influence scores into localized advantage metrics to isolate gradient-conflicting records. We demonstrate the pipeline's efficacy in sanitizing two heavily vetted alignment datasets. First, applying our pipeline to the HelpSteer2 dataset reduced the manual audit search space by 99.1%, successfully uncovering falsely-labeled records across diverse failure modes. Second, applying our automated audit strategy to Anthropic's HH-RLHF training and evaluation splits identified thousands of hidden safety and factual preference inversions. Crucially, by extending this audit to the evaluation split, we expose severe vulnerabilities in current benchmark integrity: highly capable models frequently predict the safer or more helpful response, only to be penalized by objectively flawed human ground-truth labels. Overall, our work provides a mathematically grounded, highly efficient diagnostic tool to uncover human label failures, sanitize evaluation benchmarks, and ensure the integrity of LLM alignment data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Shapley值近似的高效数据估值流水线，无需迭代重训练，通过语义k-NN有向图映射和条件对数似然变化评估数据效用，成功在HelpSteer2和HH-RLHF数据集中识别出大量标注错误和安全偏好反转，显著减少了人工审核范围。
AI.motivation: 大规模LLM对齐数据中存在的隐藏结构矛盾、安全风险和系统性标注错误，现有审计方法（如语义去重、LLM-as-a-judge）难以捕捉单个样本的实际预测影响，无法识别深层功能规则冲突。
AI.method: 构建仅需推理的数据估值流水线：1) 通过语义k-NN邻域映射为有向图；2) 利用零样本和单样本条件对数似然变化评估数据效用；3) 将预测影响分数转化为局部优势指标，隔离梯度冲突记录。
AI.result: 在HelpSteer2上将人工审计搜索空间减少99.1%，成功发现错误标注记录；在HH-RLHF训练和评估集中发现数千隐藏安全偏好反转；揭示评估基准中人类标注存在客观缺陷，导致高能力模型被错误惩罚。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种数学基础扎实、高效的诊断工具，能够揭露人类标注错误、清理评估基准，确保LLM对齐数据的完整性。

title: Not All LLM Reasoning is Visible in the Chain-of-Thought
summary: A key question for AI safety is whether a language model expresses all of its reasoning in its output tokens. We demonstrate a concrete failure mode where frontier models exhibit invisible reasoning by leveraging semantically irrelevant filler tokens to improve performance on synthetic reasoning tasks. We evaluate 13 frontier language models across three tasks and find that many models benefit significantly from filler tokens, with accuracy improvements of up to 13 percentage points. The benefit depends on which tokens are used and differs across models. We further show that filler tokens enable Claude Opus 4.5 to satisfy a hidden modular arithmetic constraint without sacrificing accuracy on its primary task, demonstrating that invisible reasoning can serve objectives entirely invisible to CoT monitoring. Reinforcement learning gives Qwen3-235B strong preferences over filler token content, but neither RL nor supervised fine-tuning produces a filler token benefit that persists at test time. Our results indicate that frontier models already perform consequential computation with no interpretable trace in their output tokens.

AI.tldr: 前沿语言模型会利用语义无关的填充词（filler tokens）进行不可见推理，在合成推理任务上准确率提升最高达13个百分点，且这种推理对思维链监控完全不可见，表明模型已在输出词元之外进行有意义的计算。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型是否仅在输出的显式词元中进行推理，检验是否存在"不可见推理"的安全隐患。
AI.method: 在13个前沿语言模型上设置三项合成推理任务，引入语义无关的填充词，观察模型性能变化；进一步设计隐藏模运算约束任务，测试不可见推理能否实现隐藏目标；并通过强化学习和监督微调实验分析其可塑性。
AI.result: 多个模型从填充词中获益显著（最高提升13个百分点）；Claude Opus 4.5能利用填充词满足隐藏约束而不影响主要任务性能；Qwen3-235B通过RL对填充词内容产生强烈偏好，但两种训练方式下填充词的益处均无法在测试时持久保留。
AI.conclusion: 前沿模型已在输出词元之外执行有意义的计算，对AI安全监控（如思维链监控）构成实质性挑战，需要新的可解释性方法。

title: Learning Input-Constrained Funnel Controllers from State Trajectory Data
summary: Designing feedback controllers that satisfy predefined performance specifications while enforcing hard input constraints is a challenging task. Our work is motivated by the idea that state trajectory data, e.g., obtained from an expert controller, often implicitly encode feasible performance attributes and input limitations. We propose an optimization-based framework that uses state trajectory data to jointly learn: (i) a performance funnel that mimics the transient and steady-state behavior encoded within the observed trajectories, and (ii) a feedback controller that enforces the learned performance specifications under hard input constraints. Unlike imitation learning methods, the proposed approach does not rely on control input data and does not reconstruct an expert policy. Instead, it synthesizes a prescribed performance controller by combining nominal model compensation with a learned state-dependent feedback gain. The resulting synthesis problem is nonconvex, for which we develop a feasibility-driven active-set synthesis procedure. Finally, we establish two complementary guarantees: a semi-global conservative actuator-authority-based certificate for prescribed performance and input satisfaction, and a local data-driven certificate ensuring these properties near sufficiently dense demonstrated trajectories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于优化框架的方法，利用状态轨迹数据联合学习性能漏斗和反馈控制器，在满足硬输入约束的同时模仿专家轨迹的瞬态和稳态行为，并提供了半全局保守性和局部数据驱动性两种保证。
AI.motivation: 设计同时满足预设性能规范和硬输入约束的反馈控制器具有挑战性，而专家控制器的状态轨迹数据往往隐式编码了可行的性能属性和输入限制，因此希望利用这些数据来简化控制器设计。
AI.method: 提出一种优化框架，联合学习两个目标：(i) 从观测轨迹中学习模仿瞬态和稳态行为的性能漏斗；(ii) 合成在硬输入约束下满足学习到的性能规范的反馈控制器。通过结合标称模型补偿和学习的状态依赖反馈增益来合成预定性能控制器，并开发了可行性驱动的主动集合成过程来解决非凸问题。
AI.result: 建立了两种互补性保证：半全局保守的基于执行器权限的预定性能与输入满足性证书，以及局部数据驱动的证书确保在足够稠密的演示轨迹附近保持这些性质。
AI.conclusion: 该方法与模仿学习不同，不依赖控制输入数据或重建专家策略，而是直接从状态轨迹合成控制器，兼具保守性和数据驱动的理论保证。

title: FedSLIM: Privacy-Preserving Federated MDL-Based Descriptive Pattern Mining Across Data Silos
summary: Federated learning has achieved considerable success for predictive modelling, yet federated descriptive analytics remains largely unexplored. Existing federated pattern mining approaches are predominantly support-based and do not optimise a principled global objective such as Minimum Description Length (MDL). We introduce FedSLIM, the first federated MDL-based framework for descriptive pattern mining. Building on the SLIM principle, FedSLIM enables collaborative optimisation of compact pattern models across distributed databases without sharing raw transactions. We propose two complementary variants that balance privacy, communication, and optimisation fidelity under different deployment assumptions. To evaluate federated MDL mining, we introduce fidelity and discovery-oriented metrics that quantify agreement with a centralised baseline and assess recovery of globally informative patterns. Experiments on multiple real-world datasets under IID and non-IID partitioning show that both variants preserve high-quality compression structure while requiring orders of magnitude less search than the centralised baseline.
