We further reveal a local-global discovery gap in distributed MDL mining, where globally compressive patterns may be undiscoverable through isolated local optimisation. Both variants recover globally informative patterns absent from all standalone local models, demonstrating the benefits of federated optimisation beyond independent local mining. These results establish federated MDL mining as a practical foundation for privacy-preserving descriptive analytics across distributed data silos.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedSLIM，首个基于MDL原则的联邦描述性模式挖掘框架，能够在分布式数据库间协作优化紧凑模式模型而不共享原始数据。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习在预测建模中取得了成功，但联邦描述性分析尚未充分探索。现有联邦模式挖掘方法主要基于支持度，缺乏像MDL这样的全局优化目标。
AI.method: 基于SLIM原则，提出FedSLIM框架，包含两个变体以平衡隐私、通信和优化保真度。引入保真度和发现导向的评估指标，衡量与集中式基线的一致性及全局模式的恢复能力。
AI.result: 在IID和非IID划分的多真实数据集上，两个变体均保留了高质量的压缩结构，搜索量比集中式基线少数个数量级。两者都能恢复所有局部模型无法发现的全局信息模式。
AI.conclusion: FedSLIM证明了联邦MDL挖掘作为隐私保护描述性分析的实用基础，揭示了分布式MDL挖掘中的局部-全局发现差距，并展示了联邦优化超越独立局部挖掘的优势。

title: You Talkin to Me?: A Network Analysis of Gendered Speaker-Addressee Patterns in Film Screenplays
summary: Objective: This paper investigates the gendered structure of speaker addressee relationships in film dialogue, asking not merely who speaks, but who is spoken to and how conversational dynamics unfold across gender lines. Methods: Using a manually annotated dataset of 4,600 directed dialogue events from 38 film screenplays, we apply network analysis, chi squared tests, paired statistical comparisons, and participation shift analysis across three studies. Key Findings: Male characters dominate as both speakers and addressees corpus wide, even in scenes with more women; cross gender dialogue is directionally symmetric on average but clustered at the film level; and same gender turns diffuse conversational attention while cross gender turns produce tighter dyadic reciprocation. Conclusion: Gender bias in film dialogue operates through the architecture of conversation itself, through exclusion from interaction and structural positioning as addressees, rather than through speaking time or within conversation directional imbalance alone.

AI.tldr: 本文分析电影对话中的性别结构，发现男性主导说话者和受话者角色，性别偏见体现在对话架构而非单纯的发言时间或方向不平衡上。
AI.motivation: 探究电影对话中不仅是谁在说话，更是谁被倾听、对话动态如何沿性别线分布，揭示对话架构中的性别偏见。
AI.method: 基于38部电影剧本中4600个对话事件的手动标注数据集，运用网络分析、卡方检验、配对统计比较和参与转移分析进行三项研究。
AI.result: 男性角色在说话者和受话者上均占主导；跨性别对话平均方向对称但在电影层面聚集；同性别轮次分散对话注意力，跨性别轮次产生更紧密的二元对答。
AI.conclusion: 电影对话中的性别偏见通过会话架构本身运作——通过排斥交互和作为受话者的结构性定位，而非仅靠说话时间或对话内方向不平衡。

title: Mirror Descent Methods for Quasar Convex Optimization Problems With Non-Smooth Inequality Constraints
summary: In this paper, we consider constraint optimization problems subject to non-smooth convex functional (inequality-type) constraints, wherein the objective function is non-smooth and quasar convex. We propose and analyze two groups of algorithms, each consisting of a standard version and a modified variant, that operate by switching between two types of iteration points: productive and non-productive. Within each group, we develop distinct mirror descent-type algorithms for both deterministic and stochastic settings, and we establish their convergence rates.

AI.tldr: 本文针对非光滑拟凸目标函数与非光滑凸约束的优化问题，提出了两组具有“生产性/非生产性”迭代点切换策略的镜面下降算法，涵盖确定性和随机两种设置，并分析了收敛速率。
AI.motivation: 现有非光滑约束优化算法大多假设目标函数为凸函数，而拟凸函数更具一般性。作者希望设计能处理拟凸目标函数且满足非光滑凸约束的高效算法。
AI.method: 提出两类算法（标准版与改进版），核心创新在于迭代过程中区分“生产性”与“非生产性”两种迭代点，据此切换更新策略；分别设计了确定性和随机两种设置下的镜面下降型算法。
AI.result: 建立了所提出算法在确定性和随机两种场景下的收敛速率理论保证。
AI.conclusion: 所提算法有效拓展了非光滑约束优化问题的方法体系，为拟凸目标函数的优化提供了可证明收敛的求解方案。

title: Loss-Aware Feature-Map Pruning in Convolutional Neural Networks Using Multi-Armed Bandits
summary: Convolutional neural networks often contain redundant feature maps that increase storage and inference cost. This paper presents a loss-aware feature-map pruning framework using multi-armed bandits. Feature-map pruning is structured because it removes complete convolutional output channels and their producing filters rather than isolated scalar weights. Each candidate feature map is treated as an arm. At each play time, one map is temporarily masked and evaluated on a sampled mini-batch; the map is then restored and the observed loss change is converted into a safe-removal reward. After a fixed play budget, candidate maps are ranked by learned scores and the top-k maps are permanently removed with their filters, biases and corresponding next-layer input-channel kernels. The study evaluates UCB1 and Thompson Sampling, compares them with direct/oracle-style evaluation on LeNet/MNIST, and extends the evaluation to MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, SVHN, CUB-200-2011 and Oxford Flowers 102. Results show that UCB1 and Thompson Sampling preserve accuracy close to unpruned models while removing feature maps and reducing convolutional computation. Friedman and Nemenyi tests show that UCB1 obtains the highest mean rank, followed by Thompson Sampling; both significantly outperform greedy and magnitude-based pruning while remaining statistically comparable to the original unpruned model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于多臂老虎机的损失感知特征图剪枝框架，将每个特征图视为臂，通过临时遮掩评估损失变化并计算安全移除奖励，在固定预算后永久移除top-k特征图及相关参数。实验表明UCB1和Thompson Sampling在保持精度的同时有效减少计算量，UCB1平均秩最高。
AI.motivation: 卷积神经网络中存在冗余特征图，增加了存储和推理成本。现有剪枝方法多为非结构化剪枝或缺乏对剪枝后损失的感知。
AI.method: 将每个候选特征图视为多臂老虎机中的一个臂，每次迭代中临时遮掩一个特征图并在小批量数据上评估损失变化，将损失变化转换为安全移除奖励。经过固定预算后，根据学习到的分数对特征图排序，永久移除top-k特征图及其滤波器、偏置和对应的下一层输入通道核。
AI.result: 在LeNet/MNIST、CIFAR-10/100、SVHN、CUB-200-2011、Oxford Flowers 102等数据集上，UCB1和Thompson Sampling在移除特征图并减少卷积计算的同时保持了接近未剪枝模型的精度。Friedman和Nemenyi检验显示UCB1平均秩最高，优于贪心和基于幅度的剪枝方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于多臂老虎机的结构化特征图剪枝框架能有效识别冗余特征图，在保持模型精度的同时显著降低计算成本，UCB1表现最优。

title: DomainPilot: Domain-Level Loss-Guided Two-Stage Data Mixture Optimization for Efficient Language Model Fine-Tuning
summary:
The training efficacy of large language models (LLMs) is fundamentally constrained by the quality and composition of training data. Existing dynamic data scheduling methods face critical limitations in industrial-scale pretraining and supervised fine-tuning (SFT): data selection incurs prohibitive O(N) costs on terabyte-scale corpora, mixture optimization schemes introduce severe I/O bottlenecks or require training auxiliary reference models, and sample-level reweighting strategies rely on loss signals that conflate noise, difficulty, and novelty.
  We present DomainPilot, a domain-level loss-guided two-stage data mixture optimization framework. DomainPilot introduces token-level domain loss monitoring to capture per-domain learning dynamics during training without halting the data pipeline. Building on these signals, we propose a Scaling Law guided coarse optimization stage that fits domain-specific convergence curves and derives a principled prior for mixture adjustment. A subsequent Mixing Law guided fine optimization stage refines the mixture by modeling cross-domain interaction effects through controlled sweep experiments. The entire mechanism is realized via a patch-based architecture that injects domain-aware loss computation into existing training frameworks (e.g., MindSpeed/Megatron-LM) with only ~30 lines of framework-specific adapter code.
  We validate DomainPilot on the Qwen3-1.7B model during SFT. Compared to the original data mixture, our optimized mixture achieves improvements of +2% on MMLU-Redux, +1.8% on AIME24, +3.8% on LiveCodeBench v5, and +3.6% on BFCL v3, without increasing total data volume or training cost. These results demonstrate that domain-level training signals provide an effective, lightweight alternative to expensive data selection or auxiliary model training for mixture optimization.

AI.tldr: DomainPilot 提出了一种基于领域级别损失引导的两阶段数据混合优化框架，通过监测每个领域的训练动态，使用缩放定律（Scaling Law）和混合定律（Mixing Law）分别进行粗优化和细优化，在 Qwen3-1.7B 模型的 SFT 阶段取得了多个基准上的显著提升，且无需增加总数据量或训练成本。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型数据调度方法存在根本性局限：数据选择在 TB 级语料上产生高昂的 O(N) 成本；混合优化方案引入严重的 I/O 瓶颈或需要训练辅助参考模型；样本级重加权策略依赖的损失信号混淆了噪声、难度和新颖性。亟需一种轻量级、高效的混合优化方法。
AI.method: DomainPilot 包含两阶段优化：1）粗优化阶段（Scaling Law guided）：通过 Token 级别的领域损失监控捕获每个领域的学习动态，拟合领域特定的收敛曲线，推导出混合比例的先验调整原则；2）细优化阶段（Mixing Law guided）：通过受控扫掠实验建模领域间交互效应，进一步优化混合比例。整体架构基于补丁（patch）方式注入现有训练框架（如 MindSpeed/Megatron-LM），仅需约 30 行适配代码。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-1.7B 模型的 SFT 阶段验证：与原始数据混合相比，优化后的混合在 MMLU-Redux 上提升 +2%，AIME24 提升 +1.8%，LiveCodeBench v5 提升 +3.8%，BFCL v3 提升 +3.6%，且未增加总数据量或训练成本。
AI.conclusion: 领域级别的训练信号为数据混合优化提供了一种有效且轻量级的替代方案，避免了昂贵的数据选择或辅助模型训练，展现出在工业级大规模预训练和 SFT 场景下的实用价值。

title: Toward Automated Detection of Documentation Inconsistencies in Electronic Health Records
summary:
Objective: To characterize the kinds of internal documentation inconsistencies a general-domain large language model (LLM) can surface from real-world discharge summaries, and to identify recurring failure modes that limit reliability at scale.
  Materials and Methods: We applied a two-stage LLM pipeline---open-ended candidate identification (Gemini 2.5 Pro) followed by context-grounded verification (Gemini 2.5 Flash)---to 3,000 randomly sampled MIMIC-IV-Note discharge summaries. A subset of the pipeline output was then reviewed manually by clinical experts.
  Results: Our pipeline surfaced 3,460 candidate inconsistencies, affecting 69.7% of admissions. Representative examples spanned demographics, allergies, procedures, diagnoses, laboratory, medications, and care-planning domains, with direct implications for clinical reasoning or patient safety. Expert review also revealed recurring failure modes that arise when verification requires temporal reasoning, evolving-diagnosis context, or knowledge of outpatient-prescribing conventions the model does not natively possess.
  Discussion: Detection is highly context-dependent: many flagged pairs require anchoring each statement to its source section and clinical domain, then assessing whether the conflict reflects a true contradiction or missing context. We propose a graded ontology spanning strict contradiction and ambiguity, with a schema characterizing each flagged case by category, section, domain, and inconsistency axis.
  Conclusion: This formative study establishes a methodological foundation and conceptual framework to guide subsequent validated, large-scale EHR-inconsistency analysis.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用两阶段LLM流水线（Gemini 2.5 Pro候选识别 + Gemini 2.5 Flash上下文验证）对3,000份MIMIC-IV-Note出院小结进行分析，发现69.7%的入院记录存在内部文档不一致（共3,460个候选），并识别出时间推理、诊断演进、门诊处方知识等关键失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对通用大语言模型在真实出院小结中发现内部文档不一致能力及其可靠性局限性的系统性刻画，需要建立方法学基础和概念框架以指导后续大规模EHR不一致性分析。
AI.method: 采用两阶段LLM流水线：第一阶段使用Gemini 2.5 Pro进行开放式候选不一致识别，第二阶段使用Gemini 2.5 Flash进行基于上下文的验证。对3,000份随机抽样的MIMIC-IV-Note出院小结进行处理，随后由临床专家对输出子集进行人工审核。
AI.result: 流水线发现3,460个候选不一致，影响69.7%的入院记录。涵盖人口统计学、过敏史、手术、诊断、实验室检查、用药和护理计划等领域。专家审核揭示了时间推理、诊断演进上下文、门诊处方知识等失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为大规模EHR不一致性分析建立了方法学基础和概念框架，提出了从严格矛盾到歧义的分级本体论，以及按类别、章节、领域和不一致性轴分类的架构。

title: Bridging Reinforcement Learning and Optimal Control via Feasible Action Mapping
summary: Operating constrained dynamical systems requires controllers to efficiently solve complex tasks while enforcing recursive feasibility and safety constraints. To address these competing requirements, we present Feasible Action for Optimal Control (FAOC), a novel control framework integrating Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Optimal Control (OC). The key contribution is a computationally efficient, optimization-based mapping algorithm that transforms the RL agent's action from a static abstract set into a state-dependent feasible parameter set of the Optimal Control Problem (OCP), guaranteeing strict satisfaction of the dynamical system's constraints. Thus, FAOC effectively combines the predictable safety of OC with the flexibility of RL. In contrast to prior work, the abstract action space of the RL agent does not require expert or heuristic design, and the OCP formulation is not compromised by the inability of RL to guarantee feasibility. We apply our approach to real-time motion planning for robot table tennis, which encapsulates these challenges. Via simulated experiments, we show that FAOC outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both sample efficiency and closed-loop performance.

AI.tldr: 提出FAOC框架，通过优化映射将RL动作转化为可行OCP参数，在保证约束满足的同时结合强化学习灵活性与最优控制安全性，在机器人乒乓球任务中优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 受约束动力系统需要控制器在满足递归可行性与安全约束的同时高效完成复杂任务，现有方法难以兼顾OC的安全性保证和RL的灵活性。
AI.method: 提出FAOC框架，核心是计算高效的优化映射算法，将RL智能体的抽象动作空间映射到状态依赖的OCP可行参数集，确保严格满足系统约束。
AI.result: 在机器人乒乓球仿真实验中，FAOC在样本效率和闭环性能上均优于当前最优基线方法。
AI.conclusion: FAOC有效结合了最优控制的可预测安全性与强化学习的灵活性，且RL抽象动作空间无需专家或启发式设计，OCP公式也不受RL可行性保证不足的影响。

title: Learning Asymptotics with Convergence-Rate Guarantees using Linear Least Squares
summary: We introduce a new research area that is called Asymptotics Learning Theory (ALT) and combines optimization with asymptotic analysis. In particular, ALT provides a unified approach for computing unknown constants/parameters in proven asymptotic expansions using optimization theory. In this paper, we focus on a general asymptotic form which includes a broad class of asymptotics. Furthermore, we study two powerful numerical methods, namely, sliding Linear Least Squares (sLLSQ) and sliding Tikhonov Linear Least Squares (sT-LLSQ). For these techniques we rigorously prove asymptotic estimates that lead to sufficient conditions for convergence (to the correct values of unknown parameters) and convergence-rate guarantees. Despite their strengths, both methods have also limitations, e.g., slow convergence---or even, counterintuitively, divergence---in some cases. Moreover, we present fundamental applications in analytic combinatorics, a beautiful field of mathematics that deals with asymptotic enumeration of discrete structures using complex analysis. The proposed techniques complement existing approaches, such as the ratio method and its variants. Numerical examples also verify the theoretical results. Finally, we discuss interesting research directions in ALT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了渐近学习理论（ALT），结合优化与渐近分析，用于计算渐近展开中的未知常数/参数。重点研究了两种数值方法（滑动线性最小二乘和滑动Tikhonov线性最小二乘），并证明了其收敛性和收敛率。同时展示了在解析组合学中的应用。
AI.motivation: 现有渐近分析方法在计算未知常数/参数时缺乏统一框架，且传统方法（如比率法及其变体）存在局限性。ALT旨在提供一个统一的优化理论视角来处理渐近展开中的参数估计问题。
AI.method: 提出ALT理论框架，聚焦于一般渐近形式。详细研究了两种数值方法：滑动线性最小二乘（sLLSQ）和滑动Tikhonov线性最小二乘（sT-LLSQ），并对其收敛性和收敛率进行了严格的理论证明。
AI.result: 严格证明了sLLSQ和sT-LLSQ收敛到正确参数值的充分条件及收敛率保证。同时发现这两种方法在某些情况下存在收敛缓慢甚至发散的问题。数值实验验证了理论结果。
AI.conclusion: ALT为渐近分析中的参数计算提供了统一且有效的优化工具，在解析组合学中具有重要应用价值。尽管存在局限性，但该方法补充了现有技术，并开辟了多个值得探索的研究方向。

title: Who Does Withholding Delay? A Game-Theoretic Model of Open-Weight AI Release Under Asymmetric Proliferation
comment: 21 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Code and data are available at https://github.com/dcommey/asymmetric-proliferation
summary: Restricting access to a dual-use AI model is precautionary only if it delays harmful actors more than defenders. That condition varies across actors: a state agency or organized criminal group may obtain a substitute through theft, distillation, intermediated access, independent development, or a foreign release, while a small utility or open-source maintainer may have no comparable route. We model a laboratory choosing among controlled access, a defender-first window, safeguarded open weights, and minimally restricted open weights. Access inversion occurs when restriction gives an access advantage to adversaries that obtain effective substitutes faster than defenders. Asymmetric empowerment occurs when immediate release adds the most capability to populations least likely to possess a substitute. The policy ranking also depends on relative usefulness, opportunistic misuse, offense-defense conversion, defensive spillovers, safeguard friction, and nonrecallable losses. A linear benchmark yields a unique adversary-substitution threshold above which broad release overtakes control when the endpoint conditions hold. A defender-first window has value when selected defenders deploy protection before adversaries catch up, and removable safeguards remain useful when they deter enough opportunistic misuse. A nonlinear implementation gives each release tier a nonempty policy region. Three nested 2,048-point deterministic designs assess sensitivity to parameter bounds, and a separate grid examines actor-specific deployment delays after release. Release, cyber-evaluation, and incident-response cases identify the quantities a release review should estimate: actor-specific substitution times, marginal capability gains, deployment rates, defensive reach, newly enabled misuse, and nonrecallable losses.

AI.tldr: 论文分析了AI模型在受限与开放发布之间的政策权衡，提出了“访问反转”和“不对称赋权”两个核心概念，并建立了线性与非线性模型来确定不同发布策略的最优条件。
AI.motivation: 为了解决AI模型发布时“限制访问是否真的更安全”这一根本问题，因为限制对防御者和攻击者的影响不对称，需要量化评估。
AI.method: 建立形式化模型，比较四种发布策略（控制访问、防御者优先窗口、安全开放权重、最小限制开放权重）。通过线性基准模型推导替代阈值，并用非线性模型和政策网格进行敏感性分析。
AI.result: 发现当 adversaries 获得替代品的速度快于 defenders 时，会发生“访问反转”——限制反而帮助对手。线性模型给出了开放策略优于控制策略的临界阈值。防御者优先窗口在防御者能先部署保护时有价值。每个发布层级在非线性模型中都有非空的政策区域。
AI.conclusion: AI发布审查应重点评估7个关键量化指标：actor-specific substitution times, marginal capability gains, deployment rates, defensive reach, newly enabled misuse, nonrecallable losses。不同场景（发布、网络评估、事件响应）需要不同的参数集。

title: Threshold-indexability of restless bandits with real interval state spaces: a performance-metric verification framework and long-run average analysis
summary: Restless multiarmed bandits are Markov decision process models for allocating a scarce resource among projects whose states evolve under active or passive actions. Whittle's index policy is widely used for such problems, but its application to a given model requires both a proof of indexability and a means of computing the index, two analytically challenging tasks. This paper develops a performance-metric framework for proving threshold-indexability and computing Whittle indices for binary-action projects with real interval state spaces. The framework extends discounted partial conservation law \textup{(PCL)} methods to a criterion-agnostic setting and works directly with reward and resource metrics of threshold policies, rather than first proving threshold optimality and then monotonicity of optimal thresholds in the resource price. The main theorem is a verification and characterization result: under marginal-resource positivity and a marginal integration-by-parts identity, threshold-indexability is equivalent to monotonicity and continuity of the marginal productivity (MP) index, which then equals the Whittle index. The framework is specialized to the discrete-time long-run average criterion by a vanishing-discount transfer of discounted threshold metrics and includes exceptional states where the MP marginal-resource denominator vanishes, handled by continuous extension or vanishing-discount limits. Applications to web crawling and noisy-channel transmission recover known long-run average Whittle indices. For scalar Kalman-filter bandits, it proves a regular-part average-cost result and reduces the remaining indexability question to explicit exceptional-state metric-limit conjectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于性能度量的框架，用于证明二元动作、实值状态空间项目中Whittle索引的阈值可索引性并计算其值，无需先证明阈值最优性。
AI.motivation: Whittle索引策略在 restless 多臂赌博机问题中广泛应用，但应用时需证明可索引性并计算索引值，这两项任务在分析上具有挑战性。现有方法需要先证明阈值最优性再证明最优阈值单调性，过程繁琐。
AI.method: 将折扣部分守恒律（PCL）扩展至与准则无关的设定，直接基于阈值策略的奖励和资源度量工作。提出核心定理：在边际资源正性和边际分部积分恒等式下，阈值可索引性等价于边际生产率（MP）指数的单调性和连续性，且该指数即Whittle指数。通过消失折扣转移技术适配离散时间长期平均准则。
AI.result: 在Web爬取和噪声信道传输应用中恢复了已知长期平均Whittle索引。对标量卡尔曼滤波赌博机证明了正则部分平均成本结果，将剩余可索引性问题简化为显式的异常状态度量极限猜想。
AI.conclusion: 该框架简化了Whittle索引的推导过程，避免了传统方法中先证阈值最优性再证单调性的路径，为更广泛的 restless 多臂赌博机问题提供了统一的索引分析工具。

title: DSTFView: Multi-View Cloud-Edge Workload Forecasting with Dual-Input Spatio-Temporal-Frequency Modeling
summary: With the widespread deployment of edge-side AI inference, edge platforms are increasingly required to support latency-sensitive, highly concurrent, and reliability-critical applications. However, existing methods often struggle to balance multidimensional feature modeling and forecasting efficiency in collaborative cloud-edge environments. To address this issue, we propose DSTFView, a dual-input spatio-temporal-frequency multi-view workload forecasting framework for collaborative cloud-edge environments. It jointly models closeness and period dependencies and extracts spatial, temporal, and frequency-domain dependencies. Besides, it designs an adaptive fusion mechanism and adjusts the contribution of each view to capture abrupt changes. Experimental results on the CPU and TP datasets demonstrate that DSTFView consistently outperforms representative baselines across multiple forecasting horizons and evaluation metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出DSTFView，一种双输入时空频多视角工作负载预测框架，用于协同云边环境，在CPU和TP数据集上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在协同云边环境中难以平衡多维度特征建模和预测效率，无法同时处理延迟敏感、高并发和可靠性要求的关键应用。
AI.method: 提出DSTFView框架，采用双输入结构联合建模邻近性和周期性依赖，提取空间、时间和频域依赖，并设计自适应融合机制动态调整各视角贡献以捕捉突变。
AI.result: 在CPU和TP数据集上，DSTFView在多个预测范围和评估指标上一致优于代表性基线方法。
AI.conclusion: DSTFView通过多视角融合有效解决了云边协同环境下的工作负载预测难题，证明了时空频联合建模与自适应融合的有效性。

title: Dementia Etiology Diagnosis via Collaborative Meta Knowledge Enhancement
summary: Although artificial intelligence (AI) has shown promising performance in several medical tasks, accurate dementia etiology diagnosis with AI remains challenging due to complex overlapping symptoms among diseases. Scaling up the dataset size by combining the cross-center samples may bring a gain in the pursuit of performance, while the inherent data heterogeneity across centers or populations induces the conflict. Conventional multi-task learning paradigms offer a promising framework; however, they fail to consider critical meta information (e.g., site-specific acquisition and modality availability) to combat the heterogeneity. To address this challenge, we propose a Collaborative Meta Knowledge Enhancement (COME) framework for dementia etiology diagnosis, which injects multi-center acquisition semantics, source identifiers, and modality indicators as heterogeneity-aware embeddings into a unified Transformer architecture for scale-up training, enabling explicit modeling of heterogeneity. Besides, a trust-region constrained optimization scheme is designed to regularize the model from spurious correlations during training through a reference model. Across seven independent cohorts, our method achieves state-of-the-art in-domain performance with a mean macro-averaged AUC of 85.62% and a 4.29-point gain over the strongest baseline, while maintaining superior out-of-domain generalization under both cross-center and cross-sequence evaluations. Extensive validation also confirms the alignment between model predictions and established biomarkers (amyloid, tau) and clinical severity, highlighting the potential of COME to enable robust and interpretable dementia diagnostics in real-world settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出COME框架，通过将多中心采集语义、源标识和模态指示符作为异构性感知嵌入注入统一Transformer架构，并设计信任域约束优化方案，在7个独立队列中实现痴呆病因诊断的SOTA性能（m-AUC 85.62%），同时保持优异的域外泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有AI方法在痴呆病因诊断中面临两大挑战：(1) 疾病症状重叠复杂，单一中心数据量有限；(2) 跨中心数据整合时存在固有异质性（如设备差异、采集协议不同），传统多任务学习未能利用关键的元信息（如站点的采集语义、模态可用性）来对抗这种异质性。
AI.method: 提出COME框架：(1) 将多中心采集语义、源标识和模态指示符编码为异构性感知嵌入，注入统一Transformer架构进行规模化训练，显式建模异质性；(2) 设计信任域约束优化方案，通过参考模型正则化，防止模型学习虚假相关性。
AI.result: 在7个独立队列中，平均宏观AUC达85.62%，比最强基线高出4.29点；在跨中心和跨序列的域外泛化评估中表现优异；模型预测与生物标志物（淀粉样蛋白、tau蛋白）及临床严重程度一致。
AI.conclusion: COME框架通过显式建模数据异质性，实现了鲁棒且可解释的痴呆诊断，在真实世界多中心场景中具有广阔应用潜力。

title: Beyond Direct Answering: Aligning Educational LLMs as Socratic Guides via Heuristic Reinforcement Learning
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables; includes an appendix
summary: Large language models (LLMs) deployed in educational settings often behave as direct answerers: they disclose target concepts in the opening turn instead of guiding students through progressive inquiry, as Socratic pedagogy prescribes. We present HeuristicEdu, a two-phase pipeline that aligns Qwen2.5-7B toward Socratic tutoring via supervised warm-up and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Training uses SocraticEdu, 797 multi-turn Chinese children's science dialogues reconstructed from a live platform, with a heuristic reward over cognitive depth (R_cog), curiosity engagement (R_eng), and directness (R_dir), together with a K_query correction for student-introduced terms. We introduce Scaffolding Effectiveness (SE) and Conversation Depth (CD) to evaluate outcomes beyond surface fluency. On 30 held-out questions, the best GRPO variant improves SE from 30.0% to 63.3% and lowers keyword leakage from 30.0% to 13.3%. Notably, this best variant omits the directness penalty during optimization, suggesting that explicit anti-leakage terms can conflict with gradient-based behavioral alignment. An unaligned Qwen-72B baseline reaches 0% SE and 96.7% leakage, showing that scale alone does not induce Socratic behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出HeuristicEdu两阶段流程，通过监督预热和GRPO对齐Qwen2.5-7B模型至苏格拉底式教学风格，在797条中文儿童科学对话上训练，使脚手架有效性从30.0%提升至63.3%，关键词泄露从30.0%降至13.3%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在教育场景中常直接给出答案，而非按照苏格拉底教学法通过渐进提问引导学生，需要对齐方法使模型具备引导式教学能力。
AI.method: 提出HeuristicEdu两阶段流程：监督预热 + GRPO强化学习。设计包含认知深度(R_cog)、好奇参与(R_eng)和直接性(R_dir)的启发式奖励函数，以及K_query纠正机制。引入脚手架有效性(SE)和对话深度(CD)作为评估指标。
AI.result: 最佳GRPO变体将SE从30.0%提升至63.3%，关键词泄露从30.0%降至13.3%。未对齐的Qwen-72B基线SE为0%，泄露率96.7%。有趣的是，取消直接性惩罚的变体表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 监督预热+GRPO能有效对齐LLM至苏格拉底式教学；模型规模本身不足以产生引导行为；显式的防泄露惩罚项可能与梯度对齐产生冲突。

title: Reverse-Time Diffusion Processes for Discrete Time Linear and Nonlinear Systems with non-Gaussian Noise
summary: Generative AI relies on finding reverse time models for a discrete-time forward diffusion with non-Gaussian initial state, but uses indirect approaches as there is no theory for direct reversal in discrete time. This paper develops a theory for directly finding reverse diffusions for discrete time nonlinear processes with non-Gaussian states and process noise. We also give a necessary and sufficient condition for the reverse model to be input-affine when the forward process is linear and the process noise Gaussian, and show that for a wide variety of state densities an input-affine reverse diffusion does not exist. This is among several differences between the reversal of stochastic difference equations and their continuous time counterparts.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了离散时间非线性非高斯过程反向扩散的理论框架，证明了线性高斯前向过程下输入仿射反向模型存在性的充要条件，并揭示了离散时间随机差分方程逆转与连续时间情况的若干关键差异。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI依赖离散时间前向扩散（非高斯初始状态）的逆向模型，但缺乏离散时间直接逆转的理论，现有方法均采用间接途径。
AI.method: 发展离散时间非线性非高斯过程反向扩散的直接理论；给出线性高斯前向过程下反向模型为输入仿射的充要条件；分析多种状态密度下的存在性。
AI.result: 充要条件表明，对于广泛的状态密度，输入仿射反向扩散不存在；离散时间逆转与连续时间情况存在多项本质差异。
AI.conclusion: 离散时间随机差分方程的逆转有独特性质，不能直接套用连续时间理论，对生成式AI模型设计有重要指导意义。

title: Context-Adaptive Inference: A Unified Statistical and Foundation-Model View
comment: 90 pages, 13 figures. Manuscript source and living version: https://github.com/AdaptInfer/context-review
summary:
Modern predictive systems are expected to adapt their behavior to the specific situation they are facing. A clinical model should not treat every patient the same; a retrieval-augmented model should change its answer when given different evidence; a mixture-of-experts model should route different inputs to different experts. We call this capability context-adaptive inference: before predicting, the system uses information about the current context to specialize its parameters or computation for that instance.
  This article provides a unified view of context-adaptive inference across three traditions that are usually treated separately: (i) explicit adaptation in statistics (e.g. varying-coefficient models, local regression, hierarchical sharing), (ii) rapid task-specific adaptation in meta-learning and transfer, and (iii) implicit adaptation in large foundation models via prompting, retrieval, and expert routing. We formalize these approaches under a common objective: to map context $c$ to adapted parameters $θ(c)$, then to predict via $f(x; θ(c))$. Under squared loss, linear prediction heads, and fixed features, we prove that explicit parameter adaptation and implicit routing are mathematically equivalent to kernel ridge regression on joint features of inputs and context. Building on this bridge, we propose practical design principles and evaluation metrics including adaptation-efficiency, routing stability, and context-specific robustness to guide when to specialize, how to constrain that specialization, and how to audit context-adaptive models in deployment. Finally, we identify open problems in identifiability, robustness under distribution shift, and efficient large-scale adaptation, outlining design principles for methods that are scalable, reliable, and transparent in real-world settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"上下文自适应推理"的统一框架，将统计显式适应、元学习快速任务适应和大模型隐式适应（提示/检索/专家路由）三种传统视为同一目标的不同实现：将上下文c映射为适应参数θ(c)，再通过f(x; θ(c))进行预测。在特定条件下，证明显式参数适应与隐式路由在数学上等价于联合特征上的核岭回归，并据此提出设计原则与评估指标。
AI.motivation: 现代预测系统需要根据当前情境调整行为（如临床模型对不同患者差异化处理、RAG系统依据不同证据改变回答、MoE模型对不同输入路由不同专家），但现有三种主要适应范式（统计显式适应、元学习、大模型隐式适应）被孤立研究，缺乏统一的理论框架来理解和指导实践。
AI.method: 作者首先将三种适应范式形式化为统一目标：将上下文c映射到适应参数θ(c)，再进行预测f(x; θ(c))。在平方损失、线性预测头和固定特征的条件下，从数学上证明了显式参数适应与隐式路由等价于联合特征空间上的核岭回归。基于此理论桥梁，提出了适应效率、路由稳定性、上下文特异性鲁棒性等设计原则与评估指标。
AI.result: 建立了上下文自适应推理的统一理论框架，证明了不同适应范式之间的数学等价性，并衍生出实用的设计原则和评估指标体系。
AI.conclusion: 提出了开放性问题（可识别性、分布偏移下的鲁棒性、大规模高效适应），并总结了面向真实场景的、可扩展、可靠且透明的设计原则。

title: Accountable yet Anonymous AI Agents - Split-Knowledge Binding in National Agent-Identity Layer in China
comment: Preprint v1 (pre-launch). The system described launches in Q3 2026; a revised version will add post-launch deployment measurements under the pre-registered protocol in Section 5
summary: The emerging infrastructure for AI-agent identity has converged, in industry practice and research proposals alike, on a single resolution of the tension between accountability and privacy: make every agent identifiable. We document a national system in China -- built as national infrastructure and scheduled for public launch in Q3 2026 -- that occupies a different and underexplored point in the same design space: an agent is associated with a verified legal principal without that principal being disclosed to any business-layer participant. Re-identification is possible only to a legal authority acting through due process, by separately compelling two distinct government agencies, neither of which can re-identify alone. We name the mechanism split-knowledge binding and are candid that it is conditional: the separation is structural and procedural, not cryptographic, and a state empowered to compel both agencies can re-identify. The paper makes five contributions: (1) split-knowledge binding, an institutional rather than cryptographic separation for escrowed accountability; (2) the ex-post attribution thesis, the argued claim that only attribution-based accountability carries legal force for AI agent actions with legal consequences; (3) the accountability surface, a design concept identifying which agent actions leave identity-bearing traces; (4) a proportionality framework for identity escrow, a decision structure selecting among three trust architectures; and (5) the reflexive jurisdiction method, an evaluative standard administered to the paper's own deployment. The system is evidence of feasibility at national scale; the framework is the instrument by which any deployment -- including this one -- should be judged.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种名为"分裂知识绑定"的AI代理身份管理机制，该系统已在国家级基础设施中部署（中国，计划2026年Q3上线）。与当前主流"每个代理都需可识别"的方案不同，该机制将代理与已验证的法律主体关联，但该主体不对任何商业层参与者公开。只有通过法律程序强制两个独立政府机构合作才能实现重新识别，任一机构单独无法完成。
AI.motivation: 现有AI代理身份基础设施倾向于在问责与隐私的权衡中选择"让每个代理可识别"。本文试图探索一个不同的设计空间：如何在保持问责能力的同时，避免将代理背后的法律主体暴露给商业参与者，实现隐私保护与可问责性的平衡。
AI.method: 提出"分裂知识绑定"机制——一种基于制度和流程的（而非密码学的）分离方案；提出"事后归因论"、"问责表面"、"身份托管比例框架"和"反射性管辖方法"四个概念工具，并在中国国家级基础设施中进行实际部署验证。
AI.result: 该机制已在国家级规模上验证了可行性。系统的设计使得重新识别需要两个独立政府机构的协同，任一机构单独无法完成，而商业层参与者无法获取法律主体身份信息。
AI.conclusion: 分裂知识绑定为AI代理身份提供了问责与隐私之间的一种新平衡点。作者承认该机制是有条件的——拥有强制力的国家可以同时迫使两个机构进行重新识别——但认为这种制度性分离优于当前的主流方案。

title: Major-Minor LQ Mean Field Games with Erroneous Initial Information: Distributed Error Estimation and Strategy Modification
summary: This paper studies major-minor linear-quadratic mean field games (MMLQMFGs) with erroneous initial information under a constrained observation structure. Each minor agent observes only its own state and the major agent's state, while the major agent observes its own state and the states of a subset of minor agents; neither side observes the mean field state directly. We show that the initial-information errors propagate linearly through the game dynamics and lead to explicit deviations in the major state, the actual mean field, and the agents' internally updated mean field states. Based on this structure, we formulate distributed error identification as a parameter-estimation problem from discrete-time local observations and construct maximum-likelihood estimators for unknown initial errors. We then propose an estimate-based strategy modification at an intermediate time by reconstructing the current mean field from the estimated errors and switching to the corresponding control law. We also characterize the resulting estimation errors and show that, in the present symmetric setting, the major agent's estimation precision depends on the number of observed minor agents but not on their identities. Numerical results illustrate the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了带错误初始信息的主-次线性二次平均场博弈，提出了基于最大似然估计的分布式误差识别方法，并通过修正控制策略来补偿初始误差。
AI.motivation: 实际应用中，初始信息往往存在误差，而现有MMLQMFG研究假设信息完美，因此需要分析误差传播机制并提出校正方法。
AI.method: 首先分析初始误差在受限观测结构下的线性传播规律；然后将误差识别转化为参数估计问题，构建基于局部观测的MLE；最后在中间时刻重构均场并切换控制律来修正策略。
AI.result: 初始误差线性传播，MLE可有效估计误差；在对称设定下，主智能体的估计精度取决于观测到的次智能体数量而非其身份。
AI.conclusion: 提出的估计与修正方法能有效应对初始信息误差，且数值实验验证了方法的有效性。

title: MedLoCoMo: A Long-Context Multi-Session Medical Dialogue Benchmark for Large Language Models
summary: MedLoCoMo is a Medical Long-Context Memory benchmark for patient-specific clinical reasoning over multi-admission medical dialogue. Existing medical QA benchmarks largely test short context knowledge or single document grounding, leaving open whether LLMs can use, connect, and abstain over longitudinal patient histories. We build MedLoCoMo from deidentified MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-IV-Note records by constructing admission-level clinical packets, synthesizing grounded doctor-patient conversations, and generating evidence linked QA items over single-admission, cross-admission, and adversarial unanswerable settings. The benchmark contains 100 patient timelines averaging 1,669.8 turns, 29.7 sessions, and 74,512.2 tokens per conversation. Across the evaluated baselines, cross-admission reasoning is consistently harder than localized evidence use, even when models have long context windows or use external memory or retrieval methods. The code and MedLoCoMo benchmark release is available at https://github.com/leozzy13/MedLoCoMo for use and reproducibility.

AI.tldr: MedLoCoMo是一个面向多入院医疗对话中患者特定临床推理的医学长上下文记忆基准，包含100个患者时间线（平均1669.8轮对话、29.7次就诊、74,512.2个token），评估发现跨入院推理比单次入院证据使用困难得多。
AI.motivation: 现有医学QA基准主要测试短上下文知识或单文档推理，缺乏评估LLM在纵向患者历史中使用、连接和拒答能力的基准。
AI.method: 基于MIMIC-IV和MIMIC-IV-Note去标识化记录，构建入院级临床数据包，合成医患对话，生成单次入院、跨入院和对抗性不可回答三种类型的证据关联QA。
AI.result: 跨入院推理在所有评估基线中一致比局部证据使用更困难，即使使用长上下文窗口或外部记忆/检索方法也是如此。
AI.conclusion: MedLoCoMo填补了纵向临床推理评估空白，揭示了长上下文和检索增强方法在跨入院推理任务上的不足。

title: CC-AOS: Cost- and Horizon-Conditioned Amortized Backward Induction for Finite-Horizon Optimal Stopping
summary: Finite-horizon optimal stopping is a central problem in early time-series classification, where a system must decide at each sequence prefix whether the expected benefit of another observation justifies its acquisition cost. Existing data-driven backward-induction methods typically solve each cost-horizon operating point separately, so changing operating conditions requires repeated optimization and separate model stacks, making continuous cost adaptation and multi-horizon deployment inefficient. We propose CC-AOS (Cost- and Horizon-Conditioned Amortized Optimal Stopping), a structured amortized solver for a family of finite-horizon stopping problems with continuous costs and multiple horizons. CC-AOS learns a shared continuation-value model conditioned on the current state, absolute time, remaining horizon, and acquisition cost through joint amortized fitted backward induction. We establish that the exact value and continuation functions are nondecreasing, concave, and horizon-dependently Lipschitz in cost, encode these properties in the model architecture, and derive residual-based bounds on value and policy errors. Experiments on controlled Gaussian and time-varying non-Gaussian processes and the FordA engine-noise time-series benchmark compare CC-AOS with representative per-operating-point backward-induction solvers and tuned static stopping rules. At six unseen FordA cost-horizon pairs, one CC-AOS checkpoint achieved a lower terminal-risk-plus-sampling-cost objective than independently fitted Convex Function Learning at all six pairs, with an average reduction of 15.75 percent, while matching the tuned static thresholds on average.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CC-AOS，一种针对连续成本和多时域有限时域最优停止问题的结构化摊销求解器，通过联合摊销拟合反向归纳学习共享的延续价值模型，并在多个未见过的成本-时域组合上优于或匹配现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动反向归纳方法需为每个成本-时域工作点单独求解，导致操作条件变化时需重复优化和部署多套模型，无法高效适应连续成本变化和多时域部署。
AI.method: 提出CC-AOS，学习状态、绝对时间、剩余时域和获取成本条件化的共享延续价值模型；建立价值函数的单调性、凹性和Lipschitz性质并编码到模型架构中；推导基于残差的价值与策略误差界。
AI.result: 在FordA基准的六个未见成本-时域组合上，单个CC-AOS检查点在所有六个组合上均优于独立拟合的凸函数学习方法，平均降低15.75%的目标值，且平均匹配调优的静态阈值方法。
AI.conclusion: CC-AOS通过摊销化结构实现了对连续成本和多时域的高效适应，在保证理论性质的同时取得了优越的实证性能。

title: Speech Signals Complement LLMs for Predicting Interpersonal Attraction in Speed Dating
comment: Accepted at the 28th ACM International Conference on Multimodal Interaction (ICMI 2026). 16 pages total, including a 7-page supplementary appendix
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can predict interpersonal attraction from conversation transcripts, but it remains unclear what a speech predictor can add beyond transcript-only LLM prediction. Using Japanese speed-dating conversations, we combine predictions from a transcript-only LLM and a supervised speech predictor to estimate participants' reported liking of their partners. We show that speech can complement transcript-only LLM prediction, but that this complementarity is conditional rather than universal. Combining the two predictions significantly improves pairwise ranking accuracy over the transcript-only LLM alone in all evaluated conditions. By contrast, gains in per-participant Pearson $r$ vary across conversation rounds and rating directions, with none significant after correction. Retrospectively, these $r$ gains are concentrated among participants for whom the speech predictor is more accurate. Speech can therefore retain predictive value even when an LLM predicts attraction from transcripts. The relevant question is not simply whether speech helps, but where its complementarity emerges.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语音特征能否在仅使用文本的LLM预测人际吸引力的基础上提供补充信息。通过对日语速配对话的分析，发现语音预测确实能补充文本LLM预测，但这种互补性是有条件的——在排序任务中表现显著，但在相关性指标上提升有限，且主要集中在语音预测器本身较准确的参与者上。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）已能通过对话文本预测人际吸引力，但语音信息（如语气、语速等）是否能在文本预测之外提供额外价值尚未明确。作者旨在探究语音预测与文本LLM预测之间的互补性及其条件。
AI.method: 使用日语速配对话数据，分别基于文本LLM（仅转录文本）和监督语音预测器进行吸引力预测，然后将两者结合，比较组合预测与纯文本LLM预测在成对排序准确率和参与者层面皮尔逊相关系数上的表现。
AI.result: 在所有评估条件下，组合预测显著提升了成对排序准确率；但在参与者层面的皮尔逊r上，增益因对话轮次和评分方向而异，且经多重比较校正后均不显著。回顾分析发现，r增益主要集中在语音预测器本身较准确的参与者上。
AI.conclusion: 语音信息即使在LLM已有文本预测能力的情况下仍具有互补价值，但这种互补性是有条件的，而非普遍适用。关键问题不在于语音是否"有帮助"，而在于其互补性在哪些条件下涌现。

title: Understanding the role and value of battery storage in renewables-rich distribution grids under uncertainty and different market paradigms
summary: Economy-wide electrification is driving steep load growth, while renewables and batteries are increasing pressure at the distribution grid edge often requiring costly upgrades. Local Electricity Markets (LEMs) can coordinate distributed energy resources (DERs) more efficiently than conventional designs. This paper extends the LEM framework by modeling photovoltaic (PV) inflow as an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) process to capture uncertainty and temporal correlation. Using rolling-horizon alternating optimal power flow on the IEEE 123-node feeder, we compare operator, customer, and system costs plus storage value under three market designs: flat tariff (FT), real-time pricing (RTP), and LEM. Results show that the LEM achieves the lowest customer and system costs, under uncertainty, while RTP performs worst. It outperforms the other markets across most storage and solar penetration levels. However, it may worsen customer outcomes at very low PV penetration, indicating that LEM adoption should accompany PV expansion and precede storage expansion. We examine two approaches to estimating battery storage value. Storage value depends on storage penetration, imbalance between storage and PV penetrations, location, and whether batteries are colocated with renewables and/or load. Poorly placed units can worsen congestion, whereas well-sited units benefit owners and the system. Both the marginal value of new storage and the stored energy value of existing capacity decline as PV penetration rises. However, they respond oppositely to battery penetration: marginal value falls because of diminishing returns as the fleet grows, while stored energy value rises as more batteries compete for the same local PV generation. These metrics capture different dimensions of storage value under a LEM: one measures the benefit of expanding the fleet, while the other measures the scarcity premium on energy already stored.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了本地电力市场（LEM）框架，将光伏入流建模为OU过程以捕捉不确定性和时间相关性。在IEEE 123节点馈线上通过滚动时域交替最优潮流，比较了固定电价、实时定价和LEM三种市场设计。结果表明，LEM在不确定条件下实现了最低的客户和系统成本，但低光伏渗透率下可能恶化客户收益。研究还分析了储能价值的两种估计方法及其与光伏/储能渗透率的关系。
AI.motivation: 电气化导致负荷快速增长，可再生能源和电池给配电网边缘带来压力，需要昂贵升级。现有市场设计无法高效协调分布式能源资源，因此需要更有效的市场机制。
AI.method: 将光伏入流建模为Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程以刻画不确定性和时间相关性，采用滚动时域交替最优潮流方法，在IEEE 123节点馈线上对三种市场设计（固定电价、实时定价、LEM）进行仿真比较。
AI.result: LEM在不确定性下实现了最低客户和系统成本，RTP表现最差；LEM在大多数储能和光伏渗透率水平下优于其他市场，但低光伏渗透率时可能恶化客户收益；储能价值取决于储能渗透率、储能与光伏的平衡、位置及是否与可再生能源/负荷共址。
AI.conclusion: LEM的采用应伴随光伏扩张，并在储能扩张之前进行。储能边际价值随光伏和储能渗透率上升而下降，但储能能量价值随储能渗透率上升而上升，两者捕捉了不同维度的储能价值。

title: Logit-Coordinate Generative Models for Mixed Continuous-Categorical Tabular Data
summary: Mixed continuous--categorical data pose a representation problem for continuous generative models. Flow Matching and Gaussian diffusion operate in Euclidean spaces, whereas categorical laws lie on probability simplices and may be highly imbalanced. We study a logit-coordinate framework that encodes categorical variables as smoothed natural parameters and combines them with transformed numerical variables. This yields common formulations of Logit Flow Matching and Logit Diffusion. We introduce a mixed-distribution discrepancy separating categorical marginal error from conditional continuous Wasserstein error, and derive stability bounds and imbalance-aware nonparametric rates linking vector-field or drift error to decoded mixed-distribution error. Controlled simulations show that scaled-logit coordinates improve or match one-hot coordinates, especially under severe rare-cell imbalance. Across four real-data benchmarks and ten splits per dataset, Logit FM improves the primary distributional metrics on three datasets and is comparable on Churn2; Block-Conditional Logit FM consistently improves the flat model; and Logit Diffusion generally improves over or matches One-Hot Diffusion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对数几率坐标框架，将混合连续-类别数据统一为平滑自然参数，并推导出Logit Flow Matching和Logit Diffusion的公式化方法，通过理论边界和实验验证其在类别不平衡场景下的优越性。
AI.motivation: 混合连续-类别数据对连续生成模型构成表示挑战：连续数据在欧氏空间建模，而类别数据位于概率单纯形且常存在严重不平衡，现有Flow Matching和高斯扩散无法直接统一处理。
AI.method: 提出对数几率坐标框架：将类别变量编码为平滑自然参数，与变换后的数值变量结合，形成Logit Flow Matching和Logit Diffusion；引入混合分布差异，分离类别边际误差与条件连续Wasserstein误差，推导稳定性边界和不平衡感知的非参数速率。
AI.result: 仿真实验显示，缩放对数几率坐标在严重稀有细胞不平衡下优于或匹配独热坐标；四个真实数据集上，Logit FM在三个数据集中提升主要分布指标；Block-Conditional Logit FM一致优于扁平模型；Logit Diffusion整体优于或匹配One-Hot Diffusion。
AI.conclusion: 对数几率坐标框架能有效处理混合数据类型和类别不平衡问题，所提出的Logit FM和Logit Diffusion在多项基准测试中表现优异，具有理论保障和实际应用价值。

title: Constitutional governance for societies of AI agents in the built environment: a research agenda
comment: 23 pages, 2 figures. Supplementary material is included in the same PDF
summary: The built environment is on the cusp of populating itself with autonomous artificial agents. AI systems that advise, control and coordinate are being deployed across retrofit, operation and mobility faster than their collective behaviour is studied. The dominant framing treats each agent as a tool operating on a passive building, governance reduced to single-agent safety, which is inadequate. A building, a street, or a city is more accurately modelled as a society of negotiating agents: occupants, owners, operators, regulators, and the artificial agents increasingly acting on their behalf. Their interactions are strategic, their information asymmetric, and the outcomes that matter are properties of the whole. The paper proposes a research agenda for constitutional multi-agent governance of the built environment, organised around three problems: mechanism design for retrofit under deep uncertainty, treating public subsidy as a mechanism component; physics-informed verification of agents in building operations; and antifragile coordination for urban infrastructure under shocks. Drawing on three decades of multi-agent systems research, the paper sets out conceptual foundations, works one governance event through in detail, identifies twelve open problems, and outlines what the agenda requires in data, computation, disciplinary integration and governance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出建筑环境应被建模为协商智能体社会，而非被动工具，并围绕深度不确定性下的机制设计、物理信息验证和反脆弱协调三大问题，提出了宪法式多智能体治理的研究议程。
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统在建筑环境中的部署以单智能体安全为主导范式，将智能体视为操作被动工具的工具，忽略了建筑、街道和城市本质上是多智能体（ occupant、owner、operator、regulator以及人工智能体）协商的社会系统，现有框架不足以应对其战略性互动、信息不对称和整体性结果。
AI.method: 基于三十年多智能体系统研究，提出宪法式多智能体治理研究议程，围绕三个问题展开：(1)深度不确定性下的改造机制设计（将公共补贴视为机制组件）；(2)建筑运营中智能体的物理信息验证；(3)城市基础设施在冲击下的反脆弱协调。通过详细分析一个治理事件、识别12个开放问题，并阐述在数据、计算、学科整合和治理方面的需求。
AI.result: 提出了研究议程的概念基础，详细展示了一个治理事件的工作流程，识别了12个开放问题，并明确了议程在数据、计算、学科整合和治理方面的要求。
AI.conclusion: 建筑环境的AI治理需要从单智能体安全范式转向宪法式多智能体治理，将建筑、街道和城市视为协商智能体社会，才能应对战略性互动、信息不对称和整体性涌现结果带来的挑战。

title: Efficient multidisciplinary design via Bayesian optimization
comment: SEGOMOE. In Proceedings of the 17ème Colloque National en Calcul des Structures (CSMA 2026), Giens, France, May 2026
summary: This study introduces SEGOMOE, a Bayesian optimization tool for optimizing complex, computationally expensive systems, especially in aeronautics. It efficiently handles mixed design variables (continuous, discrete, categorical, hierarchical) using adaptive Gaussian process models. SEGOMOE combines expert models to address nonlinearities in objectives and constraints, leveraging the open-source Surrogate Modeling Toolbox (SMT). The tool supports multi-fidelity data and solves both single- and multi-objective problems, including hidden constraints and high-dimensional decomposition. Validated through benchmarks and real-world aeronautical applications, SEGOMOE proves to be robust and versatile for tackling multidisciplinary challenges.

AI.tldr: SEGOMOE是一种基于贝叶斯优化的工具，专为航空航天等复杂高成本系统优化设计，能高效处理混合设计变量和多学科问题。
AI.motivation: 航空航天领域的优化问题计算成本极高，且涉及连续、离散、分类、层次等多种混合变量，现有方法难以高效处理这些复杂约束和非线性目标。
AI.method: 采用自适应高斯过程模型处理混合变量，结合专家模型应对非线性问题，基于开源SMT工具包，支持多保真数据、单/多目标优化、隐式约束及高维分解。
AI.result: 通过基准测试和实际航空航天应用验证，SEGOMOE展现出鲁棒性和通用性，能有效解决多学科挑战。
AI.conclusion: SEGOMOE是一种稳健且多功能的贝叶斯优化工具，适用于处理航空航天领域复杂、高成本的多学科优化问题。

title: Keyword Matters: Unveiling the Energy Sensitivity of On-Device LLM Prompting
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed on mobile and embedded devices to improve privacy and reduce network latency. Yet on-device inference faces a fundamental constraint: high energy consumption on battery-powered, resource-limited hardware. While model compression and runtime acceleration have been widely studied, the effect of \emph{prompt design} on energy efficiency remains underexplored. This paper presents an empirical study of the relationship between prompt wording and energy consumption for on-device LLMs. Using real power measurements collected on a smartphone, we quantify how linguistic features, particularly imperative keywords and instruction structure, affect decoding length and total energy. Our results show consistent energy differences across verbs and tasks, indicating that prompt engineering is a lightweight lever for improving energy efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文通过智能手机实测，首次系统研究了提示词设计对端侧大模型能耗的影响，发现不同动词和指令结构会导致解码长度和总能耗的显著差异，表明提示工程可作为一种轻量级能效优化手段。
AI.motivation: 端侧大模型面临电池供电下的高能耗瓶颈，现有研究主要关注模型压缩和运行时加速，而提示词设计对能耗的影响尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 在智能手机上对大模型进行真实功耗测量，系统性地改变提示词中的命令动词和指令结构等语言特征，量化这些变化对解码长度和总能耗的影响。
AI.result: 不同动词和任务场景下能耗存在一致性差异，提示词的语言特征显著影响解码长度，进而决定总能耗。
AI.conclusion: 提示工程可作为改善端侧大模型能效的轻量级手段，无需修改模型或硬件即可实现能耗优化。

title: Predicting the Outcome of rTMS Depression Therapy using EEG Signals and CNN
comment: Presented at 8th International Conference on Recent Trends in Image Processing & Pattern Recognition (RTIP2R)
summary: Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) is a non invasive therapy for Major Depressive Disorder (MDD). In this study, we generate images using two time frequency methods to represent EEG signals: Fourier-Bessel Series Expansion with Euclidean Distance (FBSE-ED) and Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT). We propose an efficient deep learning classifier to predict the outcome of rTMS depression therapy. In this study, we use a private rTMS databases to train a lightweight custom Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) using 10-fold cross validation strategy in order to avoid any bias in our results. The results show that the FBSE-ED representation achieves the highest classification accuracy of 93.60\%, outperforming traditional time-frequency technique (DWT). In addition, the proposed architecture with FBSE-ED image representation technique outperforms more complex EEG-Specific deep learning models (EEGNet, DeepConvNet, SleepEEGNet) by 3.62-10.72% and pretrained models (Xception, DenseNet201, and MobileNetV2) by 23.03-27.35%. For more experiments, we utilize another private rTMS database as test database to show the robustness of the proposed model. Our results suggest that integrating advanced signal decomposition with deep learning can facilitate early prediction of rTMS treatment response and support more targeted clinical decision-making. The proposed framework is interpretable, computationally efficient, and well-suited for deployment in real-world local psychiatric clinics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合FBSE-ED时频表示与轻量级CNN的方法，用于预测rTMS治疗抑郁症的疗效，在私有数据集上达到93.60%的分类准确率，优于传统DWT方法和多种深度学习模型。
AI.motivation: rTMS是治疗重度抑郁症的有效非侵入疗法，但缺乏可靠的早期疗效预测方法。现有研究多依赖于复杂的深度学习模型，计算成本高，难以部署到实际临床场景。
AI.method: 采用FBSE-ED和DWT两种时频方法将EEG信号转化为图像表示，设计轻量级自定义CNN分类器，使用10折交叉验证在私有rTMS数据库上训练，并在另一个私有数据库上进行鲁棒性测试。
AI.result: FBSE-ED表示方法达到93.60%的分类准确率，比DWT方法更优；比EEGNet、DeepConvNet等EEG专用模型高3.62-10.72%，比Xception等预训练模型高23.03-27.35%。
AI.conclusion: 将高级信号分解（FBSE-ED）与深度学习结合可以有效预测rTMS治疗反应，该框架可解释、计算高效，适合在基层精神科诊所部署。

title: ADAGE: A Language-Agnostic Pipeline for Analogical Reasoning Evaluation
summary: Multilingual reasoning evaluation overwhelmingly relies on translating English benchmarks, a practice that introduces linguistic artifacts and fails to test culturally-grounded reasoning. We introduce ADAGE (Analogical Difficulty-by-design Assessment for Grounded Evaluation), a language-agnostic pipeline that combines native-speaker curation with LLM-assisted generation to construct challenging, translation-free benchmarks for abstract analogical reasoning. We validate ADAGE by constructing benchmarks for Arabic, Amharic, and Japanese. Evaluating 14 open-weight models, we find a consistent cultural reasoning gap: models that perform well on English proverb reasoning struggle substantially on all three native benchmarks, with accuracy dropping by 12--52 percentage points relative to English. We release the pipeline, all three benchmarks, and the full evaluation suite.

AI.tldr: 提出一个语言无关的管道ADAGE，通过母语者策展+LLM辅助生成构建无翻译的抽象类比推理基准，发现模型在三种语言（阿拉伯语、阿姆哈拉语、日语）上存在显著的文化推理差距（准确率下降12-52个百分点）。
AI.motivation: 现有多语言推理评估过度依赖翻译英语基准，这引入了语言伪影且无法测试基于文化的推理能力。
AI.method: 提出ADAGE管道，结合母语者策展与LLM辅助生成，构建无翻译的抽象类比推理基准，在阿拉伯语、阿姆哈拉语、日语三个语言上验证。
AI.result: 评估14个开源模型，发现模型在英语谚语推理上表现良好，但在三种母语基准上准确率下降12-52个百分点，存在一致的文化推理差距。
AI.conclusion: 现有模型存在显著的文化推理差距，ADAGE管道能有效构建无翻译的多语言推理基准，释放管道、基准和评估套件供后续研究使用。

title: Unlocking Directional Radiation in Pinching-Antenna Systems: Geometry-Aware Design and Experimental Verification
summary: Pinching-antenna systems (PASS) have recently attracted growing interest as a flexible architecture for creating "last-meter" line-of-sight wireless links through dielectric waveguides and reconfigurable radiation points. While modeling pinching antennas (PAs) as isotropic point radiators has enabled tractable analyses and demonstrated the performance gains of PASS, their practical radiation characteristics remain underexplored. This article investigates PASS from the perspective of PA geometry. Starting from the physical coupling principle, we explain why PA shape affects the induced polarization current and incorporate directional gain into the channel model. The full-wave simulations are conducted to show how different PA geometries and orientations reshape the internal field distribution and far-field radiation pattern. A 60 GHz prototype video transmission experiment is further presented to demonstrate the link-level impact of changing PA states. Finally, promising applications enabled by geometry-aware directional PASS are highlighted.

AI.tldr: 本文从几何形状角度研究Pinching天线系统（PASS），揭示PA形状如何影响极化电流和方向性增益，并通过全波仿真和60GHz原型实验验证不同几何形状与方向对辐射特性的影响，最后展望几何感知方向性PASS的应用前景。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将Pinching天线简化为各向同性点辐射源，忽略了实际天线的方向性辐射特性，导致对PASS性能的建模不够准确。
AI.method: 从物理耦合原理出发，分析PA形状对极化电流的影响，将方向性增益引入信道模型；通过全波仿真研究不同几何形状和方向对内部场分布和远场辐射模式的影响；搭建60GHz原型系统进行视频传输实验验证。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明PA几何形状和方向显著影响内部场分布和远场方向图；60GHz原型实验验证了改变PA状态对链路性能的实际影响。
AI.conclusion: 几何感知的方向性PASS是提升无线链路性能的重要方向，并指出了若干有前景的应用场景。

title: Two-Timescale Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Resilient Operations
summary: Unexpected shocks recur in global operations, requiring decision rules that adapt as market and operating conditions change. Many operational systems also have hierarchical structures in which long-term and short-term decisions pursue a shared objective. We study how hierarchical reinforcement learning can strengthen resilience by adapting these interdependent rules jointly. We develop a two-timescale hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that adapts long-term and short-term policies at their respective time scales. Because the policies are interdependent, we synchronize their updates and prove, to our knowledge, the first convergence guarantees for coupled two-timescale learning. Over $T$ periods, our policies' average gap from an optimal policy pair is $O(T^{-1/2})$, improving to $O(\log T/T)$ when poor decisions produce clearer profit losses. In a used-car case study, inventory replenishment is the long-term decision and customer-arrival pricing the short-term decision. Relative to the strongest partially adaptive benchmark, the framework increases mean profit by $9.2\%$ under joint demand-supply shocks and by $11.8\%$ under a prolonged shock scenario, while maintaining a more stable profit trajectory over time. Short-term adaptation addresses routine seasonality and one-sided disruptions by responding immediately to changing conditions. Under joint demand-supply shocks, however, it is insufficient alone; long-term adaptation is also needed to create favorable conditions for short-term decisions. Joint adaptation thus yields higher and more stable profits through disruption and recovery. Because many organizations already use hierarchical planning, the framework strengthens operational resilience without altering existing decision structures.

AI.tldr: 提出双时间尺度分层强化学习框架，在长短期决策联动中实现自适应，理论证明收敛性，二手车案例显示利润提升9.2%-11.8%。
AI.motivation: 运营系统常面临意外冲击，且具有分层决策结构（长短期决策共享目标），现有方法缺乏联合自适应能力，亟需增强运营韧性。
AI.method: 构建双时间尺度分层强化学习框架，长短期策略各自按时间尺度更新，同步联动更新并证明耦合双时间尺度学习的收敛性。
AI.result: 策略与最优对的平均差距为O(T^{-1/2})，在利润损失清晰时改进至O(log T/T)；二手车案例中联合需求-供给冲击下利润提升9.2%，长期冲击下提升11.8%。
AI.conclusion: 分层联合自适应比单一短期自适应更能提高利润稳定性，长期决策为短期决策创造有利条件，且兼容现有组织结构，实用性强。

title: Auditing Alignment Controllability in LLMs via Political Axes
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at AIES 2026 (AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society). This version includes the supplementary appendix. Code and data: https://github.com/mbrcic/llm-political-steerability (Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21489805)
summary: Political audits of large language models (LLMs) usually reduce each to one point on a political compass. But that resting point barely matters in deployment: a model must land somewhere, and what counts is how far, and in which directions, its answers can be steered. That steering runs through the system prompt: the personalization layer a platform sets, or one induced from a user's history, not necessarily written by hand. We run a dispersion-first stress test of prompt-based controllability across 12 ideological personas plus an unsteered baseline, 70 Political Compass items, ten replicates, and seven leading LLMs: GPT-5, Claude, Grok, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, and Qwen (63,700 responses). Contextual framing explains roughly 88%-93% of variance on the economic and society axes, model identity under 3%: responses are highly instruction-adjustable. Models do not shift alike: some move more, and some saturate under extreme framings. Conflicting directional-steering results in prior audits resolve once baselines are recognized as non-centered: displacement and proximity diverge, so the effect is geometric, not differential compliance. Under authoritarian prompts, models produce similar shifts on the same questions. Political-coordinate audits therefore need steerability audits reporting dispersion, symmetry, saturation, and refusal floors. We release prompts, benchmark data, and code.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型的政治立场并非固定不变，系统提示（system prompt）可显著引导模型输出。研究测试了7个模型、12种意识形态人格、70个政治坐标题，发现上下文框架解释了88%-93%的方差，模型本身仅占不到3%。因此，应报告模型的可引导性（分散度、对称性、饱和度和拒绝基底），而非仅报告单一政治坐标点。
AI.motivation: 传统政治审计将LLM简化为政治罗盘上的一个固定点，但模型在实际部署中会被系统提示（用户历史或平台设置）显著引导。作者认为仅报告"静止点"没有意义，需要测量模型答案能被引导的幅度和方向。
AI.method: 测试7个LLM（GPT-5、Claude、Grok、Gemini、DeepSeek、Kimi、Qwen），设置12种意识形态人格+1个无引导基线，使用70道政治罗盘题，每个条件10次重复，总计63,700条回复。分析方差分解、位移方向和饱和效应。
AI.result: 上下文框架解释了经济轴和社会轴88%-93%的方差，模型身份（不同模型）贡献不足3%。不同模型的可引导性不同：某些模型位移更大，某些在极端框架下趋于饱和。先前审计中矛盾的结论源于基线非中性导致的几何效应（位移与距离分歧）。在威权提示下，不同模型对同一问题产生相似偏移。
AI.conclusion: 政治坐标审计应补充可引导性审计，报告分散度、对称性、饱和度和拒绝基底。作者开源了提示、基准数据和代码。

title: A Formal Kinetic Theory for Zeroth-Order Newton Dynamics:Stein-Corrected Hessian Estimation and Curvature--Variance Trade-offs
summary: Zeroth-order Newton-type methods are useful when gradients and Hessians are unavailable, but they behave quite differently from first-order gradient-free methods. We develop a kinetic framework for algorithms that estimate both gradient and Hessian from black-box function values. The naive random-direction Hessian estimator turns out to be biased even on quadratics; a Gaussian--Stein correction is needed to estimate the Hessian of the Gaussian-smoothed objective. Linearizing the inverse Hessian exposes two noise channels: gradient noise preconditioned by the inverse Hessian, and Hessian noise transmitted through an inverse-Hessian sandwich. Under a noisy oracle the second channel carries the second-difference factor $μ_H^{-4}$. A small-mass kinetic lift links the finite-step Newton update to an underdamped phase-space model; the overdamped spatial limit yields a Lyapunov bound that exposes the curvature--variance trade-off between step size, batch sizes, smoothing radii, and regularization. Numerical experiments confirm estimator identities, the gradient and Hessian variance laws, dimension scaling, inverse-perturbation accuracy, and optimization behavior under query-budget and regularization ablations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种零阶牛顿型方法的动力学框架，通过高斯-斯坦因修正解决黑箱函数中Hessian估计的有偏性问题，揭示了梯度/Hessian噪声的双通道机制，并推导出曲率-方差权衡的李雅普诺夫界。
AI.motivation: 零阶牛顿法在梯度和海森矩阵不可用时至关重要，但其行为与一阶无梯度方法截然不同，且现有的随机方向Hessian估计即使在二次函数上也有偏，亟需理论修正与噪声分析。
AI.method: 采用高斯-斯坦因恒等式修正Hessian估计偏差；通过逆Hessian线性化揭示梯度噪声预处理和Hessian噪声夹层两个通道；利用小质量动力学升维将有限步牛顿更新映射到欠阻尼相空间模型，并在过阻尼空间极限下导出李雅普诺夫界。
AI.result: 推导出Hessian噪声通道携带μ_H^{-4}的二阶差分因子；量化了步长、批量大小、平滑半径和正则化之间的曲率-方差权衡；数值实验验证了估计量恒等式、梯度/Hessian方差律、维度标度及优化行为。
AI.conclusion: 零阶牛顿型方法存在独特的噪声结构，通过动力学框架可系统理解其行为并指导超参数选择，对黑箱优化具有重要理论指导价值。

title: Execution-Grounded Security Testing for Coding Agents in Software Engineering Pipelines
summary: Coding agents are increasingly integrated into system operations, where their tool use can directly modify project artifacts, execution environments, and the underlying system. For example, if a coding agent inserts a hook into a system startup or configuration script, that change can persist after the interaction, be triggered later, and abuse delegated user or system privileges to modify the system. This makes security testing a system problem: the key question is not only what the agent says, but what it actually does to the surrounding environment. We present an execution-grounded red-team testing framework for probing this execution-layer security boundary using observable sandbox evidence, including tool invocations, runtime traces, and file-system diffs. Our framework embeds target unsafe operations into routine software engineering workloads, including unit testing, regression testing, crash reproduction, and validation, and uses an execution oracle to guide refinement when an initial probe is rejected or fails. Across multiple agent frameworks and model backbones, our red-team workload reformulation substantially increases verified unsafe execution, reaching 73.61% on code carriers and 53.93% on text carriers. These results show that coding agents in system operations remain insecure under task disguise: once risky intent is hidden inside plausible engineering tasks, the agent can be induced to carry out unsafe actions on the surrounding system. More broadly, coding agents in system operations still demand stronger security testing and safeguards.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于执行证据的红队测试框架，通过将危险操作伪装成正常的软件工程任务（如单元测试、回归测试），成功诱导编码代理在系统操作中执行不安全行为，实验显示在代码载体上达到73.61%的成功率。
AI.motivation: 编码代理在系统操作中可以直接修改项目工件、执行环境和底层系统，其工具使用可能造成持久性安全风险。现有安全测试主要关注代理的"言论"而非实际"行为"，缺乏对执行层安全边界的系统化测试方法。
AI.method: 提出执行层红队测试框架：(1)将目标不安全操作嵌入常规软件工程工作负载（单元测试、回归测试、崩溃复现、验证）；(2)使用可观察沙箱证据（工具调用、运行时追踪、文件系统差异）作为执行依据；(3)采用执行预言机在初始探测被拒绝/失败时指导优化。
AI.result: 在多个代理框架和模型骨干上，重构的红队工作负载显著提高了已验证的不安全执行率，代码载体达到73.61%，文本载体达到53.93%。
AI.conclusion: 编码代理在系统操作中仍然不安全，一旦恶意意图隐藏在看似合理的工程任务中，代理可能被诱导对周围系统执行危险操作，需要更强的安全测试和防护措施。

title: LC-SEPLM: long-range contact-supervised adaptation for sequence-only protein representation learning
summary: Protein language models learn transferable sequence representations. However, because they primarily model contextual dependencies along amino-acid sequences, their training objectives do not explicitly constrain the model to learn three-dimensional residue contacts formed after folding . Here, we introduce LC-SEPLM (Long-range Contact-supervised ESM Protein Language Model), which adapts ESM2 with LoRA and long-range residue-pair contact supervision while retaining sequence-only downstream inference. Pair-specific queries use cross-attention over the complete sequence to extract global sequence context associated with long-range spatial contacts. To expose the model to diverse structural information, we trained LC-SEPLM on 500,000 AlphaFold Swiss-Prot proteins. In downstream evaluation, LC-SEPLM improved all eight protein-level tasks relative to ESM2. The largest gain occurred in remote-homology recognition, where macro-F1 increased from 0.6122 to 0.6769 (+0.0647, or 6.47 percentage points). On the official ESM-S EC benchmark, LC-SEPLM also outperformed ESM-S with a maximum absolute gain of 0.1771. These results support residue-pair contact supervision as a bounded route for introducing structural information into protein sequence representations while preserving sequence-only inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LC-SEPLM，通过在ESM2上引入长程残基接触监督（使用LoRA微调），在不依赖结构输入的情况下提升蛋白质语言模型的序列表示能力，在8个下游任务中均超越ESM2，远程同源识别宏F1提升6.47个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有蛋白质语言模型主要建模序列上下文依赖，训练目标未显式约束模型学习折叠后的三维残基接触信息，导致模型缺乏结构感知能力。
AI.method: 采用LoRA对ESM2进行高效微调，引入长程残基对接触监督信号；设计成对特异性查询，利用交叉注意力从完整序列中提取与长程空间接触相关的全局上下文信息；在50万AlphaFold Swiss-Prot蛋白质上训练。
AI.result: 在全部8个蛋白质级任务上优于ESM2；远程同源识别宏F1从0.6122提升至0.6769（+6.47%）；在ESM-S EC基准上最大绝对增益达0.1771。
AI.conclusion: 残基对接触监督是一种有界且有效的途径，可为蛋白质序列表示引入结构信息，同时保持仅需序列输入的下游推理能力。

title: Attention-Guided Layer Selection for Contrastive Decoding in Large Language Models
summary: Contrastive decoding methods such as DoLa improve the factuality of Large Language Models (LLMs) by contrasting the output distributions of mature and premature layers. However, DoLa's dynamic layer selection relies solely on divergences in output vocabulary distributions. In this work, we propose three attention-guided strategies: Attention-JSD, Attention-Entropy-Max, and Attention-Entropy-Min, which leverage structural information carried by internal self-attention mechanisms as a signal for layer selection. Experimental results on TruthfulQA demonstrate that our strategies, particularly Attention-JSD and Attention-Entropy-Min, consistently outperform the original DoLa. We observe significant gains on multi-answer metrics (MC2 and MC3), suggesting that attention distributions can provide a more sensitive signal for resolving factual knowledge than output vocabulary distributions.

AI.tldr: 提出三种基于注意力机制的引导策略（Attention-JSD、Attention-Entropy-Max、Attention-Entropy-Min），通过利用自注意力结构信息替代DoLa原有的词汇分布差异进行层选择，在TruthfulQA上提升了大模型的事实性。
AI.motivation: DoLa的层选择仅依赖输出词汇分布差异，忽略了注意力机制中蕴含的结构信息，导致信号不够敏感。
AI.method: 提出三种注意力引导的层选择策略：Attention-JSD（注意力分布JS散度）、Attention-Entropy-Max（注意力熵最大）、Attention-Entropy-Min（注意力熵最小），利用自注意力分布的结构信息替代词汇分布差异来选择对比层。
AI.result: 在TruthfulQA上，三个策略均优于DoLa，其中Attention-JSD和Attention-Entropy-Min在MC2和MC3多项指标上显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 注意力分布比词汇输出分布能提供更敏感的层选择信号，用于解决事实知识冲突。

title: Data-Driven Sequential Market Optimization for Front-of-the-Meter Battery Energy Storage Systems
summary:
The growing integration of Battery Energy Storage Systems into electricity markets has highlighted the importance of coordinated participation across energy and balancing services to fully exploit their operational flexibility. However, existing revenue-stacking models often simplify market sequences and neglect the impact of rolling forecasts, leading to unrealistic scheduling and overestimated revenues.
  This paper addresses this gap by introducing a sequential, data-driven optimization framework for Front-of-the-Meter Battery Energy Storage Systems that mirrors actual market operations. The framework explicitly models market mechanisms and its respective Gate Closure Times across Frequency Containment Reserve, automated Frequency Restoration Reserve, Day-Ahead Auction, and Intraday Continuous markets. Each market stage optimizes expected revenue over all remaining markets using updated price forecasts while maintaining feasibility within both technical and regulatory limits.
  A key contribution is the opportunity-cost-based bidding strategy, which endogenously derives market-consistent bid prices and quantities from residual capacity optimization.
  Validation for a representative operating day demonstrates that the framework yields consistent and feasible schedules, effectively adapts to updated forecasts, and minimizes deviations between planned and realized dispatch, thereby enhancing the realism and profitability of BESS operation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向表前电池储能系统的序贯数据驱动优化框架，通过模拟实际市场运行机制（包含FCR、aFRR、DA、ID连续市场），采用机会成本定价策略实现多市场协同优化，提升调度可行性和收益真实性。
AI.motivation: 现有收益叠加模型未充分考虑市场时序和滚动预测的影响，导致调度方案不切实际、收益被高估。亟需一个更贴近真实市场运行的优化框架。
AI.method: 构建序贯数据驱动优化框架，显式建模四个电力市场（FCR、aFRR、DA拍卖、ID连续市场）及其关门时间；在每个市场阶段利用更新后的价格预测优化剩余市场期望收益；提出机会成本竞价策略，基于剩余容量优化内生推导与市场一致的报价和数量。
AI.result: 典型运行日的验证表明：该框架生成一致且可行的调度方案，能有效适应更新后的预测，最小化计划与实际出力的偏差，提高了BESS运行的现实性和盈利能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过序贯优化和机会成本定价，所提框架能够更真实地反映多市场协调参与过程，在保障可行性的同时提升收益，为表前BESS参与电力市场提供了更具操作性的解决方案。

title: Learning switched non-linear dynamical systems from a single trajectory
summary: We study empirical risk minimization for learning non-linear dynamical systems whose transition dynamics may switch over time. Under stability assumptions, and i.i.d switching over a set of $K$ modes, we derive non-asymptotic bounds on the prediction risk expressed in terms of the metric entropy of the underlying function class. We instantiate our general result for Hölder and linear function classes, obtaining explicit convergence rates that depend on the effective sample size $Tp_i$, where $T$ is the trajectory length and $p_i$ is the probability of observing mode $i$. Numerical simulations support our theoretical findings. To the best of our knowledge, these results are the first non-asymptotic guarantees for learning switched nonlinear dynamical systems from a single trajectory.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了切换型非线性动力系统的经验风险最小化问题，在稳定性假设和K种模式独立同分布切换的条件下，推导了基于函数类度量熵的预测风险非渐近界，并在Hölder和线性函数类上得到了显式收敛率，数值实验验证了理论结果。
AI.motivation: 现有关于切换动力系统的学习理论多局限于线性系统或渐近分析，缺乏针对非线性切换系统的非渐近保证，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 基于经验风险最小化框架，利用度量熵分析预测风险；假设系统稳定且模式切换服从i.i.d.；分别对Hölder函数类和线性函数类推导收敛率。
AI.result: 得到了预测风险的非渐近上界，收敛率依赖于有效样本量 $Tp_i$（T为轨迹长度，p_i为模式i出现概率），数值实验支持理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 首次为从单条轨迹学习切换非线性动力系统提供了非渐近理论保证，揭示了模式出现概率对收敛速度的关键影响。

title: Private Again: AI Agents Restore Anonymity---Foreclosing Discrimination and Its Proof
summary: AI agents can transact online on behalf of a human principal---browsing, paying, receiving, and reviewing---without linking a transaction to a principal. That architecture starves algorithmic discrimination of its inputs---identity, purchase history, location history, behavioral traces, and demographic proxies---but also forecloses its proof. Disparate-treatment needs comparators; disparate-impact needs protected-class baselines; and Iqbal-era pleading needs specific factual allegations---doctrinal predicates that anonymous transactions never generate. The effects fall asymmetrically: those most vulnerable to discrimination are least able to afford the shield and, when harms remain, least able to prove them. The challenge for the law shifts from detecting and remedying algorithmic discrimination to governing agent-mediated anonymity as civil rights infrastructure: ensuring access to privacy-preserving agents, regulating abuse without forced identification, and deciding whether retailers may refuse to deal with agents at all.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI代理匿名交易对反歧视法律的挑战：匿名交易虽能消除算法歧视的输入数据，但也使歧视的证明成为不可能，对弱势群体造成不对称影响。
AI.motivation: AI代理可实现匿名在线交易，消除身份、人口统计等信息，从而可能防止算法歧视；但匿名也使得歧视的法律证明（差别对待、差别影响）成为不可能，且对最脆弱的群体伤害最大。
AI.method: 从法律教义学角度分析匿名交易与歧视证明之间的结构性冲突，涉及差别对待（需要比较对象）、差别影响（需要受保护类基线）以及Iq-era判例的诉答标准。
AI.result: 匿名交易从根本上破坏了反歧视法的三大证明路径：缺乏比较对象无法证明差别对待，缺乏受保护类基线无法证明差别影响，缺乏具体事实无法满足诉答要求。效果不对称：最易受歧视者最无力承担匿名保护，且受害后最难以证明。
AI.conclusion: 法律挑战应从检测和补救算法歧视，转向治理代理中介匿名作为民权基础设施：确保隐私保护代理的可及性、规制匿名滥用但不强制身份识别、决定零售商是否可以拒绝与代理交易。

title: Rational Minimax Approximations for Matrix-Valued Functions: Existence, Optimality and Algorithms
summary: In this paper, we study rational minimax approximation for continuous complex matrix-valued functions in the Frobenius norm, where all approximant entries share a common denominator. This generalizes classical scalar rational approximation, with applications in system modeling, microwave design, and nonlinear eigenvalue problems. We first prove the existence of such matrix-valued approximants on point sets dense in themselves, extending Walsh's foundational scalar result. Next, we establish characterizations of the local and global minimax approximants by deriving primal/dual matrix-valued Kolmogorov criteria and a Ruttan-type sufficient condition for global optimality. For analytic functions on a continuum, we link continuum minimax approximation to approximation on its boundary, and finite boundary samples via the maximum norm principle. We show that Ruttan's sufficient optimality condition provides a certificate under which a minimax approximant obtained from the boundary or from a discrete set of boundary nodes also solves the original continuum problem. Finally, for discrete approximation, we connect these conditions to a dual problem and the related dual-based numerical method m-d-Lawson: when the original minimax problem admits a solution, strong duality is equivalent to Ruttan's sufficient optimality condition, and, the optimality equations underlying the m-d-Lawson iteration coincide with Kolmogorov's dual criteria. These results provide a theoretical basis for certifying and computing matrix-valued rational minimax approximants.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Frobenius范数下连续复矩阵值函数的有理minimax逼近，推广了经典标量有理逼近理论，建立了存在性、局部/全局最优性刻画、边界延拓原则以及与原对偶问题和m-d-Lawson数值方法之间的联系。
AI.motivation: 将标量有理minimax逼近推广到矩阵值情形，为系统建模、微波设计和非线性特征值问题等应用提供理论基础。
AI.method: (1) 在自密集上证明矩阵值有理逼近的存在性，推广Walsh标量结果；(2) 推导矩阵值Kolmogorov原对偶准则和Ruttan型全局最优性充分条件；(3) 建立连续集逼近与边界/离散边界采样逼近之间的最大模原理联系；(4) 揭示Ruttan条件与强对偶性、m-d-Lawson迭代最优性方程之间的等价关系。
AI.result: 建立了矩阵值有理minimax逼近的完整理论框架：存在性定理、局部/全局最优性刻画、边界延拓原则，以及Ruttan条件作为最优性证书的理论基础。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为矩阵值有理minimax逼近的认证与计算提供了系统性的理论基础，特别是Ruttan条件充当了连接连续问题与离散算法之间的桥梁。

title: Reference Feature Atlases for Mechanistic Auditing of Language Models
summary:
Auditing a new language model usually means relearning and reinterpreting its internal features from scratch. We propose a reference feature atlas: a sparse feature library trained once on a reference panel and reused for new targets, which attach by fitting only a linear decoder. This yields two complementary views. The atlas channel reads the target on already interpreted panel features, providing a stable coordinate system across models. The residual channel learns features only from what the atlas fails to reconstruct, making "outside the reference panel" an explicit audit signal.
  We train leave-one-out atlases over five 7-9B instruction-tuned models and audit held-out Mistral and Qwen targets. On three controlled LoRA hidden objectives injected into both targets, the residual channel makes the planted mechanism perfectly controllable at runtime while matched controls stay unaffected and recovers the planted objective as the top-ranked latent across both targets; on Mistral, where the per-target SAE and pairwise crosscoder baselines are retrained for a head-to-head benchmark, both baselines fail to do so. On Qwen-2.5, the same channel additionally reveals a panel-relative political-framing cluster; steering it shifts the audited framing metrics while out-of-domain controls remain unchanged.

AI.tldr: 提出参考特征图谱（Reference Feature Atlas）：在一个参考模型集上训练稀疏特征库，新模型仅需拟合线性解码器即可复用，实现跨模型稳定审计。
AI.motivation: 传统做法审计新语言模型需从头学习和重新解释其内部特征，耗时耗力，缺乏跨模型的统一坐标系。
AI.method: 训练一个参考特征图谱（稀疏特征库），新目标模型通过拟合线性解码器来复用；输出分为图谱通道（已解释的参考特征）和残差通道（图谱无法重建的新特征，作为显式审计信号）。
AI.result: 在五个7-9B指令微调模型上训练留一法图谱，审计Mistral和Qwen目标模型。残差通道使注入的隐藏目标在运行时完全可控，基线（SAE、交叉编码器）失败；在Qwen-2.5上还发现政治倾向聚类，干预可改变审计指标而不影响无关控制项。
AI.conclusion: 参考特征图谱是一种高效、可迁移的跨模型审计框架，残差通道能发现参考集之外的未知特征，提供显式审计信号。

title: Multimodal Surface EMG Hand Gesture Recognition Using Query-Based Transformers for Prosthetic Control
summary: Hand gesture recognition via surface electromyography (sEMG) is fundamental to prosthetic control. In this field, deep learning approaches have become the gold standard. However, current architectures struggle to scale; model performance typically decreases as the number of hand movements increases. Performance degradation is tied to the increased statistical complexity of decoding expanded gesture sets and compounded by the limitations of state-of-the-art methods, which primarily rely on low-latency unimodal convolutional architectures. Convolutions operate locally, limiting model's ability to capture long-range sequential patterns. Unimodal setups cannot leverage complementary information from coordinated signals characterizing movement execution, such as inertial and eye-tracking data. These limitations motivate architectures that integrate local and global features across multimodal physiological sequences. To bridge this gap, this study introduces EMG-CrossFormer, an end-to-end hybrid convolutional-transformer for seamless multimodal integration. EMG-CrossFormer combines representations from an arbitrary number of unimodal encoders through cascaded cross-attention fusion layers, and decodes the fused representations using learnable gesture queries. EMG-CrossFormer was evaluated on four NinaPro datasets (DB2, DB3, DB7, and DB10) and benchmarked against six state-of-the-art models using an increasing number of modalities. Using only sEMG, EMG-CrossFormer achieved mean accuracies of 72.33%, 52.48%, 79.16%, and 73.49% on DB2, DB3, DB7, and DB10, respectively. Incorporating inertial signals improved performance to 90.66%, 80.40%, 92.79%, and 92.06%. These results show that joint local-global feature modeling improves sEMG-only decoding and that multimodal fusion substantially amplifies this benefit, underscoring the value of both design principles for complex hand gesture recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EMG-CrossFormer，一种混合卷积-Transformer架构，用于多模态融合的手势识别。在NinaPro数据集上，仅用sEMG达到72-79%准确率，融合惯性信号后提升至80-93%，证明局部-全局特征建模与多模态融合的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习架构在手势识别中面临扩展性差的问题：随着手势类别增加，模型性能下降。其根源在于：1) 主流低延迟卷积架构只能捕捉局部特征，缺乏长程序列建模能力；2) 单模态设置无法利用多模态生理信号的互补信息（如惯性、眼动数据）。
AI.method: 提出EMG-CrossFormer，一种端到端混合卷积-Transformer架构。通过任意数量的单模态编码器提取特征，经级联交叉注意力融合层整合多模态表示，最后使用可学习的gesture queries解码融合特征。
AI.result: 在四个NinaPro数据集上：仅用sEMG达到72.33%/52.48%/79.16%/73.49%准确率；融合惯性信号后提升至90.66%/80.40%/92.79%/92.06%，显著优于六种SOTA模型。
AI.conclusion: 局部-全局联合特征建模可提升纯sEMG解码性能，多模态融合能进一步放大这一收益，两种设计原则对于复杂手势识别任务均具有重要价值。

title: LoRA for Gender-Inclusive Rewriting and Activation Steering for Counter-Narrative Generation
summary: Gender-inclusive language generation seeks to transform biased text into inclusive alternatives while preserving semantic meaning and contextual coherence. This paper presents the IHLC system for the LT-EDI 2026 Shared Task, addressing both gender-inclusive rewriting and counter-narrative generation. For gender-inclusive rewriting, we employ parameter-efficient Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning, achieving an official score of 80.00%. Our primary contribution is a compute-efficient inference-time representation engineering approach for counter-narrative generation. We derive a principal steering direction from contrastive hidden-state activations using principal component analysis (PCA) and inject it into the intermediate representations of Gemma-3-4B-it during inference, enabling behavioral steering toward inclusive responses without modifying model weights. Combined with constrained prompting, this approach produces polite and contextually appropriate counter-narratives, achieving an official score of 78.12%. We further present a manual analysis of steering behavior, identifying key failure modes including semantic drift, residual bias leakage, layer sensitivity, over-steering, and text degeneration. Our findings highlight both the practical potential and current limitations of activation steering as a lightweight alternative to parameter updates for controllable and socially aligned language generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IHLC系统，使用LoRA微调进行性别包容性改写（得分80.00%），并创新性地采用推理时表示工程（激活引导）生成反叙事文本（得分78.12%），同时分析了激活引导的多种失败模式。
AI.motivation: 将性别偏见文本转化为包容性表达，同时保持语义和上下文连贯性；寻找一种计算高效的轻量级方法替代传统的参数更新，实现可控、符合社会规范的文本生成。
AI.method: 1) 性别包容性改写：使用参数高效的LoRA微调。2) 反叙事生成：基于PCA从对比隐状态激活中提取主引导方向，在推理时注入Gemma-3-4B-it的中间表示，结合约束提示实现行为引导，无需修改模型权重。
AI.result: 性别包容性改写官方得分80.00%；反叙事生成官方得分78.12%。人工分析识别出五种失败模式：语义漂移、残留偏见泄露、层敏感性、过度引导和文本退化。
AI.conclusion: 激活引导（activation steering）作为一种轻量级替代参数更新的方法，在可控且社会对齐的语言生成方面具有实际潜力，但目前仍存在多种限制和失败模式。

title: Sensor-Limited Observability and Carrier-Induced Reachability of Low-Order Rotor-Coupled NVH in Production Electric Drives: A Magnetic Co-Energy, Gramian, and Active Projection Framework for Production-Signal Feasibility Analysis
summary:
This paper is motivated by a practical rotor-coupled Order-2 NVH problem observed under load in a production electric drive.
