Production controllers typically lack direct measurements of rotor vibration, air-gap deformation, or housing acceleration. The central question is therefore whether a mechanically important low-order vibration can be inferred or influenced using only dq currents, voltage commands, resolver angle, and resolver speed.
  The selected vibration component is represented as an equivalent air-gap deformation mode in a magnetic co-energy-based electromechanical state-space model. Finite-time Gramians evaluate current-based observability, resolver-based observability, and plant-level voltage-to-air-gap reachability. The analysis identifies flux-linkage sensitivity as the common bottleneck for passive current observability and passive voltage reachability, while resolver observability depends on a separate torque-projection condition. A mechanically significant deformation may thus remain first-order invisible to passive dq signals because production measurements observe a winding-level global projection rather than local air-gap flux redistribution.
  To address this degeneracy, the paper introduces carrier-induced active projection. A realizable electromagnetic carrier may create additional measurement and force projections, enabling carrier-on observability, reachability, and sideband signatures in production residuals. Two numerical studies examine passive low-order projection in a 48-slot, 8-pole symmetry proxy and sideband detectability under finite-window noise and near-order disturbance leakage. They demonstrate the computational structure of the framework but do not constitute FEM-calibrated motor validation.

AI.tldr: 针对量产电驱系统中转子耦合的Order-2 NVH问题，本文提出利用载波主动投影技术，弥补dq电流、电压等常规信号对气隙变形模式不可观/不可达的缺陷，并通过有限时间格拉姆矩阵分析验证了载波增强可观性与可达性。
AI.motivation: 量产电驱的控制器缺乏对转子振动、气隙变形或壳体加速度的直接测量，而仅能获取dq电流、电压指令、旋变角度和转速。核心问题在于：能否仅通过这些常规信号推断或影响机械上重要的低阶振动。
AI.method: 将振动分量等效为气隙变形模式，基于磁共能的机电状态空间模型建立系统。利用有限时间格拉姆矩阵评估基于电流的可观性、基于旋变的可观性以及电压到气隙的能达性。针对被动信号退化的缺陷，引入载波主动投影技术，通过电磁载波创造额外测量与力投影，实现载波开启下的可观性与可达性。
AI.result: 分析揭示：磁链灵敏度是被动电流可观性与被动电压能达性的共同瓶颈，旋变可观性则依赖独立的扭矩投影条件。机械变形在被动dq信号中可能一阶不可见。载波主动投影能够提供侧频带特征，在有限窗口噪声和近阶干扰泄漏下仍可检测。
AI.conclusion: 被动dq信号对局部气隙变形存在观测退化，载波主动投影是突破这一瓶颈的有效途径。该框架的计算结构已通过数值研究验证，但尚需FEM校准的电机模型进行进一步验证。

title: Distributional Split Criteria for Random Forests: Extensions, Shrinkage, and the Robustness of Mean Splitting
summary: Distributional random forests replace mean-based CART splitting with criteria that compare the full conditional response distribution in candidate children. We implement and systematically study a family of such criteria inside a single honest-forest implementation: isotropic random-Fourier-feature maximum mean discrepancy (MMD), an anisotropic diagonal-bandwidth variant, an adaptive per-split frequency-selection variant, and a non-kernel sliced-Wasserstein criterion, together with post-hoc kernel-mean shrinkage of the forest weights. Using paired-seed comparisons across synthetic quantile mechanisms, real univariate benchmarks, a California-housing subsample curve, and multivariate synthetic and real responses, we characterize where each extension pays. Three findings recur. First, among distributional criteria ordinary isotropic MMD is already close to best in class: the anisotropic, adaptive-frequency, and sliced-Wasserstein extensions, and post-hoc shrinkage, do not systematically improve on it. Second, on scalar tabular regression mean-based CART splitting remains the robust default and wins many cells. Third, multivariate responses are the regime where distributional splitting clearly earns its keep, most sharply on a pure-dependence copula where the energy score separates the criteria even though marginal CRPS does not. The evidence supports a simple allocation story: distributional splitting helps only when non-location structure is both present and estimable; otherwise it dilutes split-selection power away from the mean. All criteria, the honest forest, and the paired-comparison harness are implemented in the open-source \texttt{drforest} library, whose Rust-backed split search makes broad criterion sweeps inexpensive.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了分布随机森林中多种分裂准则（各向同性MMD、各向异性变体、自适应频率选择、切片Wasserstein距离及后验核均值收缩），发现：各向同性MMD已接近最优；均值CART在单变量表格回归中仍是稳健默认方法；分布分裂仅在多元响应场景中显著优于传统方法。开源drforest库支持高效计算。
AI.motivation: 传统随机森林使用基于均值的CART分裂准则，无法捕捉响应分布中除位置参数以外的结构信息。作者希望探究用分布比较准则替代均值分裂是否能带来系统性提升，并明确在何种数据场景下这种替换是值得的。
AI.method: 在一个统一的诚实森林框架下实现了五种分布分裂准则：各向同性随机傅里叶特征MMD、各向异性对角带宽变体、自适应逐分裂频率选择变体、非核切片Wasserstein距离，以及后验核均值收缩。通过配对种子比较，在合成分位数机制、真实单变量基准、加州住房子样本曲线、以及多变量合成与真实响应上进行了系统评估。
AI.result: 1）各向同性MMD在分布准则中已接近最优，其他复杂变体及后验收缩未带来系统性改进；2）在标量表格回归上，均值CART分裂仍是稳健默认选择且多数情况下胜出；3）多元响应是分布分裂的真正优势场景，尤其在纯相依copula上，能量评分能区分各准则而边际CRPS不能。
AI.conclusion: 分布分裂仅在非位置结构存在且可估计时才有效，否则会稀释分裂选择在均值上的能力。支持一个简单的资源分配叙事：只有在多元响应等场景中，分布分裂才值得其计算开销。

title: A unified approach to non-unique fixed points via modified C-class Ciric-type contractions
summary: Fixed point theory is central to nonlinear analysis, yet classical results often assume strict contractivity and guarantee uniqueness, limiting applicability to mappings with inherently non-unique fixed points. This paper addresses this gap by introducing a modified C-class function and establishing new non-unique fixed point theorems for Ciric-type mappings in complete metric spaces. We construct a generalized contractive inequality using a three-variable modifed C-class function combined with an altering distance function. Under orbital continuity and orbital completeness, we prove that Picard iteration converges to a fixed point without requiring global Lipschitz conditions or strict contractivity. Carefully designed examples illustrate the sharpness and generality of the framework, strictly extending classical Ciric and Chatterjea contractions as well as hybrid $(Φ,ψ)$-contractions. Our main contributions are: (i) a unified framework encompassing classical and generalized C-class contractions, (ii) existence results for non-unique fixed points, (iii) a simple criterion for uniqueness when desired, and (iv) practical validation through nontrivial examples. These results provide a robust foundation for further research in nonlinear operator theory, iterative methods, and applications in optimization and variational problems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过引入改进的C类函数，在完备度量空间中为Ciric型映射建立了新的非唯一不动点定理，无需严格压缩性或全局Lipschitz条件，并通过实例验证了框架的普适性。
AI.motivation: 经典不动点理论通常要求严格压缩性并保证唯一性，这限制了其在具有内在非唯一不动点映射中的应用。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 构造了三变量改进C类函数与变距函数的广义压缩不等式，在轨道连续性和轨道完备性条件下，证明Picard迭代收敛到不动点。
AI.result: 建立了非唯一不动点存在性定理，提供了唯一性判定准则，统一并推广了经典Ciric压缩、Chatterjea压缩及混合(Φ,ψ)-压缩。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为非线形算子理论、迭代方法及优化与变分问题的进一步研究提供了坚实基础。

title: SCAIR: Schema-Conditioned Agentic Iterative Reasoning for Enterprise Knowledge Graphs
summary: Knowledge Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (KG-RAG) enables natural language interaction with structured enterprise knowledge, yet existing agentic approaches that perform well on public benchmarks often fail to generalize to real-world enterprise Knowledge Graphs (KGs), which are dense, schema-driven, and operationally constrained. To address these limitations, we propose SCAIR (Schema-Conditioned Agentic Iterative Reasoning), a training-free framework that integrates structured planning with controlled iterative reasoning by injecting schema-conditioned structural priors and enforcing schema-aware traversal during multi-hop reasoning. Experiments on an enterprise-oriented benchmark constructed from a real-world Configuration Management DataBase (CMDB) demonstrate that SCAIR substantially improves performance over existing KG-RAG methods. Crucially, our study highlights that reliable enterprise graph reasoning cannot rely on generic agentic designs; instead, it must explicitly incorporate the target domain's structural and operational constraints into the reasoning process. We demonstrate that by aligning agent design with business logic, substantial performance gains can be achieved without the need for costly model retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出SCAIR框架，通过注入模式条件的结构先验和模式感知遍历，在无需训练的情况下提升企业知识图谱的检索增强生成性能。
AI.motivation: 现有KG-RAG方法在真实企业知识图谱（密集、模式驱动、操作受限）上泛化能力差，需要专门的设计来应对企业级结构化知识的推理挑战。
AI.method: SCAIR (Schema-Conditioned Agentic Iterative Reasoning)：无训练框架，集成结构化规划与受控迭代推理，通过注入模式条件的结构先验并在多跳推理中强制执行模式感知遍历。
AI.result: 在基于真实CMDB构建的企业级基准测试上，SCAIR显著优于现有KG-RAG方法。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的企业图推理不能依赖通用智能体设计，必须显式融入目标领域的结构和操作约束；将智能体设计与业务逻辑对齐可在无需模型重训练的情况下带来显著性能提升。

title: What Softmax Throws Away: Mass-Aware Attention for Evidence Accumulation
summary:
High task performance does not show whether a model retains prediction-relevant structural information in its internal representation. Temporal graph models, for example, can achieve high future-link AUC while basic graph statistics remain difficult to recover from the same representation. We identify one source of this gap in the weighted averaging used by standard attention: when an evidence pattern is repeated, the numerator and denominator grow at the same rate, so inputs with different amounts of accumulated evidence can produce the same aggregate.
  We propose Mass-Aware Attention (MAA), which generalizes standard L1 normalization to an Lp family. Under repetition, MAA makes the numerator and denominator scale at different rates, retaining the effective number of contributing inputs in the representation magnitude. It adds no supervision, parameters, hidden dimensions, or explicit count features, and recovers standard attention at p=1.
  Across four continuous-time dynamic graph models and three datasets, MAA improves future-link AUC in 11 of 12 model-dataset cells. Linear recovery from the same hidden representation increases by 4.49% on average, and preferential-attachment recovery improves in all 12 cells after family-wise correction. We also observe consistent evidence in marked temporal point processes, temporal knowledge graphs, retrieval-augmented generation, and spatio-temporal point processes. Information accessibility and task utility remain distinct: NLL improves in MTPP, ranking is largely preserved in TKG, additional information in RAG does not improve the diagnostic head, and downstream LayerNorm can erase the signal in STPP. These results position MAA as a general normalization principle for improving predictor-facing representation informativeness by controlling repetition invariance in standard attention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Mass-Aware Attention (MAA)，通过将标准注意力的 L1 归一化推广到 Lp 族，使得重复证据模式下分子分母不同速缩放，从而保留表示中的结构性信息。MAA 无监督无参数，在时序图模型等多种任务上提升了链路预测 AUC 和线性可恢复性，同时揭示了信息可访问性与任务效用之间的区别。
AI.motivation: 标准注意力机制中，重复证据模式下分子分母同速增长，导致不同累积证据量的输入产生相同聚合结果，使得模型内部表示丢失了预测相关的结构性信息（如基本图统计量难以从表示中恢复）。
AI.method: 将标准注意力的 L1 归一化推广到 Lp 族（Mass-Aware Attention, MAA），使分子分母在重复模式下以不同速率缩放，从而在表示幅度中保留有效贡献输入的数量信息。p=1 时退化为标准注意力，无需额外监督、参数或显式计数特征。
AI.result: 在 4 个连续时序动态图模型和 3 个数据集上，MAA 在 11/12 的模型-数据集中提升未来链路 AUC；线性恢复平均提升 4.49%；优先连接恢复在所有 12 个细胞中提升（家族校正后）。在标记时序点过程、时序知识图谱、检索增强生成和时空点过程中也观察到一致证据。
AI.conclusion: 信息可访问性与任务效用是不同的概念：NLL 在 MTPP 中提升，TKG 中排序基本保留，RAG 中额外信息未改善诊断头，STPP 中下游 LayerNorm 可消除信号。MAA 作为一种通用归一化原则，通过控制标准注意力中的重复不变性来提升预测器导向的表示信息量。

title: Interview with Kalle Lyytinen on "Implications of Theories of Language for Information Systems"
summary: Over fourty years after the initial publication of "Implications of Theories of Language for Information Systems" in MIS Quaterly, Lyytinen reflects about the origins of his publication and the developments in this area of research over the past decades. In the here presented interview, Lyytinen discusses the linguistic core of information systems also in light of recent trends and developments in the field, especially with regards to large language models and generative AI. Future research directions following a linguistic perspective on Information Systems (IS) research are outlined.

AI.tldr: 一篇关于信息系统语言理论的访谈文章，Lyytinen回顾了其40多年前的经典论文，探讨了语言视角在信息系统研究中的核心地位，并讨论了大型语言模型和生成式AI等最新趋势对该领域的影响及未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 反思"语言理论对信息系统的影响"这一经典论文的起源及其40多年来的发展脉络，探讨语言视角在信息系统研究中的持续相关性，尤其是在大型语言模型和生成式AI兴起的背景下。
AI.method: 采用访谈形式，由Lyytinen回顾和反思其经典论文的起源、发展历程，并结合当前技术趋势（如大语言模型、生成式AI）进行讨论，最后展望未来研究方向。
AI.result: 揭示了信息系统研究中语言视角的持续重要性，以及在AI时代下的新应用方向；指出了大语言模型和生成式AI如何重新定义信息系统的语言核心。
AI.conclusion: 语言视角仍然对信息系统研究具有核心价值，未来应结合大型语言模型等新兴技术进一步拓展该研究领域。

title: Grid-Forming Enhanced STATCOMs for Wind Power Plant Stability: Design, Modeling, and Control
comment: -11 pages and 9 figures -Presented and published in CIGRE: Grid of the Future Symposium 2025
summary: The increasing integration of renewable energy sources (RES) into modern power systems, particularly in weak grid environments, demands advanced solutions for voltage and frequency stability. This paper demonstrates that Enhanced STATCOMs (E-STATCOMs) with grid-forming capabilities outperform synchronous condensers (Syncons) in wind farm applications. Using a power-admittance-based linear modeling framework and validated through detailed EMT simulations, the study shows that E-STATCOMs provide superior damping of sub-synchronous resonance (SSR), faster dynamic response, and effective suppression of DC components, transient overvoltages, and new oscillatory modes introduced by series compensation. Unlike Syncons, which are limited by mechanical inertia, E-STATCOMs offer tunable control, virtual impedance emulation, and scalable fault current support. These advantages make E-STATCOMs a more robust and flexible solution for stabilizing renewable-dominated grids, especially those with long transmission lines and series compensation. The paper also aims to provide a benchmark E-STATCOM design criterion that enables stakeholders, such as transmission system operators (TSOs), to assess its suitability without the need for exhaustive EMT simulations.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了具备构网能力的增强型STATCOM（E-STATCOM）在风电场应用中优于同步调相机（Syncon），能提供更好的次同步谐振阻尼、更快的动态响应，并有效抑制直流分量、暂态过电压及串补引入的新振荡模态。与受限于机械惯性的Syncon不同，E-STATCOM具备可调控制、虚拟阻抗仿真和可扩展的故障电流支持，是稳定可再生能源主导电网的更强健、更灵活的解决方案。
AI.motivation: 高比例可再生能源并网（尤其在弱电网环境下）对电压和频率稳定性提出了严峻挑战，亟需更先进的解决方案来替代传统同步调相机等设备。
AI.method: 采用基于功率导纳的线性建模框架，并通过详细的电磁暂态（EMT）仿真进行验证，对比E-STATCOM与同步调相机在风电场应用中的性能。
AI.result: E-STATCOM在次同步谐振阻尼、动态响应速度、直流分量抑制、暂态过电压抑制以及串补引入的新振荡模态抑制方面均优于同步调相机。
AI.conclusion: E-STATCOM是一种比同步调相机更鲁棒、更灵活的解决方案，适用于可再生能源主导的电网稳定，尤其适合长输电线路和串补场景。同时提出了基准E-STATCOM设计准则，帮助TSO无需详尽EMT仿真即可评估其适用性。

title: On Non-Stationary Dynamic Pricing: Adaptivity and Optimality
summary: We study the contextual dynamic pricing problem under non-stationarity, where a firm sells products to $T$ sequentially arriving consumers that behave according to an unknown demand model that can change over time. The demand model is assumed to be a generalized linear model (GLM), allowing for a feature vector in $\mathbb{R}^d$ that encodes products and consumer information. To achieve optimal revenue (i.e., least regret), the firm needs to learn and exploit the unknown GLMs while monitoring for potential changes. We propose a multiscale change-point detection based algorithm that achieves a regret of order $\widetilde{O}(\sqrt{s_TdT}\wedge\{V_T^{1/3}d^{1/3}T^{2/3}+\sqrt{dT}\})$, where $s_T$ is the number of piecewise stationary segments and $V_T$ is a newly defined notion of design-adjusted variation budget of model parameters. Our algorithm is adaptive and does not require knowing $s_T$ or $V_T$. Moreover, to our knowledge, this is the first dynamic pricing algorithm that is adaptive to the nature of changes and achieves the best-of-both-worlds rate, thus closing a long-standing gap in the literature. We remark that, due to the varying contexts, existing works in the adaptive non-stationary bandit literature cannot be applied to achieve optimality for contextual dynamic pricing. The regret is further accompanied with a newly constructed minimax lower bound, confirming the optimality of our algorithm (up to logarithmic factors). Extensive numerical experiments are conducted to illustrate the efficiency and robustness of the proposed algorithm in non-stationary dynamic pricing.

AI.tldr: 本文针对非平稳环境下的上下文动态定价问题，提出了一种基于多尺度变点检测的自适应算法，首次实现了最优的“两全其美”遗憾界，并给出了匹配的极小化下界。
AI.motivation: 现实中的动态定价常面临消费者需求模型随时间变化（非平稳性）的问题，现有方法要么无法适应变化，要么依赖已知变化参数（如分段数），缺乏既能自适应变化又能达到最优遗憾的算法。
AI.method: 提出多尺度变点检测算法，在广义线性模型（GLM）框架下，通过设计自适应变化预算（V_T）和新颖的检测机制，在不预知变化次数或预算的情况下动态调整学习与利用策略。
AI.result: 取得了 ~O(√(s_T d T) ∧ (V_T^{1/3} d^{1/3} T^{2/3} + √(dT))) 的遗憾界，并构造了匹配的极小化下界，证明了算法在 log 因子意义下的最优性。
AI.conclusion: 该算法首次在上下文动态定价中实现了自适应的“两全其美”速率，填补了理论空白；数值实验验证了算法的效率和鲁棒性。

title: State-dependent error correlations shape voting thresholds in committees of AI agents
summary: The aggregation benefit of a committee of artificial intelligence (AI) agents comes from complementary information across members. Classical voting guarantees assume independent errors. Language-model errors often co-occur on the same cases. We combine Sah-Stiglitz screening with error dependence that can differ between good and bad cases. In a homogeneous exchangeable Gaussian-copula model, shared errors create a positive asymptotic error floor for majority voting and can change the approval threshold that minimizes expected loss. We estimate a heterogeneous extension from 174,384 votes cast by 28 language models on four binary-screening benchmarks. Parameters estimated from odd-indexed items predicted committee loss on even-indexed items. For the sampled committee composition, the full-matrix dependence model increased identity-line R^2 from 0.840 under independence to 0.967. In a design-balanced analysis, cost-sensitive threshold selection under independence reduced scaled loss from 60.25 for majority to 52.50. Modeling dependence reduced it further to 50.77, an incremental improvement of 1.73 units (95% bootstrap CI, 0.68-2.33). The overall reduction from majority was 15.73% (95% bootstrap CI, 13.41-16.75%).

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了语言模型委员会投票中的误差依赖性问题。通过Sah-Stiglitz筛选框架和高斯copula模型，发现共享误差会导致多数投票出现正渐近误差下限。基于28个语言模型在四个基准上的174,384次投票实验，表明建模误差依赖能将预测R²从0.840提升至0.967，损失从多数投票的60.25降至50.77（降幅15.73%）。
AI.motivation: 传统投票理论假设委员间误差独立，但语言模型的错误往往在同一样本上共现。作者旨在量化这种误差依赖对委员会聚合收益的影响，并开发能有效建模依赖性的统计方法，以提升AI委员会决策的准确性。
AI.method: 采用Sah-Stiglitz筛选框架扩展至异方差依赖场景；使用可交换高斯copula建模同质误差依赖，并估计异质扩展模型；在28个语言模型、4个基准（共174,384票）上实验，用奇偶项交叉验证评估损失。
AI.result: 全矩阵依赖模型的R²从独立模型的0.840提升至0.967；考虑依赖性的阈值选择将损失从独立模型的52.50降至50.77，比多数投票的60.25降低15.73%（95% CI: 13.41-16.75%）。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型投票委员会的误差依赖显著影响聚合效果，建模依赖性能带来统计上与实务上显著的改进。这对设计AI聚合决策机制（如阈值选择）具有重要指导意义。

title: Optimality of a Threshold Policy for a Queueing System with One Fast Server and Two Identical Slow Servers
summary:
This paper studies the optimal control problem of a queueing system with three servers: one fast server and two identical slow servers. The two-server version of this problem, with one fast server and one slow server, was introduced by Lin and Kumar (1984), and the optimal policy has been shown to be of threshold type. However, generalizing this result beyond the two-server setting has been considered an open problem. In this paper, we resolve the first nontrivial case by proving that a threshold policy is optimal for the three-server system considered.
  The core technical ideas in this paper are generated by GPT-5.5 Pro. We have included a short report describing the authors' interactions with GPT-5.5 Pro. The authors verified the proofs and rewrote the paper for better rigor, clarity, and exposition. In addition, three key lemmas have also been verified in Lean 4.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个三服务器排队系统（一个快速服务器，两个相同慢速服务器）的最优控制问题，证明了阈值策略是最优的，并使用了GPT-5.5 Pro辅助生成技术思路，部分引理用Lean 4进行了形式化验证。
AI.motivation: 解决Lin和Kumar (1984)提出的两服务器阈值策略在三服务器场景下是否仍然最优的开放问题，将结果推广到更一般的多服务器情形。
AI.method: 利用GPT-5.5 Pro生成核心技术思路，作者验证并重写证明以保证严谨性，同时使用Lean 4对三个关键引理进行形式化验证。
AI.result: 证明了阈值策略在三个服务器（一个快速、两个慢速）的排队系统中是最优的，解决了该问题的第一个非平凡情形。
AI.conclusion: 阈值策略在三服务器排队系统中仍然最优，为多服务器拓展提供了基础，同时展示了AI辅助数学研究的一种实践模式。

title: Schema-Aware Localisation (SAL): Live Schema Grounding and Hallucination Validation for Oracle NL2SQL
summary: Large language models can generate fluent SQL from natural language, but on real enterprise Oracle databases they frequently fail at execution time: columns and aliases are hallucinated and dialect-specific syntax is missed, leading to ORA-00904 invalid-identifier errors. In this setting, failures are primarily due to missing schema grounding: the model cannot know which tables and columns actually exist. This paper introduces Schema-Aware Localisation (SAL), a lightweight middleware layer for Oracle NL2SQL that requires no model retraining. SAL queries Oracle's USER_TAB_COLUMNS catalog to build a live schema map, selects a relevant table subset for each question (falling back to the full schema for multi-table queries), and injects this ground-truth context into the LLM prompt. Generated SQL is then checked by the Hallucination Index (Hidx), which validates every alias.column reference against the live catalog, automatically rewrites predictable prefix errors, and otherwise triggers a structured retry with itemised corrections. We evaluate SAL on 500 TPC-H natural language questions executed against a live Oracle Autonomous Database 23c instance using GPT-4o-mini. Without any schema grounding, execution-grounded truth (EGT; executes and matches the reference result set) is 2.2% (12/500). A hand-written static schema hint brings EGT to 62.0%. SAL, with no manual schema curation, achieves 62.6% EGT (96% simple, 95% medium, 40.7% complex) while reducing execution failures from 97.6% to 2.6%.

AI.tldr: 针对Oracle NL2SQL中列名幻觉和方言错误导致执行失败的问题，本文提出SAL中间件：实时查询Oracle的USER_TAB_COLUMNS构建动态schema，通过Hallucination Index（Hidx）验证别名.列引用并自动改写错误，无需模型重训。在TPC-H数据集上，SAL使执行准确率从2.2%提升至62.6%，执行失败率从97.6%降至2.6%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在Oracle企业数据库上生成SQL时频繁执行失败，主要因为列名和别名幻觉（ORA-00904错误）以及方言语法错误，根本原因是模型缺乏对真实数据库schema的感知。
AI.method: SAL中间件：1）实时查询USER_TAB_COLUMNS构建动态schema；2）为每个问题选取相关表子集（多表查询回退全量schema）；3）将真实schema注入LLM提示词；4）Hidx验证SQL中所有别名.列引用，自动改写可预测的前缀错误，否则触发结构化重试。
AI.result: 在500个TPC-H问题/Oracle 23c/GPT-4o-mini上：无schema grounding仅2.2% EGT，静态schema hint为62.0%，SAL达62.6%（简单96%、中等95%、复杂40.7%），执行失败率从97.6%降至2.6%。
AI.conclusion: SAL通过轻量级实时schema感知中间件，在不重训模型的情况下显著提升了Oracle NL2SQL的执行准确率，有效解决了schema幻觉导致的执行失败问题。

title: Optimizing Transformer Neural Network for Real-Time Outlier Detection on FPGAs
summary:
In this work, we explore how the inference time of a Transformer Neural Network can be efficiently optimized with applications to real-time anomaly detection in financial time series. The financial time series are price series such as asset prices. Unfortunately, the data is often with errors or outliers that make the downstream data processing tasks useless, unstable or even harmful. Moreover, the amount of financial time-series data has been significantly increasing. Hence, there is a need for better data-cleaning methods in terms of accuracy and in terms of processing speed.
  Transformers as a neural network architecture have achieved superior performances in many tasks such as Natural Language Processing and Computer Vision. Time series modelling and especially anomaly detection tasks can benefit from the features of transformers architecture in multiple ways, including the capacity to capture long-range dependencies and interactions.
  Increasingly powerful hardware, such as field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs), have seen increasing usage in recent years due to their reconfigurability and high performance. They can be efficiently utilized to speed up the computations of the Transformer architecture.
  We explore different Transformer architectures for time series modelling and how they can be efficiently implemented on an FPGA board (PYNQ-Z2). In particular, we examine the application of Transformers to detect anomalies in time series and we show how they can be efficiently implemented on an FPGA board to minimize latency.
  The code is available at https://github.com/thxi/icl_thesis

AI.tldr: 本文研究了如何通过FPGA优化Transformer推理时间，用于金融时间序列的实时异常检测，并提供了开源代码。
AI.motivation: 金融时间序列数据存在错误和异常值，且数据量激增，现有数据处理方法在准确性和速度上均需改进。
AI.method: 探索不同Transformer架构用于时间序列建模，并在FPGA板（PYNQ-Z2）上进行高效实现以最小化延迟。
AI.result: 展示了Transformer在时间序列异常检测中的应用效果，以及FPGA实现相比传统方案在推理速度上的优势。
AI.conclusion: FPGA加速的Transformer架构可以有效应对金融时间序列实时异常检测的准确性和速度需求。

title: Beyond a Global Norm: Personalizing Toxicity Sensitivity in Language Models Without Retraining
summary: Reducing toxicity is often framed as a global alignment problem, yet perceptions of harmful language are subjective and context-dependent. We present the first comparative evaluation of training-free methods for aligning language generation to user-specific toxicity sensitivities across three inference-time intervention stages: pre-decoding (prompt conditioning and rewriting), in-decoding (token, logit, and representation steering), and post-decoding (candidate re-ranking). Evaluated against toxicity sensitivity targets derived from the PRISM dataset, all methods reduce alignment error by 28-47%. However, the results reveal a fundamental trade-off between alignment effectiveness, personalization, and general language quality, showing how toxicity sensitivity alignment is an inherently multi-objective problem.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统比较了无需训练的推理阶段对齐方法，用于将语言生成与用户特定的毒性敏感度对齐。实验发现所有方法均能将对齐误差降低28-47%，但揭示了对齐效果、个性化和语言质量之间的根本性权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有毒性减少研究通常将问题视为全局对齐，忽视了用户对有害语言感知的主观性和上下文依赖性，缺乏对训练无关方法的系统性比较。
AI.method: 在推理阶段的三个干预环节（预解码、解码中、后解码）上，系统评估了多种无需训练的对齐方法，并以PRISM数据集的毒性敏感度目标为基准进行对比实验。
AI.result: 所有方法均能将对齐误差降低28-47%，但存在对齐效果、个性化程度与语言质量之间的多目标权衡。
AI.conclusion: 毒性敏感度对齐本质上是一个多目标优化问题，不同推理阶段的对齐方法各有优劣，无法同时最优地兼顾所有目标。

title: Analytics for the Optimization of the Soybean Oil Purification Process
comment: This is the author's accepted version of a paper published in: IECON 2023- 49th Annual Conference of the IEEE Industrial Electronics Society
summary: Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, among others, are very promising methodologies and technologies that are emerging for implementing a broad spectrum of analytics within digitalized eco-systems. Analytics containing adequate analytical models are generating a burgeoning interest from Business Intelligence-, Information Technology (IT)- and Operational Technology (OT)-professionals, who are able to exploit the huge amount of internally and externally available data and information that lies behind digitalized components and systems and their associated processes. In this paper, the authors present the essential specifications of an analytical model developed and implemented applying the Knowldege Discovery in Databases (KDD) approach. The analytical model is the essential part of an analytics component, positioned as an digitalized asset within an Industry 4.0 compliant (RAMI 4.0) infrastructure, and used to optimize the industrial Soybean Oil Purification Process associated to the digitalized eco-system.

AI.tldr: 本文基于KDD方法开发了一个分析模型，作为工业4.0（RAMI 4.0）基础设施中的数字化资产，用于优化大豆油纯化过程。
AI.motivation: 利用机器学习和人工智能等新兴技术，挖掘数字化生态系统中海量内外部数据与信息的价值，以优化工业流程。
AI.method: 采用知识发现（KDD）方法，开发并实现了一个分析模型，该模型作为分析组件的核心，部署在符合工业4.0（RAMI 4.0）标准的基础设施中。
AI.result: 成功开发了用于优化工业大豆油纯化过程的分析模型，并集成到数字化生态系统中。
AI.conclusion: 该分析模型能够有效利用工业4.0环境下的数据资源，为业务流程优化提供支撑。

title: Minimax Lower Bounds of Kernel Discrepancy Estimation: MMD, HSIC, KSD
summary: Over the past 20 years, kernel discrepancies have been leveraged as a highly powerful tool for quantifying the disagreement of distributions, with numerous successful applications in two-sample, goodness-of-fit, and independence testing, among others. Their fastest estimators are known to converge at a parametric rate---$n^{-1/2}$---under mild conditions. While this rate is known to be minimax optimal on $\mathbb R^d$ under strict assumptions with bounded kernels, little is known about its optimality beyond the finite-dimensional Euclidean setting with unbounded kernels. In this work, we prove that the minimax lower bound of estimation of the most popular kernel discrepancies (maximum mean discrepancy, Hilbert-Schmidt independence criterion and kernel Stein discrepancy; MMD, HSIC, KSD) is $n^{-1/2}$ on general topological spaces, and under mild assumptions on the kernel; the same rates are shown (as corollaries) to hold for the estimation of the mean embedding and the centered cross-covariance operator. Our results settle the question of optimal estimation of these kernel discrepancies.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，在一般拓扑空间和温和核函数假设下，MMD、HSIC、KSD等核差异量的估计极小极大下界为n^{-1/2}，从而解决了这些核差异量最优估计的问题。
AI.motivation: 以往核差异量的估计量在有限维欧氏空间且有界核条件下已知达到n^{-1/2}的极小极大最优率，但在更一般的拓扑空间及无界核情形下其最优性未知。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 通过理论推导，在一般拓扑空间上，对核函数施加温和假设，证明MMD、HSIC、KSD的估计极小极大下界为n^{-1/2}，并推论该结果也适用于均值嵌入和中心化互协方差算子的估计。
AI.result: 证明了在一般拓扑空间和温和核假设下，MMD、HSIC、KSD的估计极小极大下界为n^{-1/2}，该速率与已有上界匹配，确认为最优。
AI.conclusion: 系统性地解决了核差异量（MMD、HSIC、KSD）在一般拓扑空间上的最优估计问题，为该领域的理论基础提供了重要补充。

title: On Capturing the Narrative: Social Media Manipulation Wargaming for Cyberliteracy
comment: 7 pages, 1 figure. Paper is under review
summary: Misinformation is deeply embedded in online discourse, with nearly one in five posts during global events generated by bots that amplify false content. In recent years, the use of Generative AI has further lowered the barrier to producing convincing misinformation, yet most digital literacy education still relies on static checklists and single-player inoculation games built for an earlier media landscape. This paper describes how we addressed this educational gap through Capture the Narrative, a four-week multi-university competition in which student teams build LLM-powered bots to influence a simulated election. We report on our custom social-media platform, the competition environment and design of its 4,000 AI-driven Non-Player Character (NPC) citizens, and what running Capture the Narrative at scale actually involved. In our first iteration, 108 teams from 18 Australian universities produced 7,068,206 player-bot posts, approximately 60% of all platform content. We surveyed 256 students before and 83 after the competition to understand their perceptions of misinformation and the game itself and found that students did not become more confident at spotting bots, contrary to what inoculation theory predicts. Because engagement was rewarded, most teams prioritised high-volume posting over nuanced influence, mirroring real-world platform dynamics. We close with recommendations for educators considering similar interventions, and propose future improvements, such as including a blue-team defensive phase.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一项名为"Capture the Narrative"的多大学竞赛，学生团队构建LLM驱动的机器人以影响模拟选举。108支队伍在定制平台上发布了超过700万条帖子，但研究发现参与竞赛并未提升学生识别机器人的能力，反而因为奖励机制鼓励了高量发帖而非精准影响，反映了现实社交媒体的动态。
AI.motivation: 现有数字素养教育仍依赖静态清单和单人游戏，未能跟上生成式AI降低虚假信息制造门槛的现状，存在教育方法上的空白。
AI.method: 设计并实施了为期四周的多大学竞赛，学生团队构建LLM驱动的机器人影响模拟选举；开发了定制社交媒体平台，包含4000个AI驱动的NPC公民；对256名参与者进行了前后问卷调查。
AI.result: 108支队伍来自18所澳大利亚大学，产生了7,068,206条玩家机器人帖子（占平台内容约60%）；学生并未因参与而提高识别机器人的能力；多数团队倾向于高量发帖而非精准影响。
AI.conclusion: 竞赛验证了该方法的可行性，但发现奖励机制导致了与现实平台相似的负面动态；提出了未来改进方向（如增加蓝队防御阶段）和对教育工作者的建议。

title: Randomized Constructive Heuristics for the VRPTW: A Focus on Regret-k
summary: The Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (VRPTW) requires a fleet of capacitated vehicles to serve customers within strict time windows while minimizing total travel time. Constructive heuristics are fundamental for generating solutions and commonly serve as starting points for metaheuristics such as Iterated Local Search (ILS), Genetic Algorithms, and Ant Colony Optimization (ACO). This work studies three classical constructive heuristics - Nearest Neighbor, Best Insertion, and Regret-k - within a randomized, multi-start framework, a setting that remains largely under-explored despite their well-established deterministic use. We address how to effectively randomize these heuristics and, in particular, propose a novel randomization of Regret-k by separating the ''who'' (which customer to insert next) and ''where'' (insertion position) decisions, applying a probabilistic selection proportional to the regret value to preserve the heuristic's foresight while injecting the diversity needed for a multi-start approach. We further study the impact of combining these greedy randomized constructions with Local Search and ACO. Experiments follow the DIMACS 2021 conventions (integer, truncated Euclidean distances) on the Solomon and Gehring \& Homberger benchmarks (100--1000 customers), comparing against the Best-Known Solutions and the state-of-the-art Hybrid Genetic Search solver, with all critical components implemented in modern C++ and bound to Python via pybind11. To the best of our knowledge, the randomization of Regret-k has never been examined; our analysis highlights the trade-off between solution quality and computational cost, providing a preliminary step toward hybrid methods (ACO, ILS, Branch-and-Price) for the Time-Dependent VRPTW within the MAMUT project.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了VRPTW问题中三种经典构造式启发式算法（最近邻、最佳插入、Regret-k）在随机化多起点框架下的表现，提出了一种新颖的Regret-k随机化方法（将"谁"和"哪里"决策分离，基于后悔值概率选择），并探索了与局部搜索和蚁群优化的结合效果。
AI.motivation: 尽管三种构造式启发式算法在确定性使用中已非常成熟，但它们在随机化多起点框架下的表现尚未被充分探索。尤其是Regret-k的随机化方法此前未见研究，作者希望填补这一空白，并为后续混合方法（如ACO、ILS、Branch-and-Price）奠定基础。
AI.method: 1) 将最近邻、最佳插入、Regret-k三种启发式算法置于随机化多起点框架中；2) 提出将Regret-k的"选择哪个客户"和"插入到什么位置"两个决策分离，基于后悔值进行概率选择以保留前瞻性同时增加多样性；3) 结合局部搜索和蚁群优化；4) 遵循DIMACS 2021约定，使用整数截断欧氏距离，在Solomon和Gehring & Homberger基准（100-1000客户）上实验。
AI.result: 通过对比已知最优解和最新的Hybrid Genetic Search求解器，分析了随机化多起点框架下三种启发式算法的解质量与计算成本之间的权衡。Regret-k随机化作为首次提出的方法，展示了其有效性和多样性注入能力。
AI.conclusion: 随机化Regret-k是一种有前景的方法，在保持启发式前向性的同时增加了多样性。本研究为MAMUT项目中时间依赖VRPTW的混合方法（ACO、ILS、Branch-and-Price）提供了初步基础，突显了解质量与计算开销之间的权衡关系。

title: PhononBench-MP40: a spectrum-resolved benchmark dataset for phonon stability
summary: Imaginary phonon modes remain a practical bottleneck in computational materials screening because otherwise plausible structures can be locally dynamically unstable under a chosen workflow. Here we present PhononBench-MP40, a spectrum-resolved benchmark dataset of Materials Project-derived crystals for workflow-defined phonon stability. The dataset starts from 47,969 MP40 workflow tasks and provides 46,899 completed records with paired stability labels and local phonopy YAML spectra, including 16,683 Stable records and 30,216 completed-phonon unstable records. A further 1,067 relaxation failures are reported separately rather than merged into the completed phonon denominator. The release centers on the local YAML spectrum: the stability label, the lowest sampled frequency and any threshold-dependent relabeling are derived from that spectrum. The dataset is openly available through Science Data Bank at https://doi.org/10.57760/sciencedb.38735. A companion GitHub repository provides the calculation code and lightweight access utilities. PhononBench-MP40 provides an auditable reference for workflow-defined stability classification, minimum-frequency analysis, threshold studies and failure-aware triage, while keeping the reference workflow, data schema and interpretation boundaries explicit.

AI.tldr: 提出了PhononBench-MP40基准数据集，包含46,899条来自Materials Project的声子稳定性记录及其YAML谱图，用于计算材料筛选中虚声子模式的基准测试。
AI.motivation: 虚声子模式是计算材料筛选中的实际瓶颈，即看似合理的结构在特定工作流程下可能局部动态不稳定。现有缺乏一个光谱分辨的基准数据集来系统评估工作流定义的声子稳定性。
AI.method: 从47,969个MP40工作流任务出发，生成了46,899条完成记录，包含稳定性标签和局部phonopy YAML谱图。记录了16,683条稳定记录和30,216条完成声子计算但不稳定的记录，另有1,067条弛豫失败单独报告。
AI.result: 构建了PhononBench-MP40数据集，以局部YAML谱图为核心，从中导出稳定性标签、最低采样频率及阈值相关的重新标记。数据集通过Science Data Bank公开发布，并配有GitHub代码仓库。
AI.conclusion: PhononBench-MP40为工作流定义的稳定性分类、最低频率分析、阈值研究和可审计的失效分类提供了参考基准，并明确了参考工作流、数据模式和解释边界。

title: FMOPF: Latent Flow Matching with Constraint-Aware Interaction Priors for AC Optimal Power Flow
summary: AC optimal power flow determines the minimum-cost generation dispatch under nonlinear power balance constraints and is solved thousands of times daily in electricity market operations. Learning a direct mapping from load conditions to OPF solutions can accelerate this computation, yet with deepening renewable penetration, a single optimal dispatch is no longer sufficient. Operators require a characterization of the distribution of feasible near-optimal solutions for risk quantification, sensitivity analysis, and multi-objective trade-off assessment. Supervised neural networks provide fast point predictions but cannot capture this conditional distribution. Diffusion-based generative models can sample diverse solutions in principle, yet existing methods operating in the raw state space exhibit degraded solution quality and fail to scale beyond medium-sized systems. We identify the root cause as the conflation of two distinct tasks within a single model. Compressing the high-dimensional OPF solution manifold is one task, and learning the conditional mapping from loads to that manifold is another. This paper presents FMOPF, a framework that resolves this conflation by decoupling compression from generation through latent flow matching and by explicitly modeling load-state coupling through a Constraint-Aware Interaction Prior Network. Experiments on four IEEE test systems demonstrate that FMOPF provides the most effective Newton-Raphson warm starts, achieves the lowest tail risk among generative methods, and is the first such method to scale to systems with several hundred buses while preserving full feasibility. Ablation studies confirm that the latent generation pipeline is a necessary condition for physical feasibility and that the interaction prior functions as a late-stage tail-risk controller.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FMOPF框架，通过解耦压缩与生成（使用潜流匹配）和约束感知交互先验网络，解决了现有扩散模型在生成可行近优OPF解时质量差、无法扩展到大系统的问题，在四个IEEE测试系统上实现了最优的Newton-Raphson热启动、最低的尾部风险以及首个可扩展到数百节点系统的方法。
AI.motivation: 随着可再生能源渗透率加深，电力系统运营商不仅需要单一最优调度解，还需要可行近优解的分布来进行风险量化、灵敏度分析和多目标权衡评估。现有监督神经网络只能提供点预测，扩散模型虽能采样多样化解但解质量差且无法扩展到中大型系统，根本原因是混淆了高维OPF解流形压缩和条件映射生成这两个不同任务。
AI.method: 提出FMOPF框架，核心思路是解耦压缩与生成：1）通过潜流匹配（latent flow matching）在低维潜空间中进行生成，避免在高维原始状态空间中直接建模；2）设计约束感知交互先验网络（Constraint-Aware Interaction Prior Network）显式建模负荷与状态之间的耦合关系，作为尾部风险控制器。
AI.result: 在四个IEEE测试系统上的实验表明：FMOPF提供了最有效的Newton-Raphson热启动方案；在生成方法中达到了最低的尾部风险；是首个能扩展到数百节点系统并保持完全可行性的生成方法。消融实验证实潜空间生成流水线是物理可行性的必要条件，交互先验网络起到尾部风险控制的作用。
AI.conclusion: 通过将高维解流形压缩与条件生成解耦，FMOPF有效解决了现有生成模型在OPF问题上的可扩展性和解质量瓶颈，为大规模电力系统提供了一种兼具物理可行性、低尾部风险和良好可扩展性的多样化解生成方案。

title: IndicTalk: A Large-Scale Persona-Based Multilingual Conversational Corpus for Indic Languages
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed conversational AI, yet high-quality multilingual code-mixed dialogue resources remain scarce, particularly for Indic languages where speakers naturally alternate between English and their native language in both native-script and Romanized forms. We present IndicTalk, one of the largest multilingual Indic code-mixed conversational corpora, comprising over 13,28,604 event-grounded multi-turn conversations across 18 language varieties covering 9 Indic languages. The corpus is generated through a fully automated pipeline that combines real-world news grounding, persona-conditioned dialogue generation using multilingual LLMs, and automatic quality validation. Extensive linguistic, automatic, and human evaluations demonstrate that IndicTalk produces fluent, coherent, and naturally code-mixed conversations across both script variants. We will release IndicTalk to support the development and evaluation of multilingual conversational AI for underrepresented Indic languages. The dataset is available at: https://huggingface.co/datasets/LingoIITGN/IndicTalk .

AI.tldr: IndicTalk是一个包含13,28,604段多轮对话的大规模多语言印地语代码混合对话语料库，覆盖9种印度语言的18种语言变体，通过自动化流程生成并经过严格质量验证。
AI.motivation: 高质量的多语言代码混合对话资源稀缺，特别是对于印度语言（涉及本地文字和罗马化形式混合使用的情况），现有数据不足以支持多语言对话AI的发展。
AI.method: 采用全自动流水线：1) 基于真实新闻事件作为对话背景；2) 使用多语言LLM进行人物人格条件化对话生成；3) 自动质量验证。覆盖9种印度语言的18种变体（含本地文字和罗马化形式）。
AI.result: 产生了13,28,604段多轮对话；语言、自动化和人工评估均表明对话流畅、连贯、自然代码混合，两种文字变体均表现良好。
AI.conclusion: IndicTalk可作为支持欠代表性印度语言的多语言对话AI开发与评估的重要资源，数据集将在Hugging Face上公开发布。

title: The role of symmetries on the stability of power grids
summary: The stability of power grids principally depends on the synchronization of multiple generating units. So far, the relationship between grid stability and symmetries remains unclear. This article fills in the research gap by innovatively using the mathematical tool of group theory. We find that grid symmetries involve two aspects-network and component symmetries, which reflect the homogeneities of network structures and generating units, respectively. As disclosed, the stability of power grids has a tight bearing on network and component symmetries, where corresponding automorphism group and symmetric subgroup orders reflect their levels of symmetries, respectively. In the perspective of network symmetries, where grid stability and synchronization speed are dictated by the algebraic connectivity, the stability ranking list of grids with four generators is K4 > C4 > K13 > R4 > P4 > X4, which fully agrees with that of network symmetries. In terms of component symmetries, the stability of power grids largely benefits from improved component symmetries yet with R4 as an exceptional case, where it is recommended to avoid the centralized effort of a single generator. These conclusions have significant implications for the control of modern power grids with distributed resources and controllable generators, including energy storage and renewable power generators interfaced by grid-following/-forming converters.

AI.tldr: 本文利用群论这一数学工具，研究了电网稳定性与对称性之间的关系，发现网络对称性和组件对称性分别通过代数连通性和对称子群阶数影响电网稳定性，并给出了不同拓扑结构的稳定性排序。
AI.motivation: 此前电网稳定性与对称性之间的关系尚不明确，本文旨在填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 创新性地运用群论数学工具，将电网对称性分解为网络对称性和组件对称性两个维度，分别利用自同构群阶数和对称子群阶数量化对称性水平，通过比较不同拓扑结构的电网进行稳定性分析。
AI.result: 在四发电机电网中，稳定性排序为K4 > C4 > K13 > R4 > P4 > X4，该排序与网络对称性排序完全一致；组件对称性提升通常有利于稳定性，但R4是例外情况，建议避免单发电机过度集中出力。
AI.conclusion: 电网稳定性与网络对称性和组件对称性密切相关，这一发现对含有分布式资源（如储能、可再生能源发电机及并网变流器）的现代电网控制具有重要指导意义。

title: proxymate: Diagnosis and Adjustment of Proxy Estimates for Reliable Inference
summary:
Proxy outcomes (such as short-term behavioral signals, model predictions, or surrogate endpoints) are frequently used in place of primary outcomes that are too slow to mature, rare, or challenging to measure directly. But valid inference on a proxy does not guarantee valid inference on the primary estimate as proxy-based estimates can be systematically biased in ways that are difficult to predict, leading to improperly calibrated confidence intervals.
  We present proxymate, a framework and open-source Python package for proxy validation and adjustment. proxymate organizes into four levels: The Representativity Level (population validity), the Unit Level (measurement quality), the Estimate Level (decision validity), and the Domain Level (cross-domain transportability). Within each level, proxymate provides diagnostic checks, and targeted adjustment strategies that map specific failures to appropriate corrections.
  At Meta, proxymate has been adopted by many different use cases, spanning experimentation, prevalence estimation, and monitoring use cases, all facing different proxy challenges (limited human review time, long maturation window of outcomes, low detectability) and showcasing the modularity of the framework. Across all products, proxymate assessed and corrected millions of proxy, primary unit comparisons. It has facilitated launches across multiple work streams including enabling quick decision making on thousands of experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 proxymate 框架，用于代理指标（如短期行为信号、模型预测或替代终点）的验证与校正。该框架分为四个层级（代表性、单位、估计、领域），提供诊断检查和针对性调整策略。在 Meta 内部已应用于实验、估计和监控等多种场景，评估并纠正了数百万个代理-真实指标对比，加速了决策流程。
AI.motivation: 代理指标虽然常用，但基于代理的推断可能存在系统性偏差，导致置信区间校准不当。需要一套系统化的验证和调整方法，以确保从代理指标到主要指标的推断是有效且可靠的。
AI.method: proxymate 框架包含四个层级：(1) 代表性层级 - 评估代理与目标在总体层面的匹配度；(2) 单位层级 - 评估测量质量；(3) 估计层级 - 评估决策有效性；(4) 领域层级 - 评估跨领域可迁移性。每个层级提供诊断检查及针对性校正策略。
AI.result: 在 Meta 内部，proxymate 已应用于实验、流行率估计和监控等场景，处理了不同代理挑战（如有限的人工审核时间、长结果成熟窗口、低可检测性）。总计评估和纠正了数百万个代理-主要单位对比，支持了数千个实验的快速决策。
AI.conclusion: proxymate 为代理指标的验证和校正提供了一个模块化、系统化的框架，能够有效识别并纠正代理偏差，已在工业实践中证明了其大规模应用的可行性和价值。

title: Beyond Local Inspection: Global, Guideline-Grounded Evaluation of Post-hoc XAI Methods for ECG Classification
summary: Explainable AI (XAI) is used to assess whether artificial intelligence models rely on meaningful patterns, yet explanations that appear plausible for individual predictions may systematically misrepresent model behavior. This is particularly problematic in medicine, where models may rely on irrelevant signal characteristics rather than disease-specific patterns without being recognizable. We address this challenge using electrocardiogram (ECG) data, for which clinical guidelines provide explicit knowledge about diagnostically relevant signal regions. We introduce a global, guideline-grounded framework that aggregates explanations across heartbeats to evaluate them against clinically defined regions of interest. Using four binary classifiers trained on PTB-XL, we assess 13 gradient-based methods across two categories of patterns: low-amplitude segments and high-amplitude QRS morphology. Our results reveal a systematic failure of methods transferred from computer vision. Their explanations often follow signal amplitude rather than clinical relevance, with mean Spearman correlations up to 0.69, leading them to overlook diagnostically decisive low-amplitude regions. For ischemia, LRP-$ε$ assigns only 4.6% of relevance to the ST segment, compared with 63.8% for LRP-SIGN. Nine of 13 methods fall below chance for at least one condition, indicating inconsistent reliability across patterns. These findings show that global, domain-grounded evaluation can uncover systematic explanation failures not obvious from sample-level heatmaps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于临床指南的全局解释评估框架，用于检测心电图AI模型中解释方法系统性失败的问题。通过对13种梯度归因方法在4个二分类器上的评估，发现从计算机视觉迁移来的方法普遍存在"关注信号幅度而非临床相关性"的缺陷，部分方法在特定疾病诊断中的表现甚至低于随机水平。
AI.motivation: 现有XAI方法多基于样本级热图进行局部评估，难以发现解释在全局层面的系统性偏差。在医学场景中，模型可能依赖无关信号特征而非疾病特异性模式，且难以被察觉。亟需一种能够聚合全局信息、并以领域知识为基准的评估框架。
AI.method: 提出全局、基于临床指南的评估框架：将心电图的解释结果按心拍聚合，与临床定义的感兴趣区域（如ST段、QRS波形）进行对比。使用PTB-XL数据集训练4个二分类器，评估13种基于梯度的归因方法，涵盖低振幅段和高振幅QRS形态两类模式。
AI.result: 1) 从计算机视觉迁移的解释方法系统性失败，其解释往往跟随信号幅度而非临床相关性（Spearman相关系数最高达0.69）。2) LRP-ε对缺血的ST段仅分配4.6%的相关性，而LRP-SIGN分配63.8%。3) 13种方法中有9种在至少一种疾病条件下低于随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 全局、领域知识驱动的评估能够揭示样本级热图无法发现的系统性解释失败。在将XAI方法从计算机视觉迁移到医学领域时，必须进行严格的领域适应性验证。

title: Branch \& Price \& Cut for the Time-Dependent Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (TDVRPTW)
summary: In urban contexts, travel times vary strongly with the time of day and traffic conditions. The Time-Dependent Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (TDVRPTW) extends the classical VRPTW by making travel times depend on departure time, with the objective of minimizing the total travel time of at most $k$ vehicle routes serving customers within strict time windows. Exact resolution of this realistic yet understudied problem currently relies on the Branch \& Price approach of Dabia et al. (2013), in which a Column Generation scheme decomposes the problem into a set-partitioning master problem and a resource-constrained shortest-path pricing problem solved by dynamic programming. This work, conducted within the MAMUT project (Machine Learning and Matheuristics for Urban Transport), aims to advance the state of the art for the exact and explainable resolution of the TDVRPTW. We propose to reimplement and revisit the pioneering Branch \& Price algorithm by transferring recent advances made on the single-vehicle variant (TDTSPTW) to the multi-vehicle setting, notably an exact anytime extension of A* and a Large Neighborhood Search guided by dynamic programming for the pricing sub-problem. We further explore the integration of data mining and machine learning to guide column generation by exploiting knowledge from previously computed routes. The goal is a high-performance and interpretable solver that meets the requirements of real-world urban transport while preserving guarantees on solution quality.

AI.tldr: 本文旨在通过重新实现和改进Branch & Price算法，结合A*扩展、大邻域搜索以及数据挖掘/机器学习技术，推进时间依赖车辆路径问题(TDVRPTW)的精确且可解释求解。
AI.motivation: 城市交通中旅行时间随时间和交通状况剧烈变化，TDVRPTW虽更贴近现实但研究不足，现有精确求解方法（Dabia等人的Branch & Price）有待改进，需要更高效且可解释的求解器以满足实际需求。
AI.method: 重新实现并改进Branch & Price算法，将单车辆变体（TDTSPTW）的最新进展（精确任意时间A*扩展、动态规划引导的大邻域搜索）迁移到多车辆场景，并探索利用数据挖掘和机器学习从历史路径中提取知识来指导列生成过程。
AI.result: 尚在MAMUT项目进行中，预期结果是高性能、可解释、保证解质量的求解器，推动TDVRPTW精确求解的前沿。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合传统精确算法与机器学习技术，有望在保证解质量的同时提升求解效率与可解释性，满足真实城市交通场景的需求。

title: Too much evidence, too little time: From text to actionable recommendations through multi-objective evidence reasoning
summary: Evidence-based clinical decision making requires specialists to identify, evaluate and synthesize relevant scientific literature. However, PubMed searches for complex clinical cases often return hundreds of publications that cannot be reviewed manually under time constraints. This study proposes SCEPTER (Single-Case Evidence-driven PubMed-To-rEcommendation Reasoner), a framework for transforming clinical case descriptions into evidence-based recommendations. SCEPTER combines PubMed retrieval, PubMedBERT semantic ranking, large language model (LLM)-based claim extraction, evidence-level weighting, contradiction detection, consensus analysis and multi-objective Pareto claim selection. The framework generates structured evidence syntheses and grounded actionable recommendations. A Paper Q&A module further enables interactive exploration of selected publications. The proposed framework introduces multi-objective reasoning model that integrates literature support, contradiction analysis and interactive literature interrogation into a unified clinical decision-support pipeline. Evaluation on 150 case studies demonstrated that the framework reduced an average search space of 576 papers to 53 retained papers, 7 Pareto-optimal claims and 3 final recommendations, corresponding to an overall compression ratio of 192:1. Despite this reduction, the retained evidence maintained high diversity (entropy=0.901). The ablation study showed that Pareto-based selection increased evidence diversity and recommendation utility compared with conventional ranking approaches.

AI.tldr: SCEPTER是一个将临床病例描述转化为循证推荐意见的框架，通过PubMed检索、语义排序、LLM提取、证据加权、矛盾检测和Pareto优化等步骤，将平均576篇文献压缩至7条Pareto最优主张和3条最终推荐（压缩比192:1），同时保持高多样性（熵值0.901）。
AI.motivation: 临床决策依赖文献证据，但PubMed检索常返回数百篇文献，人工审阅耗时巨大。现有方法缺乏将病例描述直接转化为可操作推荐意见的端到端解决方案，且难以兼顾证据多样性、矛盾检测和多目标优化。
AI.method: SCEPTER框架包含：PubMed检索获取初始文献池→PubMedBERT语义排序→LLM提取临床主张→证据等级加权→矛盾检测与共识分析→多目标Pareto最优主张选择→生成结构化证据综合与推荐意见，并提供Paper Q&A模块支持交互式文献探索。
AI.result: 在150个病例研究中，平均检索空间从576篇降至保留53篇，提取7条Pareto最优主张，生成3条最终推荐，压缩比达192:1，保留证据的熵值为0.901（高多样性）。消融实验表明Pareto选择方法相比传统排序方法能提升证据多样性和推荐效用。
AI.conclusion: SCEPTER框架成功将多目标推理（文献支持度、矛盾分析、交互式文献查询）整合为统一的临床决策支持管线，在极大压缩文献规模的同时保持了证据的多样性和推荐质量，为解决临床信息过载问题提供了有效方案。

title: Multimodal Domain Generalization for Depression Detection: An Attention-Based BiLSTM Network with Domain-Adversarial Training
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems (TNNLS)
summary: Automatic depression detection with deep learning has shown promise but often suffers from limited generalization due to domain shift arising from inter-speaker variability. To address this critical issue, we present the first patient-independent multimodal depression detection framework that incorporates domain generalization (DG), jointly leveraging both acoustic and textual modalities. The proposed model integrates bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM) with intra- and cross-modal attention mechanisms, accompanied by segment-level fusion for decision-making. Generalization is further enhanced by applying a gradient reversal layer inspired by Domain-Adversarial Training of Neural Networks (DANN), which promotes domain-invariant representations by adversarially limiting the model's ability to identify individual speakers, effectively reducing patient-specific bias. Conducting experiments on the Androids-Corpus dataset with a 5-fold cross-validation (CV) protocol, various pairings of audio and text feature extractors were evaluated over different segment durations, determining MelSpec and ItalianBERT as the optimal baseline at a 30-second segment duration. The addition of DG to this baseline yields a 2.5% increase in accuracy and 3.3% in F1-score, achieving 93.2% accuracy, 93.2% precision, 96.2% recall, and 94.2% F1-score, surpassing all existing benchmarks. Extensive ablation studies assess the impact of multimodal fusion, deep architectural choices, and DG, highlighting their combined contribution to robust and generalizable depression detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个患者无关的多模态抑郁检测框架，结合声学与文本模态，采用BiLSTM、注意力机制和对抗域泛化（DANN），在Androids-Corpus数据集上达到93.2%准确率和94.2% F1分数，超越现有基准。
AI.motivation: 现有深度抑郁检测方法因说话人间域偏移导致泛化能力差，本文旨在解决这一关键问题，实现患者无关的稳健检测。
AI.method: 提出多模态域泛化框架：BiLSTM + 模态内/跨模态注意力 + 分段融合决策，并引入梯度反转层（DANN）进行对抗性训练以消除患者特定偏差。
AI.result: 在Androids-Corpus数据集上，5折交叉验证中MelSpec+ItalianBERT（30秒分段）为最优基线；加入域泛化后准确率提升2.5%，F1提升3.3%，达到93.2%准确率、94.2% F1分数，超越所有现有基准。
AI.conclusion: 多模态融合、深度架构选择与域泛化策略共同贡献于稳健且可泛化的抑郁检测，消融实验验证了各组件的有效性。

title: Co-Evolving Graph and Text Memory for Training-Free Multi-Hop Question Answering
summary: Multi-hop question answering requires coordinating relational and textual evidence across reasoning steps, a combination neither a text corpus nor a knowledge graph can supply alone. Prior work often emphasizes only part of this loop: graph-augmented RAG retrieves from a pre-built or query-updated graph, KGQA systems search within topic-centered subgraphs, and memory-augmented agents maintain evolving memories without continuously reconciling graph memory with textual context. We propose Co-E, a training-free system built around synchronized bidirectional graph-text working memory. A synchronization cycle consolidates textual memory, extracts relational triples into graph memory, and injects graph facts back into the generation context. Because both memories are maintained, they shape subsequent retrieval and generation. Evaluated on six multi-hop QA benchmarks, Co-E improves over comparable training-free open-backbone baselines and is competitive with larger or trained systems.

AI.tldr: Co-E是一个无需训练的多跳问答系统，通过双向同步的图-文本工作记忆来协调关系型与文本型证据，在六个基准测试上优于同类无训练方法，并可与更大或经过训练的系统竞争。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（图增强RAG、KGQA、记忆增强智能体）都只强调多跳推理回路的部分环节，无法同时协调文本语料和知识图谱的关系与文本证据。
AI.method: 提出Co-E，一个无需训练的系统，构建同步双向图-文本工作记忆。同步循环包括：整合文本记忆→提取关系三元组注入图记忆→将图事实注入生成上下文，两种记忆相互塑造后续检索与生成。
AI.result: 在六个多跳QA基准上，Co-E优于同类无训练的开源基线方法，与更大规模或经过训练的系统相比也具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 双向同步图-文本工作记忆能有效弥补单一知识源在多跳推理中的不足，无需训练即可取得有竞争力的性能。

title: Can sunlight replace LEDs in vertical farms? A critical assessment of optical-fiber daylighting strategies
summary: Vertical farming is a promising approach for increasing food production in controlled environments while reducing land use, water consumption, and dependence on external climatic conditions. However, its large electricity demand, mainly driven by artificial lighting, still limits its energetic and economic sustainability. This study evaluates the techno-economic potential of an optical-fiber daylighting system designed to transport concentrated sunlight directly to the crop growing zones of a vertical farm. A validated transient vertical farm model was coupled with Tonatiuh ray-tracing simulations to assess a single-axis solar-tracked Fresnel concentration system. Five optical fiber typologies and three daylighting strategies were compared in terms of crop production, specific electrical energy consumption, and light cost, and benchmarked against light-pipe and rooftop photovoltaic solutions. The optical-fiber system achieved an annual useful-PAR delivery efficiency of 19-27%, depending on fiber typology. By distributing daylight across all rack shelves and limiting heat gains through a UV-IR filter, it reduced electricity consumption by 35-89%, compared with 12% for the light-pipe configuration. The daylight-only strategy achieved the lowest SEEC, equal to 1.81 kWh kg^-1, but caused a 52% crop productivity reduction. Hybrid LED-optical-fiber strategies avoided this penalty and achieved electricity savings of about 50%, with a minimum SEEC of 3.16 kWh kg^-1. However, current optical fiber costs make the system economically unattractive, requiring an estimated capital cost reduction of about 90% to become competitive. Rooftop photovoltaics covered 22% of annual electricity demand and achieved an 11-12-year payback, making PV the most economically viable rooftop solar option under current market conditions.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了光纤日光传输系统在垂直农场中的技术经济潜力。系统可将太阳光直接输送到作物生长区，减少35-89%的电力消耗，但当前光纤成本过高，需降低约90%才能具备竞争力。光伏屋顶方案经济性更优，回收期11-12年。
AI.motivation: 垂直农场可提高食物生产效率并减少资源消耗，但其人工照明导致巨大电力需求，限制了能源和经济可持续性。因此需要探索利用自然光替代人工照明的技术方案。
AI.method: 将验证过的瞬态垂直农场模型与Tonatiuh射线追踪模拟耦合，评估单轴太阳追踪菲涅尔聚光系统。比较五种光纤类型和三种日光利用策略，并以光管和屋顶光伏方案作为基准。
AI.result: 光纤系统年有用PAR传输效率19-27%；减少电力消耗35-89%（光管仅12%）；纯日光策略SEEC最低1.81 kWh/kg但减产52%；混合LED-光纤策略避免减产，SEEC最低3.16 kWh/kg；当前光纤成本需降约90%才能具备竞争力；光伏覆盖22%年用电需求，回收期11-12年。
AI.conclusion: 光纤日光传输在技术上可行且节能效果显著，但经济上尚不可行。混合LED-光纤策略可在不牺牲产量的前提下实现约50%的电力节约。当前市场条件下，屋顶光伏是更具经济优势的屋顶太阳能选择。

title: Frequency-Based Reservoir computing
summary:
Reservoir computing has emerged as an efficient machine learning framework for predicting time series generated by dynamical systems. In contrast to other machine and deep learning approaches, a reservoir computing trains only the output layer via linear regression, leaving the reservoir (recurrent layer) untrained. This simplification makes reservoir computers easier to train and more amenable to experimentation. However, because current reservoirs consist of networks of randomly connected nodes and require the optimization of numerous hyperparameters, a framework that precisely explains how reservoir computing operates and how it can be optimized remains missing. Here, we propose a frequency-based reservoir inspired by the brain's oscillatory dynamics and its hierarchy of timescales. The frequency-based reservoir can be interpreted as an ensemble of independent oscillatory units, each processing a portion of the input's frequency content.
  This allows us to understand the reservoir's internal behavior by modeling it as a single unit driven by an external input. Borrowing from the theory of a nonlinear oscillator forced by complex periodic inputs, we found that units of the frequency-based reservoir selectively amplify and store specific input frequencies, which are then used for prediction. The frequency-based reservoir performs as well as or better than equivalent random reservoirs. Furthermore, the frequency-based approach can be optimized to improve short-term prediction, a property that random reservoirs lack. Finally, we show that the frequency-based reservoir can also predict complex spatiotemporal dynamics. Our results show that reservoir computing can be designed using brain properties and theoretical insights borrowed from the physics of forced nonlinear oscillators.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种受大脑振荡动力学和时标层次启发的新型频率基储层计算框架，该框架由独立振荡单元组成，每个单元处理输入信号的特定频率成分。通过借用非线性振荡器受迫理论，发现频率基储层能选择性地放大和存储特定输入频率用于预测，性能不逊于甚至优于传统随机储层，且可优化短时预测能力。
AI.motivation: 现有储层计算基于随机连接节点网络，需优化大量超参数，缺乏精确解释其运行原理和优化方法的理论框架。受大脑振荡动力学和时标层次启发，希望设计可解释、可优化的储层计算新范式。
AI.method: 提出频率基储层，由独立振荡单元组成，每个单元处理输入信号的部分频率内容；借用受迫非线性振荡器理论分析单元行为，将储层内部动态建模为受外部输入驱动的单个单元。
AI.result: 频率基储层性能达到或超过传统随机储层；具有可优化性，能改善短时预测（随机储层缺乏此特性）；能预测复杂时空动力学。
AI.conclusion: 储层计算可以借助大脑特性（振荡动力学）和物理理论（受迫非线性振荡器）来设计和优化，为理解储层计算内部机制提供了新视角。

title: Regulating for AI Legitimacy
summary:
AI systems already govern. They rank speech and allocate attention, filter applicants and triage claims. The dominant frame for AI governance, alignment, asks whether such systems pursue the right objectives safely. It cannot answer a prior question: by what right are those objectives set and enforced?
  This Article argues that legitimacy is an autonomous regulatory objective, distinct from alignment and not secured by it. Legitimacy here is sociological: the belief among those subject to power that it is exercised rightfully. Performance does not produce that belief. We already have the proof of concept. Social media and search delivered enormous gains on every familiar metric and still triggered a legitimacy crisis, because publics questioned who authorized a handful of firms to set the rules of speech, visibility, and knowledge. It is possible to build a benevolent AI and still face a political crisis over its authority.
  The Article maps three sites where AI legitimacy falters: opacity, which blocks audiences from forming justified beliefs; private power, where firms exercise public-facing authority without recognizable authorization; and administrative automation, which strains reason-giving, participation, and review inside the state. It then asks what law can contribute. Thin legality (publicity, stability, consistent application) signals non-arbitrariness and buys real recognition, but invites legitimacy-washing when form drifts from practice. Thick legality supplies what form cannot: public authorship of the rules that bind.
  Three portable principles follow. Integration seats consequential AI rule-setting in venues a polity already treats as authoritative. Familiarity presents rules and reasons in locally credible forms. Contestation guarantees a credible second look with real remedies.

AI.tldr: 本文论证合法性（legitimacy）是AI治理中独立于对齐（alignment）的自治监管目标，指出AI系统虽能高效运作，但若缺乏公众对其权力行使正当性的认可，仍会引发政治危机。文章分析了AI合法性缺失的三个根源（不透明、私人权力、行政自动化），并提出通过薄合法性（形式合规）与厚合法性（公共参与）以及三项原则（整合、熟悉、抗争）来重建AI系统的合法性。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI治理框架（对齐）只关注系统是否安全地追求正确目标，却忽略了更根本的问题：谁有权设定这些目标并强制执行？社会已出现合法性危机（如社交媒体引发公众质疑），证明高性能并不自动带来正当性信念。
AI.method: 采用社会学合法性视角（公众对权力行使正当性的信念），从三个维度（不透明、私人权力、行政自动化）诊断AI合法性缺失的根源，并区分薄合法性（形式法治）与厚合法性（公共参与）两个层面，最后提出三项可移植原则（整合、熟悉、抗争）。
AI.result: 识别出AI合法性危机的三个关键场域：不透明性（阻碍公众形成正当信念）、私人权力（企业行使公共权威但缺乏授权）、行政自动化（削弱国家内部的理由说明、参与和审查）。薄合法性可提供一定认可但易沦为合法性洗白，厚合法性才能提供真正的公共规则制定权。
AI.conclusion: 合法性应当成为AI治理的独立监管目标。重建AI合法性需要将AI规则制定嵌入已被公众认可的权威机构（整合），以当地可信形式呈现规则与理由（熟悉），并保证实质性的申诉与补救渠道（抗争）。

title: Diamond transports in quadratic-form and distorted optimal transport
summary: The diamond transport is generated by the uniform law on a diamond-shaped copula support. Since a classical optimal transport (OT) objective is affine in the coupling, this transport cannot be the unique minimizer in the classical setting. We study a broader family of transports, called diamond-type transports, in non-classical settings such as quadratic-form optimal transport (QOT) and distorted optimal transport (DOT), which are generally nonconvex. Our main results are within the QOT framework: for symmetric one-dimensional marginals, the diamond transport is an optimizer for a large class of QOT problems whose costs depend on within-coordinate distances. Examples include product costs under positive-definiteness and convexity conditions and, in particular, mixed rectangular costs. For rectangular costs, we show that the diamond transport is the unique minimizer except for boundary cases. In the DOT framework, diamond-type transports are minimizers for a natural class of cost, and the diamond transport is the unique minimizer in specialized examples. We also identify the intersection between DOT and QOT, which corresponds precisely to quadratic distortion functions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了非经典最优传输（QOT和DOT）框架下钻石型传输的性质，证明了在对称一维边际条件下，钻石传输是多种QOT问题的最优解，并在特定条件下唯一。
AI.motivation: 经典最优传输中，由均匀分布定义的钻石传输因目标函数仿射而无法成为唯一最小化器，因此需要在非经典（非凸）传输框架下重新审视其最优性。
AI.method: 在二次型最优传输（QOT）和扭曲最优传输（DOT）框架下分析钻石传输，利用产品成本的正定性和凸性条件，以及矩形成本等特殊形式，证明优化性质。
AI.result: 在QOT中，对称一维边际下钻石传输是含坐标内距离成本函数的优化器；矩形成本下除边界情况外是唯一最小化器。DOT中钻石型传输是一类自然成本的最小化器。
AI.conclusion: 拓展了钻石传输在非凸最优传输框架下的理论，揭示了QOT与DOT的交集恰好对应二次扭曲函数，为该领域提供了新的优化视角。

title: Temporal Context Reinstatement Drives Episodic-Like Order Memory in Long-Context Language Models
summary: Human episodic memory supports the retrieval of experiences that unfold over extended timescales, yet the computational mechanisms underlying this ability remain debated due to the limited mechanistic accessibility in long-term memory experiments in humans. Long-context LLMs may offer promising ways to reveal plausible computational mechanisms that drive this type of retrieval. Here, we investigate whether and how LLMs capture the core behavioral signatures of episodic memory via a temporal order memory task. Using a new dataset of human behavior based on memory of a full-length novel, we show that models exhibit the same characteristic distance effect observed in humans on this task. We next apply long-context mechanistic interpretability analyses to uncover how models solve this task, and find that model performance relies on a one-dimensional temporal code that is reinstated during retrieval by a single time-reinstatement attention head. These findings support temporal context reinstatement as an important mechanism for episodic-like temporal-order memory in LLMs, offering new insights into how temporal aspects of long-term episodic memory may be instantiated in both artificial and biological systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用长上下文LLM探索人类情景记忆的时间顺序检索机制，发现模型在回忆小说情节时表现出与人类相同的距离效应，并通过机械可解释性分析揭示了一个单注意力头实现的时间代码重激活机制，支持时间情境重激活理论。
AI.motivation: 人类情景记忆能够检索长时间跨度的经历，但其计算机制因长期记忆实验的机械可访问性受限而存在争议。作者希望利用长上下文LLM来揭示驱动这种检索的可行的计算机制。
AI.method: 使用完整小说的记忆任务构建人类行为数据集，让LLM执行时间顺序记忆任务；采用长上下文机械可解释性分析（mechanistic interpretability）来揭示模型解决该任务的具体机制。
AI.result: LLM表现出与人类相同的特征性距离效应；模型性能依赖于一种一维时间代码，该代码在检索阶段通过一个单一的时间重激活注意力头（time-reinstatement attention head）被重新激活。
AI.conclusion: 时间情境重激活是LLM中实现类似情景时间顺序记忆的重要机制，为理解人工和生物系统中长时情景记忆的时间方面如何实例化提供了新见解。

title: Physically Verifiable Evidence and LLM-Based Reporting for Bearing Fault Diagnosis
summary: Trustworthy deployment of AI-based diagnosis in safety-critical mechanical systems hinges on validation: whether a prediction can be checked against physical reality before it is acted upon. Current intelligent fault diagnosers fail this standard in two ways. Their standard output, a class label with a softmax confidence score, is an internal statistic of the classifier, offering nothing checkable against independent physical knowledge; and the growing use of generative language models in maintenance reporting adds a second risk: hallucinated content entering reports on which decisions rest. Taking bearing fault diagnosis as the testbed, this work addresses both problems from the output side. The proposed Diagnostic Evidence Network (DENet) is an encoder-agnostic multi-task framework extending the output to a structured evidence record: the classification, a predicted characteristic frequency comparable against the theoretical value determined by bearing geometry and shaft speed, and a temporal localization of transient impulses inspectable on the raw waveform. Across four encoders and three public datasets, this evidence incurs no statistically significant accuracy cost, with a frequency error of about 6 Hz on 1,024-point segments where spectral estimation is structurally inapplicable. Centrally, the deviation between predicted and theoretical frequency constitutes a label-free, inference-time validation signal: it detects misclassifications with AUROC values of 0.970 and 0.871, and remains discriminative in the high-confidence regime where confidence-derived detectors are blind. Finally, a QLoRA-adapted language model is constrained to translate, but never generate, diagnostic content, reducing unsupported-claim rates from 10-12% to 2% and eliminating fabricated quantities.

AI.tldr: 提出诊断证据网络（DENet），通过输出结构化的证据记录（特征频率、瞬态脉冲定位）替代传统分类置信度，实现可验证的AI故障诊断，并约束语言模型仅翻译不生成，减少幻觉内容。
AI.motivation: 现有智能故障诊断器输出不可验证（softmax置信度无物理可核对性），且生成式语言模型可能产生幻觉内容，影响安全关键机械系统的决策可靠性。
AI.method: 设计编码器无关的多任务框架DENet，扩展输出为结构化证据：分类标签、可对比理论值的预测特征频率、可检查的瞬态脉冲时域定位；同时用QLoRA适配语言模型，约束其仅翻译不生成诊断内容。
AI.result: 在四种编码器、三个公共数据集上，证据输出无显著精度损失，频率误差约6Hz；频率偏差作为无标签验证信号，检测误分类的AUROC达0.970/0.871，在高置信度区域仍有效；语言模型幻觉率从10-12%降至2%，虚构数量归零。
AI.conclusion: 提出可验证的诊断输出范式，通过物理可核对的结构化证据和受约束的语言模型，提升AI故障诊断在安全关键系统中的可信部署潜力。

title: BHARATI: Morphology-Aware Tokenizers for Classical Indian Languages with Subword Fertility Analysis
summary: Standard subword tokenization algorithms such as Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) and SentencePiece are trained predominantly on modern language corpora and produce inefficient segmentations when applied to classical Indian languages. Sanskrit, Tamil, and other classical Indic languages exhibit agglutinative morphology, productive sandhi (phonological fusion at word boundaries), and domain-specific vocabularies absent from general-purpose training data. This paper presents BHARATI, a set of SentencePiece BPE tokenizers trained on a balanced 781 MB corpus spanning seven languages (English, Hindi, Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam) with native script support for all languages. We describe three successive tokenizer versions: v1 (English and Sanskrit only, with broken byte-fallback for Tamil), v2 (four-language support with byte-level fallback for southern languages), and v3 (full seven-language native subword coverage). Subword fertility analysis demonstrates that v3 averages 2.6 tokens per Indian Knowledge System (IKS) technical term, compared to 5.25 tokens per term with GPT-2's tokenizer and 3.75 tokens with the multilingual SentencePiece baseline, with the largest gains on a set of reserved IKS terms that are represented as single tokens by construction. On a held-out test set of 490 IKS-domain sentences (70 per language across seven languages, released with the measurement script), v3 reduces sequence length by roughly 90% relative to GPT-2 and byte-level encoding (which lack native Indic subwords) and by approximately 25% relative to the mBART-50 multilingual baseline, averaged across the six Indic languages, directly translating to increased effective context length for downstream language models. The tokenizer models (32,000 vocabulary), training scripts, and evaluation benchmarks are released under open licenses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BHARATI，一种基于SentencePiece BPE的七语言（英语、印地语、梵语、泰米尔语、泰卢固语、卡纳达语、马拉雅拉姆语）分词器，针对印度经典语言优化。相比GPT-2和mBART-50基线，在印度知识体系（IKS）术语上子词数量减少50%以上，序列长度缩短约90%（vs GPT-2）和25%（vs mBART-50），有效提升了后续语言模型的上下文长度。
AI.motivation: 现有BPE/SentencePiece分词器主要基于现代语言语料训练，对梵语、泰米尔语等古典印度语言分词效率低下。这些语言具有黏着形态、复杂的连音规则（sandhi）和领域特有词汇，导致分词碎片化严重，浪费语言模型的有效上下文长度。
AI.method: 在781MB平衡语料上训练三版SentencePiece BPE分词器：v1（英+梵，泰米尔语用字节回退）、v2（四语言，南方语言用字节级回退）、v3（七语言完整原生子词覆盖）。词汇量32,000，所有语言均使用原生文字。
AI.result: 在IKS技术术语上，v3平均2.6 tokens/词，对比GPT-2的5.25和mBART-50基线的3.75。在490句IKS测试集上，对六种印度语言平均序列长度相比GPT-2减少约90%，相比mBART-50减少约25%。部分IKS术语可作为单token表示。
AI.conclusion: 针对古典印度语言设计的专门分词器能显著提升分词效率，减少序列长度，从而为下游语言模型提供更长的有效上下文。所有模型、脚本和评估基准均已开源。

title: Optimization of Current Lookup Tables for Minimum Stator Copper Loss and Torque Ripple in the Full Torque-Speed Range for a Six-Phase PMSM With Nonsinusoidal Back-EMF
summary: A recently proposed method was able to generate current references with minimum stator copper loss (SCL) and torque ripple over the full torque-speed range of multiphase nonsalient permanent-magnet synchronous machines (PMSMs) with nonsinusoidal back-electromotive force (back-EMF). However, it relied on large lookup tables (LUTs) generated offline, requiring several hours for generation and large memory for storage. Since on-chip memory in industrial digital signal processors (DSPs) is limited, this hinders practical implementation. This paper addresses this problem by analyzing how the LUTs of that method can be simplified and optimized, focusing on the example of a symmetrical six-phase PMSM drive. Breakpoint selection (BS), LUT construction (LC), and interpolation approaches are evaluated to optimize the tradeoff between LUT simplification and performance. It is shown that the required memory and LUT generation time can be greatly reduced while keeping nearly the same feasible torque-speed area and performance. Simulation results confirm negligible performance degradation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多相永磁同步电机中现有方法依赖大型查找表（LUT）导致存储和生成时间成本高的问题，提出通过断点选择、LUT构建和插值方法的优化，在保持性能前提下大幅减少内存和生成时间。
AI.motivation: 现有方法虽能实现多相无凸极永磁同步电机在全扭矩-速度范围内最小定子铜损和低转矩脉动的电流参考生成，但其依赖离线生成的大型查找表（LUT），需要数小时生成时间和大容量存储空间，而工业DSP片上存储有限，阻碍了实际应用。
AI.method: 以对称六相PMSM驱动为例，通过三种技术优化LUT：(1) 断点选择（BS），(2) LUT构建（LC），(3) 插值方法。系统评估这些方法在LUT简化与性能之间的权衡。
AI.result: 所需内存和LUT生成时间大幅减少，同时保持了几乎相同的可行扭矩-速度区域和性能，仿真结果证实性能退化可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 通过优化LUT的断点选择、构建和插值策略，可有效解决现有方法在实际工业DSP中的存储和实现瓶颈，实现高效的电流参考生成。

title: A Model for Imbalanced Label Aggregation: A Focus on Minority-Class Detection
summary: We study imbalanced crowdsourcing with a focus on class-dependent annotator accuracy, a setting that, to the best of our knowledge, remains relatively underexplored despite its importance in real-world inspection systems where the labels of greatest operational importance are also the rarest ones. In this setting, annotators may be reliable on both classes, unreliable on both classes, majority-class specialists, or minority-class specialists. Existing models only partially address this problem: they either capture class-dependent errors but ignore item difficulty, or they model item difficulty without capturing class-dependent errors. To fill this gap for imbalanced datasets in crowdsourcing, we introduce a generative aggregation model combining item difficulty with class-dependent annotator competence. The model allows both annotator abilities and item difficulties to vary across classes. We then revisit Condorcet's Jury Theorem in the class-imbalanced setting. We also show that majority voting asymptotically preserves the underlying class proportion. We evaluate our model on $33$ real-world crowdsourcing datasets, covering multiclass tasks such as images and text, as well as two large-scale regimes: large-scale annotation datasets, with many annotations per item, and large-scale item datasets, with a large number of annotated instances. Across these diverse settings, our model consistently achieves the highest minority recall while remaining competitive in balanced accuracy, making it particularly relevant when rare-label recovery is the primary objective.

AI.tldr: 本文针对不平衡众包场景，提出了一种融合项目难度与类别依赖标注者能力的新颖生成式聚合模型，有效解决了现有模型无法同时处理这两类因素的局限，并在33个真实数据集上取得了最优的少数类召回率。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的检测系统（如稀有事件标注）常面临严重的类别不平衡问题，且标注者对不同类别可能表现出不同的准确率（如仅擅长识别多数类或仅擅长识别少数类）。然而，现有众包聚合模型要么能捕捉类别依赖误差但忽略项目难度，要么能建模项目难度但无法处理类别依赖误差，无法同时应对这两个关键因素。
AI.method: 提出一种生成式聚合模型，同时建模项目难度（item difficulty）与类别依赖的标注者能力（class-dependent annotator competence），允许标注者的能力和项目难度在不同类别间变化。并在理论上重新审视了Condorcet陪审团定理在不平衡设置下的表现，证明了多数投票渐进保持原始类别比例的性质。
AI.result: 在33个真实众包数据集（涵盖图像、文本等多类别任务，以及大规模标注和大规模项目两种场景）上进行评估，该模型在少数类召回率上持续取得最高值，同时在平衡准确率上保持竞争力，特别适合以罕见标签恢复为主要目标的场景。
AI.conclusion: 该模型有效填补了不平衡众包聚合中同时建模类别依赖误差与项目难度这一空白，在稀有类别识别任务中表现卓越，为现实世界的不平衡标注系统提供了更优的解决方案。

title: Share No More Than the Request Requires: Federated Disclosure for Perspective-Aware AI
summary: Modern AI systems bring societal risks such as mass surveillance, extreme concentrations of power, and loss of user autonomy---calling into question a model where third-parties collect and control massive amounts of user data. Users require a sovereign system to securely own, govern, and disclose their context while remaining compliant across regulated domains with strict provenance, interpretability, and policy adherence. Perspective-aware AI approaches this by transforming a user's aggregated personal data into a structured identity model called a \emph{Chronicle}: a temporal knowledge graph that represents and grows with the user. Chronicles support the secure disclosure of context across federated networks. A Chronicle holder may expose a queryable, authorized view that a third-party agent may consult without centralizing anyone's data. This paper explores the problem of minimum-necessary disclosure across domain boundaries: when a requester's agent queries a Chronicle, how can the system constrain its response to release only what the requester's relationship, stated purpose, and specific task require? We propose \textbf{Provenance Preserving Chronicles} (PPC), a federated protocol that compiles each holder's Chronicle into a compact \emph{authorized evidence subgraph} governed by one rule: \emph{share no more than the request requires}. Holders keep local sovereignty; an access controller projects relationship-aware views over domain-expert ontologies; and a two-phase flow returns provenance-linked text first, releasing raw artifacts only after explicit holder approval. We frame the problem, map gaps in blockchain, P2P, and holder-sovereign designs, define the core constructs, and sketch the protocol with an explicit threat model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Provenance Preserving Chronicles (PPC)，一种联邦协议，通过将用户个人数据转化为结构化知识图谱（Chronicle），在跨域查询中实现最小必要信息披露，确保用户主权、合规性和可追溯性。
AI.motivation: 现代AI系统存在大规模监控、权力集中和用户自主权丧失等社会风险，第三方收集和控制海量用户数据的模式存在问题。用户需要一种主权系统来安全拥有、治理和披露其上下文，同时满足严格的可追溯性、可解释性和策略合规要求。
AI.method: 构建用户结构化的身份模型Chronicle（时间知识图谱），通过Provenance Preserving Chronicles (PPC)联邦协议，将Chronicle编译为授权证据子图，遵循"披露不超过请求所需"原则。采用双阶段流程：先返回带溯源链的文本，经用户明确批准后再释放原始数据。
AI.result: 定义了问题框架，映射了区块链、P2P和持有者主权方案中的差距，定义了核心构造，并设计了包含明确威胁模型的协议草图。
AI.conclusion: PPC为解决跨域最小必要信息披露提供了一种持有者主权的联邦方案，平衡了用户数据主权与第三方合规查询需求。

title: DRP-FLR: Data-Driven Assessment of Demand Response Potential for Flexible Load Regulation in Smart Grids
summary: The rapid growth of AI workloads and renewable energy resources exacerbates supply-demand imbalance in power systems, making traditional load regulation designed for efficient allocation inadequate and motivating demand response (DR) mechanisms to enable load controllability in smart grids. However, existing DR-oriented approaches either focus on optimizing electricity cost or occupant comfort with limited benefit to system-level balance. Others overlook the diverse and dynamic consumption patterns of heterogeneous energy entities, leading to significant over- or under-regulation. Therefore, we propose DRP-FLR. First, DRP-FLR achieves accurate short-term load forecasting by embedding exogenous knowledge (e.g., entity information, prediction time) into historical load representations. Next, it constructs entity-specific load-pattern profiles by clustering historical load curves, and estimates DR potential by matching forecasted loads with pattern profiles. Finally, DRP-FLR formulates flexible load regulation as a mixed-integer optimization problem and solves it with an MILP solver to jointly optimize DR utilization, participant economic benefit, and renewable accommodation, while enforcing supply-demand balance and economic feasibility. Experiments on a regional grid and a campus microgrid show that DRP-FLR reduces regulation deviation by 36.63%-91.87% and improves participant benefit by 44.66% on average.

AI.tldr: 提出DRP-FLR框架，通过知识嵌入的短期负荷预测、负载模式聚类和MILP优化，实现智能电网中异构能源实体的精确需求响应，减少调节偏差36.63%-91.87%，提升参与者收益44.66%。
AI.motivation: 现有需求响应方法要么只优化电费或用户舒适度，对系统级平衡贡献有限；要么忽视异构能源实体多样化的动态消费模式，导致过度调节或调节不足。
AI.method: 1) 通过将外部知识（实体信息、预测时间）嵌入历史负荷表示实现短期负荷预测；2) 通过聚类历史负荷曲线构建实体特定的负荷模式画像，并通过匹配预测负荷与模式画像估算DR潜力；3) 将灵活负荷调节建模为混合整数优化问题，用MILP求解器联合优化DR利用率、参与者经济效益和可再生能源消纳。
AI.result: 在区域电网和校园微电网实验中，DRP-FLR将调节偏差降低36.63%-91.87%，参与者收益平均提升44.66%。
AI.conclusion: DRP-FLR通过结合知识增强预测、模式聚类和联合优化，有效提升了智能电网需求响应的系统级平衡和经济效益。

title: cMoLLM at Scale: Horizontal Scaling Laws for Mixture-of-LLMs
summary: Scaling large language models (LLMs) has driven their success, yet dense Transformers couple capacity and computation: every parameter is activated for every token, making training and inference costs grow linearly with model size-a critical bottleneck as models approach trillion-parameter regimes. We aim to scale capacity through MoE-style mixture throughout the LLM pipeline rather than only the FFN. Prior pipeline-level approaches include ParaScale, which introduces virtual tokens and parallel streams but incurs substantial overhead and suffers from homogenized routing and gradient collapse, and AltUp, which uses an auxiliary prediction branch but offers limited adaptivity and slow convergence. We establish that MoE-style mixture layers can be reformulated as variable-kernel dynamic convolutions, where each expert corresponds to a $1{\times}1$ convolutional kernel and routing implements input-conditioned kernel aggregation.
