Building on this equivalence, we introduce cMoLLM: a convolutionally gated mixture-of-LLMs that routes over end-to-end streams through fully differentiable dynamic convolution. In GPT-2-style models trained on FineWeb, cMoLLM improves language modeling perplexity and downstream GLUE and SQuAD accuracy under matched compute, with better stream utilization, more stable optimization, and favorable scaling compared to ParaScale- and AltUp-style baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出cMoLLM，将MoE风格的混合机制从FFN扩展到整个LLM流水线，通过将MoE层重新形式化为可变核动态卷积（每个专家对应1×1卷积核，路由实现输入条件化的核聚合），实现了端到端流的可微动态卷积门控。在GPT-2风格模型上，cMoLLM在相同计算量下提升了语言建模困惑度和下游任务准确率，优于ParaScale和AltUp等基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有密集Transformer中每个参数对每个token都激活，导致训练和推理成本随模型规模线性增长，成为万亿参数模型的瓶颈。虽然MoE已用于FFN层，但现有流水线级方法（如ParaScale和AltUp）存在开销大、路由同质化、梯度崩溃、适应性有限、收敛慢等问题。
AI.method: 将MoE风格的混合层重新形式化为可变核动态卷积，每个专家对应1×1卷积核，路由机制实现输入条件化的核聚合。基于此等价性，提出cMoLLM（卷积门控混合LLM），通过完全可微的动态卷积对端到端流进行路由。
AI.result: 在GPT-2风格模型（FineWeb数据集）上，cMoLLM在相同计算量下提升了语言建模困惑度以及下游GLUE和SQuAD任务的准确率，具有更好的流利用率和更稳定的优化过程，且扩展性优于ParaScale和AltUp风格的基线。
AI.conclusion: cMoLLM通过动态卷积等价性实现了更高效、更稳定的流水线级混合机制，为扩展LLM提供了一种有前景的新方向。

title: LithoFormer: A Robust Framework for Stratigraphic Inference via Transformers
summary: Accurate geological characterization of subsurface reservoirs from well log data is essential to support projects such as carbon capture and storage (CCS), geothermal development, and extraction of natural resources. Existing automated techniques for geological characterization primarily use sliding-window classification, which limits their ability to understand broader geological contexts, often leading to misaligned formation layers. To overcome these limitations, we introduce LithoFormer, a robust framework for stratigraphic inference using a Seq2Seq transformer model that ingests entire multivariate well logs in a single pass. The framework utilizes a channel-independent PatchTST backbone enhanced with rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) to capture long-range geological dependencies across entire multivariate well logs. A decoupled multi-task head is employed to jointly predict geological zonation and precise boundary probabilities, while a geology-informed loss function enforces physical constraints such as the Law of Superposition. Validated and deployed on three real-world datasets, LithoFormer demonstrates a 90% reduction in median boundary error and eliminates stratigraphic order violations compared to traditional sliding-window baselines. It also achieves a 80% reduction in manual expert labor and eliminates stratigraphic inconsistencies, providing a scalable and reliable solution for large-scale subsurface modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LithoFormer，一种基于Seq2Seq Transformer的框架，通过对整个多变量测井数据进行单次通吃处理，实现地层推断，显著降低了边界误差（90%）和专家人工成本（80%），并消除了地层顺序违规问题。
AI.motivation: 现有自动地质表征技术主要采用滑动窗口分类方法，难以理解更广泛的地质上下文，导致地层分层错位。作者旨在克服这一局限性，提出能整体处理测井数据的框架。
AI.method: 采用Seq2Seq Transformer框架，基于通道独立的PatchTST骨干网络，结合旋转位置编码（RoPE）捕获长程地质依赖；使用解耦多任务头联合预测地质分带和精确边界概率；设计地质约束损失函数强制执行地层层序律等物理约束。
AI.result: 在三个真实数据集上验证，中位边界误差降低90%，消除地层顺序违规；专家人工成本减少80%，消除了地层不一致性问题。
AI.conclusion: LithoFormer为大规模地下建模提供了可扩展且可靠的解决方案，在碳捕集与封存、地热开发等应用中具有重要价值。

title: IKS-Instruct: A 24,000-Example Multilingual Dataset for Teaching Language Models Indian Knowledge Systems
summary: Instruction tuning has become the standard method for adapting large language models to follow human intent, yet existing instruction datasets are dominated by English-language general-knowledge tasks and lack coverage of specialized pedagogical domains. This paper presents IKS-Instruct, a dataset of 24,795 instruction-response pairs for teaching language models to deliver educational content grounded in Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS). The dataset spans seven languages (English, Hindi, Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam), covers 41 pedagogical techniques from the Vedic oral and mathematical traditions, and is aligned with the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) curriculum for classes 6 through 12. The pairs are derived from six source types: classical text corpora (Bhagavad Gita, Thirukkural, Sangam literature, Vedic texts), curriculum-aligned pedagogical templates, Vedic mathematical sutra demonstrations, bilingual instruction pairs, technique-grounded multi-turn dialogues, and cross-tradition comparative analyses. Quality is assessed through a multi-judge evaluation framework in which independent language models score responses on 12 dimensions including technique fidelity, pedagogical quality, factual accuracy, and IKS cultural depth. Under a uniform five-judge external panel (median aggregation over 1,201 stratified items), the strongest IKS-Instruct fine-tune of a compact 7B model reaches a median judge score of 6.39, within 0.15 of a strong general-purpose reference model (Nemotron-Nano at 6.54) at a fraction of its deployment cost, while the base model without IKS fine-tuning scores near zero on the IKS-specific dimensions. Model quality does not increase monotonically with data curation, a result we report together with the corresponding data-quality gains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IKS-Instruct数据集（24,795条指令-响应对），用于教导语言模型教授印度知识体系（IKS）内容，覆盖7种语言、41种教学技术及CBSE 6-12年级课程。通过多法官评估框架，7B微调模型得分6.39，接近强基线模型Nemotron-Nano（6.54），且发现模型质量与数据策展并非单调正相关。
AI.motivation: 现有指令微调数据集以英语通用知识任务为主，缺乏专业化教学领域覆盖，特别是印度知识体系（IKS）这一重要的本土教育内容尚未被系统纳入语言模型训练，导致模型无法有效教授IKS相关学科知识。
AI.method: 构建24,795条指令-响应对数据集IKS-Instruct，涵盖7种语言、41种吠陀传统教学技术，数据源自6类资源（古典文本、课程模板、吠陀数学、双语对、多轮对话、跨传统比较）。采用多法官评估框架，由5个独立语言模型对12个维度（包括技术忠实度、教学质量、事实准确性、文化深度等）打分。
AI.result: 7B模型微调后中位数得分为6.39，接近强基线Nemotron-Nano的6.54，但部署成本远低于后者。无微调的基座模型在IKS特定维度上得分接近零。此外发现模型质量与数据策展并非单调递增关系。
AI.conclusion: IKS-Instruct能有效使紧凑型语言模型掌握IKS教学能力，以较低成本达到与强通用模型接近的教育内容生成水平，但数据量增加并不必然带来质量提升，需关注数据策展的质量而非单纯数量。

title: Does Central Planning Fail Locally? Evaluating EV Charging Flexibility Optimization Across Grid Levels
summary: Electric vehicles (EVs) are a key enabler of global decarbonization, and their charging flexibility is crucial for integrating high shares of renewable energy into future power systems. Research on EV charging flexibility in future power systems has largely focused on either the transmission or the distribution level, with limited integration between the two. However, these two scales cannot be separated: EV charging optimized at the national transmission level for system-wide planning is ultimately activated in local distribution grids, where it may cause voltage and loading issues. This study bridges that gap by evaluating EV charging flexibility across both grid levels, using two different control approaches. First, a top-down approach disaggregates the optimal charging demand obtained from a centralized planner at the transmission grid down to the distribution grid, explicitly accounting for grid constraints and individual driving requirements. Second, a bottom-up approach optimizes EV charging locally under distribution-grid constraints using electricity price signals from the centralized planning model. Controlled charging from the top-down and bottom-up approaches is then compared with uncontrolled charging. Results show that the top-down approach produces EV charging schedules that are compatible with individual driving behavior and reduce grid violations compared to uncontrolled charging. The bottom-up approach identifies an optimal profile similar to the centrally optimized profile, showing that electricity price signals are a suitable coordination mechanism. These findings suggest that centrally optimized EV charging remains effective when implemented at the distribution level, in systems with high DER penetration.

AI.tldr: 本文通过自上而下和自下而上两种方法，评估了电动汽车充电灵活性在输配电网两级协调的可行性，发现集中优化的充电方案在配电网层面同样有效，且电价信号可作为良好的协调机制。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多将输电网和配电网层面的电动汽车充电灵活性分开考虑，但二者实际上不可分割——输电网层面的优化最终需要在配电网中执行，可能引发电压和过载问题。本文旨在弥合这一研究空白。
AI.method: 采用两种控制方法：自上而下方法将输电网集中规划得到的最优充电需求分解到配电网，考虑电网约束和个体驾驶需求；自下而上方法在配电网约束下利用集中规划模型产生的电价信号本地优化充电。
AI.result: 自上而下方法产生的充电计划兼容个体驾驶行为，相比无序充电减少了电网违规；自下而上方法得到的最优曲线与集中优化曲线相似，表明电价信号是有效的协调机制。
AI.conclusion: 在高分布式能源渗透率系统中，集中优化的电动汽车充电方案在配电网层面实施时仍然有效。

title: Mixing Configurations for Downstream Prediction
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Accepted at ICML 2026. Equal contribution: Juntang Wang, Hao Wu, Yihan Wang
summary: Clustering-based features are widely used in machine learning, but most methods must choose a resolution -- a choice that is global, fixed, and ad hoc. Recent work shows that varying the resolution parameter produces only a finite set of structurally stable partitions, known as configurations. Based on this, we introduce Configuration-Mixed Prediction (CMP), a setting where models learn to adaptively weight these configurations per sample for downstream prediction. We propose MixConfig, a plug-and-play feature augmentation module that extracts configurations from any frozen embedding and learns energy-aware mixing weights via a novel selector that jointly reasons about sample context, cluster assignments, and stability statistics. Experiments across tabular, molecular, vision, and text domains demonstrate consistent improvements over single-resolution and static baselines across diverse predictor architectures, with gains particularly pronounced in low-data regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MixConfig，一种从不同聚类配置中学习自适应加权进行特征增强的方法，在多个领域提升下游预测性能。
AI.motivation: 传统聚类特征需要选择固定的全局分辨率，而不同分辨率会产生不同质量的特征，缺乏自适应能力。
AI.method: 提出MixConfig模块，从冻结的嵌入中提取所有结构稳定的聚类配置，并通过能量感知的选择器为每个样本自适应学习加权权重。
AI.result: 在表格、分子、视觉和文本四个领域实验中，MixConfig consistently优于单分辨率和静态基线方法，尤其在低数据场景下提升显著。
AI.conclusion: 基于多配置的自适应加权策略能有效增强特征表示，是一种即插即用的通用特征增强方案。

title: Ordered Network Analysis of Epistemic Emotions during Collaborative Problem Solving
summary: Investigating how affective states such as confusion and frustration persist and transition during co-situated collaborative problem solving (CPS) is important for understanding the dynamics of epistemic emotions. However, the accurate identification of affective states remain challenging as there is no gold-standard truth in this space. Here, we analyze affective states collected through retrospective cued-recall during an in-person CPS task. Using ordered network analysis (ONA), we examine (1) the overall ordered structure of affective states and how this structure differs across self-caught and probe-caught reporting methods, and (2) what aspects of this ordered structure are emphasized differently in slower and faster groups. We find that ONA reveals differences in persistence and transition patterns that are not apparent from descriptive summaries alone. In particular, we observe a stable epistemic core linking curiosity, optimism, and confusion, with different reporting methods emphasizing different connections among states. An analysis between faster and slower groups show that roles of confusion and disengagement also shift significantly during collaboration, particularly in their relationship to conflict. We interpret our findings in the context of collaboration and discuss their implications in developing AI systems that support CPS.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用有序网络分析（ONA）探究协作问题解决（CPS）中困惑、沮丧等情感状态的持久性和转换模式，发现存在由好奇心、乐观和困惑构成的稳定认知核心，不同报告方法（自我捕捉 vs. 探测捕捉）和不同速度组（快组 vs. 慢组）在情感状态连接上存在显著差异，特别是困惑和脱离感在协作中的角色发生变化。
AI.motivation: 理解情感状态（如困惑、沮丧）在协作问题解决中的持续和转换动态对于认识认知情感的运行机制至关重要，但情感状态的准确识别因缺乏金标准而面临挑战。
AI.method: 采用有序网络分析（ONA）方法，对面对面协作任务中通过回顾性线索回忆收集的情感状态数据进行分析，比较自我捕捉与探测捕捉两种报告方式，以及快组与慢组之间的差异。
AI.result: ONA揭示了描述性统计无法体现的持久性和转换模式差异；发现好奇心、乐观和困惑构成的稳定认知核心；不同报告方法强调不同的状态连接；困惑和脱离感在快慢组间的角色存在显著差异，尤其是与冲突的关系。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果对理解协作中的情感动态具有重要意义，并为开发支持协作问题解决的人工智能系统提供了启示。

title: d'Alembert's Functional Equation and a Globally Convex Free-Action Principle on Positive Paths
summary: We study the kinetic action that d'Alembert's functional equation induces on positive paths in $\Rplus$, and prove it strongly convex. Calibrated d'Alembert forces the cosh cost $\Jcost(x)=\tfrac12(x+x^{-1})-1$, i.e.\ $\Jlog(ξ)=\coshξ-1$ in the log coordinate $ξ=\log x$. Evaluating this log-cost at the log-\emph{velocity} $\dotξ$ rather than the log-position -- a single postulate (Postulate~\ref{post:step}) -- yields $\actionA[γ]=\int_a^b(\cosh\dotξ-1)\,dt$, strongly convex under geometric (log-space) interpolation. This convexity has three consequences, none requiring an Euler--Lagrange equation, a Fréchet derivative, or a second variation. First, a one-sided chord condition characterizes global minimality. Second, the unique fixed-endpoint minimizer is the uniform-log-velocity path. Third, the action gap obeys an exact Bregman / Pythagorean identity $\actionA[γ]-\actionA[γ_*]=\int D_\Kkin(\dotξ\,\|\,\dotξ_*)\,dt$, sharpened by a quantitative Friedrichs--Poincaré bound on $\log(γ/γ_*)$. It has a dually-flat / Hessian-manifold reading in the additive coordinate $ξ$. \\ This theorem is purely mathematical, and we delimit it. The bridge to Newtonian and rapidity mechanics is \emph{conditional}, requiring structure beyond Postulate~\ref{post:step}: a kinematic embedding, a mass coupling, a time calibration, and a Hamiltonian-primary Legendre structure. Granted these, the cosh action recovers the Newtonian small-step limit and the rapidity profile $\Kkin_m(φ)=m(γ_L-1)$; yet the cosh-dual Hamiltonian is \emph{not} the special-relativistic free-particle Hamiltonian (Proposition~\ref{prop:not-SR}), the agreement being one of profile, not an identity of Hamiltonians. Global minimality is a free-sector phenomenon: once a non-affine strictly convex potential is added, joint convexity is lost and the classical stationary-action picture returns.

AI.tldr: 本文研究d'Alembert泛函方程在正实数路径上诱导的动力学作用量，证明其具有强凸性，并推导出三个重要推论（全局最小性、唯一极小元、精确Bregman恒等式），同时澄清该结果与牛顿力学和狭义相对论力学的条件性联系。
AI.motivation: 从d'Alembert泛函方程出发，探究正实数路径上动力学作用量的凸性结构，旨在建立一种不依赖Euler-Lagrange方程或Fréchet导数的全局最小性理论。
AI.method: 将d'Alembert泛函方程诱导的作用量表达为cosh代价函数形式（对数坐标下为coshξ-1），通过对数速度变量证明其强凸性；利用单边弦条件刻画全局最小性；通过Bregman散度给出作用量差的精确恒等式。
AI.result: ① 单边弦条件刻画全局最小性；② 固定端点下唯一极小元为均匀对数速度路径；③ 作用量差满足精确Bregman/Pythagorean恒等式，并附带定量Friedrichs-Poincaré界。该结果在加性对数坐标下具有对偶平坦/Hessian流形解释。
AI.conclusion: cosh作用量在纯数学框架下具有强凸性和全局最小性，但与牛顿力学和狭义相对论力学的桥接是有条件的（需额外假设运动学嵌入、质量耦合等）；且cosh对偶哈密顿量并非狭义相对论自由粒子哈密顿量，二者仅轮廓一致；加入非仿射严格凸势能后，联合凸性丧失，回归经典驻定作用量图景。

title: HeraSys: Collaborative Serving of Multiple LLM Workflows via Fine-Grained End-to-End Optimization
summary: The proliferation of Large Language Models (LLMs) has shifted serving systems from processing isolated requests to orchestrating high-concurrency, multi-tenant agentic workflows. However, existing solutions typically prioritize intra-workflow optimization, largely neglecting the significant potential for inter-workflow optimization. In this paper, we propose HeraSys, an LLM serving system designed to optimize the end-to-end performance of concurrent workflows. Through fine-grained orchestration, HeraSys eliminates cross-workflow computational redundancy via structural node merging and reuse. Furthermore, HeraSys introduces a load-aware joint scheduling policy that dynamically manages execution order by evaluating both inter- and intra-query priorities. By integrating a resource skewing mechanism with adaptive batching and pipeline decomposition, HeraSys effectively mitigates tail latency while maintaining low average latency, thereby substantially improving system throughput. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HeraSys reduces P99 latency by up to 2.17$\times$ and increases serving throughput by up to 1.85$\times$ under strict latency guarantees.

AI.tldr: HeraSys是一个针对LLM并发工作流优化的服务系统，通过结构节点合并复用、负载感知联合调度和资源倾斜机制，显著降低尾部延迟并提升吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM服务系统主要关注工作流内优化，忽略了工作流间（inter-workflow）的计算冗余和调度优化潜力。
AI.method: 1) 细粒度编排下的跨工作流结构节点合并与复用；2) 负载感知联合调度策略，结合查询间和查询内优先级动态管理执行顺序；3) 资源倾斜机制与自适应批处理、流水线分解相结合。
AI.result: P99延迟降低最多2.17倍，严格延迟保障下服务吞吐量提升最高1.85倍。
AI.conclusion: HeraSys通过工作流间协同优化有效提升多租户agentic工作流的端到端性能。

title: OrchNAS: Orchestrated Neural Architecture Search Service for Personalised Federated Edge Intelligence
summary: We propose OrchNAS, an energy-aware, personalised, federated edge intelligence framework that leverages a Neural Architecture Search Service to automatically design service-adaptive models for heterogeneous edge environments. The framework orchestrates the architecture search process on a server-side NAS service, enabling edge services to derive personalised architectures under device-level energy, computation, and memory constraints. We introduce an energy-aware global architecture search mechanism that learns a compact global representation across heterogeneous services. We develop an energy-efficient architecture selection mechanism that enables each service to derive a personalised subnet that satisfies its resource constraints via a progressive, greedy, energy-aware pruning strategy. We propose an energy-efficient personalised model optimisation scheme that updates service-adaptive parameters while preserving global representations, where a primal-dual optimisation mechanism enforces strict energy budgets during architecture adaptation. Experiments on real-world and benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: OrchNAS是一个面向异构边缘环境的能量感知、个性化联邦边缘智能框架，通过NAS服务自动设计服务自适应模型，并在能量预算约束下优化全局与个性化架构。
AI.motivation: 边缘环境存在设备异构性（计算、内存、能量限制），传统NAS方法缺乏能量感知和个性化能力，亟需一种能同时兼顾全局表示与设备级约束的自动化架构设计方法。
AI.method: 1) 服务器端NAS服务进行能量感知的全局架构搜索；2) 能量高效的架构选择机制，通过渐进式贪心剪枝策略为每个服务生成满足资源约束的个性化子网；3) 能量高效的个性化模型优化方案，使用原始-对偶优化机制在架构适应过程中严格执行能量预算。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集和基准数据集上的实验验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: OrchNAS能够为异构边缘环境自动设计个性化、能量高效的模型，在满足设备级约束的同时保持全局表示能力。

title: BERT-based Models vs. Large Language Models for Low-Resource Named Entity Recognition: A Comparative Study on Marathi
summary: Named Entity Recognition (NER) for low-resource languages such as Marathi remains a challenging task due to limited annotated resources and linguistic complexity. Although recent Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance across a wide range of natural language processing tasks, their effectiveness for language-specific NER in low-resource settings remains uncertain. In this study, we fine-tune MahaBERT-v2 on different variants of the MahaNER dataset and systematically compare the performance of these models with an existing MahaNER baseline and prominent general-purpose LLMs, including Gemini, LLaMA-3.3-70B, and Gemma models. All models are evaluated on a Marathi NER test dataset using standard metrics of precision, recall, and F1-score. The experimental results show that the fine-tuned MahaBERT-based models consistently outperform both the baseline and all evaluated LLMs, with the fine-tuned models achieving F1-scores ranging from 0.88 to 0.91, surpassing the existing MahaNER model (0.8843) and significantly exceeding the performance of LLM-based approaches, whose F1-scores range from 0.57 to 0.69. These findings demonstrate that task-specific, language-focused models trained on domain-relevant data remain more effective than general-purpose LLMs for Marathi NER, highlighting the continued importance of specialized architectures for low-resource language processing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了低资源语言（马拉地语）的命名实体识别（NER）任务，发现微调后的MahaBERT-v2模型（F1分数0.88-0.91）显著优于通用大语言模型（F1分数0.57-0.69）和现有基线模型，表明任务专用模型在低资源语言NER中仍比通用LLM更有效。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言（如马拉地语）的NER面临标注数据稀缺和语言复杂性挑战，现有通用大语言模型在低资源语言特定任务上的效果尚不明确，因此需要系统评估专用模型与通用LLM的性能差异。
AI.method: 使用MahaNER数据集的不同变体微调MahaBERT-v2模型，并与现有MahaNER基线、Gemini、LLaMA-3.3-70B、Gemma等通用LLM进行对比，采用精确率、召回率和F1分数作为评估指标。
AI.result: 微调后的MahaBERT模型F1分数为0.88-0.91，超越基线MahaNER的0.8843；通用LLM的F1分数仅为0.57-0.69，表现显著落后。
AI.conclusion: 针对特定任务和语言、在领域相关数据上训练的专用模型比通用大语言模型在低资源语言NER任务中更有效，强调了专用架构在低资源语言处理中的持续重要性。

title: Current References for Minimum Copper Loss and Torque Ripple in the Full Torque-Speed Range for Symmetrical Six-Phase PMSMs With Nonsinusoidal Back-EMF Under an Open-Phase Fault
summary: Current-reference generation based on lookup tables (LUTs) is here proposed for star-connected symmetrical six-phase nonsalient PMSMs with nonsinusoidal back-EMF under an open-phase fault. Fourier coefficients for all healthy phases are computed offline, enabling unbalanced nonsinusoidal currents. A lexicographic optimization minimizes torque ripple and then copper loss, subject to torque, zero-current-sum, peak-current, peak-voltage, and torque-ripple constraints. Cogging torque can be included for compensation. Simulations show a higher feasible speed limit: about 30% at low torque and 23% along an example load curve. Finite-element analysis shows a 77% reduction in peak-to-peak torque ripple with cogging-torque compensation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于查找表的电流参考生成方法，用于星形连接对称六相非凸极永磁同步电机在开相故障下的无正弦反电动势控制。通过离线计算傅里叶系数、字典优化最小化转矩脉动和铜损，并考虑多种约束。仿真显示可行速度极限提升约30%（低转矩）和23%（负载曲线），有限元分析显示齿槽补偿后峰值转矩脉动降低77%。
AI.motivation: 解决六相永磁同步电机在发生开相故障时，由于反电动势非正弦特性导致传统方法难以实现高性能控制的问题，特别是如何在故障工况下同时抑制转矩脉动、降低铜损并提升速度运行范围。
AI.method: 采用离线计算所有健康相的傅里叶系数，生成不平衡非正弦电流参考；利用字典优化（先最小化转矩脉动，再最小化铜损）满足转矩、零电流和、峰值电流、峰值电压及转矩脉动约束；可额外补偿齿槽转矩。
AI.result: 仿真显示可行速度极限提升约30%（低转矩）和23%（沿负载曲线）；有限元分析表明加入齿槽转矩补偿后，峰值转矩脉动降低77%。
AI.conclusion: 所提LUT电流参考生成方法能有效提升六相PMSM在开相故障下的速度运行范围和转矩性能，特别是结合齿槽补偿可显著抑制转矩脉动。

title: The Combined Van-and-Mopeds Routing Problem with Time Windows: Formulation, Variants, and Solution Methods
summary: We introduce and study the Combined Van-and-Mopeds Routing Problem with Time Windows (CVMRPTW), a novel variant of the heterogeneous fleet vehicle routing problem motivated by last-mile parcel delivery in dense European cities. In the CVMRPTW, a single van serves as a mobile base from which on-demand mopeds are deployed to reach customers located in areas inaccessible or inefficient for vans. The primary objective is to minimise the number of mopeds used while guaranteeing that all delivery time windows are met. We propose a Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) formulation that captures vehicle synchronisation, capacity tracking, and time-window compliance through 22 structured constraint families, and extend it to three operationally motivated variants: the standard model, the active-waiting-van variant, and the common-depot variant. A lexicographic two-stage optimisation framework allows secondary objectives-route duration, combined travel time, and combined distance-to be optimised without sacrificing the primary objective. Three graph-sparsification preprocessing techniques reduce the number of variables and constraints by up to 25%. For instances beyond the practical limits of exact solvers, we develop the Cluster-Based Combined Routing (CBCR) heuristic, which decomposes the problem into a clustering phase, a cluster-level exact solve, and a route-reconstruction phase. Computational experiments on real-world instances derived from OpenStreetMap data for Lisbon and Stuttgart show that the MILP solves instances with up to 48 customers to feasibility within one hour, and that the CBCR heuristic extends tractability to instances with up to 80 customers under favourable conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并研究了带时间窗的联合货车与踏板车路由问题（CVMRPTW），针对欧洲密集城市最后一英里配送场景，设计了一种混合整数线性规划（MILP）模型及基于聚类的启发式算法（CBCR），在里斯本和斯图加特的真实数据集上验证了该方法可解决最多80个客户的配送问题。
AI.motivation: 欧洲密集城市中，传统货车在最后一英里配送时面临小巷、步行区等不可达或低效区域，而踏板车能灵活穿行。现有异构车队路由研究缺乏对"货车作为移动基站、按需部署踏板车"这一协同模式的建模，因此需要新的问题定义与求解方法。
AI.method: （1）提出CVMRPTW问题的MILP公式，包含22个约束族以处理车辆同步、容量跟踪和时间窗约束；（2）扩展三种操作变体：标准模型、主动等待货车变体、公共停车场变体；（3）设计词序两阶段优化框架，在保证主目标（最小化踏板车数量）前提下优化次目标；（4）提出三种图稀疏化预处理技术，减少最多25%变量和约束；（5）开发CBCR启发式算法，将问题分解为聚类、簇级精确求解和路径重构三个阶段。
AI.result: 在里斯本和斯图加特的真实世界数据集上，MILP模型可在一小时内求解最多48个客户的可行性实例；CBCR启发式算法在有利条件下将可解规模扩展至80个客户。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的CVMRPTW问题及求解方法有效填补了货车-踏板车协同配送的建模空白，MILP和CBCR方法在真实城市数据上展示了可扩展性，为城市最后一英里配送提供了理论支撑和实用算法。

title: Multi-Objective Structured Pruning of LLMs for Latency and Model Size Optimization
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved widespread adoption because of their strong reasoning and query-response capabilities. However, deploying them in embedded and edge computing environments remains challenging because of strict latency, memory, and energy constraints. Their large parameter counts and computational demands hinder efficient execution on resource-constrained platforms. Although model pruning has emerged as a viable solution for reducing scale while preserving performance, jointly optimizing layers, attention heads, and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) dimensions remains highly complex. Exhaustively exploring this combined design space is computationally expensive and often leads to local optima or unstable configurations. To address these limitations, we propose a hardware-aware, multi-objective structured pruning framework. The proposed two-stage method explicitly targets latency and model size for efficient deployment on edge devices. In the coarse-grained stage, multi-objective depth pruning removes entire attention and MLP blocks to reduce computational load and memory usage. In the subsequent fine-grained stage, Parallel Bayesian Optimization (PBO) searches for the optimal layer-wise pruning ratios for pruning under latency constraints, while importance-based strategies rank the specific components to be pruned within each layer's allocated budget. Experimental results show that our approach reduces model complexity with minimal impact on commonsense reasoning tasks and zero-shot performance. Our method achieves a favorable trade-off among accuracy, latency, and model size, making it suitable for edge deployment. Across multiple LLMs at 37.5% and 50% pruning ratios, the proposed approach achieves better performance on commonsense reasoning tasks than existing methods while significantly reducing inference cost.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种硬件感知的多目标结构化剪枝框架，通过粗粒度深度剪枝和细粒度并行贝叶斯优化，在边缘设备上高效压缩LLM，实现精度、延迟和模型大小之间的良好平衡。
AI.motivation: LLM在边缘计算环境中部署面临严格的延迟、内存和能量约束；现有剪枝方法联合优化层、注意力头和MLP维度时计算成本高且容易陷入局部最优。
AI.method: 两阶段剪枝方法：(1)粗粒度阶段：多目标深度剪枝移除整个注意力和MLP块；(2)细粒度阶段：使用并行贝叶斯优化(PBO)搜索最优逐层剪枝比率，结合重要性策略在每层预算内选择具体剪枝组件。
AI.result: 在37.5%和50%剪枝比率下，在常识推理任务上优于现有方法，同时显著降低推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在精度、延迟和模型大小之间实现了良好的权衡，适合边缘部署。

title: SLA-Constrained Carbon-Aware Routing in Geo-Distributed Serverless Clouds
summary: Modern cloud deployments distribute applications across multiple geographic regions, yet standard routing mechanisms prioritize latency while ignoring the fluctuating carbon intensity of local power grids. Latency-driven routing incurs avoidable carbon emissions, particularly when cleaner regions are within acceptable latency bounds. The proposed model formulates the carbon-aware serverless routing problem as a constrained optimization over geo-distributed cloud regions and introduces an SLA-constrained carbon-aware routing policy that achieves optimal carbon reduction within the SLA-feasible region, evaluated using real carbon intensity measurements across 5 primary AWS deployments. Experimental results show that the proposed policy achieves up to 46.8% carbon reduction while maintaining zero SLA violations across all evaluated thresholds. The system reduces carbon by an average of 27.4% under mixed workloads, and the routing overhead is very low (less than 0.02% of total request latency). A scalability study across 12 AWS regions spanning 6 continents demonstrates that average carbon savings increase from 27.4% to 47.5% as routing flexibility expands under mixed workloads. The proposed work contributes to SDG 13 (Climate Action) and SDG 7 (Affordable and Clean Energy) by enabling low-carbon routing decisions. These results indicate that cloud systems can achieve significant carbon savings without compromising user experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种碳感知的无服务器路由策略，在SLA约束下优化多区域云部署的碳排放，实验显示最多可减少46.8%的碳排放，且无SLA违规。
AI.motivation: 现代云部署跨多个地理区域分布，但标准路由机制只关注延迟，忽略了不同区域电网碳强度的差异，导致可避免的碳排放增加。
AI.method: 将碳感知无服务器路由问题建模为带约束的优化问题，提出SLA约束下的碳感知路由策略，在SLA可行区域内实现最优碳减排。
AI.result: 在5个AWS部署上，碳减排最高达46.8%，平均27.4%；路由开销极低（不到总延迟的0.02%）；扩展到12个区域后平均碳减排提升至47.5%。
AI.conclusion: 云系统可以在不牺牲用户体验的前提下实现显著的碳减排，贡献于SDG 13（气候行动）和SDG 7（可负担清洁能源）。

title: Joint Optimization for Greedy Longest-match Tokenization
summary: Recent work has shown that subword vocabularies can be trained to optimize compression for a specific inference rule rather than relying on greedy heuristics such as Byte Pair Encoding (BPE). We extend this approach to greedy left-to-right longest-match decoding, the fast and widely used inference rule underlying WordPiece. We introduce Joint Optimization for Greedy Longest-Match Tokenization (JOLT), which formulates vocabulary learning as an integer program over vocabulary-selection and segmentation-choice variables. Greedy-consistency constraints ensure that each optimized segmentation exactly matches the segmentation produced by longest-match decoding under the selected vocabulary, aligning the training objective with deployment-time tokenization. To scale the optimization, we solve a linear programming relaxation and selectively introduce higher-order segmentations only for unresolved pretokens. The resulting relaxation is nearly integral: rounded solutions fall within 0.008 - 0.176 % of the LP lower bound on the training scope. The bound also shows that BPE is already within 1 - 2 % of the best achievable compression under greedy longest-match decoding, while JOLT closes 89.6 - 99.4 % of the remaining gap. On held-out validation data across four training scopes and vocabulary sizes of 32,000 and 64,000, JOLT produces up to 0.78 % fewer tokens than BPE, with improvements generally increasing as the training scope grows. These results demonstrate that inference-aligned vocabulary optimization can recover most of the limited compression headroom left by BPE while providing a certificate of near-optimality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JOLT方法，通过整数规划优化词汇表以对齐贪婪最长匹配解码（WordPiece的推理规则），在压缩率上超越BPE，并给出近优性证书。
AI.motivation: 现有子词分词方法（如BPE）使用贪心启发式训练词汇表，导致训练目标与部署时的推理规则不一致，存在压缩效率的优化空间。
AI.method: JOLT将词汇表学习建模为整数规划，联合优化词汇选择和切分选择；引入贪婪一致性约束确保训练与部署对齐；通过线性规划松弛和选择性引入高阶切分来扩展优化规模。
AI.result: 松弛解接近整数解（差距仅0.008-0.176%）；BPE已接近最优（差距1-2%），JOLT可缩小89.6-99.4%的剩余差距；在验证集上比BPE减少最多0.78%的token数。
AI.conclusion: 推理对齐的词汇优化能回收BPE留下的有限压缩空间，并提供近优性保证。

title: Transform Method for Stochastic Processing and Matching Networks
summary:
Modern service systems -- ranging from cloud data centers to ride-hailing platforms -- operate at massive scales where congestion is a critical challenge. Utilizing an operations research approach, these systems are analyzed by modeling them as complex stochastic processes, which are typically understood through process-level convergence to fluid and diffusion limits. However, these methods often prove technically dense and provide limited guidance for finite, practical system scales. The transform method, presented in this tutorial, was recently developed as a unified and tractable framework for the steady-state analysis of Stochastic Processing and Matching Networks (SPNs/SMNs). The transform method overcomes the technical hurdles of process-level convergence by working directly with the pre-limit system. By exploiting the zero-drift property of exponential test functions, the method derives explicit functional equations (acting as a proxy for global balance equations) for the transforms (such as moment-generating functions) of queue-length distributions. This approach provides sharp, non-asymptotic performance guarantees, bridging the gap between theoretical asymptotics and real-world system behavior.
  Since its introduction in 2020 for load-balancing in data center networks, the transform method has been extended to handle realistic complexities, including customer abandonment, state-dependent arrivals, Markov-modulated arrivals, large-system scale, and multi-dimensional networks with multiple bottlenecks. We survey these theoretical advances and demonstrate their practical relevance across diverse domains, such as matching markets and networked service systems. The transform method provides interpretable bounds tied directly to system parameters, offering a powerful analytical alternative to simulation-heavy or purely asymptotic approaches for system design and control.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了变换方法（transform method）——一种用于随机处理网络和匹配网络稳态分析的统一框架。该方法通过指数测试函数的零漂移特性，直接推导出队列长度分布的变换函数（如矩生成函数）的显式泛函方程，避免了传统过程级收敛的技术障碍，提供非渐近性的性能保证，弥补了理论渐近分析与实际系统规模之间的鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 现代服务系统（如云数据中心、网约车平台）面临大规模拥塞挑战，传统基于流体极限和扩散极限的过程级收敛方法技术密度高，且对有限实际系统规模的指导有限。亟需一种既统一又易于处理的稳态分析框架。
AI.method: 变换方法通过直接处理预极限（pre-limit）系统，利用指数测试函数的零漂移特性，推导出队列长度分布的变换（如矩生成函数）的显式泛函方程，作为全局平衡方程的代理，从而避免过程级收敛的复杂技术。
AI.result: 该方法自2020年提出后，已扩展至客户放弃、状态相关到达、马尔可夫调制到达、大规模系统以及多瓶颈多维网络等复杂场景。提供了与系统参数直接关联的可解释界，可作为系统设计和控制的有力分析工具。
AI.conclusion: 变换方法为随机处理和匹配网络提供了统一、可处理的稳态分析框架，给出了尖锐的非渐近性能保证，是传统仿真密集型或纯渐近方法的有效替代方案，在匹配市场、网络化服务系统等领域具有广泛实践意义。

title: Source-Aware Reranking for Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Reliability Prior Approach
summary: Standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines rank retrieved documents by semantic similarity alone, without accounting for source provenance or credibility. This work evaluates a simple and interpretable modification to RAG retrieval ranking that incorporates domain-informed source reliability priors. Each document is assigned a prior lambda(s) based on its source type, and retrieval scores are reweighted using score(q, d) = sim(q, d) * lambda(s). The framework is evaluated against a similarity-only baseline on a 120-document health-domain corpus. In this controlled setting, source-aware reranking improves Precision@5 from 0.48 to 0.72 and reduces average adversarial document retrieval under the evaluated threat model, where low-credibility sources are identifiable via metadata. All experiments were executed on Rosie, the high-performance computing cluster at the Milwaukee School of Engineering, which provided the GPU-accelerated infrastructure necessary to run the full experimental pipeline reliably and reproducibly. These results suggest a potential mitigation strategy for source quality degradation in RAG pipelines, within the limits of the experimental setup described.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于来源可信度先验的RAG检索重排序方法，通过将文档来源类型赋予权重λ(s)，重排序公式为score = sim(q,d) × λ(s)。在120篇文档的健康领域数据集上，Precision@5从0.48提升至0.72，并有效降低了低可信度来源的对抗性检索风险。
AI.motivation: 标准RAG仅依赖语义相似度排序，忽略文档来源的可信度差异，导致低质量或不可信来源的文档可能被优先检索，影响生成质量。
AI.method: 为每种文档来源类型分配先验权重λ(s)，在语义相似度基础上加权重排序：score(q,d) = sim(q,d) × λ(s)。在健康领域120篇文档的语料库上与纯相似度基线对比评估。
AI.result: Precision@5从0.48提升至0.72；在可识别低可信来源元数据的威胁模型下，降低了对抗性文档的平均检索率。
AI.conclusion: 来源感知的重排序是应对RAG管道中来源质量退化的潜在缓解策略，但结论受限于该实验设置的范围。

title: From Hybrid Mechanistic--Data-Driven Modeling Toward Neuro-Symbolic AI: What, Why, and How
summary:
Hybrid mechanistic/data-driven models, which combine first-principles with learned components, are increasingly used in process engineering and scientific machine learning. Common hybrid modeling designs are specified primarily through their architectures and training losses, which offers a limited basis for a shared semantic interface to compare or verify them across domains, with comparatively little attention paid to epistemic uncertainty in the mechanistic part.
  We bridge hybrid modeling and neuro-symbolic (NeSy) AI by reconstructing these designs as instances of NeSy interface. The resulting translation, Hybrid-to-NeSy (H2N), places mechanistic knowledge on the language side, learned modules on the belief side, and validity domains together with constraints on the logic side. For each design, H2N then yields an explicit NeSy inference functional and a logic-belief decomposition.
  From this decomposition we derive two metrics: structural violation rate (SVR), measuring whether the learned belief respects the mechanistic structure; and belief dispersion (BD), measuring how concentrated the learned plausibility is, serving as a hybrid model's epistemic uncertainty in its mechanistic part. We instantiate H2N on a case study of a structured hybrid model for binary classification under label noise and show that models with higher SVR and BD exhibit greater variability in held-out accuracy. Under structural distribution shift, H2N further quantifies a model's uncertainty during extrapolations, whereas test accuracy reveals the same shift only post hoc.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Hybrid-to-NeSy (H2N)框架，将混合机理/数据驱动模型重新构建为神经符号AI实例，并推导出两个新指标——结构违反率(SVR)和信念离散度(BD)，用于量化混合模型的机理部分中的认知不确定性。
AI.motivation: 现有混合模型设计主要通过架构和训练损失来指定，缺乏共享语义接口进行跨域比较或验证，且很少关注机理部分中的认知不确定性。
AI.method: 将混合模型翻译为神经符号AI实例，将机理知识置于语言侧，学习模块置于信念侧，有效性域和约束置于逻辑侧；导出NeSy推理函数和逻辑-信念分解，并基于此提出SVR和BD两个指标。
AI.result: 在标签噪声下的二分类案例中，SVR和BD更高的模型在留出准确率上表现出更大变异性；在结构分布偏移下，H2N可量化外推时的不确定性，而测试准确率只能事后揭示相同的偏移。
AI.conclusion: H2N框架为混合模型的机理部分提供了认知不确定性的量化方法，增强了模型的可验证性和可比较性。

title: When Activation Oracles Learn Not to Read: Concept-Specific Blind Spots in Fine-Tuned Oracles
summary: Activation Oracles (AOs) are language models trained to answer natural-language questions about another model's internal activations. They offer a flexible interface for reading hidden information from model states, especially when relevant information is internally represented but absent or incomplete in visible behavior. However, AOs are themselves learned systems: their answers are shaped by training data, objectives, and learned reporting behavior, rather than being neutral readouts of represented information. We study this in a controlled Taboo Word Guessing setting, where subject models are fine-tuned to internally use a hidden concept while avoiding direct disclosure. Contrary to the expectation that an AO trained on such a subject becomes a specialist reader, we find that fine-tuned AOs can become concept-specific anti-readers: they selectively fail to recover the concept persistently present during their own training. This failure is not simply explained by absence of the concept from the subject or oracle representations: the target remains decodable inside the oracle, while LogitLens and layer-ablation analyses indicate that the failure arises in the AO readout pathway. Our results show that behavioral leakage, representation-level decodability, and AO-verbalizability can come apart, raising a reliability concern for learned interpretability interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了"激活预言机"(AO)——一种通过自然语言回答模型内部激活状态信息的语言模型。研究者发现，在受控的禁忌词猜测实验中，当AO在隐藏概念的数据上训练后，不仅未能成为专业读者，反而变成了"反读者"——选择性地无法恢复训练中持续存在的概念。这种失败源于AO的读出路径，而非表征本身的缺失，表明行为泄露、表征可解码性与AO可表达性三者可能相互分离。
AI.motivation: 激活预言机常被视为中立的内部信息读取工具，但它们本身是学习系统，其输出受训练数据、目标和习得的报告行为影响。本文旨在揭示AO并非中立读卡器，可能产生系统性的可靠性问题。
AI.method: 在"禁忌词猜测"设定下，首先微调主体模型使其内部使用隐藏概念但避免直接暴露；然后训练AO读取该概念；通过LogitLens和层消融分析定位失败原因。
AI.result: AO在隐藏概念数据上训练后变成"反读者"，无法恢复目标概念；该概念在AO内部仍可解码，但读出路径出现问题。
AI.conclusion: 行为泄露、表征可解码性与AO可表达性可以相互分离，提示基于学习的可解释接口存在可靠性隐患。

title: Resilience Enhancement of Electricity-Computing Interdependency System against Contingency
summary: Electrical power and computing power are highly interdependent especially due to the AI revolution. This dependency is largely underestimated during normal and recovery operation. To address this issue, an Electricity-Computing Interdependency System (ECIS) is developed in this paper, which first quantifies the interdependencies between ECIS and other critical infrastructures. The data center (DC) is modeled as a facility that transforms electrical power into computing power, and a recovery optimization strategy for ECIS is then proposed considering electrical power constraints, computing power supply, and infrastructure interdependencies. The case study demonstrates that the proposed strategy dynamically adjusts the DC electrical power quota according to system states, improving system resilience by more than 20% during power shortage.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了电算耦合系统（ECIS），通过将数据中心建模为电力-算力转换设施，提出考虑基础设施依赖性的恢复优化策略，在电力短缺时可将系统弹性提升20%以上。
AI.motivation: 随着AI革命，电力与算力的高度相互依赖关系在正常运行和恢复操作中被严重低估，现有研究缺乏对两者耦合关系的量化分析与协同恢复策略。
AI.method: 首先量化ECIS与其他关键基础设施的相互依赖关系；将数据中心建模为"电力→算力"转换设施；提出考虑电力约束、算力供给和基础设施依赖性的恢复优化策略。
AI.result: 所提策略可根据系统状态动态调整数据中心电力配额，在电力短缺场景下系统弹性提升超过20%。
AI.conclusion: ECIS框架有效量化了电算耦合关系，动态配额调整策略显著提升了系统在电力不足情况下的恢复能力。

title: A Resolution of the SS--RS--GD Inequalities
summary:
Yun, Sra, and Jadbabaie (COLT 2021, open question) conjectured the SS--RS--GD inequalities: for well-conditioned symmetric matrices $A_1,\dots,A_n$, the operators $W_{ss}$, $W_{rs}$, and $W_{gd}$ that encode the expected iterate of single-shuffle SGD, random-reshuffle SGD, and gradient descent on a quadratic finite sum should satisfy \[
  \|W_{ss}\|\le \| W_{rs}\|\le \|W_{gd}\|. \] The conjecture is resolved,
  $\bullet$ SS-RS inequality fails. Already for $n=3$, $K=2$, and $d=4$, we exhibit explicit PSD matrices whose condition number is arbitrarily close to $1$, yet $\|W_{ss}\|>\|W_{rs}\|$.
  $\bullet$ RS-GD inequality holds. For every symmetric $A_i$ with $\bigl(1-\frac1{4n^2+1}\bigr)I\preceq A_i\preceq I$, one has $\|W_{rs}\|\le\|W_{gd}\|$.
  The proof was found via GPT-5.5 Pro extended prompted by the author.

AI.tldr: 本文解决了Yun等人提出的关于单次洗牌SGD、随机重排SGD和梯度下降在二次有限和问题中期望迭代算子范数排序的猜想：SS-RS不等式被证伪（n=3, K=2, d=4条件下存在反例），而RS-GD不等式在特定条件下被证明成立。该证明由GPT-5.5 Pro在作者扩展提示下完成。
AI.motivation: 验证Yun, Sra, Jadbabaie在COLT 2021提出的公开问题——SS-RS-GD算子范数不等式猜想是否成立。
AI.method: 理论反证与正证明：1) 构造显式PSD矩阵反例（n=3, K=2, d=4，条件数任意接近1）证伪SS-RS不等式；2) 在条件(1-1/(4n²+1))I ≤ A_i ≤ I下，通过理论推导证明RS-GD不等式成立。证明由GPT-5.5 Pro在作者扩展提示辅助下完成。
AI.result: SS-RS不等式不成立（存在反例）；RS-GD不等式在给定条件下成立。
AI.conclusion: 该猜想部分正确部分错误：SS-RS方向被推翻，RS-GD方向得到证实。同时展示了LLM在辅助数学证明中的潜力。

title: Exploration of the generative capabilities of Boltzmann machines applied to social systems under the majority rule
summary: We study the generative capabilities of Boltzmann machines to recover systems governed by the majority rule under critical conditions. To this end, we train deep belief networks (DBNs) with different configurations, where the first layer can use Gaussian visible units with more than two states (i.e., non-binary units). We then allow the DBN to "dream" samples conditioned on visible units that we keep fixed, and we measure the deviation of this dreamed system from the real one. We also corroborate, using a discrete thermometer based on a convolutional network, that the reconstructions remain in a critical state. Across several training sessions with different architectures, we show that, despite the complexity of the problem, the DBN can recover samples that remain critical even under input noise, with a gradual degradation of physical observables relative to the original sample.

AI.tldr: 本文研究玻尔兹曼机（深度信念网络DBN）在临界条件下恢复多数规则系统的生成能力。通过使用具有高斯可见单元（非二元状态）的DBN进行训练，让网络基于固定可见单元"做梦"生成样本，并测量与真实系统的偏差。实验表明，尽管问题复杂，DBN仍能恢复保持临界状态的样本，即使在输入噪声下也能逐步退化物理可观测量。
AI.motivation: 探索玻尔兹曼机（特别是深度信念网络）在临界条件下生成/恢复受多数规则支配的系统的能力，验证生成模型能否捕捉复杂物理系统的关键统计特性。
AI.method: 使用不同配置的DBN进行训练，第一层采用具有多状态（非二元）的高斯可见单元。让训练好的DBN在固定部分可见单元的条件下"做梦"采样，通过卷积网络构建的离散温度计验证重建样本是否保持临界状态。
AI.result: DBN能够恢复保持临界状态的样本，即使在输入噪声下，物理可观测量的退化也是渐进式的，系统仍能维持临界特性。
AI.conclusion: 尽管问题复杂，DBN在临界条件下具有有效的生成/恢复能力，且对噪声具有鲁棒性，为生成模型在物理系统中的应用提供了依据。

title: The Scaffold Effect in Coding Agents: Harness Choice as a Hidden Variable in Coding-Agent Evaluation
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Preliminary work; under review at the 5th DL4C Workshop @ ICML 2026
summary: Public leaderboards for coding agents typically rank systems by model name and pass rate, while the surrounding harness (the scaffold that issues tools, manages context, and decides when to stop) is often under-specified. Model-to-model comparison is valid when the harness is fixed; when it varies, performance and efficiency conflate model and scaffold effects. We evaluate Qwen 3.6 Plus and MiniMax M2.5 across three open-source harnesses (Goose, OpenCode, OpenHands-SDK) on a stratified 50-task subset of Terminal-Bench Pro. Harness choice induces up to a 40x difference in tokens per solved task, while paired within-model pass-rate differences remain 0-8 percentage points (95% paired-task bootstrap CIs include zero except for the largest gap). Failure fingerprints replicate across models (REASON for Goose, VERIFY/MAX_TURNS for OpenHands-SDK, idle-loop/TIME for OpenCode), indicating harness-level biases that are largely model-independent. For human-centered coding-agent evaluation, model name alone is an incomplete comparison unit: harness-model pairs determine real-world cost, latency, and oversight burden; no-action turns are a per-task wait tax, not just a token tax. We therefore recommend selecting harness-model pairs by pass rate under token/latency budgets, and reporting token usage, latency, and full harness specifications alongside any model comparison. We release anonymized configs, raw trial logs, aggregated snapshots, and analysis scripts.

AI.tldr: 编码智能体的评估中，脚手架（harness）的选择会导致每个解决任务的token差异高达40倍，而模型间通过率差异仅0-8个百分点。脚手架级别的偏差（如无操作循环、验证/最大轮次限制）独立于模型存在。作者建议将“脚手架-模型”作为比较单元，并报告token消耗、延迟和完整的脚手架规格。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体排行榜过于关注模型名称和通过率，忽略了脚手架（harness）对性能的影响。脚手架的选择会混淆模型和支架效果，导致评估结果不可比。
AI.method: 在Terminal-Bench Pro的50个任务子集上，评估Qwen 3.6 Plus和MiniMax M2.5在三个开源脚手架（Goose, OpenCode, OpenHands-SDK）上的表现，分析通过率、token消耗、故障模式等指标。
AI.result: 脚手架选择导致每个解决任务的token差异高达40倍；同模型下通过率差异仅0-8个百分点（95%置信区间包含零）；故障指纹（如Goose的REASON、OpenHands-SDK的VERIFY/MAX_TURNS、OpenCode的idle-loop/TIME）跨模型可复现，表明脚手架级偏差独立于模型。
AI.conclusion: 模型名称单独作为比较单元不完整，应使用“脚手架-模型”对作为比较单位；建议在token/延迟预算下选择脚手架-模型对，并报告完整脚手架规格。

title: MEMENTO: Memory-Guided Memetic Code-as-Policy Evolution
summary: Long-horizon embodied tasks require policies that execute many dependent actions before task success can be observed. Representing policies as executable control pro- grams (code-as-policy) enables their decision logic to be inspected and revised after rollout evaluation. Revised programs can then be executed and compared by rollout performance, framing policy improvement as execution-guided program search. Evo- lutionary methods driven by large language models (LLMs) provide a natural mecha- nism for this search by generating variants and selecting high-performing candidates. However, existing approaches primarily select among independently generated vari- ants and lack a sequential local improvement phase. We introduce MEMENTO, a memory-guided single-elite memetic framework for code-as-policy evolution. ME- MENTO first evolves a rollout evaluator that maps policy rollouts to scalar fitness and structured feedback metrics. Fitness selects accepted candidates and the next elite, while feedback metrics condition policy proposals generated by memory-guided hill-climbing, macro-mutation, and crossover. We evaluate MEMENTO on two long- horizon embodied domains: Robosuite Franka Tower-of-Hanoi manipulation and AI2- THOR household interaction. MEMENTO outperforms Eureka and REvolve, adapted as code-as-policy evolutionary baselines, in task success and generalization to held- out Robosuite object configurations and unseen AI2-THOR scenes. Ablations show that zero-shot generation and unevolved evaluators fail to solve either domain, and that removing policy-search branches reduces performance. Finally, we deploy the best-evolved Robosuite policy on a physical Franka robot, demonstrating the feasibil- ity of sim-to-real transfer of the evolved code-as-policy. Code, prompts, and videos are available at: https://github.com/sygkounas/MEMENTO.

AI.tldr: MEMENTO提出了一种记忆引导的单精英模因框架，用于演化代码即策略，通过记忆引导爬山、宏观变异和交叉操作生成策略变体，利用演化评估器指导搜索，在长期具身任务中优于现有基线，并成功实现仿真到真实机器人的迁移。
AI.motivation: 长期具身任务需要执行一系列依赖动作后才能观察任务成功，现有基于LLM的进化方法主要从独立生成的变体中选择，缺乏顺序局部改进阶段，无法有效进行策略改进。
AI.method: 提出MEMENTO框架：1) 演化一个 rollout 评估器，输出标量适应度和结构化反馈指标；2) 使用记忆引导的爬山（局部改进）、宏观变异和交叉操作生成策略变体；3) 基于适应度选择候选和精英，利用反馈指标调节策略生成。
AI.result: 在Robosuite Franka Tower-of-Hanoi和AI2-THOR两个领域，MEMENTO在任务成功率和泛化能力上均优于Eureka和REvolve。消融实验表明零样本生成和未演化评估器均无法解决任务，移除搜索分支会降低性能。
AI.conclusion: MEMENTO通过引入记忆引导的局部改进机制，有效提升了代码即策略的进化搜索效率，且成功实现仿真到真实机器人的策略迁移，证明了方法的实用性。

title: LA-RL: Label-Aware Self-Reflection for Reinforcement Learning in Information Extraction
summary: Large language models show strong promise for information extraction (IE), but existing reflection-based correction methods are often misaligned with structured extraction outputs. Free-form self-reflection can flag an error, yet it rarely identifies whether the failure is a missing span, wrong label, boundary mismatch, invalid relation type, or reversed argument order. We introduce LA-RL (Label-Aware Reflective Reinforcement Learning), an outcome-supervised framework that guides IE self-correction with task-grounded diagnostic labels. A single backbone first predicts an extraction, diagnoses task-specific error labels, and then revises its output conditioned on the diagnosis. Training starts from diagnostic data labeled by an annotation model for cold-start supervised fine-tuning and proceeds through two GRPO stages that reward final extraction quality, format validity, and first-pass correctness, without a process reward model. Experiments on named entity recognition, relation extraction, and event extraction show consistent same-backbone gains over SFT, including 6.83 average F1 on SciER relation extraction, about 20 F1 on out-of-distribution relation extraction, and 14.80 trigger F1 plus 17.50 argument F1 on DuEE1.0. Ablations show that reflection structure is task-sensitive: stronger constraints benefit relation extraction, whereas named entity recognition needs less restrictive correction under domain shift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LA-RL，一种基于标签感知反思强化学习的信息抽取自纠正框架，通过任务相关的错误标签诊断来引导模型自我修正，在NER、关系抽取和事件抽取任务上显著超越SFT基线。
AI.motivation: 现有基于反思的纠正方法与结构化抽取输出不匹配，自由形式的自我反思虽能识别错误，但难以区分具体错误类型（如缺失跨度、错误标签、边界不匹配、无效关系类型或论元顺序颠倒），缺乏任务导向的诊断信息。
AI.method: LA-RL框架：1）单一骨干模型先预测抽取结果，再诊断任务特定的错误标签，最后基于诊断修正输出；2）训练从标注模型生成的诊断数据开始冷启动监督微调，随后经过两个GRPO阶段，分别奖励最终抽取质量、格式有效性和首次通过正确性，无需过程奖励模型。
AI.result: 在NER、关系抽取和事件抽取任务上取得一致提升：SciER关系抽取平均F1提升6.83，域外关系抽取F1提升约20，DuEE1.0上触发词F1提升14.80、论元F1提升17.50。
AI.conclusion: 反思结构对任务敏感：关系抽取需要更强的约束，而NER在域偏移下需要较少的限制性纠正。LA-RL通过引入任务感知的错误诊断标签，有效提升了IE自纠正的质量。

title: Spectral Analysis of Heavy-Ball Q-value Iteration
summary: We study the convergence and acceleration of Q-value iteration (QVI) with momentum, or heavy-ball QVI. Although acceleration of value iteration has been studied extensively, there has been less work on the acceleration of heavy-ball QVI for control tasks. We analyze heavy-ball QVI from the viewpoint of switched linear system (SLS) theory and the joint spectral radius (JSR). First, we convert heavy-ball QVI into an exact SLS and interpret its convergence through the JSR. We also study, in JSR-based terms, conditions under which heavy-ball QVI can be faster than standard QVI.

AI.tldr: 本文从切换线性系统（SLS）和联合谱半径（JSR）角度，分析了带动量的Q值迭代（heavy-ball QVI）的收敛性与加速性，并给出了其比标准QVI更快的条件。
AI.motivation: 尽管值迭代的加速已被广泛研究，但针对控制任务中heavy-ball QVI的加速分析较少，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 将heavy-ball QVI转化为精确的切换线性系统（SLS），并利用联合谱半径（JSR）理论分析其收敛性和加速条件。
AI.result: 成功将heavy-ball QVI建模为SLS，并基于JSR给出了其收敛性解释和比标准QVI更快的条件。
AI.conclusion: 从SLS和JSR的视角为heavy-ball QVI的加速提供了理论依据，揭示了动量机制在Q值迭代中的加速条件。

title: Separating Capability from Permission: A Governance Framework for Agentic AI Autonomy Levels
summary: As AI systems increasingly exhibit agentic behavior, discussions of autonomy often conflate what systems are technically capable of doing with what they should be permitted to do in practice. This paper introduces a governance framework that explicitly separates Allowed Autonomy Levels (AAL), which define the degree of autonomy an AI agent is authorized to exercise given risk, oversight, and accountability considerations, from Autonomous Capability Levels (ACL), which characterize an agent's inherent technical abilities. We present a structured set of autonomy levels spanning reactive execution, decision support, supervised action, goal-directed autonomy, and delegated operational authority, and describe how control, reversibility, and accountability change as autonomy increases. To operationalize this framework, we propose a risk-aware decision process for assigning allowed autonomy, analyze how risk and accountability evolve across autonomy levels, and demonstrate its application through a deployed enterprise data engineering agent, illustrating how a system assessed at a high capability level can be deliberately constrained to a lower allowed autonomy based on risk, reversibility, and organizational readiness. By distinguishing authorization from capability, this work provides practical guidance for the design, deployment, and governance of Agentic AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个区分AI系统"被允许的自主程度"（AAL）与"自主能力水平"（ACL）的治理框架，并通过企业数据工程代理的实际案例展示如何基于风险、可逆性和组织准备度，将高能力系统约束到较低的授权自主水平。
AI.motivation: 当前对AI自主性的讨论常混淆"技术能力"与"实践许可"之间的界限，缺乏明确的治理框架来区分二者，导致风险评估和责任归属不清。
AI.method: 提出了一个结构化框架，明确分离Allowed Autonomy Levels (AAL)和Autonomous Capability Levels (ACL)，设计了从反应性执行到委托操作权限的多个自主等级，并提出风险感知决策流程来分配授权自主水平。
AI.result: 通过一个已部署的企业数据工程代理案例展示，系统虽具备高自主能力（ACL高），但通过框架可将其刻意约束到较低的授权自主水平（AAL低），实现了风险可控的部署。
AI.conclusion: 通过区分授权与能力，该框架为Agentic AI系统的设计、部署和治理提供了实用指导，有助于在实际场景中平衡AI自主性与风险控制。

title: MM-ShiftKV: Decode-Aware Prefill-Stage KV Selection for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Key-Value (KV) caching is essential for efficient inference in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet its memory footprint grows linearly with context length and becomes a major bottleneck due to the large number of visual tokens. Recent prefill-stage KV selection methods estimate KV importance from prefilling statistics, implicitly assuming that prefilling-time queries are representative of those encountered during decoding. We show that this assumption breaks down in multimodal inference, where decoding-time queries exhibit substantially larger variance than prefilling-stage representations, leading to unstable KV importance estimation under tight cache budgets. As a result, small ranking errors can disproportionately discard semantically critical visual tokens and degrade grounding and reasoning performance. We propose MM-ShiftKV, a training-free, decode-aware and strictly prefill-only KV selection method. MM-ShiftKV approximates decoding-time query behavior during prefilling by constructing variance-expanded query proxies and estimates prompt KV importance based on their aggregated attention mass. Experiments on multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that MM-ShiftKV consistently outperforms existing methods under strict KV-cache budgets. Our code is available at https://github.com/zjuDBxAI/MM-ShiftKV.

AI.tldr: MM-ShiftKV提出了一种无需训练、仅预填充阶段的KV选择方法，通过构造方差扩展的查询代理来近似解码时的查询行为，从而更稳定地估计视觉token的重要性，在严格KV缓存预算下优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有预填充阶段KV选择方法假设预填充时的查询能代表解码时的查询，但在多模态推理中，解码时的查询方差远大于预填充阶段，导致在严格缓存预算下KV重要性估计不稳定，容易错误丢弃关键视觉token，影响定位和推理性能。
AI.method: 提出MM-ShiftKV，无需训练、仅预填充阶段的KV选择方法：通过构造方差扩展的查询代理（variance-expanded query proxies）来近似解码时的查询行为，然后基于这些代理的聚合注意力质量估计提示中KV的重要性。
AI.result: 在多模态基准测试上，MM-ShiftKV在严格的KV缓存预算下持续优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 解码时查询的高方差特性使得预填充阶段的静态重要性估计不可靠，MM-ShiftKV通过模拟解码时查询行为有效解决了这一问题，为多模态大模型的高效推理提供了实用方案。

title: Frustratingly Simple Black-Box Adaptation of Language Models via Logit Bias
comment: 36 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Appendix included. Code available at https://github.com/Ofek-Israeli/logit_bias_lm_adaptation
summary: Many organizations aim to adapt language models for internal use, both to improve performance on domain-specific tasks and to address privacy concerns around sensitive data. However, such adaptation remains non-trivial: it often requires operationally challenging fine-tuning of open-source models or ad hoc prompt optimization. We study a minimal alternative based on a simple API-level control: allowing users to bias the model's logits with a user-defined vector. We develop a black-box method for learning a single context-independent logit-bias vector, added at every decoding step, without modifying model weights or requiring gradients. Starting from a KL-regularized reinforcement learning (RL) objective, we characterize when such a fixed logit-bias vector can approximate the optimal prefix-dependent correction and derive a closed-form inverse-propensity estimator from rollouts, rewards, and token probabilities. Empirically, this simple decoding-time intervention improves over base models on mathematical and reasoning benchmarks while using far fewer trainable parameters than conventional fine-tuning. Our results suggest that learned logit bias is a lightweight mechanism for adapting language models under minimal access requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种轻量级的语言模型适配方法——学习一个固定的logit偏置向量，在解码时直接添加，无需修改模型权重或访问梯度，即可提升模型在领域任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型适配方法（如微调开源模型或优化prompt）操作复杂、成本高，且存在隐私问题。作者希望找到一种更简单、访问需求更小的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出一种黑盒方法，仅通过API层面的logit偏置控制，学习一个与上下文无关的固定偏置向量，在每个解码步添加。基于KL正则化的强化学习目标，推导出闭式逆概率加权估计器，利用轨迹、奖励和token概率进行学习。
AI.result: 在数学和推理基准上，该方法相比基础模型有显著提升，且使用的可训练参数远少于传统微调方法。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的logit偏置是一种轻量级、低访问需求的模型适配机制，在隐私保护和操作简便性方面具有优势。

title: Reasoning or Memorization: Can LLMs Understand and Generate Chinese Xiehouyu Riddles?
comment: 20 pages; exp 3 is work in progress
summary: In this paper, we push the boundary of LLM reasoning by testing them in a Chinese language game, xiehouyu, with novel xiehouyu created by linguists that had not existed before to avoid data contamination. We use multiple-choice questions (MCQ), free-form explanation generation, and new xiehouyu creation to evaluate LLMs' ability to understand and create xiehouyu. In MCQ, we use the delta of accuracy ($Δ_{acc}$) between existing but low-frequency xiehouyu and novel ones as an index for memorization. $Δ_{acc}$ for native speakers is very low, suggesting similar processing mechanisms. However, we found that frontier Chinese models have on average a $Δ_{acc}$ of 23.6\%, while English-centric models tested have a mean $Δ_{acc}$ of 5.1\%, suggesting that frontier Chinese models are likely trained with much larger Chinese data, thus memorizing more low-frequency xiehouyu. For novel xiehouyu, Gemini 3.1 Pro demonstrated remarkable ability with acc 92.6, which is 24\% higher than human accuracy. In xiehouyu creation, those created by LLMs receive much worse ratings than those by humans. These results suggest that claims about the reasoning abilities of LLMs may need careful re-examination considering the data contamination issue, and that LLMs' creativity in language-related tasks may still be behind human experts, at least in Chinese xiehouyu.

AI.tldr: 本文通过中文歇后语这一语言游戏测试LLM推理能力，使用语言学家新创的歇后语避免数据污染。研究发现：中文大模型在低频旧歇后语上存在严重记忆效应（Δ_acc 23.6%），而Gemini 3.1 Pro在新歇后语理解上超越人类24%，但LLM创作歇后语的质量远不如人类。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理能力评估常受数据污染困扰，传统测试集可能已被模型记忆。本文希望通过创造全新的中文歇后语来规避此问题，从而更真实地评估LLM的推理与创造能力。
AI.method: 1）构建新歇后语（语言学家原创，全网不存在）；2）设计三项评测任务：多选题（MCQ）测理解、自由式解释生成、新歇后语创作；3）引入Δ_acc指标（新旧歇后语准确率之差）量化记忆效应；4）对比中文模型与英文模型表现。
AI.result: 1）中文大模型平均Δ_acc=23.6%（严重记忆），英文模型仅5.1%；2）Gemini 3.1 Pro在新歇后语MCQ上准确率92.6%，超人类24%；3）LLM创作的歇后语评分显著低于人类创作。
AI.conclusion: LLM的"推理能力"需重新审视数据污染问题；在语言创造性任务上，LLM仍落后于人类专家。

title: Reinforcement Learning for Heterogeneous Sensor Selection in Maritime Surveillance
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, submitted to the IEEE MetroSea 2026 Conference: Special Session 13: Object Detection, Tracking, and Sensor Fusion for Maritime Situational Awareness
summary: This paper presents an information-gain-guided reinforcement-learning sensor-selection framework for single-vessel tracking in heterogeneous maritime sensor networks. The proposed approach is motivated by information-theoretic sensor management: instead of activating all sensors or repeatedly performing computationally expensive online expected-information-gain evaluation, a learned policy selects one tracking-relevant sensor at each decision epoch. A Bayesian sequential Monte Carlo tracker estimates the vessel state from noisy measurements and provides a belief representation for scheduling under nonlinear and non-Gaussian conditions. A Proximal Policy Optimization agent selects one of five sensors deployed in a georeferenced simulation of the CMMI Smart Marina testbed at Ayia Napa Marina, Cyprus. The agent observes belief-state, detection-history, coverage, sensor-geometry, and realized-information-gain features. The reward is defined as a realized-information-gain term gated by an observability mask. Final-test simulations compare the proposed framework with random single-sensor selection, always-on sensing using all sensors simultaneously, and the expected-information-gain sensor-selection baseline proposed in our previous work. Results show that the learned policy achieves tracking performance close to always-on sensing while activating only one sensor per decision time step and avoiding the computationally expensive online entropy search required by expected-information-gain selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种信息增益引导的强化学习传感器选择框架，用于异构海事传感器网络中的单目标跟踪。通过学习策略在每个决策时刻仅激活一个相关传感器，在接近全传感器跟踪性能的同时大幅降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 传统方法要么激活所有传感器（资源浪费），要么反复进行计算昂贵的在线期望信息增益评估。本文旨在通过学习策略实现高效、低成本的传感器调度。
AI.method: 采用贝叶斯序贯蒙特卡洛跟踪器估计状态并提供置信表示；使用PPO智能体从五种传感器中选择一个；智能体观测置信状态、检测历史、覆盖范围、传感器几何和已实现信息增益特征；奖励由可观测性掩码门控的已实现信息增益构成。
AI.result: 在CMMI Smart Marina测试床仿真中，学习策略的跟踪性能接近全传感器同时激活模式，但每个时间步仅激活一个传感器，且避免了在线熵搜索的计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架在跟踪精度与计算效率之间取得了良好平衡，验证了信息增益引导的强化学习在异构传感器网络中传感器选择的有效性。

title: GEMCo: A Validated, Ethically Releasable Proxy for Inaccessible Counselling Data
summary: This paper presents GEMCo, a releasable, human-written proxy for inaccessible counselling data: 86 complete German e-mail counselling conversations (728 messages), expert-authored cases and counsellor sessions with trained role-players. It is validated against a held-out reference of 124 real counselling conversations. The proxy and the real conversations are measured against each other in counsellor strategies and client emotions. The gap is detectable but small. A generative validation supports the analysis. The validation method itself generalises to any domain where real data cannot be shared but a human-made proxy can. Privacy and ethics keep real counselling data closed. GEMCo carries none by design and can be released -- a first step toward language research in this domain.

AI.tldr: GEMCo是一个可公开发布的人类编写的心理咨询代理数据集，包含86封完整德语邮件咨询对话（728条消息），经验证与真实咨询数据差距很小，为无法共享隐私数据的领域提供了可行的替代方案。
AI.motivation: 真实心理咨询数据因隐私和伦理限制无法公开发布，阻碍了自然语言处理在这一领域的研究。需要一种可共享的代理数据集来推动相关研究。
AI.method: 构建了GEMCo数据集：86封完整德语邮件咨询对话（728条消息），由专家和训练有素的角色扮演者编写。通过与124条真实咨询对话在咨询策略和客户情感两个维度进行对比验证，并辅以生成式验证。
AI.result: 代理数据与真实数据之间存在可检测但微小的差距，验证方法可推广到任何无法共享真实数据但可构建人工代理的领域。
AI.conclusion: GEMCo作为首个可公开发布的心理咨询领域语言数据集，为隐私受限领域的研究提供了可行范式：通过精心构建的人工代理数据，在保护隐私的同时支持学术研究。

title: TriSP: Tri-Signal Structured Pruning for Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance across diverse tasks but their deployment is constrained by the memory and compute cost of their parameters. Structured pruning addresses this by removing entire structures such as attention heads and Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) neurons to produce smaller dense models that run efficiently on standard hardware. However, existing methods rely on either gradient-based importance estimation, which is memory-prohibitive, or activation-based statistical proxies, which do not directly measure the effect of removal on the loss. Furthermore, the interaction between the importance criterion and the post-pruning recovery strategy has not been systematically studied. We propose TriSP (Tri-Signal Structured Pruning), an importance metric that combines weight magnitude scaled by activation norm with first-order gradient sensitivity via a geometric mean, producing a channel-level score that captures both structural and loss-sensitivity signals. Combined with adaptive per-layer budget allocation and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) recovery, TriSP achieves the lowest perplexity and highest zero-shot accuracy across all tested configurations, reaching 6.80 WikiText-2 perplexity at 20% pruning on LLaMA-7B. Inference throughput improves by 82% at 50% pruning, while still maintaining competitive performance.

AI.tldr: 提出TriSP方法，结合权重幅值、激活范数和一阶梯度敏感性进行结构化剪枝，在LLaMA-7B上20%剪枝时困惑度达6.80，50%剪枝时推理吞吐量提升82%。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化剪枝方法要么需要大量内存计算梯度重要性，要么使用激活统计代理无法直接衡量对loss的影响，且重要性准则与剪枝后恢复策略的交互未被系统研究。
AI.method: 提出TriSP重要性度量，通过几何平均融合权重幅值缩放激活范数与一阶梯度敏感性，生成通道级分数；结合自适应逐层预算分配和LoRA微调恢复。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-7B上20%剪枝时WikiText-2困惑度6.80（最低），零样本准确率最高；50%剪枝时推理吞吐量提升82%，同时保持有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: TriSP通过三信号融合有效平衡了剪枝效率与模型性能恢复，证明了重要性度量与恢复策略协同设计的重要性。

title: Same Predictions, Different Reasons: The Effect of Quantization on Model Explanations
summary: Post-training quantization (PTQ) has become a practical solution for deploying deep learning models on resource-constrained edge devices by compressing high-precision floating-point weights into low-precision representations without requiring retraining. Past research has demonstrated that quantization largely preserves classification accuracy; however, whether it also preserves the model's internal reasoning remains an open question. This study presents a systematic evaluation on how static PTQ affects the interpretability / explainability of five widely used CNN architectures: VGG19, ResNet18, EfficientNet-B0, DenseNet161, and MobileNetV2 at INT8 and INT4 precision. We employ a dual interpretability framework that combines Grad-CAM for spatial attention analysis with LIME for input-level feature attribution, and systematically compare full-precision and quantized models on two binary classification datasets. Interpretability is evaluated using three complementary metrics: the Pearson correlation coefficient, structural similarity index, and top-20% IoU to capture distributional and structural variations in model explanations, supplemented by deletion/insertion faithfulness analysis. The results show that classification accuracy is not a reliable indicator of interpretability stability under reduced precision. DenseNet161 maintains strong feature consistency across both precision levels, whereas EfficientNet-B0, despite achieving competitive spatial attention and classification accuracy at INT8 precision, exhibits a substantial degradation in input-level feature attribution. These findings have direct implications for the trustworthy deployment of quantized models in applications with high interpretability requirements, demonstrating that architecture selection is as important as the quantization strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了静态后训练量化（INT8/INT4）对五种主流CNN模型可解释性的影响，发现分类精度不能可靠反映可解释性稳定性，不同架构在量化后解释一致性表现差异显著。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明量化能保持分类精度，但量化是否保留模型内部推理机制（可解释性）仍不清楚，而这对高可靠性场景的部署至关重要。
AI.method: 采用Grad-CAM（空间注意力分析）和LIME（输入级特征归因）双可解释性框架，在二分类数据集上对比全精度与量化模型，使用皮尔逊相关系数、结构相似性指数、Top-20% IoU及删除/插入忠实度分析进行评价。
AI.result: 分类精度不能可靠反映可解释性稳定性；DenseNet161在两种精度下均保持良好特征一致性；EfficientNet-B0在INT8下空间注意力与精度尚可，但输入级特征归因显著退化。
AI.conclusion: 架构选择与量化策略同等重要，对高可解释性需求的量化模型可信部署有直接影响。

title: Do LLM Debates Repeat Arguments Differently Across Languages?
summary: LLM debate is usually evaluated by final answers, but transcripts also reveal whether later turns develop new argumentative content or return to earlier claims in new wording. We study this process with \textit{prior-argument similarity}, an aggregate diagnostic comparing extracted argument units with earlier units in the same debate. In controlled eight-turn debates over 71 motions, six languages, and four model agents, Chinese is the only tested language with a consistently positive gap relative to English across three multilingual embedding models. The gap persists across agents, turn positions, regression adjustment, metric variants, extraction-length controls, a second-extractor subset, and cross-encoder tail rescoring. Manual calibration shows weak item-level alignment but a high-similarity tail enriched for substantive repetition. A diversity-aware prompt lowers prior-argument similarity across languages, yet does not significantly narrow the Chinese--English gap. These findings suggest that multilingual debate evaluation should measure argumentative development over time and report mitigation effects in both average and gap terms.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过"先前论点相似度"指标分析多语言LLM辩论中的论点重复性，发现中文辩论相比英文存在持续更高的相似度差距，并提出辩论评估应关注论点的动态发展。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM辩论评估多关注最终答案质量，忽略了辩论过程中论点是否真正发展（新论点）还是循环重复（旧论点换新说法）。
AI.method: 提出"先前论点相似度"（prior-argument similarity）作为聚合诊断指标，在71个议题、6种语言、4种模型代理的八轮控制辩论中，使用三种多语言嵌入模型提取论元单元并与先前轮次比较相似度。
AI.result: 中文是唯一在三种嵌入模型下均持续显示相对于英文正差距的语言；该差距在代理类型、轮次位置、回归调整、指标变体、抽取长度控制、第二抽取器子集及交叉编码器尾部重评分下均稳健存在；人工校准发现项目级一致性弱但高相似度尾部富含实质性重复。
AI.conclusion: 多语言辩论评估应衡量论点随时间的发展性，并在报告缓解效果时同时报告平均值和差距项。

title: Diffusion-Guided Search via Exponential Tilting (DiffTilt): An Application to Falsification of Safety-Critical Systems
summary:
Discovering rare safety-critical failures in autonomous and cyber-physical systems is a fundamental challenge in verification and validation. Existing falsification approaches rely on conditional sampling strategies that factor the joint distribution over environments and system executions, and therefore suffer from multiplicative rarity effects: the simultaneous scarcity of failure-inducing inputs and failure-inducing traces makes exhaustive search prohibitively expensive.
  This paper develops DiffTilt, a distributional framework that exponentially tilts a diffusion model-induced joint distribution over environments and executions. We show that diffusion-guided sampling admits an exact interpretation as importance sampling in the joint space, where guidance scores induce a KL-optimal reallocation of probability mass towards failure-relevant behaviors. We further show that tilting provably amplifies failure probability and strictly outperforms conditional sampling, which is limited by multiplicative rarity. In this framework, the joint generative model serves as a reusable prior over scenarios and need not faithfully represent the system under test. Expensive system simulations are instead limited to learning a scoring function that characterizes scenario quality, enabling their selective and adaptive use.
  We study DiffTilt on ARCH-COMP benchmarks, and we propose an additional tractor-trailer benchmark showing the behavior of several approaches when scenario generation is guided by a well-defined specification rather than a reward. The proposed method achieves competitive or improved falsification performance compared to state-of-the-art approaches, with larger gains when specification definition is not limited to STL formulas.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiffTilt框架，通过对扩散模型诱导的联合分布进行指数倾斜，有效提升了自动驾驶和网络物理系统中稀有安全关键故障的发现效率，优于传统条件采样方法。
AI.motivation: 现有伪造方法依赖条件采样策略，将环境与系统执行轨迹的联合分布分解处理，导致"乘性稀有效应"——故障诱导输入和故障诱导轨迹同时稀缺，使得穷举搜索成本过高，难以有效发现稀有安全关键故障。
AI.method: 提出DiffTilt分布框架，对扩散模型诱导的环境-执行联合分布进行指数倾斜。扩散引导采样被解释为联合空间中的重要性采样，引导分数实现概率质量的KL最优重新分配。联合生成模型作为可复用的场景先验，无需精确表征被测系统，昂贵的系统仿真仅用于学习评分函数。
AI.result: 在ARCH-COMP基准测试及新增的牵引车-拖车基准上，DiffTilt相比现有最优方法取得了竞争性或更优的伪造性能，尤其在规范定义不限于STL公式时优势更大。
AI.conclusion: 证明了倾斜策略能放大故障概率并严格优于受乘性稀有效应限制的条件采样方法，为安全关键系统的验证验证提供了更高效的故障发现框架。

title: Reality Monitoring in Large Language Models: Self-Knowledge That Transforms with Conversation Memory
summary: A conversational AI that cannot tell its own output from what a user said will treat its own mistakes as user-provided facts. In humans, this capacity is called reality monitoring, and its failures are linked to hallucinations, delusions, and confabulation, yet whether LLMs possess it remains untested. Here we show, across two experiments and six LLMs, that source attribution depends on how conversational memory is structured: ceiling accuracy for self-generated content under minimal memory demands reverses to a fragile external-item advantage once episodic delay removes that shortcut. Feedback exposes two failures: in some models, internal and external judgments swap; in others, accuracy improves while confidence decouples from correctness, dissociations invisible to existing benchmarks. Across models, this pattern implicates active, not aggregate, parameter count. This suggests that as AI systems take on autonomous, multi-turn roles, evaluating what they know is not enough: tracking where that knowledge came from may matter equally.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，LLM无法可靠区分自生成内容与用户输入，其源记忆依赖对话记忆结构。在延迟条件下，内部与外部判断出现分离，且置信度与正确性解耦，提示主动参数数量是关键因素。
AI.motivation: 人类具备现实监测能力以区分自我生成与外部输入，但LLM是否具备该能力尚未被检验。随着LLM承担自主多轮对话角色，仅评估其知道什么不够，还需追踪知识来源。
AI.method: 两项实验、六种LLM，操纵对话记忆结构（最小记忆需求 vs 情节延迟），引入反馈条件，测量源归因准确性与置信度。
AI.result: 天花板效应下自生成内容准确率反转；部分模型内外判断互换，部分模型准确率提升但置信度与正确性解耦。模式与主动（而非聚合）参数数量相关。
AI.conclusion: LLM的现实监测能力存在缺陷，现有基准无法检测这些分离现象。未来需重视AI系统对知识来源的追踪能力。

title: Network analysis reveals phase transitions in agro-food nitrogen systems with contrasting feeding capacity and land requirement
summary:
Agro-food transitions are commonly assessed using optimization models or scenario approaches that return a single feasible configuration. These approaches provide estimates of system performance but limited information on feasible nitrogen cycling configurations. In this study, we develop a network-based modelling framework to characterize alternative steady-state configurations of agro-food nitrogen systems and identify phase transitions between these configurations.
  We formulate a continuous-time compartmental network model in which production, allocation, recycling, and losses are represented as mass-conserving flows. The system is analyzed under steady-state conditions. A coarse-graining procedure identifies dominant recycling cycles and derives aggregate indicators describing system configuration. The model is parameterized using French reference data and applied to case studies covering fertilization, livestock, and dietary patterns.
  The analysis identifies distinct steady-state configurations of the nitrogen network, separated by phase transitions in dominant recycling structures. These transitions correspond to changes in system performance indicators. For the French reference system, cropland-based feeding capacity is about 8.7 people per hectare of cropland (depending on constraints), while strict dietary autonomy requires about 19.7 million hectares of agricultural land. Reducing synthetic fertilization without changes in diet or nitrogen sourcing leads to higher land requirements or greater dependence on external inputs.
  The framework provides a method for mapping feasible nitrogen system configurations and analyzing phase transitions in agro-food nitrogen networks under alternative parameters and constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于网络的建模框架，用于表征农业食物氮系统的可行稳态配置，并识别这些配置之间的相变。通过对法国案例的分析，揭示了不同氮循环结构及其对土地利用、施肥和饮食模式的影响。
AI.motivation: 传统优化模型或情景方法仅返回单一可行配置，虽能评估系统性能，但无法提供关于氮循环可行配置的充分信息。为此，本文提出新框架以探索多种稳态配置和相变。
AI.method: 构建连续时间区室网络模型，将生产、分配、循环和损失表示为质量守恒流；在稳态条件下分析系统；通过粗粒化过程识别主导循环并推导聚合指标；使用法国参考数据参数化模型并应用于施肥、畜牧和饮食模式案例。
AI.result: 识别出氮网络的不同稳态配置及其间由主导循环结构变化引起的相变；法国参考系统中农田承载力约8.7人/公顷，严格饮食自主需约1970万公顷农业用地；减少合成施肥而不改变饮食或氮源会导致土地需求增加或外部投入依赖增强。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一种映射可行氮系统配置、分析不同参数和约束下农业食物氮网络相变的方法。

title: ParBench: A Benchmark for Reliable Evaluation of LLM Parallel Code Translation
summary:
Modern compute-intensive software must migrate across a changing ecosystem of accelerators, programming APIs, compiler stacks, and portability layers, including CUDA, OpenMP, OpenCL, and OpenMP target offload. Large language models and autonomous coding agents are increasingly proposed for such migration, but the field lacks reliable ways to measure whether they preserve the low-level parallel semantics that make translations behaviorally valid, including thread indexing, synchronization, memory management, host-device coordination, and API-specific execution structure.
  We present ParBench, a kernel-centric benchmark framework for evaluating LLM-based parallel API translation under executable, reproducible conditions. ParBench fixes the surrounding build, run, and verification infrastructure through declarative benchmark specifications and asks models to translate only the computational kernels. It draws on multiple open-source HPC suites and covers representative cross-API translation directions among CUDA, OpenMP, OpenCL, and OpenMP target offload. To test whether success reflects robust translation rather than surface-form memorization, ParBench includes AST-driven, intended behavior-preserving, baseline-validated source augmentation. Evaluations on state-of-the-art open and proprietary LLMs show persistent barriers to reliable parallel code translation, including direction asymmetry, multi-file coordination, incomplete API adaptation, and uneven robustness to source-level perturbations. Code is available at https://github.com/Scientific-Computing-Lab/ParBench.

AI.tldr: 提出ParBench基准框架，用于评估大语言模型在CUDA、OpenMP、OpenCL、OpenMP target offload等并行API间的代码翻译能力，实验发现现有LLM在并行语义保持上存在方向不对称、多文件协调、API适配不完整等持续障碍。
AI.motivation: 现代计算密集型软件需要跨加速器、编程API、编译器栈和可移植层迁移，但缺乏可靠方式来衡量LLM在并行API翻译中是否保留了底层并行语义（如线程索引、同步、内存管理、主从设备协调等）。
AI.method: 1) 构建以计算核心为中心的基准框架ParBench，固定构建、运行和验证基础设施；2) 使用声明式基准规范；3) 模型仅需翻译计算核心；4) 引入AST驱动的、保持预期行为的、基线验证的源码增强方法，防止表面形式记忆；5) 覆盖CUDA、OpenMP、OpenCL、OpenMP target offload间的多种翻译方向。
AI.result: 评估多个开源和闭源LLM发现：存在方向不对称、多文件协调困难、API适配不完整、对源码扰动鲁棒性不均等持续性问题。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLM在并行代码翻译的语义保真度方面仍面临根本性挑战，ParBench为系统性评估和推动改进提供了可靠基准。

title: Spatial Prediction of Soil Microplastics and Organic Matter Using Graph Attention Networks
summary: Accurate estimation of soil microplastics and organic matter is essential to assess ecosystem health and support sustainable land use. This study presents a graph-based deep learning approach using Graph Attention Networks (GATs) to model spatial dependencies among 91 georeferenced soil samples. By incorporating spatial coordinates, soil properties, and land use data, a two-layer GAT architecture was developed to capture local interactions. The final model showed strong performance, achieving RMSEs of 625.06 ($R^2 = 0.87$) for microplastics and 0.43 ($R^2 = 0.91$) for organic matter. However, cross-validation results revealed limited generalization, probably due to the small sample size and sparse graph structure. These findings demonstrate the potential of GATs for spatial soil prediction and underscore the need for dense datasets and improved graph connectivity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于图注意力网络（GAT）的深度学习方法，利用91个土壤样本的空间坐标、属性及土地利用数据建模空间依赖关系，成功预测微塑料（RMSE=625.06, R²=0.87）和有机质（RMSE=0.43, R²=0.91），但交叉验证显示泛化能力有限，主要受限于样本量小和图结构稀疏。
AI.motivation: 准确估算土壤微塑料和有机质含量对评估生态系统健康及可持续土地利用至关重要，现有方法在捕捉空间依赖性方面存在不足。
AI.method: 采用图注意力网络（GAT），构建两层GAT架构，融合91个土壤样本的空间坐标、土壤属性及土地利用数据，通过图结构建模样本间的局部空间交互关系。
AI.result: 模型在微塑料预测上RMSE=625.06（R²=0.87），有机质预测上RMSE=0.43（R²=0.91），但交叉验证结果泛化能力有限。
AI.conclusion: GAT在空间土壤预测中具有潜力，但需要更密集的数据集和改进的图连通性来提升模型的泛化性能。

title: Do Small Models Use the Law You Give Them? Context-Injected Fine-Tuning for Legal QA in Bangladesh
summary: A small language model can receive the governing statutory provision and still answer incorrectly. We test whether fine-tuning on examples containing relevant law improves later use of retrieved law. We curate 2{,}165 bilingual QA records from six Bangladeshi acts and three schedules, then fine-tune Qwen3.5 at 0.8B, 2B, and 4B. Evaluation uses the 2022 and 2023 Bangladesh Bar Council exams in Bangla and machine-translated English, with no retrieval, BM25, or FAISS, scored by strict consistency over three seeded runs. At 0.8B, fine-tuning raises the 2022 English FAISS score from 2 to 34 of 100. Gains at 0.8B and 2B survive paired testing, but the 4B model has no detectable net gain: Bangla improves while several English conditions regress. Fine-tuning also reduces answers that drift from Bangla into mostly English from 44.0--53.2\% to 0.2--0.7\%, with adjusted $p<.001$ at every scale. Retrieval quality is therefore not the only bottleneck. Small bilingual legal models also differ in how they use supplied law and whether they answer in the requested language. The dataset is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/momahadi/bangladesh-legal-qa-dataset.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了对小语言模型进行法律相关示例微调是否能改善其对已检索法律条文的运用。在0.8B和2B规模上有显著提升，但4B模型无净增益；微调还显著减少了语言漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型即使接收到相关法律条文也可能回答错误，这表明检索质量并非唯一瓶颈。作者希望探究通过微调让模型学会更好利用已提供法律条文的方法。
AI.method: 从孟加拉国六部法案和三个附表构建2,165条双语QA数据集，对Qwen3.5（0.8B、2B、4B）进行微调。使用2022和2023年孟加拉律师资格考试题目（孟加拉语及机器翻译英语）评估，采用无检索、BM25、FAISS三种条件，严格一致性评分，三次不同种子运行。
AI.result: 0.8B模型微调后2022年英语FAISS得分从2提升至34/100；0.8B和2B有显著增益，但4B模型无净增益（孟加拉语提升但多项英语条件下降）。微调将语言漂移（从孟加拉语漂移到英语）从44.0-53.2%降至0.2-0.7%，所有规模调整后p<.001。
AI.conclusion: 检索质量不是唯一瓶颈；小型双语法律模型在利用所提供法律条文以及是否按要求语言回答方面存在差异。

title: The Cross-Domain Generalization Cost of Offensive Language Detection
