summary: Offensive language detection models generally suffer performance degradation when deployed across datasets and across languages, yet most existing studies stop at reporting this phenomenon and lack a systematic methodology for decomposing the causes of degradation into attributable components and quantifying the cost of remediation. This paper proposes a diagnosis and optimization framework composed of three coordinated technical components. First, a zero-shot transfer loss decomposition that separates the performance degradation from OLID to MLMA into two independently measurable components, namely dataset effect and language effect. Second, a controlled fine-tuning protocol that quantifies both adaptation efficiency and the hidden damage inflicted on the source task by comparing few shot learning curves under continued fine-tuning and cold-start starting points. Third, three joint training strategies incorpo rating temperature sampling and experience replay, which offer a controllable Pareto trade-off between improving multilingual capability and preserving source-task performance. Experiments built on this framework show that the dataset effect dominates the zero-shot transfer loss and substantially outweighs the language effect. Few-shot adaptation without a replay mechanism, though data-efficient, inflicts source task damage 4 to 9 times greater than that of the joint training strategies, and its damage magnitude is highly unstable. The three joint training strategies trade 3.2 to 4.1 percentage points of source-task performance for 8.1 to 42.6 percentage points of multilingual capability gain, forming a clear and controllable Pareto trade-off.

AI.tldr: 提出一个诊断和优化框架，将跨数据集和跨语言的性能下降分解为数据集效应和语言效应，并通过受控微调和联合训练策略实现可控的Pareto权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有研究仅报告跨数据集/跨语言的性能下降现象，缺乏系统性方法将退化原因分解为可归因的组成部分并量化修复成本。
AI.method: 提出三部分框架：(1)零样本迁移损失分解，将性能退化分离为数据集效应和语言效应；(2)受控微调协议，通过对比少样本学习曲线量化适应效率和源任务损伤；(3)三种联合训练策略（含温度采样和经验回放），实现多语言能力与源任务性能的可控Pareto权衡。
AI.result: 数据集效应主导零样本迁移损失且远超语言效应；无回放机制的少样本适应虽数据高效，但源任务损伤是联合训练策略的4-9倍且高度不稳定；三种联合训练策略以3.2-4.1%源任务性能换取8.1-42.6%多语言能力提升，形成可控Pareto前沿。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为跨域跨语言攻击性语言检测的退化诊断和优化提供了系统性方法论，实现了退化归因量化和可控权衡。

title: Modelling the Correlation Structure of Uncertain Input Parameters for Energy System Optimization
summary: Statistical dependence among uncertain input parameters in stochastic energy system optimization models is often ignored, even though this can substantially bias outcomes. To address this gap, we are developing a comprehensive framework for characterizing, modelling, and benchmarking statistical dependence. In this work, we present a copula-based workflow to identify, characterize, and model linear and monotonic correlation structures between input parameters, representing the first development step towards this framework. We demonstrate our workflow using solar generation, day-ahead electricity prices, and electricity demand data in Austria between 2019 and 2025. Our results show substantial linear and monotonic dependence between these variables, and that this dependence is well captured by the copula-based approach. Finally, building on this scalable foundation, we highlight key levers for next steps towards the full framework, including time-dependent and higher-dimensional dependence modelling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于copula的工作流，用于识别和建模随机能源系统优化模型中输入参数之间的线性和单调相关性，并以奥地利2019-2025年的太阳能发电、日前电价和电力需求数据验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 随机能源系统优化模型中，输入参数的不确定性统计依赖常被忽略，导致结果偏差。现有研究缺乏系统性的框架来表征和建模这种依赖关系。
AI.method: 采用copula方法构建工作流，用于识别、表征和建模输入参数间的线性和单调相关结构，并结合实际数据验证。
AI.result: 奥地利数据表明太阳能发电、日前电价和电力需求之间存在显著的线性和单调依赖关系，且copula方法能很好地捕捉这些依赖。
AI.conclusion: 该copula工作流为构建完整的统计依赖建模框架打下了可扩展的基础，未来可扩展至时变和高维依赖建模。

title: Lexical discovery in unknown environments orchestrated by Large Language Models
summary: Populations of autonomous agents deployed in unknown environments (e.g. planetary or deep-sea exploration) must develop shared vocabularies to refer to entities that have no name in any human language. We propose the Neuro-Symbolic Lexical Discovery (NSLD) framework, in which a population of LLM-based agents plays a referential game over out-of-distribution visual referents, autonomously self-organising a shared alien lexicon. Each agent combines a frozen CLIP vision encoder with a private FAISS vector index and a text-only LLM. Crucially, discovered alien words are anchored to natural language via semantic proximity in the embedding space, enlarging the human vocabulary with new perceptually grounded words. Consensus is reached in simulations with populations of up to twenty agents and ten visual referents. Convergence dynamics are characterised through three analytical models achieving R^2 > 0.95, representing a first step towards pre-deployment planning in autonomous exploration missions.

AI.tldr: 提出神经符号词汇发现（NSLD）框架，让LLM代理群体通过指涉游戏为未知视觉实体自主构建共享外星词汇，并通过嵌入空间语义锚定扩展人类词汇。
AI.motivation: 自主代理在未知环境（如行星或深海探索）中需要为无人类语言命名的实体建立共享词汇，现有LLM方法缺乏自组织词汇发现能力。
AI.method: 每组代理结合冻结CLIP视觉编码器、私有FAISS向量索引和纯文本LLM，通过指涉游戏（referential game）在分布外视觉指称上自组织共享外星词汇，新词通过嵌入空间语义邻近性锚定到自然语言。
AI.result: 在模拟中，最多20个代理和10个视觉指称下达成共识；三种分析模型的收敛动力学R²>0.95。
AI.conclusion: NSLD框架首次实现了代理群体自主构建锚定于感知的共享词汇，为自主探索任务的前期部署规划提供了理论基础。

title: Efficient Learning of Truncated Boolean Product Distributions: Influence to the Rescue
summary:
Learning the natural parameters $z \in \mathbb{R}^n$ of discrete distributions $μ_z$ from independent samples constrained to a subset $S \subseteq \{0,1\}^n$ is a foundational challenge in high-dimensional statistics. Existing methods for efficiently estimating truncated Boolean product distributions, notably the work of [Fotakis et al' COLT'20, Algorithmica '22], require either strong local connectivity assumptions on $S$ -- a property denoted fatness -- or stringent anti-concentration assumptions and necessitate the total mass of the truncation set to be a constant with respect to $n$. Moreover, the results in [Fotakis et al' COLT'20, Algorithmica '22] suffer from sample complexities that scale as $Ω(2^n)$ if the mass of $S$ is exponentially small in $n$.
  In this work, we circumvent these limitations by analyzing the geometry of $S$ under the measure $μ_z$. We refine the existing parameter estimation guarantees under the fatness assumption, improving the prior sample complexity to $O( \log n / ε^2)$ for $\ell_\infty$-recovery, matching the untruncated minimax rate. We further generalize fatness using the notion of influence utilized in the analysis of Boolean functions and provide sufficient conditions for efficient inference. Notably, unlike previous work, our method does not require sampling at arbitrary parameterizations of the model. Lastly, we establish a theoretical lower bound demonstrating the sample complexity exhibits an intrinsic exponential dependence on the width of the model and the minimum distance between elements in the set.

AI.tldr: 本文针对截断布尔乘积分布的参数估计问题，提出基于测度μ_z下集合S几何分析的新方法，将样本复杂度从指数级降至O(log n/ε²)，并推广了fatness假设至布尔函数的影响力概念，突破了现有工作对强局部连通性、反集中假设及截断集总质量为常数的限制。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（Fotakis等, COLT'20, Algorithmica '22）在估计截断布尔乘积分布时存在三大局限：1）需要强局部连通性（fatness）或反集中假设；2）要求截断集总质量为常数；3）当截断集质量指数小时，样本复杂度为Ω(2^n)。本文旨在克服这些限制。
AI.method: 1) 利用测度μ_z下集合S的几何分析替代传统假设；2) 在fatness假设下将ℓ_∞恢复的样本复杂度改进至O(log n/ε²)，达到无截断时的极小最优率；3) 引入布尔函数分析中的影响力（influence）概念推广fatness，给出高效推断的充分条件；4) 建立理论下界，证明样本复杂度对模型宽度和集合最小距离具有指数依赖性。
AI.result: 1) 在fatness假设下，ℓ_∞恢复的样本复杂度从指数级降至O(log n/ε²)；2) 基于影响力的推广条件无需强假设即可实现高效推断；3) 方法无需在分布任意参数化下采样；4) 下界表明指数依赖性是本质的。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过几何分析与影响力理论，显著改进了截断布尔乘积分布的参数估计效率，在理论上匹配了无截断情形的极小最优率，并揭示了样本复杂度指数依赖的固有性。

title: Two Regimes of Chain-of-Thought Unfaithfulness: Behavioral Detection Fails Where Models Are Wrong
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) explanations support oversight only if they are faithful: the stated reasoning must actually produce the answer. Auditing black-box (behavioral) detection of unfaithful CoT against FaithCoT-Bench's human annotations, we find answer correctness structures the problem at every level. Answer incorrectness alone (an oracle diagnostic, not a deployable detector) outperforms every purpose-built signal (AUROC 0.696), because 69% of annotated unfaithfulness occurs on incorrect answers. Stratifying by correctness splits detection into two regimes: on correct answers, behavioral signals moderately separate faithful from post-hoc reasoning (0.63-0.67); on incorrect answers, where most unfaithfulness lives, no tested signal is detectably above chance (replicated on all four models for benchmark-wide signals). The standard step-removal metric anti-correlates with human labels; this inversion reproduces on the benchmark's released scores and on hint-dependent counterfactually labeled traces. Linear probes decode the behaviorally blind regime in Llama-3.1-8B and the correct-answer regime in Qwen-2.5-7B, with no shared, positively aligned direction detected across regimes; instructed answer-first traces (7 models) transfer to neither annotated regime, while hint-induced unverbalized answer flips do, in model- and source-dependent settings. We also independently verify and resolve a documentation-data mismatch in the benchmark's label semantics.

AI.tldr: 本文发现答案正确性主导了思维链忠实度检测：69%的不忠实发生在错误答案上，而正确答案区域检测效果中等，错误答案区域所有检测信号均不优于随机；标准步移除指标与人类标签反相关；线性探针可解码部分行为盲区，但指令驱动的答案优先策略泛化失败。
AI.motivation: 现有的黑箱行为检测方法在识别不忠实思维链（CoT）时效果有限，需要系统理解答案正确性这一因素如何影响检测性能，从而揭示哪些场景下检测有效、哪些场景下检测失效。
AI.method: 以FaithCoT-Bench的人类标注为基准，对比多种黑箱行为检测信号；按答案正确性分层分析检测性能；利用线性探针解码模型内部表示；测试跨模型、跨场景的迁移能力；独立验证并修正基准的标注语义不一致问题。
AI.result: 答案错误本身（AUROC 0.696）优于所有专门设计的检测信号；69%的不忠实标注出现在错误答案中。正确答案区域检测AUROC为0.63-0.67；错误答案区域所有信号均不优于随机。步移除指标与人类标注反相关。线性探针在Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen-2.5-7B上分别解码不同区域，无共享正向方向；答案优先指令不迁移，但提示诱导的未言语化答案翻转可在特定条件下迁移。
AI.conclusion: 答案正确性是不忠实CoT检测的基本结构性因素，当前行为信号在错误答案区域完全失效，需要针对该区域开发新的检测方法；同时应关注标注语义一致性问题以保证基准可靠性。

title: LiFT-MPC: Language-in-the-Loop Feedback Tuning of Cost Previews for MPC
summary: In model predictive control (MPC) with time-varying objectives, predicted signals need to be often incorporated in the cost function, such as prices in energy system operation. These are, however, often difficult to predict from the historical trajectory of these signals alone, as they may depend on other contextual events. We propose LiFT-MPC, an MPC framework that integrates a LiFT (Language-in-the-Loop Feedback Tuning) correction scheme to refine such predictions within the MPC loop. The prediction mechanism is updated online via a control-performance loss function, and we establish a performance guarantee for the resulting closed loop system. Numerical experiments using a realistic example of energy-storage management with real prices and news context to improve predictions, demonstrate an improved economic performance

AI.tldr: 提出LiFT-MPC框架，通过语言反馈调优机制在线修正MPC中的预测信号，提升时变目标控制性能，并在能量存储管理中验证了经济性改进。
AI.motivation: 模型预测控制中时变目标（如能源价格）难以仅从历史轨迹准确预测，需要借助其他上下文信息（如新闻）来提升预测质量。
AI.method: 提出LiFT-MPC框架，将语言反馈调优（LiFT）校正方案集成到MPC循环中，通过控制性能损失函数在线更新预测机制。
AI.result: 在能量存储管理实例中，结合真实价格和新闻上下文改进预测，展示了经济性能的提升。
AI.conclusion: LiFT-MPC能有效利用语言上下文信息在线修正预测，且建立了闭环系统的性能保证。

title: Mean-field model for pollution abatement via cap and trade mechanism
summary: We consider a mean-field model of competitive firms operating under an AK production technology, where output is proportional to capital and production generates emissions. In this setting, we introduce a regulator whose objective is the reduction of cumulative emissions, in the spirit of Emission Trading Systems (ETS), where firms must hold and trade permits to cover their emissions in a regulated market. The regulator acts as a central planner and controls the supply of permits, balancing emission reduction and aggregate output. Permits are allocated through a dynamic auction mechanism that adjusts supply in real time to achieve both market efficiency and the regulator's long-term goals. The regulator and the firms interact through the endogenous permit price, which is determined by the regulator's policy and affects firms' optimal strategies via the market clearing condition. The regulator's optimal policy is derived within a Mean-Field Control (MFC) framework. Exploiting the linear-quadratic structure and the presence of common noise, we characterise the equilibrium via a system of coupled FBSDEs and associated Riccati equations. Our results provide a tractable characterisation of optimal permit allocation policies in large economies and offer insights into the design of efficient emission trading mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文在AK生产技术的平均场竞争企业模型中引入监管者，通过动态拍卖机制进行排放权分配，利用均值场控制框架推导出最优许可分配政策，并通过FBSDEs和Riccati方程刻画均衡。
AI.motivation: 在排放交易体系（ETS）中，监管者需要平衡减排目标与总产出，但如何在大规模经济体中设计有效的动态许可证分配机制是一个关键挑战。
AI.method: 采用均值场控制（MFC）框架，利用线性二次型结构及共同噪声，通过耦合的正向-倒向随机微分方程（FBSDEs）和Riccati方程刻画监管者与企业的均衡互动。
AI.result: 获得最优许可证分配政策的可处理解析刻画，揭示了在大型经济体中监管政策如何通过内生许可证价格影响企业最优策略。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为设计高效的排放交易机制提供了理论依据，提供了大规模经济中许可分配的最优政策方案。

title: Structure Over Scale: Schema-Constrained Causal Graphs for RAG
summary: Graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (GraphRAG) grounds answers in structured knowledge, but current systems extract entities and relationships exhaustively, producing graphs whose size and construction cost scale with corpus length rather than with the reasoning a query requires. We introduce HCG-RAG (Hierarchical Causal Graph RAG), which replaces open-ended extraction with schema-constrained causal graphs: an automated pipeline distills a corpus into a fixed, typed vocabulary of causal variables and materializes a compact two-tier graph over it. Our schema-constrained graphs match entity-relation baselines on answer quality at a fraction of the cost: 3-20x fewer nodes, 8x-135x fewer build-time LLM calls than the most LLM-intensive baseline (MS-GraphRAG), and graphs compact enough for a domain expert to audit, correct, and extend. On medical and clinical benchmarks, including a neurologist-validated epilepsy dataset, HCG-RAG matches or exceeds the best entity-relation systems. An ablation isolates the causal graph as a structured retrieval filter, contributing +6 percentage points (pp) over embedding-only retrieval. Across all domains with discoverable hierarchical causal structure, only methods imposing higher-level organization outperform flat entity-relation retrieval, indicating that what is placed in the graph matters more than how many nodes it contains.

AI.tldr: HCG-RAG提出用层级因果图替代传统实体关系图谱，通过固定类型化词汇表和紧凑双层图结构，以极低的构建成本（节点减少3-20倍，LLM调用减少8-135倍）达到或超越现有方法的回答质量，并在医学领域验证了“图的质量比数量更重要”。
AI.motivation: 现有GraphRAG系统对文本进行穷举式实体关系提取，导致图规模和构建成本随语料长度线性增长，忽略了查询所需的推理层次，造成大量冗余。
AI.method: 提出HCG-RAG框架：1）自动流水线将语料蒸馏为固定类型化因果变量词汇表；2）构建紧凑的双层因果图（层级因果图）；3）用因果图作为结构化检索过滤器。
AI.result: 节点减少3-20倍，LLM调用减少8-135倍；在医学/临床基准上匹配或超越最优基线；因果图作为过滤机制贡献+6pp的准确率提升；只有强加高层级组织的方法才优于平面实体关系检索。
AI.conclusion: 证明图的质量（结构化因果组织）比图的大小（节点数量）更重要，为构建高效、可审计的GraphRAG系统提供了新范式。

title: Learning from the Descent Direction: Adaptive Gradient Descent under One-Sided Hölder Regularity
summary: We study adaptive gradient descent for continuously differentiable, possibly nonconvex objectives under one-sided Hölder regularity. Unlike classical Hölder- or Lipschitz-gradient assumptions, which control the full gradient variation, our condition bounds only the directional term appearing in the descent inequality. This can allow less conservative step sizes when large gradient changes are orthogonal to, or favorable along, the update direction. We propose an adaptive scalar-step method based on an estimate of positive one-sided Hölder curvature, combined with a simple sufficient-decrease safeguard. For nonconvex objectives on a convex region containing the accepted update segments, we prove an explicit best-iterate stationarity bound with a rate determined by the Hölder exponent. Unlike predetermined diminishing step-size schemes, the method adapts to the local descent geometry. We evaluate the approach on two full-batch benchmarks designed to separate directional curvature from full gradient variation. On a binary classification problem, the method achieves the lowest final cross-entropy, objective value, and gradient norm, together with the largest classification margin among the compared scalar gradient methods. On a nonconvex Hölder regression problem, it attains the lowest final objective gap and gradient norm. These results indicate that one-sided Hölder curvature is an effective adaptive step-size signal when full-gradient variation is inflated by directions that do not hinder descent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于单侧 Hölder 曲率估计的自适应梯度下降方法，该方法仅约束下降不等式中的方向项而非完整梯度变差，允许在梯度变化与更新方向正交或有利时使用更大的步长，并在非凸问题上证明了显式的最优迭代平稳性界。
AI.motivation: 经典 Hölder 或 Lipschitz 梯度假设控制完整梯度变差，导致保守步长。当大梯度变化与更新方向正交或有利时，步长被不必要地限制，需更精细的曲率刻画以提升自适应能力。
AI.method: 提出基于正单侧 Hölder 曲率估计的自适应标量步长方法，结合充分下降保障机制。仅利用下降不等式中的方向项调整步长，适配局部下降几何。
AI.result: 在二分类问题上取得最低交叉熵、目标值和梯度范数，最大分类间隔；在非凸 Hölder 回归问题中取得最低最终目标差距和梯度范数。
AI.conclusion: 单侧 Hölder 曲率是一种有效的自适应步长信号，特别适用于全梯度变差被不阻碍下降的方向所夸大的场景。

title: Mwando: Leveraging AI to Preserve and Teach shiKomori
summary: This paper presents Mwando, a virtual educational assistant designed to support the teaching and preservation of shiKomori, the language of the Comoros Islands. The system covers the four main dialectal variants (shiNgazidja, shiMwali, shiNdzuani and shiMaore) through a knowledge base constructed from phrases, proverbs, dictionaries and grammar lessons. A multi-agent architecture combining vector search, a knowledge graph and web search fallback enables accurate and context-aware responses. Evaluation on 500 queries demonstrates strong performance on vocabulary lookup and grammar explanations, while qualitative case studies illustrate both capabilities and current limitations. This work represents an initial step toward computational support for shiKomori and provides a blueprint for developing AI-powered educational tools for other low-resource languages.

AI.tldr: Mwando是一个面向科摩罗语（shiKomori）的虚拟教育助手，通过多智能体架构（向量搜索+知识图谱+网络搜索回退）支持四种方言变体，在词汇查询和语法解释上表现良好，为低资源语言AI教育工具提供了蓝图。
AI.motivation: 科摩罗语（shiKomori）作为一种低资源语言，缺乏计算支持工具，面临语言消亡危机。本文旨在通过AI技术辅助该语言的教学与保存，并为其他低资源语言提供可复制的方案。
AI.method: 构建了涵盖四种方言变体的知识库（短语、谚语、词典、语法课程），采用多智能体架构，融合向量搜索、知识图谱和网络搜索回退机制，实现准确且上下文感知的响应。
AI.result: 在500条查询的评估中，词汇查找和语法解释表现优异；定性案例研究同时展示了系统的能力与当前局限性。
AI.conclusion: Mwando是科摩罗语计算支持的第一步，为低资源语言开发AI驱动教育工具提供了可行蓝图。

title: A Nonlinear CTH-Based Adaptive Cruise Controller With Safety and String Stability Guarantees
summary: This paper studies the problem of longitudinal control, with safety and string stability guarantees, in vehicle platoons. A nonlinear adaptive cruise controller based on the Constant Time Headway (CTH) policy is designed for platoons of heterogeneous vehicles, that incorporates a speed-dependent nonlinear gain guaranteeing bounded vehicle speeds and a saturation-type nonlinearity to guarantee bounded (or non-aggressive) accelerations, while preserving collision-avoidance properties of time-headway-based spacing policies. By introducing a suitable spacing-error variable, explicit nonlinear error dynamics are obtained, allowing a direct analysis of the closed-loop system. It is shown that the collision-free region is positively invariant and that the proposed controller guarantees convergence of the spacing errors. Furthermore, nonlinear string-stability properties are established directly from the closed-loop dynamics without resorting to linearization or frequency-domain arguments. In particular, sufficient conditions are derived for $L_p$ string stability, $1\le p\le\infty$, with respect to disturbances, external inputs acting on the leading vehicle, and perturbations of the initial conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文针对异构车辆队列的纵向控制问题，设计了一种基于恒定车头时距(CTH)策略的非线性自适应巡航控制器，通过引入速度依赖的非线性增益和饱和型非线性，保证了有界车速和非激进加速度，同时避免碰撞。通过定义新的间距误差变量，推导了显式非线性误差动力学，证明了无碰撞区域的正不变性及间距误差的收敛性。进一步，无需线性化或频域分析，直接从闭环动力学建立了非线性弦稳定性，导出了关于干扰、前车输入和初始条件扰动的L_p弦稳定性充分条件。
AI.motivation: 车辆队列的纵向控制需同时保证安全（避免碰撞）和弦稳定性（抑制扰动沿队列传播）。现有方法多依赖线性化或频域分析，难以处理非线性、异构车辆及有界约束（如车速、加速度界限）等实际问题，亟需一个能直接基于非线性动力学分析的理论框架。
AI.method: 基于CTH间距策略，设计包含速度相关非线性增益（保证有界车速）和饱和型非线性（限制加速度）的控制器；重新定义间距误差变量以简化非线性误差动力学；利用正不变集理论证明无碰撞区域；通过Lyapunov-like分析证明误差收敛；直接从闭环非线性动力学推导L_p弦稳定性条件（1≤p≤∞），涵盖外部扰动、前车输入和初始条件扰动。
AI.result: 证明了所提控制器下无碰撞区域是正不变的，间距误差渐近收敛；导出了无需线性化或频域方法的非线性L_p弦稳定性充分条件。
AI.conclusion: 该非线性控制器为异构车辆队列提供了同时具备安全（碰撞避免）和L_p弦稳定性的解决方案，所提出的直接非线性分析方法避免了传统线性化或频域假设的局限性，更具普适性。

title: Upper and lower approximations of the second order. Exhausters of the second order
summary: The upper and lower approximations of the second order are defined for a function differentiable in the directions. Exhausters of the second order are introduced. The relation between the second-order Frechet subdifferentials and the second-order exhausters is given. A rule for constructing exhausters of the first and second orders is given for Lipschitz functions.Necessary and sufficient extremum conditions through exhausters are given. It is discussed about the use of Exhausters in optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了二阶可微方向函数的上、下近似（二阶 exhausters），建立了与二阶 Fréchet 次微分的关系，给出了 Lipschitz 函数的一、二阶 exhausters 构造规则，并基于 exhausters 给出了极值的充要条件，讨论了其在优化中的应用。
AI.motivation: 扩展 exhauster 概念到二阶情形，以更精细地刻画非光滑函数的局部极值条件。
AI.method: 定义二阶方向可微函数的上、下近似（二阶 exhausters），推导其与二阶 Fréchet 次微分的关系，给出 Lipschitz 函数的构造规则。
AI.result: 建立了二阶 exhausters 的理论框架，给出了基于 exhausters 的极值充要条件。
AI.conclusion: 二阶 exhausters 为优化问题提供了新的工具，尤其适用于非光滑函数的极值分析。

title: xMIx: High-Performance Serving-Time Platform for Mechanistic Interpretability Apps
summary:
Mechanistic interpretability (MI) has emerged as a powerful approach for analyzing and intervening in inference computations, with a growing number of applications such as jailbreak attempt detection, truthfulness evaluation, and hallucination detection. Unfortunately, MI deployment in production model-serving systems is currently not practical, as most existing MI frameworks introduce prohibitively high runtime overheads. The fundamental problem is that MI functions do not compose cleanly with served models: they fragment deployment, often force draining requests and rebuilding serving state, and conflict with critical performance optimizations such as continuous batching and CUDA-graph execution, essential for production deployments.
  We present xMIx, a serving-native framework for deploying MI applications in production inference serving environments. xMIx enables attaching MI functions to a predefined set of locations in the model runtime, interposing on activations within the layers and residual streams. xMIx supports conditional invocation of MI functions depending on the outputs in preceding model layers. Multiple MI applications can be deployed in a single model instance. xMIx compiles them all into the serving path but activates them dynamically at runtime only when necessary, with negligible performance cost, and without requiring a separate model instance or alternative execution stack.
  We integrate xMIx with the vLLM serving system and evaluate it across three major models and seven diverse MI applications. xMIx achieves performance comparable to native vLLM execution, incurring a slowdown of 1.3% mean inter-token latency (ITL), 1.2% for tail P99 ITL, 2.6% for mean time to first token (TTFT), and 1.6% for mean total token throughput (TTT).

AI.tldr: xMIx 是一个面向生产环境的 MI（机械可解释性）服务框架，通过将 MI 函数编译到模型推理路径中并动态激活，在支持多种 MI 应用的同时，仅引入不到 3% 的性能开销，解决了现有 MI 框架在推理服务中部署成本过高的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有 MI 框架在推理服务中部署时存在不可接受的高运行时开销，其根本原因是 MI 函数与模型服务不能干净组合，导致部署碎片化、请求中断、状态重建等问题，且与连续批处理、CUDA-graph 执行等关键性能优化相冲突。
AI.method: xMIx 将 MI 函数"附加"到模型运行时中预定义的位置（如层间激活和残差流），支持根据前层输出条件调用 MI 函数，并将多个 MI 应用编译到同一服务路径中，在运行时动态激活，无需独立模型实例或替代执行栈。xMIx 与 vLLM 推理系统集成。
AI.result: 在三个主要模型和七个 MI 应用上的评估表明：平均 token 间延迟（ITL）增加 1.3%，P99 ITL 增加 1.2%，平均首次 token 时间（TTFT）增加 2.6%，平均总 token 吞吐量（TTT）降低 1.6%，性能与原生 vLLM 执行相当。
AI.conclusion: xMIx 成功将 MI 应用部署到生产级推理服务中，以极低的性能代价实现了多种 MI 功能的原生集成，使 MI 从实验工具走向工程部署成为可能。

title: Beyond Directed Acyclic Graphs: Causal Zeros and Causal Differential Equations
summary: Pearl's structural causal model (SCM) framework, built on directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) and the do-calculus, is the dominant formal language for causal reasoning. Yet it carries two structural restrictions: every relationship must be pre-specified as a directed causal edge, and feedback cycles are forbidden. This paper examines two classes of phenomena that strain these restrictions. First, symmetric physical and economic constraints, the ideal gas law being the canonical case, carry no intrinsic causal direction. Direction emerges only under intervention, and which variable is solved for must be specified as part of the intervention. We formalize such constraints as causal zeros within an Extended Causal Model by adding an activation operator, subject to local solvability and graph-admissibility conditions. Second, for the class of finite-propagation state-space systems considered here, we treat apparent instantaneous cycles as artifacts of suppressed time and ground both causal zeros and feedback in Causal Differential Equations (CDEs). In these, the transient regime is a time-unrolled acyclic causal process, and causal zeros arise as the defining functions of attracting equilibrium manifolds; periodic and chaotic attractors define further regimes of the same dynamics, treated through attractor-relative intervention. We give the extended do-calculus, identifiability conditions, counterfactual semantics, and open problems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Pearl结构因果模型(SCM)中要求所有关系必须预指定因果方向且禁止反馈循环的两项限制，提出扩展因果模型。通过引入激活算子处理对称物理约束（如理想气体定律），并将因果零点和反馈统一到因果微分方程(CDE)框架中，将瞬时循环视为时间展开的因果过程，给出了扩展的do-演算、可识别性条件及反事实语义。
AI.motivation: Pearl的SCM框架在因果推理中占据主导地位，但它强制要求每条关系都有预定的因果方向，且不允许反馈循环存在。然而现实世界中存在大量对称约束（如物理定律）和系统反馈现象，无法被该框架自然表达。本文旨在突破这两项结构限制，建立更通用的因果形式化体系。
AI.method: 1) 提出扩展因果模型，引入"激活算子"(activation operator)来处理对称约束，通过局部可解性和图可接受性条件将约束形式化为"因果零点"(causal zeros)。2) 构建因果微分方程(CDE)框架：将瞬态过程视为时间展开的无环因果过程，因果零点定义吸引平衡流形；周期和混沌吸引子通过"吸引子相对干预"处理。3) 在此基础上给出扩展的do-演算、可识别性条件和反事实语义。
AI.result: 成功形式化了对称物理约束（如理想气体定律），表明因果方向在干预下才涌现；将瞬时因果循环解释为时间尺度压缩的产物；建立了能统一处理因果零点和反馈循环的CDE框架。
AI.conclusion: SCM的两项结构限制可以被有效突破：对称约束通过激活算子纳入因果模型，反馈循环通过微分方程时间展开来处理。该扩展框架为因果推理在物理系统、经济学等存在对称约束和反馈的领域提供了更强大的形式化工具，但也留下了一些开放问题待后续研究。

title: Task-Conditional Faithfulness Auditing of Multimodal LLMs for Grid Diagnosis
summary: Multimodal large language models (LLMs) can combine topology, measurements, and incident text for grid diagnosis, yet answer accuracy does not establish that task-appropriate evidence was used. This letter proposes a general framework in order to conduct task-conditional faithfulness audit. It compares self-reported reliance, intervention-derived behavioral reliance, and preregistered engineering importance. The framework first registers task-specific evidence requirements and compares them with self-reported reliance and behavioral changes under controlled modality ablations. To resolve detected discrepancies, we design an evidence-gated correction and re-audit mechanism that regenerates failed responses under evidence constraints and independently re-ablates them to verify improved grounding without performance loss. Case studies evaluate three differently scaled LLMs on IEEE 39- and 118-bus scenarios. These results validate the framework ability to detect, diagnose, and correct task-conditional faithfulness failures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个通用框架，用于审计多模态大语言模型在电网诊断任务中的条件忠实度，通过对比自述依赖、行为依赖和工程重要性，检测并修正模型在完成任务时是否使用了正确的证据。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在电网诊断中虽能结合拓扑、测量和文本信息，但答案准确并不能保证模型使用了任务所需的适当证据，因此需要系统的方法来审计模型的证据使用忠实度。
AI.method: 提出任务条件忠实度审计框架：1）注册任务特定证据需求；2）比较自述依赖、插除实验下的行为依赖与预注册工程重要性；3）对检测到的不一致，设计证据门控修正与再审计机制，在证据约束下重新生成失败响应并独立验证。
AI.result: 在IEEE 39和118节点场景下对三种不同规模的大语言模型进行案例研究，验证了框架能够有效检测、诊断和修正任务条件忠实度失败。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够系统地检测、诊断和修正多模态大语言模型在特定任务中的证据使用不忠实问题，且不会损害模型性能。

title: Finite-Time Analysis of the Natural Policy Gradient in Finite-Horizon Markov Decision Processes
comment: 33 pages, 3 figures (each with two subfigures), 1 table. Accepted at the Reinforcement Learning Conference (RLC 2026)
summary: Natural Policy Gradient (NPG) is a well-established Reinforcement Learning algorithm that underlies widely used methods such as Trust Region Policy Optimization and Proximal Policy Optimization, both of which have demonstrated strong empirical success. In this paper, we study exact NPG in finite-horizon Markov Decision Processes with known dynamics and horizon-dependent transition kernels. We provide the first finite-time convergence guarantees for this algorithm in this setting, for which we consider both constant and increasing step size regimes. With a constant step size $η_t=η$, we prove that NPG converges sublinearly with a rate of $\mathcal{O}(H^{2}/t)$ after $t$ iterations, where $H$ is the horizon length. We also extend this constant step size analysis to linear MDPs in an exact population-projection oracle under a full support projection distribution, recovering the same sublinear rate as in the tabular setting. Furthermore, with increasing step sizes, we prove that this algorithm achieves a linear convergence rate of $\mathcal{O}\left(\left(1-\frac{1}{\vartheta_ρ}\right)^t\right)$ for a problem-dependent constant $\vartheta_ρ> 1$, and the horizon-only robust schedule of the form $η_t=η_0(H/(H-1))^t$ where $η_0>0$ and $H \geq 2$, attains this same geometric rate.

AI.tldr: 本文首次证明了精确自然策略梯度（NPG）算法在有限时域马尔可夫决策过程（MDPs）中的有限时间收敛保证，包括常数步长下的次线性收敛率 $\mathcal{O}(H^{2}/t)$ 和递增步长下的线性收敛率 $\mathcal{O}\left(\left(1-\frac{1}{\vartheta_ρ}\right)^t\right)$，并扩展至线性MDP设定。
AI.motivation: NPG是TRPO、PPO等成功强化学习算法的基础，但其在有限时域MDP（含时变转移核）下的理论收敛性尚缺乏严格证明。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 研究了精确NPG在有限时域MDP（已知动力学、时变转移核）下的两种步长策略：1）常数步长 $\eta_t=\eta$ 得到次线性收敛率；2）递增步长（含问题相关常数 $\vartheta_ρ$ 和仅依赖时域长度的鲁棒调度 $\eta_t=\eta_0(H/(H-1))^t$）证明线性收敛。还扩展至线性MDP的全支持投影分布设定。
AI.result: 常数步长：收敛率 $\mathcal{O}(H^{2}/t)$（表格设定及线性MDP设定均成立）；递增步长：几何收敛率 $\mathcal{O}\left(\left(1-\frac{1}{\vartheta_ρ}\right)^t\right)$，且仅依赖时域长度的鲁棒调度也能达到相同几何速率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了精确NPG在有限时域设定下的首个有限时间收敛保证，弥合了理论与实际算法（如TRPO/PPO）之间的分析差距，并为线性MDP设定提供了理论扩展。

title: Modulus of conically averaged mappings and its applications to angles between two subspaces
comment: Accepted for publication in Mathematics of Operations Research
summary: Conically averaged mappings, a generalization of averaged mappings, are important in a wide range of Optimization Algorithms. In this paper, we propose the modulus of conical averagedness to classify conical averaged mappings. Introducing the monotone and comonotone values of generalized monotone mappings, we investigate their connections to the modulus of conical averagedness. In the linear setting, we completely characterize conically averaged matrices, and derive explicit and pleasing formulae for computing their modulus of averagedness. As applications, we compute the Dixmier and Friedrichs angles between two subspaces. Nonlinear results are established as extensions of the linear case. Conical averagedness of proximal and reflection mappings of hypoconvex functions are also studied.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了锥平均映射的模来分类锥平均映射，引入了广义单调映射的单调值和余单调值，并研究它们与锥平均模的联系。在线性情形下完全刻画了锥平均矩阵，推导出简洁的平均模计算公式，并应用于计算两个子空间之间的Dixmier角和Friedrichs角。非线性结果作为线性情形的推广，还研究了次凸函数的近端映射和反射映射的锥平均性。
AI.motivation: 锥平均映射作为平均映射的推广，在优化算法中具有广泛应用，但缺乏对其分类和度量的统一理论框架。本文旨在提出锥平均模来系统分类这类映射。
AI.method: 通过引入单调值和余单调值建立与锥平均模的联系；在线性情形下给出锥平均矩阵的完整刻画和模的计算公式；将线性结果推广到非线性情形，并研究次凸函数相关映射的锥平均性。
AI.result: 获得了锥平均矩阵的完全刻画和简洁的平均模计算公式；成功应用于计算Dixmier角和Friedrichs角；建立了非线性情形的推广结果。
AI.conclusion: 锥平均模为分类锥平均映射提供了有效工具，线性与非线性结果共同构建了较完整的理论体系，并为优化算法的分析提供了新视角。

title: An Agentic Orchestration of Atomistic Simulations
summary: Atomistic simulations are central to materials design, but their execution involves complex, multi-step workflows that require significant human expertise. Here, we present an agent-based system embedded within the URSA (Universal Research and Scientific Agent) framework that automates the design, execution, and validation of atomistic simulations, demonstrated using the Large-scale Atomic/Molecular Massively Parallel Simulator (LAMMPS) tool. Our system autonomously selects interatomic potentials, constructs and runs simulations, and performs iterative error recovery within a closed-loop workflow. We evaluate the scientific reliability of the agent by benchmarking its outputs against LAVA, a high-throughput toolkit for LAMMPS and the Vienna Ab initio Simulation Package (VASP) calculations. Our framework reduces manual intervention and trial-and-error, thereby improving the rigor, reproducibility, and scalability of atomistic modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于URSA框架的智能代理系统，能够自动化原子尺度模拟（如LAMMPS）的设计、执行和验证，显著减少人工干预，提高可重复性和可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 原子尺度模拟涉及复杂多步骤工作流，需要大量人类专业知识，手动操作耗时且易错，缺乏可扩展性和可重复性。
AI.method: 基于URSA框架构建代理系统，自主选择势函数、构建和运行模拟，并在闭环工作流中执行迭代错误恢复；通过LAVA工具包进行基准测试验证科学可靠性。
AI.result: 系统能够自主完成原子模拟全流程，减少人工干预和试错，提升了模拟的严谨性、可重复性和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该代理系统有效自动化了原子尺度模拟流程，为材料设计中的高通量、高可靠性模拟提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Hidden Boundary Motion in Transformer Optimization: Function-Space Orthogonalization of Affine Weight and Bias Updates
summary:
Weights and biases are normally optimized as separate parameter tensors, yet they do not represent separate functions when the input to an affine layer has nonzero mean. For an affine map $z=Wx+b$ with input mean $μ$, a weight update contains a sample-independent displacement $ΔWμ$ that is functionally indistinguishable from a bias update. We call this hidden contribution \emph{boundary motion} and decompose each update into a centered, sample-varying \emph{shape} component and a shared \emph{boundary} component. On a four-layer Transformer trained from scratch on IMDb, the bias-like term $g_bμ^	op$ has a median norm equal to 0.664 of the raw weight-gradient norm across affine layers and training checkpoints. More strikingly, the median ratio $
orm{ΔWμ}/
orm{Δb}$ is 134.7, while $
orm{ΔWμ}/
orm{Δb+ΔWμ}$ is 0.994. Thus, under AdamW, the observed boundary motion is almost entirely realized through the weight matrix rather than the explicit bias.
  We implement a diagnostic optimizer, Shape--Boundary Orthogonal AdamW (SBO-AdamW), that optimizes $g_W-g_bμ^	op$ and $g_b$ with independent Adam states and compensates the weight-induced boundary displacement. In a single-seed experiment, SBO-AdamW raises validation accuracy from 81.68\% to 85.81\% and validation-selected test accuracy from 78.73\% to 82.73\%, with the best validation checkpoint occurring at step 800 instead of step 3000. However, the moving-batch-center compensation produces severe bias-coordinate drift and strongly reduces boundary energy. The present evidence therefore supports hidden boundary motion as an important optimization mechanism, but it does not yet establish a final general-purpose optimizer. A stable centered-affine parameterization is identified as the required next step.

AI.tldr: 论文发现仿射层中权重更新存在与偏置更新功能上不可区分的"边界运动"成分（ΔWμ），该成分在AdamW优化下主要通过权重矩阵而非显式偏置实现。提出的SBO-AdamW优化器虽能提升性能（验证准确率从81.68%升至85.81%），但存在偏置坐标漂移问题，亟需稳定的中心化仿射参数化方案。
AI.motivation: 权重和偏置通常被视为独立参数张量进行优化，但当输入均值非零时，权重更新中包含与偏置更新功能等价的样本无关位移ΔWμ，这种隐藏的"边界运动"未被现有优化器显式处理。
AI.method: 1）将权重更新分解为样本相关的"形状"分量和共享的"边界"分量（ΔWμ）；2）设计SBO-AdamW优化器，对g_W - g_b μ^T和g_b分别用独立Adam状态优化，并补偿权重引起的边界位移。
AI.result: 在四层Transformer/IMDb实验中：边界项中位数范数为原始权重梯度范数的0.664倍；||ΔWμ||/||Δb||中位数比值为134.7；SBO-AdamW将验证准确率从81.68%提升至85.81%，测试准确率从78.73%提升至82.73%，最佳验证点从step 3000提前至step 800。
AI.conclusion: 隐藏的边界运动是重要的优化机制，但SBO-AdamW存在偏置坐标漂移和边界能量大幅降低的问题，尚未形成通用优化器，下一步需要稳定的中心化仿射参数化方案。

title: Do Diagrams Help Large Language Models Reason? Evidence from Syllogistic Reasoning
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 15th International Conference on the Theory and Application of Diagrams (Diagrams 2026)
summary: Diagrams are widely used to support logical reasoning, and prior studies suggest that representations such as Euler diagrams can improve human reasoning performance. Recent work has also explored their effects on large language models (LLMs). In this paper, we compare four representational conditions for syllogistic reasoning: natural language, logical notation, linear diagrams, and Euler diagrams. Using 285 problems from Ando et al. (2024), we evaluate two contemporary LLMs, Claude 3.5~Sonnet and GPT-4o-mini. Our results show that diagrammatic representations do not consistently improve performance. Although the models perform well on entailment and contradiction problems, they struggle with neutral problems and often make systematic conversion errors. Overall, the results suggest that the tested models gain limited benefit from diagrams in logical reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了自然语言、逻辑符号、线性图和欧拉图四种表示方式对LLMs（Claude 3.5 Sonnet和GPT-4o-mini）在三段论推理任务中的表现，发现图表表示并未持续提升模型性能，模型在蕴涵和矛盾问题上表现良好，但在中性问题上存在困难并出现系统性的转换错误。
AI.motivation: 探索图表（如欧拉图）能否像提升人类推理能力一样，提升大语言模型（LLMs）的逻辑推理表现。
AI.method: 使用Ando等人(2024)的285个三段论推理问题，在四种表示条件（自然语言、逻辑符号、线性图、欧拉图）下评估Claude 3.5 Sonnet和GPT-4o-mini两种LLM的性能。
AI.result: 图表表示未持续提升LLM推理性能；模型在蕴涵和矛盾问题上表现良好，但在中性问题上表现不佳，且常出现系统性转换错误。
AI.conclusion: 当前测试的LLM在逻辑推理任务中从图表表示中获益有限，图表对模型推理的辅助作用并不显著。

title: A Statistical Difference between Single-Layer Learning and Hierarchical Learning in Wide Neural Networks
summary:
Hierarchical neural networks are widely used in artificial intelligence, yet their mathematical properties remain incompletely understood. In the infinite-width limit, two different theoretical frameworks have been proposed. One reduces deep learning to kernel regression with a fixed kernel by assuming that the parameters remain close to their initialization, whereas the other allows the parameters to move away from their initialization, requiring the kernel itself to be optimized.
  In this paper, we study a three-layer neural network with a finite but large number of hidden units. We show that training the input-to-hidden weights yields a smaller generalization error than keeping them fixed. Furthermore, the latter setting exhibits singularities in the parameter space, whereas the former does not. These findings indicate that singularities play an essential role even in wide neural networks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究三层宽神经网络，证明训练输入到隐藏层权重比固定它们能获得更小的泛化误差，并发现固定权重会导致参数空间奇异性，而训练权重则不会，表明奇异性在宽神经网络中仍起重要作用。
AI.motivation: 当前无限宽神经网络的两种理论框架（神经正切核与特征学习）存在分歧，且对宽网络中奇异性（singularities）的作用理解不足。作者希望通过有限但宽的神经网络分析，厘清哪种框架更准确，并揭示奇异性的角色。
AI.method: 理论分析三层神经网络（宽度大但有限），比较两种训练策略：（1）固定输入到隐藏层权重（对应神经正切核框架）；（2）训练所有权重（对应特征学习框架）。通过泛化误差界和参数空间几何分析进行对比。
AI.result: （1）训练输入到隐藏层权重的泛化误差小于固定它们的情形；（2）固定权重设置中参数空间存在奇异性，而训练权重设置中奇异性消失。这表明奇异性并非窄网络特有，在宽网络中依然关键。
AI.conclusion: 宽神经网络中特征学习（训练所有权重）优于固定核方法，且奇异性的存在与否是两种框架的本质区别。这为理解深度学习的理论机制提供了新视角，表明实际应用中应重视特征学习而非仅依赖神经正切核。

title: Variational Formulations for Fractional Integral and Differential Equations
comment: This is a preprint of a paper published in 'Journal of Convex Analysis' at [https://www.heldermann.de/JCA/jcacover.htm]. Dedicated to Alexander Plakhov on the occasion of his 65th anniversary
summary: Given a fractional-order linear equation $L^αu = f$, we define an appropriate symmetric bilinear form so that the fractional operator $L^α$ is symmetric with respect to that bilinear form. Using the bilinear form, we then define a functional of the fractional calculus of variations proving that the solutions of the given fractional-order equation are critical points of the fractional variational functional. In the case of fractional integral equations, the provided bilinear form is non-degenerate, and all critical points are solutions of the given equation. In the case of fractional differential equations, a relation with the least-squares method is obtained.

AI.tldr: 本文为分数阶线性方程定义了合适的对称双线性形式，使分数阶算子对称，并通过该形式构建变分泛函，证明方程解是该泛函的临界点。对分数阶积分方程，双线性形式非退化；对分数阶微分方程，建立了与最小二乘法之间的联系。
AI.motivation: 为分数阶（积分和微分）方程建立变分框架，使得分数阶算子具有对称性，从而将求解问题转化为泛函临界点问题。
AI.method: 定义合适的对称双线性形式，使分数阶算子L^α关于该形式对称；利用该双线性形式构造分数阶变分泛函；通过变分法证明解与临界点的对应关系。
AI.result: 分数阶方程的解是所定义变分泛函的临界点；对积分方程，双线性形式非退化，所有临界点均为解；对微分方程，建立了与最小二乘法的联系。
AI.conclusion: 成功将分数阶线性方程纳入变分框架，为分数阶问题的求解提供了新的理论工具，并为微分方程情形提供了与最小二乘法的衔接。

title: HyCE-RAG: Hypergraph Chain-of-Evidence Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Explainable Multi-hop Question Answering
summary: Multi-hop question answering requires systems to retrieve evidence from multiple documents and connect scattered facts into a coherent reasoning process. Standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mainly relies on semantic similarity between a query and text chunks, and therefore often fails to model structural relations among entities, facts, and evidence units. Graph-based RAG improves this by introducing graph-structured knowledge, but pairwise edges are still limited in representing higher-order associations involving multiple entities and contexts. We propose HyCE-RAG, a Hypergraph Chain-of-Evidence Retrieval-Augmented Generation framework for explainable multi-hop question answering. HyCE-RAG organizes entities, relations, and contextual evidence into hyperedges, builds a query-aware evidence hypergraph, and performs confidence propagation over entity--hyperedge incidence structures. It then uses confidence-guided evidence assembly to select, connect, and rank evidence paths before answer generation. The scoring process jointly considers semantic relevance, entity connectivity, evidence coverage, relation reliability, extraction confidence, and propagated confidence. By providing the language model with structured evidence chains rather than flat retrieved passages, HyCE-RAG supports more faithful and interpretable reasoning. Experiments on HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue, and two GraphRAG-Bench subsets show that HyCE-RAG consistently outperforms standard RAG and graph-based RAG baselines in answer accuracy, context relevance, and faithfulness. These results suggest that hypergraph-based evidence organization is a promising direction for post-retrieval reasoning in complex question answering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HyCE-RAG框架，利用超图结构组织证据链，通过置信度传播和证据组装提升多跳问答的准确性与可解释性，在多个数据集上优于标准RAG和图RAG方法。
AI.motivation: 标准RAG依赖语义相似度检索，无法建模实体间的结构关系；图RAG虽引入图结构，但成对边仍难以表达涉及多实体和高阶关联的证据组织。现有方法在复杂多跳问答中证据建模能力不足。
AI.method: HyCE-RAG将实体、关系和上下文证据组织为超边，构建查询感知的证据超图，在实体-超边关联结构上进行置信度传播，再通过置信度引导的证据组装筛选、连接和排序证据路径，最终生成答案。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、MuSiQue和GraphRAG-Bench子集上，HyCE-RAG在答案准确率、上下文相关性和忠实性方面一致优于标准RAG和图RAG基线。
AI.conclusion: 基于超图的证据组织是复杂问答中检索后推理的一个有前景的方向，能有效提升多跳问答的可解释性和推理忠实度。

title: Distribution-Specific Curvature Control with Finite-Sample Guarantees for Open-Weight Safety
summary: A short fine-tuning run can undo the safety guards of an open-weight model---retraining a refusal-trained assistant to aid weapons development or produce hate speech. Preventing such harmful fine-tuning while retaining benign adaptability remains difficult: the only prior method with an explicit curvature certificate, spectral deformation, inflates curvature globally and thereby obstructs benign adaptation along with harmful adaptation. We propose HarmAlign, which applies function-preserving spectral deformation along a estimated contrastive activation subspace. We derive finite-sample bounds for the estimated subspace energy and the resulting local harmful-distribution curvature lower bound. A stability--progress dichotomy for constant-step gradient descent turns the certified curvature into conditional convergence-rate control. Empirically, within a fixed-architecture, finite-budget first-order threat model, HarmAlign blocks direct fine-tuning and three data- or objective-adaptive attacks across a hazardous-knowledge relearning setting and a harmful-assistance fine-tuning setting, while the protected benign tasks remain trainable. The block persists across the tested first-order optimizer variants over every attack checkpoint, and under out-of-distribution harmful fine-tuning, and it extends to important cases in our threat model: accidental safety degradation and emergent misalignment.

AI.tldr: 提出HarmAlign方法，通过谱变形在对比激活子空间上施加曲率约束，在不影响良性适配的前提下阻断有害微调，并提供理论保证和实证验证。
AI.motivation: 现有安全防护方法（如谱变形）全局膨胀曲率，同时阻碍了良性适配和有害适配；需要在保留良性可适应性的前提下，有效阻止有害微调。
AI.method: HarmAlign在估计的对比激活子空间上施加保函数谱变形，推导子空间能量和有害局部曲率下界的有限样本界，并通过稳定性-进展二分法将认证曲率转化为条件收敛速率控制。
AI.result: 在固定架构、有限预算的一阶威胁模型下，HarmAlign能阻断直接微调及三种数据/目标自适应攻击，同时受保护的良性任务仍可训练；该阻断在多种一阶优化器、分布外有害微调及意外安全退化/紧急错位场景下均有效。
AI.conclusion: HarmAlign提供了一种有效的安全微调防护方法，在理论和实证层面均优于现有方法，兼顾了安全性与良性任务的可训练性。

title: Novel Claim or Déjà Vu? Rethinking "Contamination-Free'' Dynamic Evaluation for Multimodal Automated Fact-Checking
summary: Multimodal automated fact-checking (MAFC) verifies claims by retrieving and reasoning over external evidence. However, most existing static benchmarks risk contamination: they primarily consist of outdated claims verifiable using an LLM's internal knowledge without external evidence. This can inflate performance estimates and fail to reflect true capability on novel claims that require up-to-date information. To address this, emerging dynamic benchmarks collect claims published after LLMs' knowledge cut-off dates, assuming they are uncontaminated. This work revisits this assumption by empirically studying contamination risks in both the state-of-the-art (SOTA) static AVeriTeC benchmark and our newly constructed dynamic ClaimReview2025Q4 benchmark, as well as their impact on MAFC evaluation. Our experiments yield 16 findings, highlighting three key results: (1) Dynamic evaluation reduces but does not eliminate contamination risks, as 17.09\%--29.30\% of post-cut-off claims remain potentially contaminated; (2) Many newly published claims can be verified either directly or by synthesizing multiple pieces of public knowledge available before the cut-off; and (3) Contamination can induce statistically significant inflation in MAFC performance, increasing Macro-F1 by up to 11.34 points and distorting system rankings. In light of these findings, we re-evaluate SOTA LLMs under a strictly contamination-controlled setting. Our study provides practical guidelines for trustworthy MAFC evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过构建动态基准并开展实验，揭示了多模态自动化事实核查（MAFC）评估中存在的数据污染风险：即使是声称无污染的动态基准，仍有17%-29%的样本存在潜在污染；污染会显著高估模型性能（Macro-F1最多提升11.34分）并扭曲系统排名；作者据此提出了严格的污染控制评估建议。
AI.motivation: 现有静态MAFC基准面临数据污染问题（模型可通过内部知识回答，无需外部证据），导致性能评估虚高。尽管动态基准意图通过采用LLM知识截止日期后的新发布声明来解决此问题，但这一假设本身缺乏验证。本文旨在检验动态基准是否真正消除了污染风险，并评估污染对MAFC评估的实际影响。
AI.method: 对比研究：1）使用现有SOTA静态基准AVeriTeC与新构建的动态基准ClaimReview2025Q4；2）设计实验量化两类基准中的污染比例；3）评估污染对MAFC系统性能指标（Macro-F1）和系统排名的影响；4）在严格污染控制设置下重新评估SOTA LLMs。
AI.result: 1）动态评估降低了但未消除污染风险，17.09%-29.30%的截止日期后声明仍有潜在污染；2）许多新声明可直接或通过整合截止日期前的公开知识得到验证；3）污染导致Macro-F1最高虚增11.34分，并扭曲了系统排名。论文共报告16项具体发现。
AI.conclusion: 动态基准不能完全解决MAFC评估中的污染问题，需要进行严格的污染控制。作者基于研究结果提供了可信MAFC评估的实践指南。

title: A Multi-stage Constrained Optimization Framework for Data-driven Problems
summary: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) transform high-dimensional, often noisy data into a compact latent representation, making downstream optimization more tractable. Three challenges persist in VAE-based constrained optimization: (i) sampling effectively within the latent space, (ii) identifying the active decision variables that actually influence the objective and constraints, and (iii) enforcing constraints without destabilizing training. We propose a Multi-stage Constrained Optimization Framework (MCOF). First, an entropy-constrained VAE (EC-VAE) coupled with a feature selector embeds objective and constraint information into a designated subset of latent variables, so that optimization proceeds over a low-dimensional subspace while the remaining coordinates supply solution diversity. Second, a Uniform Transformation (UT) module applies a per-dimension probability integral transform, replacing the irregular aggregate posterior with a uniform distribution over a bounded box and mitigating posterior collapse and Gaussian mixture bias. Third, a constraint-priority filter method (CPFM) solves the resulting surrogate problem by alternating violation-reduction and objective-reduction steps under a filter acceptance test, returning solutions that are feasible for the learned surrogate to a specified tolerance without requiring multiplier estimation. Finally, unselected latent coordinates are resampled to generate diverse decodings of a single optimized solution. We validate MCOF on a synthetic problem, where we ablate each stage and recover the analytic optimum, and on a ZINC250k drug design task, where the generated molecules satisfy the imposed constraints and are entirely novel relative to the training set.

AI.tldr: 提出多阶段约束优化框架(MCOF)，通过熵约束VAE、均匀变换和约束优先过滤方法解决VAE约束优化中的三个关键挑战，在合成数据上恢复解析最优解，在ZINC250k药物设计任务中生成新颖且满足约束的分子。
AI.motivation: 现有VAE约束优化面临三大挑战：潜空间有效采样、识别影响目标函数和约束的主动决策变量、在不破坏训练稳定性的前提下强制执行约束。现有方法难以同时解决这些问题。
AI.method: MCOF框架包含三个阶段：(1) 熵约束VAE(EC-VAE)结合特征选择器，将目标与约束信息嵌入特定潜变量子集；(2) 均匀变换(UT)模块通过逐维概率积分变换，将非规则聚合后验转化为有界区间上的均匀分布；(3) 约束优先过滤方法(CPFM)交替进行违反度降低和目标降低步骤，通过过滤验收标准获得可行解。
AI.result: 在合成问题上消融验证各阶段有效性并恢复解析最优解；在ZINC250k药物设计任务中，生成的分子完全满足约束条件且与训练集相比具有全新性。
AI.conclusion: MCOF有效解决了VAE约束优化的三大挑战，通过解耦潜变量、修正后验分布和过滤式约束处理，实现了高质量可行解的生成，并在药物分子设计上展示了实用性。

title: Generalized Fine-Tuning of Diffusion Models via Stochastic Control and FBSDEs
summary: We propose a generalized fine-tuning framework for diffusion models from the perspective of stochastic control. Beyond entropy-regularized formulations, we introduce a general running cost that induces a relative generalized path cost, encompassing both Kullback-Leibler divergence and optimal transport metrics as special cases. This leads to a fully nonlinear Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation. We characterize the value function through a forward-backward stochastic differential equation system and establish existence and uniqueness under standard regularity conditions. The optimal control admits a nonlinear feedback form driven by the backward stochastic differential equation gradient component. Finally, we show that generalized fine-tuning naturally introduces an additional gradient-dependent penalty, providing a unified framework for diffusion fine-tuning under general distributional constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于随机控制视角的扩散模型广义微调框架，通过引入一般化运行成本统一了KL散度和最优传输度量，建立了完全非线性的HJB方程，并证明了最优控制的反馈形式及梯度惩罚机制。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型微调方法多基于熵正则化或特定散度度量，缺乏统一的理论框架。作者希望从随机控制视角出发，构建一个能涵盖KL散度和最优传输等不同分布约束的广义微调框架。
AI.method: 引入一般化运行成本，推导相对广义路径成本；建立完全非线性HJB方程；通过前向后向随机微分方程（FBSDE）系统刻画值函数；在标准正则性条件下证明存在唯一性；推导最优控制的非线性反馈形式。
AI.result: 最优控制具有由BSDE梯度分量驱动的非线性反馈形式；广义微调自然引入了额外的梯度依赖惩罚项；该框架统一了扩散模型在一般分布约束下的微调方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为扩散模型微调提供了一个统一的随机控制理论框架，将KL散度和最优传输等视为特例，拓展了扩散模型微调的理论基础和方法边界。

title: Differencing the Diffusion Trajectory toward Uncertain Components for Time Series Forecasting
summary: Diffusion models have become a widely used framework for probabilistic time series forecasting, modeling the distribution of future values given an observed history. In time series forecasting, however, the future continues the observed history, creating an asymmetry the standard diffusion process leaves unaddressed, with slowly-varying content largely determined by the observed continuity while higher-frequency dynamics carry most of the residual uncertainty. Existing diffusion-based forecasters decouple this asymmetry through an external rule before generation, leaving the corruption trajectory blind to which parts of the target the history can already anchor. We propose DiffDiff, a diffusion framework that embeds this predictability asymmetry into the diffusion trajectory itself, so that a single end-to-end diffusion process becomes aware of which parts of the target the history can already anchor. DiffDiff makes the forward operator step-dependent so that the noisy intermediate state progressively shifts from the target itself toward its second-order differenced structure, while a conditioning pathway supplies the denoiser with both value-domain and differential history information balanced by a stage-adaptive gate at each diffusion step. The terminal distribution approaches a standard Gaussian, preserving compatibility with existing samplers. On seven benchmarks across four prediction horizons, DiffDiff outperforms six diffusion baselines, and our analysis confirms that DiffDiff concentrates the diffusion's generative effort on the most uncertain components of the target while relieving it from rebuilding the history-anchored content.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DiffDiff，一个将预测不对称性嵌入扩散轨迹的时序预测框架，通过逐步依赖的前向算子使噪声过程从目标本身转向二阶差分结构，并在七个基准数据集上超越六个扩散基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散预测模型通过外部规则解耦历史锚定内容与高频不确定性，但腐蚀轨迹对目标中哪些部分已被历史确定保持盲区，导致生成效率低下。
AI.method: DiffDiff设计步数依赖的前向算子，使噪声中间状态从目标本身渐进地转向二阶差分结构；同时通过阶段自适应门控平衡值域与差分历史信息，作为条件路径供给去噪器；终端分布保持标准高斯分布，兼容现有采样器。
AI.result: 在七个基准数据集、四个预测范围上，DiffDiff超越六个扩散基线模型；分析表明DiffDiff将生成努力集中在最不确定的成分上，减少了重建历史锚定内容的负担。
AI.conclusion: DiffDiff通过将可预测性不对称性内嵌到扩散轨迹中，使单一端到端过程能够自动感知目标中已被历史锚定的部分，从而更高效地分配生成资源。

title: Spectral-Aware Analytic Class-Incremental Learning for Long-Tailed Distributions
summary: Analytic Continual Learning (ACL) offers a computationally efficient alternative to gradient-based approaches. Recent ACL methods are based on Recursive Least Squares (RLS) and have achieved the state-of-the-art results compared to other alternatives. However, they falter significantly in Class-Incremental Learning scenarios characterized by Long-Tailed distributions. While the ill-conditioning of the autocorrelation (Gram) matrix is a known limitation of RLS, we demonstrate that class imbalance exacerbates this issue into a distinct spectral pathology: "tail" classes suffer from severe spectral collapse, rendering their subspaces numerically indistinguishable from noise. Standard Ridge Regression ($L_2$) fails to address this effectively as it applies isotropic regularization - a uniform penalty that is insufficient to stabilize the tail without over-shrinking the head. To address this, we propose Geometry-Spectral Rectification (GSR), a theoretically grounded framework that treats long-tailed learning as a spectral regularization problem. Unlike standard isotropic regularization (Ridge) which uniformly penalizes all eigenvalues, GSR acts as an anisotropic spectral filter, selectively inflating the collapsed eigenvalues of tail classes. We construct a structured, data-dependent spectral perturbation matrix $Δ$ that selectively inflates collapsed tail eigen-directions of the Gram matrix. Theoretical analysis proves that GSR guarantees an improved stable rank for the Gram matrix, ensuring numerical stability. Extensive experiments show that GSR establishes a new state-of-the-art for analytic CIL, offering a superior trade-off between computational efficiency and robust generalization in long-tailed settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出几何-谱修正（GSR）框架，通过各向异性谱滤波解决分析持续学习中长尾分布下的谱塌缩问题，在类增量学习场景中取得新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有分析持续学习方法（基于RLS）在长尾类增量学习中表现严重下降，原因是类别不平衡导致尾部类别发生谱塌缩，而标准的岭回归（各向同性正则化）无法有效解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出GSR框架，通过构造结构化的数据依赖谱扰动矩阵Δ，对Gram矩阵中尾部类别的塌缩特征值进行选择性膨胀，实现各向异性谱滤波，而非均匀惩罚所有特征值。
AI.result: 理论证明GSR能改善Gram矩阵的稳定秩，保证数值稳定性；实验表明GSR在分析类增量学习中达到新SOTA，在计算效率与长尾泛化能力之间取得更好的平衡。
AI.conclusion: GSR从谱正则化角度有效解决了长尾学习中的谱塌缩问题，为分析持续学习在长尾分布场景下的应用提供了理论框架和实用方案。

title: The JEPA Paradox in Language: The Geometry of Linguistic Alternatives
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are effective for images, video, and audio, yet deterministic JEPA-style latent prediction has not become a standard objective for text encoders. We argue that this gap reflects a mismatch between squared-error latent prediction and the conditional structure of language. The key requirement is conditional concentration: given a context and target location, the target representation should lie near a single meaningful point. Local image prediction often satisfies this through spatial continuity, whereas masked text can admit multiple valid token or span completions whose representations need not share a coherent center. We formalize this mismatch through three conditions---predictability, non-collapse, and low conditional variance---and show how their failure creates centroid degeneracy and collapse pressure in text. Matched I-JEPA and T-JEPA experiments reveal the predicted sequence: mutual-information saturation and elevated target variance precede train--validation instability, effective-rank degeneration, cosine collapse, and poor downstream transfer. The same pattern appears across five independent data seeds, indicating that it is not a sampling artifact. These results do not rule out predictive learning for language; they show that text-compatible JEPA objectives must preserve multiple plausible completions rather than compress them into a single latent point.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了确定性JEPA式潜在预测在文本领域失效的原因：语言的条件结构允许多种有效补全，而平方误差预测强制将多模态表示压缩为单一中心点，导致坍缩和下游性能下降。
AI.motivation: 尽管JEPA在图像、视频和音频中效果显著，但确定性JEPA式潜在预测尚未成为文本编码器的标准目标。作者试图解释这一差距的根本原因。
AI.method: 形式化定义了三个条件（可预测性、非坍缩、低条件方差），通过I-JEPA与T-JEPA的对比实验，观测互信息饱和、目标方差上升、有效秩退化、余弦坍缩等序列现象，并使用五个独立数据种子验证。
AI.result: 文本中的JEPA预测会导致互信息饱和、目标方差升高、训练-验证不稳定、有效秩退化、余弦坍缩和下游迁移性能下降。这些模式在五个数据种子中一致出现。
AI.conclusion: 文本兼容的JEPA目标必须保留多种可能的补全，而非将它们压缩为单一潜在点。这不排除预测式学习在语言中的可能性，但需要多模态而非确定性的目标设计。

title: Topological Data Analysis and Graph-Theoretic Approaches for Tennis Match Prediction
summary: We present two approaches for predicting tennis match outcomes using topological data analysis and graph theory on ATP singles matches from 2000-2025. The first method applies lower-star filtration to player competitive networks, extracting topological features through persistent homology using four summary methods (VAB, HNAV, HWNAV, OW-HNPV) combined with Modified Band Depth analysis. Algorithmic optimizations including ego graph approximations and triangle elimination enable analysis of about 66k matches. Our Random Forest model achieves 66.2% accuracy (AUC = 0.719) using topological, graph-theoretic, and ranking features. Feature importance analysis reveals that rankings contribute 36.3%, centralities 25.5%, and TDA features 24.0%, with topological features providing complementary signal. When rankings are unavailable, the topology-only model maintains 63.56% accuracy, demonstrating that network-derived features alone capture meaningful competitive structure. The second method uses a modified Katz similarity index with temporal edge weighting, achieving 62.48% accuracy on held-out test data. This work represents the first application of lower-star filtration to tennis prediction, provides systematic comparison of four topological summary methods in sports analytics, and demonstrates that TDA can achieve above-chance prediction using network topology alone while providing additional value when combined with traditional features.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种基于拓扑数据分析(TDA)和图论预测网球比赛结果的方法。第一种方法利用lower-star filtration提取球员竞争网络的拓扑特征，结合四种拓扑摘要方法和随机森林模型，在约6.6万场ATP比赛中达到66.2%的准确率(AUC=0.719)。特征重要性分析显示排名贡献36.3%，中心性25.5%，TDA特征24.0%。当仅使用拓扑特征时，准确率仍达63.56%。第二种方法采用改进的Katz相似度指标，在测试集上获得62.48%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 将拓扑数据分析(TDA)引入体育预测领域，探索网络拓扑结构在网球比赛结果预测中的价值，填补lower-star filtration在网球预测中应用的空白，并系统比较多种拓扑摘要方法在体育分析中的效果。
AI.method: 1) 构建球员竞争网络，应用lower-star filtration进行持续同调分析，使用四种摘要方法(VAB、HNAV、HWNAV、OW-HNPV)结合Modified Band Depth提取拓扑特征；2) 通过ego图近似和三角消除等算法优化处理约6.6万场比赛；3) 采用随机森林模型融合拓扑特征、图论特征和排名特征；4) 第二种方法使用带时间边权重的改进Katz相似度指标。
AI.result: 随机森林模型准确率66.2%(AUC=0.719)；排名特征贡献36.3%，中心性25.5%，TDA特征24.0%；纯拓扑模型准确率63.56%；改进Katz相似度方法准确率62.48%。
AI.conclusion: TDA特征能捕捉传统特征之外的互补信号，仅凭网络拓扑即可实现高于随机水平的预测，与排名等传统特征结合时能进一步提升预测性能。

title: The Capacitated $p$-Location Problem with Territorial Coverage Constraint: Efficient Solution and Case Study
summary: This paper studies the Capacitated $p$-Location Problem (C$p$LP) and its extensions incorporating equity considerations. In location science, the $p$-Median problem ($p$MP) is a classical model which selects $p$ facilities from a finite set of candidates to serve a set of customers minimizing total allocation costs. The C$p$LP which includes the Capacitated p-Median Problem (C$p$MP) and its relaxed variant (C$p$MP$^r$), extends the $p$MP by incorporating capacity constraints on facilities.We first introduce the C$p$LP with Territorial Coverage Constraints (C$p$LP-TC), a extension of the CpLP that enforces equity considering the spatial units. Building on this, we propose the multi-scale variant (C$p$LP-MTC), which generalizes territorial coverage constraints across nested spatial scales, allowing equity to be enforced simultaneously at multiple levels of spatial aggregation. A strengthened Integer Linear Programming (ILP) formulation with valid inequalities is presented. In addition, we develop the Random Sampling Spatial Voting (RSSV) matheuristic, which integrates a heuristic reduction phase with the strengthened ILP. The method is flexible, requires minimal parameter tuning, and remains accessible to non specialist users. Computational experiments on benchmark and real world instances demonstrate its efficiency and reliability. The results also demonstrate the impact of equity territorial based constraints on fairness in location planning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了带容量约束的p-选址问题及其考虑公平性的扩展变体，提出了带地域覆盖约束的多尺度模型和随机采样空间投票元启发式算法，实验证明该方法高效可靠，并能有效提升选址规划的公平性。
AI.motivation: 经典的p-中位问题未考虑设施容量约束和选址的公平性问题，而实际应用中容量限制和地域公平性至关重要。本文旨在填补这一空白，将容量约束与多层次空间公平性整合到选址模型中。
AI.method: 提出带地域覆盖约束的CpLP（CpLP-TC）及其多尺度变体（CpLP-MTC），构建了带有效不等式的强化ILP模型，并设计了随机采样空间投票（RSSV）元启发式算法，结合启发式约简与强化ILP求解。
AI.result: 在基准测试和真实实例上的计算实验表明，RSSV方法高效且可靠，同时验证了地域约束对选址规划公平性的显著影响。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的模型和方法能够有效兼顾容量约束与多尺度空间公平性，且RSSV算法参数少、易使用，为非专业用户提供了实用的选址决策工具。

title: Chart Deception in Vision-Language Models: From Vulnerability to Mitigation
summary: Information visualizations are widely used to communicate patterns, trends, and outliers, yet deceptive design choices-such as truncated or inverted axes, distorted aspect ratios, inappropriate encodings, and misleading color mappings-can systematically alter interpretation while preserving the underlying data. As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly used for chart understanding and analytical reasoning, assessing their robustness to such deceptive visualizations has become critical for trustworthy data analysis. We introduce VisDeception, the first controlled paired benchmark for evaluating the robustness of VLMs to misleading chart designs. The benchmark contains 1,600 paired faithful and misleading charts spanning eight major categories of deceptive visualization tactics, where each misleading chart is paired with a faithful counterpart generated from the same underlying data. To isolate deception-induced reasoning errors from baseline chart-understanding errors, we introduce the Deception Score, a paired evaluation metric that quantifies how misleading visualizations shift model responses away from the faithful interpretation of the data. Across 32,000 responses from 10 state-of-the-art VLMs, we find that even advanced models remain highly vulnerable to deceptive visual manipulations. To improve robustness, we further propose an inference-time multi-agent mitigation framework that grounds reasoning in structured chart metadata extracted from the visualization before answer generation, enabling models to reduce the influence of deceptive visual cues without requiring explicit user instructions. Together, our findings reveal important reliability gaps in current chart-understanding systems and establish benchmark-driven evaluation, deception-aware metrics, and structured reasoning as promising directions for developing more trustworthy VLMs for visual analytics.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出了VisDeception基准，用于评估视觉语言模型在面对欺骗性图表设计（如截断轴、扭曲比例等）时的鲁棒性，并提出了Deception Score指标和基于多智能体的推理框架来增强模型可靠性。
AI.motivation: 随着视觉语言模型在图表理解和分析推理中的广泛应用，欺骗性可视化设计可能导致模型产生系统性误解，但目前缺乏评估模型对此类欺骗性设计鲁棒性的标准化基准。
AI.method: 构建了包含1600对忠实/欺骗性图表的VisDeception基准，涵盖8大类欺骗策略；提出Deception Score配对评估指标；设计多智能体推理框架，利用结构化图表元数据减少视觉欺骗影响。
AI.result: 对10个SOTA视觉语言模型进行32000次响应测试，发现即便是先进模型对欺骗性视觉操作仍然高度脆弱。
AI.conclusion: 当前图表理解系统存在显著可靠性差距，基准驱动评估、欺骗感知度量和结构化推理是开发更可信视觉语言模型的有效方向。

title: Discrepancy-Rounded Fair Bandits with Static and Time-Varying Exposure Floors
summary: Minimum-exposure constraints arise in recommendation, content curation, and regulated allocation when each provider, arm, or group must receive guaranteed exposure inside a period rather than only in aggregate. We study stochastic bandits with exact exposure floors and show that the right object is a rounding problem: a fractional fair schedule is realized as integral pulls, and the exposure error is exactly a discrepancy vector. The main contribution is a blockwise model with time-varying floors. BDQ-UCB satisfies every block floor deterministically and has fair regret governed by the nonmandatory budget $R$, not the horizon $T$, with high-probability regret $O(\sqrt{KR\log(KT)})$. A MOSS residual variant attains $O(\sqrt{KR})$, and a matching lower bound gives the minimax rate $Θ(\sqrt{KR})$, even with positive mandatory exposure; a kl-UCB$^{++}$ residual rule adds instance-dependent optimality. The formulation becomes essential for overlapping group floors: per-arm rounding can violate a group constraint by $Ω(s)$ in the group size, whereas Beck--Fiala null-space rounding meets every group floor within the block budget with violation below the arm degree $t$, and composes with UCB at the same $R$-parametrized regret. For learned group plans, we close disjoint systems at $\widetildeΘ(\sqrt{KT})$, give a dual-ledger decomposition explaining why naive index rules fail under overlap, and prove a plan-sampling rule that is pathwise feasible under an initial cover-slack condition and attains a conditional $\widetilde O(\sqrt{KT})$ guarantee, leaving the condition-free overlap rate open. Experiments on synthetic floors, MovieLens-100k genre exposure, and deployment stress tests show exact feasibility without penalty tuning and regret competitive with tuned Lagrangian baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文研究具有最小曝光约束的随机bandit问题，将分数公平调度实现为整数拉取，提出BDQ-UCB算法实现确定性块级约束满足，遗憾上界为O(√KR log(KT))，并给出匹配的下界Ω(√KR)。针对重叠组约束，采用Beck-Fiala零空间舍入方法将违规控制在臂度t以内。实验验证了方法的可行性。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统、内容策展和资源分配中，每个提供者（臂、组）必须在每个时段内获得保证的最低曝光量，而不仅仅是长期总曝光。现有bandit算法未考虑这种严格的时段级曝光下限约束。
AI.method: 将分数公平调度的取整问题建模为bandit框架，提出BDQ-UCB（块级确定性配额UCB），通过块级模型处理时变曝光下限；针对重叠组约束，引入Beck-Fiala零空间舍入方法；提出MOSS残差变体和kl-UCB++残差规则实现最优遗憾。
AI.result: BDQ-UCB以O(√KR log(KT))的高概率遗憾满足所有块级约束；MOSS变体达到O(√KR)，匹配下界Ω(√KR)；重叠组约束下违规控制在臂度t以内；实验表明无需惩罚调参即可精确满足约束。
AI.conclusion: 曝光下限bandit问题的核心是取整问题，块级模型和零空间舍入提供了有效的理论框架。BDQ系列算法在理论最优性和实际可行性上均优于调参Lagrangian基线。

title: Guiding Language Models to Be More Empathetic: Culturally Sensitive Mental Health Advice Generation Through Human-LLM Collaboration
summary: Despite recent advances in large language models (LLMs), their ability to generate empathetic mental health counseling responses in low-resource languages remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we curate 625 authentic mental health cases from three complementary sources: (1) publicly available Facebook posts discussing mental health concerns, (2) transcripts from the Bangladeshi television program "Ami Akhon Ki Korbo", and (3) anonymized student questionnaire responses covering diverse emotional and psychological challenges. Based on these cases, we build an evaluation corpus comprising advice written by licensed clinical psychologists and responses generated by three modern proprietary LLMs: GPT-4o Mini, Claude 4.5 Haiku, and Gemini 2.5 Pro. We further propose the Role-Playing Reflective Chain-of-Thought Advisory Framework (RP-RCAF), a task-specific prompting strategy that combines expert-authored few-shot examples with structured self-reflection to produce supportive, culturally aware, and ethically aligned counseling through a compassionate advisor persona. We also introduce the Grok 4-Based Response Evaluation and Scoring Framework (G-REFS), which integrates automated assessment with expert psychologist validation across emotional sensitivity, cultural appropriateness, linguistic clarity, and ethical soundness. Experimental results show that RP-RCAF consistently outperforms conventional prompting across all evaluated models and produces responses that more closely align with professional psychological counseling.

AI.tldr: 本文针对低资源语言（孟加拉语）中的心理健康咨询场景，构建了包含625个真实案例的数据集，提出RP-RCAF提示框架和G-REFS评估框架，实验表明该方法能显著提升LLM生成共情式心理咨询回复的质量。
AI.motivation: LLM在低资源语言中生成共情式心理健康咨询回复的能力尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: (1) 从Facebook帖子、电视节目Transcripts和学生问卷中收集625个孟加拉语真实案例；(2) 构建包含心理咨询师回复和三个LLM生成回复的评估语料库；(3) 提出RP-RCAF提示策略（角色扮演+反思性思维链+专家示例）；(4) 提出G-REFS评估框架（自动化评估+专家验证）。
AI.result: RP-RCAF在所有评估模型上均优于传统提示方式，生成的回复更接近专业心理咨询标准。
AI.conclusion: 任务特定的提示框架（结合角色扮演、反思性思维链和专家示例）能显著提升LLM在低资源语言心理健康咨询中的表现，为跨语言共情AI提供了可行路径。

title: Breaking the Total Variance Barrier: Sharp Sample Complexity for Linear Heteroscedastic Bandits with Fixed Action Set
summary: Recent years have witnessed increasing interests in tackling heteroscedastic noise in bandits and reinforcement learning. In these works, the cumulative variance of the noise $Λ= \sum_{t=1}^T σ_t^2$, where $σ_t^2$ is the variance of the noise at round $t$, is used to characterize the statistical complexity of the problem, yielding \emph{simple regret} bounds of order $\tilde{\cal{O}}(d \sqrt{Λ/ T^2})$ for $d$-dimensional linear bandits with heteroscedastic noise. However, with a closer look, $Λ$ remains the same order even if the noise is close to zero at half of the rounds, which indicates that the $Λ$-dependence is not optimal. In this paper, we revisit the stochastic linear bandit problem with heteroscedastic noise, where the action set is prefixed throughout the learning process. We propose a novel variance-adaptive algorithm \texttt{VAEE} (Variance-Aware Exploration with Elimination) for large action set, which actively explores actions that maximizes the information gain among a candidate set of actions that are not eliminated. With the active-exploration strategy, we show that \texttt{VAEE} achieves a \emph{simple regret} with a nearly \emph{harmonic-mean} dependent rate. For finitely many actions, we propose a variance-aware variant of G-optimal design based exploration, which achieves a simple regret with sharper dependence on $d$. We also establish a nearly matching lower bound for the fixed action set setting indicating that \emph{harmonic-mean} dependent rate is unavoidable. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work that breaks the $\sqrtΛ$ barrier for stochastic linear bandits with heteroscedastic noise.

AI.tldr: 本文针对异方差噪声下的随机线性赌博机问题，提出了方差自适应算法VAEE，实现了基于调和均值的简单遗憾界，突破了传统√Λ依赖的局限，并给出了匹配的下界。这是首个打破√Λ屏障的工作。
AI.motivation: 现有异方差噪声下bandit问题的遗憾界依赖于累积方差 Λ，但Λ在噪声部分回合接近零时仍保持相同量级，说明Λ依赖不是最优的。本文旨在设计能利用噪声方差波动信息、实现更精细遗憾界的算法。
AI.method: 提出VAEE算法，采用主动探索策略，在未被淘汰的候选动作集中最大化信息增益。对于有限动作集，提出基于方差感知的G-optimal设计探索变体。
AI.result: VAEE实现了近似的调和均值依赖的简单遗憾率；有限动作集下获得了对维度d更尖锐的依赖；建立了几乎匹配的下界，证明调和均值依赖率是不可避免的。
AI.conclusion: 首次在异方差噪声随机线性赌博机中突破√Λ屏障，调和均值依赖的遗憾界更准确地反映了噪声方差的波动特性。

title: Kernel-Type Fractional Extensions of Reverse Callebaut, Rogers Hölder and Cauchy Schwarz Inequalities on Time Scales
summary: In this paper, we establish kernel-type fractional extensions of reverse Callebaut, Rogers--Hölder and Cauchy--Schwarz inequalities on time scales. The proposed results are formulated by means of a nonnegative kernel operator associated with the diamond-$α$ integral, which enables the inclusion of memory effects within the framework of dynamic inequalities. By choosing particular kernels and time scales, the obtained inequalities reduce to their continuous, discrete and quantum counterparts. Moreover, when the kernel is taken as the identity kernel, the results recover the corresponding classical diamond-$α$ dynamic inequalities. Several consequences are derived as special cases, including fractional reverse Cauchy--Schwarz inequalities and weighted reverse Rogers--Hölder inequalities. The results provide a unified approach for studying reverse inequalities in continuous, discrete, quantum and fractional dynamic settings and may be applied to obtain a priori estimates for Volterra-type and delay dynamic equations.

AI.tldr: 本文在时间尺度上建立了带核函数的分数阶反向Callebaut、Rogers–Hölder和Cauchy–Schwarz不等式，通过diamond-α积分引入核算子统一处理连续、离散、量子及分数阶动态不等式，并推广了经典结果。
AI.motivation: 现有反向不等式只在连续、离散或量子等单一框架下成立，缺乏统一处理机制。作者希望借助时间尺度理论和分数阶核函数，建立更通用的反向不等式框架，以涵盖记忆效应并统一各离散与连续情形。
AI.method: 基于时间尺度上的diamond-α积分，引入非负核算子构造分数阶扩展；通过选取不同的核函数和时间尺度，分别导出连续、离散、量子及经典diamond-α动态不等式；核退化为单位核时恢复已有结果。
AI.result: 建立了分数阶反向Callebaut、Rogers–Hölder及Cauchy–Schwarz不等式的一般形式；推导了分数阶反向Cauchy–Schwarz不等式和加权反向Rogers–Hölder不等式等特例；所得结果统一覆盖连续、离散、量子及分数阶动态情形。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为反向不等式在多种动态框架下提供了统一途径，可用于Volterra型及延迟动态方程的先验估计，具有广泛的应用潜力。

title: DeepLook: Deeper Thinking with Lookahead
summary: Inference-time scaling has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving large language model reasoning, often delivering larger gains on difficult reasoning tasks than parameter scaling alone. However, existing approaches remain inefficient in how compute is allocated within a reasoning trace. Motivated by the observation that reasoning failures often exhibit an early onset of uncertainty before a wrong answer become explicit, we introduce DeepLook, a training-free monitor-and-intervene decoding framework that concentrates lookahead compute at uncertainty bottlenecks. DeepLook aggregates token-level confidence into segment-level signals, triggers when confidence drops relative to recent history, and explores candidate continuations with fixed-horizon lookahead. Branches are ranked by Average Lookahead Confidence (ALC), the average segment-level confidence over rollout continuations, then pruned and aggregated through voting. On four competition-style mathematics benchmarks across DeepSeek-R1-8B, Qwen3-32B, GPT-OSS-20B, and GPT-OSS-120B, DeepLook shifts the accuracy--token-cost Pareto frontier: it improves accuracy over DeepConf-low in 11 of 16 settings while reducing dataset-level token generation by 87.3% on average, including gains of +3.1 on AIME25 with Qwen3-32B and +8.8 on BRUMO25 with GPT-OSS-20B. These results show that selective, future-aware intervention yields substantially stronger accuracy--cost trade-offs than uniformly scaling complete reasoning trajectories. Code is available here.

AI.tldr: 提出DeepLook，一个无需训练的监控-干预解码框架，通过在推理不确定性瓶颈处集中前瞻计算，显著提升准确率-计算成本帕累托边界。
AI.motivation: 现有推理时扩展方法在推理轨迹内计算分配效率低下，推理失败往往在答案变得明显错误之前就出现早期不确定性。
AI.method: 将token级置信度聚合成segment级信号，在置信度相对历史下降时触发，用固定视野前瞻探索候选延续，基于平均前瞻置信度(ALC)排序分支，通过剪枝和投票聚合。
AI.result: 在4个竞赛数学基准上，16个设置中11个提升准确率，平均减少87.3%的token生成量，AIME25提升+3.1，BRUMO25提升+8.8。
AI.conclusion: 选择性、面向未来的干预比统一扩展完整推理轨迹能获得更优的准确率-成本权衡。

title: Verbalized Particle Posterior: Bayesian Inference over Natural Language Hypotheses
summary: Verbalized Machine Learning (VML) parameterizes a model as a natural-language prompt that an LLM evaluates as f(x; theta). The framework is interpretable, but it commits to a single hypothesis with no measure of uncertainty, and that hypothesis varies substantially across optimization runs on the same data. We propose the Verbalized Particle Posterior (VPP), which treats verbalized learning as a Bayesian inference problem: maintain a population of natural-language hypotheses as particles, update them with Metropolis-Hastings (VPP-MH) or Sequential Monte Carlo (VPP-SMC), and predict by Bayesian model averaging. Both algorithms treat the LLM as a black box, requiring no access to logits or gradients. A distinctive consequence follows. In classical Bayesian learning, model selection sits outside the posterior; in VPP both model structure and parameters share a single language space, and the posterior ranges over both. We evaluate VPP on regression, classification, and rule-discovery benchmarks. It improves over a single VML run on every benchmark and matches or exceeds an oracle-best ensemble of independent VML runs on most, while eliminating the catastrophic single-run failures that VML occasionally produces. Because each particle is a human-readable hypothesis, the posterior is itself something a reader can inspect, seeing in plain text which explanations the data supported and which it ruled out.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Verbalized Particle Posterior (VPP)，将语言化机器学习视为贝叶斯推断问题，通过粒子群维护多个自然语言假设，用 Metropolis-Hastings 或序贯蒙特卡洛方法更新，最终通过贝叶斯模型平均进行预测。VPP 在回归、分类和规则发现任务上优于单一 VML 方法，匹配或超越独立 VML 集成，同时消除了单次运行的灾难性失败。
AI.motivation: Verbalized Machine Learning (VML) 虽具可解释性，但存在两个关键缺陷：一是仅输出单一假设，缺乏不确定性度量；二是不同运行得到的假设差异大、不稳定。本文希望通过贝叶斯推断框架来捕捉假设空间的不确定性，提升鲁棒性。
AI.method: 将语言化学习建模为贝叶斯推断问题：维护一个自然语言假设的粒子群（population of particles），采用 Metropolis-Hastings (VPP-MH) 或 Sequential Monte Carlo (VPP-SMC) 算法更新粒子，将 LLM 作为黑盒使用（无需 logits 或梯度），最后通过贝叶斯模型平均进行预测。模型结构和参数共享同一语言空间，后验分布同时覆盖两者。
AI.result: 在回归、分类和规则发现基准测试上，VPP 在每个任务上都优于单一 VML 运行，在大多数任务上匹配或超越 oracle 最优的独立 VML 集成，同时消除了 VML 偶尔产生的灾难性单次运行失败。
AI.conclusion: VPP 为语言化机器学习提供了贝叶斯推断框架，不仅提升了预测性能和鲁棒性，而且每个粒子都是人类可读的假设，后验分布本身可供读者检查——以纯文本形式展示数据支持了哪些解释、排除了哪些解释，兼具性能与可解释性。

title: Language Shapes Instruction Hierarchy Compliance in Multilingual LLMs
comment: Code and data are available at https://github.com/g1moon/Language-Shapes-IH
summary: Instruction hierarchy (IH) requires models to prioritize instructions by source, ensuring that higher-priority instructions override lower-priority ones. Despite its importance for safe and controllable deployment, existing evaluations have focused almost exclusively on English, leaving it unclear whether IH compliance remains stable in multilingual settings. We introduce XIH-Bench, a benchmark for multilingual IH evaluation with both same-language and cross-language conflicts across six languages, four domains, and three IH settings. Across models, we find two consistent patterns. First, IH compliance exhibits a clear language-dependent asymmetry: a language that strengthens compliance in the higher-priority position can become disruptive in the lower-priority position. Second, cross-language conflicts yield higher compliance than same-language conflicts, a phenomenon we term the Language Boundary Effect. We further show that language specialization can make lower-priority instructions in model-favored languages harder to override, creating multilingual reliability and security risks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出XIH-Bench多语言指令层级基准测试，发现指令遵从存在语言依赖不对称性和语言边界效应，模型偏好的语言会削弱安全可控性。
AI.motivation: 现有指令层级评估几乎全部聚焦英语，未检验多语言场景下指令优先级遵从的稳定性，存在安全与可控部署的盲区。
AI.method: 构建XIH-Bench基准，覆盖六种语言、四个领域和三种指令层级设置，包含同语言和跨语言冲突场景。
AI.result: 1) 指令遵从存在语言依赖不对称性；2) 跨语言冲突比同语言冲突的遵从更高（语言边界效应）；3) 模型偏好的语言中低优先级指令更难被覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 多语言指令层级存在可靠性和安全风险，语言边界效应和语言不对称性需在模型部署中重视。

title: The Intruder Threshold: A Spectral Law for LoRA Fine-Tuning
summary: LoRA fine-tuning can create intruder dimensions: new leading singular vectors of the updated weight matrix $W+BA$ that are nearly orthogonal to all pretrained singular vectors and that drive catastrophic forgetting. Since their discovery, no theory has predicted, layer by layer on measured spectra, when they appear. We derive a per-layer critical update strength $s^\ast=\barθ/(γσ_1(BA))$, computed from the measured spectrum of $W$ alone through the rectangular spiked-deformation transform, together with an exact secular-equation characterization of the updated spectrum, with no fitted parameters. In a pre-specified study spanning four dense Transformer families, a state-space model, a mixture-of-experts model, and an encoder-decoder (18 adapters, 9{,}840 layer scans), the law localizes the empirical threshold within a factor of two on $82\%$ of layers, separates intruder-bearing from intruder-free layers at deployment with a mean AUC of $0.89$, holds unchanged on six third-party adapters, and predicts where WikiText-2 perplexity begins to degrade; a combination of the two pre-specified edge evaluations reaches $98\%$ and is confirmed out-of-bag on the external adapters ($0.997$). Full fine-tuning disperses its update far below the threshold of every layer, which resolves the asymmetry between LoRA and full fine-tuning. Norm-matched interventions confirm that threshold-crossing layers, rather than update magnitude, carry the forgetting, and a spike-budget rule derived from the thresholds, requiring one SVD and no validation sweeps, reduces forgetting by $62\%$ on the most fragile model at no task cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于奇异谱理论的方法，能够逐层预测LoRA微调中入侵维度（intruder dimensions）出现的临界阈值，无需拟合参数，并在多种模型和适配器上验证了其有效性，同时揭示了LoRA与全参数微调的不对称性，并基于此提出了减少灾难性遗忘的规则。
AI.motivation: LoRA微调会产生入侵维度（intruder dimensions），即更新权重矩阵中与预训练奇异向量几乎正交的新主导奇异向量，这些向量会导致灾难性遗忘。但目前尚无理论能够逐层、基于实测谱预测这些入侵维度何时出现，因此需要建立系统的理论解释。
