AI.method: 通过矩形尖峰变形变换（rectangular spiked-deformation transform），从预训练权重矩阵W的实测谱出发，推导出逐层临界更新强度$s^*$，并结合精确的久期方程（secular equation）表征更新后的谱分布，无需拟合参数。在4个密集Transformer家族、状态空间模型、混合专家模型、编码器-解码器等18个适配器、9840层扫描上进行验证。
AI.result: 该理论在82%的层上将经验阈值定位在2倍因子范围内，区分入侵层与非入侵层的AUC为0.89，在六种第三方适配器上保持不变，并能预测WikiText-2困惑度开始恶化的位置。结合两种边缘评估时准确率达到98%，在外部适配器上为0.997。全参数微调的更新远低于每层阈值，解释了LoRA与全微调的不对称性。基于阈值导出的尖峰预算规则（spike-budget rule）仅需一次SVD，无需验证扫描，在最脆弱模型上将遗忘减少62%且不损失任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 该理论成功解释了LoRA微调中入侵维度的出现机制，预测了灾难性遗忘的临界点，揭示了LoRA与全参数微调的本质差异，并提供了无需验证的实用遗忘缓解策略，具有重要的理论和实践价值。

title: A QUBO-Based Optimization Framework for ATM Cash Replenishment Scheduling
summary: The management of cash replenishment in Automated Teller Machine (ATM) networks requires scheduling recharges in order to minimize operational costs while maintaining high service levels and avoiding cash-outs, under uncertain and time-varying withdrawal demand. This work formulates the ATM cash replenishment problem through a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) model, which naturally captures nonlinear cost interactions, while incorporating operational constraints through penalty terms. The objective function combines fixed and variable replenishment costs with co-location discounts, as well as penalties for a late replenishment that could cause a service interruption. The resulting QUBO instances are solved using MegaQUBO, a GPU-accelerated QUBO solver. An empirical evaluation on a real dataset of 276 ATMs located in Italy, covering four representative months of 2022 (April, May, October, and November), benchmarks the proposed approach against a threshold-based operational policy. Results show consistent cost reductions of approximately 15%-18% while maintaining an excellent average service level (around 99.8%-99.9). Overall, the study demonstrates that QUBO-based optimization, coupled with GPU-based solving, can provide a practically deployable decision-support tool for large-scale ATM cash logistics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基於QUBO模型的ATM現金補貨最佳化方法，並使用GPU加速求解器MegaQUBO，在義大利276台ATM的真實數據上實現約15%-18%的成本節省，同時維持99.8%-99.9%的高服務水準。
AI.motivation: ATM現金補貨管理需要在不確定且時變的提款需求下，最小化營運成本同時維持高服務水準，現有方法難以有效處理非線性成本互動與大規模求解。
AI.method: 將問題建模為QUBO，透過懲罰項納入營運限制，目標函數整合固定與可變補貨成本、共置折扣及延遲補貨罰則，並使用GPU加速的MegaQUBO求解器求解。
AI.result: 在義大利276台ATM、四個月的真實數據上，相較於基於閾值的營運政策，成本降低約15%-18%，平均服務水準維持在99.8%-99.9%。
AI.conclusion: 基於QUBO的最佳化方法搭配GPU求解，可作為大規模ATM現金物流的實用決策支援工具。

title: Group Preference Collapse in Personalized Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Personalized multimodal large language models (MLLMs) aim to generate user-specific responses, but existing methods mainly rely on profile-level information and overlook diverse user preferences. We identify group preference collapse, where multi-user personalized MLLMs become insensitive to individual preferences and drift toward dominant population-level choices due to suppressed preference signals and unreliable preference use during generation. We propose PrefMoE, a preference-centric framework that separates stable profile information from preference-related representations. PrefMoE decomposes preferences into shared prototypes and personalized residuals, preserves individualized residuals with imbalance-aware learning, counterfactual pseudo-user augmentation, and residual decorrelation, and routes profile and preference factors through separate LoRA adaptation paths. Experiments across multiple MLLM backbones show that PrefMoE improves preference-sensitive personalization while substantially reducing preference collapse. Project page: https://prefmoe.github.io/.

AI.tldr: PrefMoE提出了一种偏好中心框架，通过将稳定轮廓信息与偏好相关表示分离，并利用共享原型与个性化残差分解，结合不平衡感知学习、反事实伪用户增强及残差解相关，有效缓解多用户个性化多模态大模型中的群体偏好坍缩问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要依赖轮廓级信息，忽视多样化用户偏好，导致多用户个性化MLLM出现群体偏好坍缩——模型对个体偏好不敏感，偏向群体层面的主流选择。
AI.method: 将偏好分解为共享原型和个性化残差；通过不平衡感知学习保留个性化残差；使用反事实伪用户增强和残差解相关技术；通过独立的LoRA适配路径路由轮廓与偏好因子。
AI.result: 在多个MLLM骨干网络上实验表明，PrefMoE显著提升了偏好敏感的个性化效果，并大幅减少了偏好坍缩现象。
AI.conclusion: PrefMoE通过显式分离轮廓与偏好信息，并精细建模个性化残差，有效解决了多用户个性化场景中的偏好坍缩问题。

title: Learned Interventions in Lean 4 grind
summary: Lean~4's \grind{} tactic combines congruence closure, \ematch{}ing, and case-splitting into a single automated solver, and like any such solver, it relies on hand-tuned heuristics to decide what to instantiate and where to case-split. These heuristics are tempting targets for learning, but there is a catch: because \grind{}'s search is non-monotone, a learned heuristic that helps one proof can break another, and an always-on replacement usually nets out near zero. We avoid this by invoking a learned intervention only after stock \grind{} has already failed: a failure-triggered cascade that, by construction, cannot lose a proof \grind{} already had. We apply it to two of \grind{}'s internal decisions. A cost-aware \ematch{} filter solves slightly more problems and runs about 5\% faster. A lookahead step, proves five theorems it otherwise times out on. We also report the negative result that motivated the design: across four feature-based models, statically predicting the correct case split is no better than random, because whether a split explodes is a runtime property that the features do not capture. Our results suggest that learning within theorem-proving tactics is most effective as a mechanism for deciding when and how to spend bounded search, backed by a reliable symbolic fallback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种失败触发的级联机制，在 Lean 4 的 grind 策略中引入学习型启发式方法，通过仅在原策略失败后介入，保证不损失已有证明能力。实验表明：代价感知的 ematch 过滤提升约 5% 速度和更多解题数；前瞻步骤帮助解决 5 个超时定理。同时报告了负面结果：静态预测 case split 不优于随机。结论认为，定理证明中学习最有效的方式是作为有限搜索的决策机制，由可靠的符号推理作为后备。
AI.motivation: grind 策略依赖手工调优的启发式方法来进行实例化和 case-split，这些启发式方法具有学习潜力，但由于搜索的非单调性，学习型启发式在帮助一个证明的同时可能破坏另一个，整体改进几乎为零。因此需要一种不损失已有能力的介入方式。
AI.method: 提出失败触发的级联机制：仅当原始 grind 策略失败后，才调用学习型启发式干预。具体应用于两个内部决策：1) 代价感知的 ematch 过滤器；2) 前瞻步骤。通过构造保证不丢失原有证明能力。
AI.result: 代价感知的 ematch 过滤器解决了更多问题，运行速度提升约 5%；前瞻步骤解决了 5 个原本超时的定理。负面结果：基于四种特征模型静态预测 case split 的正确性不优于随机。
AI.conclusion: 定理证明中学习最有效的方式是作为决定何时以及如何花费有限搜索的机制，并以可靠的符号推理作为后备。

title: Soft-Constrained Optimization of Latent Space in Variational Autoencoders
summary: The usefulness of a variational autoencoder (VAE) depends on two properties of its latent space that are hard to obtain together: high encoding capacity in the individual latent variables, and a low-dimensional, disentangled organization of those variables. Weakening the Kullback-Leibler regularization raises capacity but degrades disentanglement, while strengthening it prunes latent variables away entirely. We formulate VAE training as a soft-constrained optimization problem that addresses both. First, we impose an entropy-based constraint (EC) on individual latent variables, showing that the entropy of a latent code upper-bounds the mutual information it carries about the generative factors of the data. Second, we propose a weight-filter method that exploits the slack of the soft constraint to prune low-entropy dimensions during downstream training. On dSprites, the EC raises the aggregate latent-variable activation score by 43-62% over a vanilla VAE, attains the highest FactorVAE score among the \b{eta} \b{eta}-VAE variants (0.891 vs 0.847), and lowers reconstruction error by up to 38%. On MNIST, the weight filter reduces the latent dimensionality supplied to a downstream classifier from ten to two while holding accuracy above 90%, converging in 37% fewer epochs than the same procedure without the EC. We also find that low-entropy discrete factors tend to merge into a single latent variable, whereas high-entropy continuous factors are distributed across several.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于熵约束（EC）的软约束优化方法，在提升VAE潜变量编码容量的同时保持解耦性，并通过权重过滤方法在训练中剔除低熵维度，在dSprites和MNIST数据集上显著提升了激活分数、FactorVAE分数和下游任务效率。
AI.motivation: VAE的潜在空间需要同时具备高编码容量和低维解耦组织，但这两者难以兼得：削弱KL正则化会提高容量但破坏解耦，加强正则化则会完全剪除潜变量。现有方法无法同时优化这两个目标。
AI.method: 1) 提出**熵约束（Entropy Constraint, EC）**：对单个潜变量施加熵约束，利用潜变量熵上界约束其与数据生成因子的互信息；2) 提出**权重过滤方法（Weight Filter）**：利用软约束的松弛性，在下游训练过程中剪除低熵维度，实现自动降维。
AI.result: dSprites：EC使潜变量激活分数提升43-62%，FactorVAE分数达0.891（优于β-VAE变体的0.847），重建误差降低38%；MNIST：权重过滤将下游分类器潜变量维度从10降至2，准确率保持90%以上，收敛轮数减少37%。
AI.conclusion: 熵约束和权重过滤方法有效平衡了VAE的编码容量与解耦性，同时发现低熵离散因子倾向于合并到单个潜变量，高熵连续因子则分散到多个潜变量。

title: Convexifying Mean-Field Control: An Occupation-Measure and Frank-Wolfe Approach
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to the 2026 American Control Conference (ACC)
summary: Large-scale robotic swarms motivate the use of mean-field control (MFC). Classical partial differential equation (PDE)-based formulations provide a principled framework but can become computationally challenging in higher dimensions, whereas machine learning achieves scalability at the cost of approximation and guarantees. In this work, we establish an optimization-based framework that lifts the MFC problem into the space of occupation measures, resulting in a convex relaxation formulated as an optimization over measures. The resulting problem is solved using a Frank-Wolfe (FW) algorithm in the measure space, with each iteration reduced to a tractable optimal control problem. This approach retains the O(1/k) convergence rate of FW, avoids discretization of the state space, and naturally incorporates interaction and safety constraints. Numerical experiments demonstrate agreement with analytic and PDE-based baselines in two dimensions and show that the method scales to three-dimensional environments with multiple obstacles, where standard grid-based PDE solvers become impractical. A full 3D instance with ten obstacles is solved in minutes on a standard workstation, underscoring the practicality and scalability of the proposed framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于测度空间Frank-Wolfe算法的大规模机器人集群平均场控制框架，通过将问题提升到占据测度空间构建凸松弛，实现高维环境下无需状态空间离散化的高效求解，在二维与三维场景中验证了其与经典PDE方法相当的性能及更好的可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 大规模机器人集群需要高效的均场控制方法，但经典PDE方法在高维环境下计算成本高昂，而机器学习方法虽具可扩展性却牺牲了逼近精度与理论保证，因此需要一种兼顾计算效率与理论保障的框架。
AI.method: 将MFC问题提升到占据测度空间，构建凸松弛形式的优化问题；采用测度空间上的Frank-Wolfe算法迭代求解，每步简化为一个可求解的最优控制子问题，无需离散化状态空间。
AI.result: 该方法在二维场景中与解析解和基于PDE的基线结果吻合；成功扩展到含多个障碍物的三维环境，解决了标准网格PDE求解器无法处理的问题；在标准工作站上数分钟内即可求解含十个障碍物的完整3D实例。
AI.conclusion: 该框架保留了FW算法O(1/k)的收敛率，避免了状态空间离散化，自然融入交互与安全约束，在大规模机器人集群控制中兼具理论保障与实用可扩展性。

title: Evaluating LLMs as Interpretable Controllers for Dynamical Systems
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for decision-making and reasoning tasks, yet their potential as controllers for physical systems remains largely unexplored. This work investigates whether LLMs can function as interpretable controllers for a dynamic thermal environment, examining their ability to follow setpoints, interpret natural-language commands, reason about actuator effects, and incorporate prior model-based knowledge. Five LLMs of varying scales are evaluated under multiple scenarios, including settings with penalties on heater or fan usage and cases where the models have access to a physics-based prediction tool. The results show that control performance depends on model complexity: while low- and mid-scale models frequently misinterpret actuator dynamics or generate inconsistent reasoning, high-complexity models such as Qwen-3~14B and GPT-4o achieve accurate temperature tracking, stable actuator usage, and coherent explanations aligned with physical principles. Incorporating a physics-based model significantly improves control smoothness and energy efficiency by enabling anticipatory decision-making. A detailed reasoning taxonomy further reveals a clear progression from causal misinterpretation in smaller models to cohesive and temporally aware reasoning in larger ones. The findings demonstrate that LLMs can act as interpretable controllers when sufficiently capable and appropriately grounded in domain knowledge, highlighting promising opportunities for hybrid model-based and language-driven control strategies that can provide plausible explanations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM作为可解释控制器在动态热环境中的能力，发现高复杂度模型（如Qwen-3 14B和GPT-4o）能准确追踪温度、稳定执行控制并给出符合物理原理的解释，而引入物理模型可提升控制平滑性和能效。
AI.motivation: LLM在决策和推理任务中广泛应用，但作为物理系统控制器的潜力尚未充分探索。本文旨在探究LLM能否成为可解释的物理控制器，并评估其在不同复杂度下的表现。
AI.method: 选取五种不同规模的LLM，在动态热环境中测试其设定点跟踪、自然语言指令解释、执行器效果推理及物理模型知识融入能力，并引入物理模型预测工具进行比较。
AI.result: 低中规模模型常误解执行器动力学或产生不一致推理；高复杂度模型（Qwen-3 14B, GPT-4o）能准确跟踪温度、稳定使用执行器并提供与物理原理一致的解释。结合物理模型可改善控制平滑性和能效。
AI.conclusion: 当LLM具备足够能力并适当结合领域知识时，可以充当可解释的控制器，为混合模型驱动与语言驱动的控制策略提供可能性。

title: Bayesian Complete-Pooling in Cross-Subject Classification for Motor Imagery Electroencephalogram
summary: Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) have long sought calibration-free operation, but classifiers are typically benchmarked by discrimination alone, blind to whether predicted probabilities are well calibrated - a meaningful gap given nonstationary electroencephalogram (EEG) signals and the risk of overconfident point-estimate classifiers under distribution shift. We conducted a large-scale study contrasting Bayesian complete-pooling models against frequentist baselines for cross-subject, left-hand versus right-hand motor imagery EEG classification across 20 datasets. Six frequentist pipelines were each paired with an analogous Bayesian pipeline sharing identical feature engineering, fit via Markov chain Monte Carlo posterior sampling. Our primary metric was the Brier score, decomposed into reliability and resolution, alongside AUROC for discrimination and Shannon entropy for sharpness. Each metric was analyzed via random-effects meta-analysis (REML, Knapp-Hartung adjustment), verified by leave-one-out influence analysis. Bayesian complete-pooling produced statistically but not practically significant improvements in reliability and increases in predictive uncertainty (lower sharpness); Brier score, resolution, and discrimination showed no significant differences. Between-study heterogeneity was low across all metrics, though the reliability result was sensitive to leave-one-out removal. We additionally profiled computational cost, finding that Bayesian pipelines consumed roughly thirteen times more energy than their frequentist counterparts, a cost that remains modest relative to common household appliances. These results suggest that Bayesian complete-pooling alone offers limited practical benefit for cross-subject motor imagery classification, and that partial-pooling across subjects and sessions is a more promising direction for future work.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模对比研究（20个数据集），发现贝叶斯完全池化模型在跨被试运动想象脑电分类中，相比频率学派基线仅带来统计显著但实际意义有限的可靠性提升，同时计算成本增加约13倍，表明该方法实际收益有限。
AI.motivation: 脑机接口长期追求无需校准的分类器，但现有基准测试仅关注判别能力，忽视预测概率的校准性。EEG信号非平稳且存在分布漂移，点估计分类器易过度自信，因此需要评估分类器的校准质量。
AI.method: 对20个数据集的左手vs右手运动想象脑电分类，将6种频率学派流程与对应的贝叶斯完全池化流程（共享特征工程，MCMC后验采样）配对对比。主要指标为Brier分数（分解为可靠性和分辨率），辅以AUROC（判别能力）和香农熵（锐度），采用随机效应元分析（REML，Knapp-Hartung调整）及留一法影响分析。
AI.result: 贝叶斯完全池化在可靠性上产生统计显著但非实际显著的改进，预测不确定性增加（锐度降低）；Brier分数、分辨率和判别能力无显著差异。研究间异质性低，但可靠性结果对留一法移除敏感。贝叶斯流程能耗约为频率学派的13倍，但相对于家用电器仍属适度。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯完全池化单独使用对跨被试运动想象脑电分类的实际益处有限，跨被试和跨session的部分池化是更有前景的研究方向。

title: EmoTrace: An Emotion Trajectory-Centered Framework for Psychological Support Dialogue Generation
summary: Using large language models (LLMs) to assist psychological counseling is an important task in the field of natural language processing. The construction of high-quality psychological support dialogue corpora serves as a critical foundation for training counseling-oriented conversational models. However, existing data generation approaches generally suffer from several limitations, including emotionally stable seekers, limited variation in emotional dynamics, and a high degree of compliance with counselors' guidance. These issues result in LLM that lack the capability to effectively respond to emotionally unstable scenarios. In addition, counselor responses are typically driven by problem-solving objectives, thereby overlooking the role of emotion-focused interaction, which are essential in psychological counseling. To address these gaps, we propose EmoTrace, a multi-turn dialogue corpus generation framework centered on modeling seekers' emotional trajectories. we construct seekers' cognitive profile and introduce a seeker module with emotional schemas and an associated activation mechanism, a counselor module, and an emotional trajectory control module, thereby enhancing the layering of the seeker's emotional expression and the counselor's targeted empathic expression. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms existing approaches in terms of emotional richness and empathy quality.

AI.tldr: 提出EmoTrace框架，通过建模来访者情感轨迹生成多轮心理咨询对话语料，解决现有数据生成方法中情感稳定、情感动态变化有限、过度顺从咨询师引导等问题，实验证明该方法在情感丰富度和共情质量上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有心理支持对话语料生成方法存在情感稳定、情感动态变化有限、过度顺从咨询师引导等局限，导致LLM缺乏应对情感不稳定场景的能力；同时咨询师回复通常以问题解决为导向，忽略了心理咨询中至关重要的情感焦点互动。
AI.method: 提出EmoTrace框架，构建来访者认知画像，引入带情感图式的来访者模块及其激活机制、咨询师模块和情感轨迹控制模块，增强来访者情感表达的层次性和咨询师针对性共情表达。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提方法在情感丰富度和共情质量方面优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过建模情感轨迹生成对话语料，能有效提升LLM在心理 counseling 场景下的情感应对能力和共情质量。

title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Predicting Nitrous Oxide Flux
summary: Nitrous oxide (N$_2$O) is the dominant ozone-depleting substance emitted in the 21st century, and the third largest contributor to anthropogenic greenhouse gases due to its high potency and long atmospheric lifetime, with more than 70% of N$_2$O emissions occurring as a result of agricultural processes. Current approaches to predicting N$_2$O flux emissions include process-based models such as DayCent and Cycles, as well as classical AI models, but the application of Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) to predicting N$_2$O flux emissions is largely underexplored. Our paper draws upon the mechanistic equations that underlie the DayCent family of process-based models to construct a rigorously derived, literature-traceable physics residual. We then build and train an MLP-based PINN on a multi-site agricultural dataset spanning four geographically distinct US agricultural sites. Across all tested values of the physics loss weighting hyperparameter $λ$, our PINN consistently and substantially outperformed uncalibrated Cycles simulation (R$^2=0.01$), with our MLP baseline achieving mean R$^2=0.411$ across ten random seeds. Physics constraints consistently degrade model performance in holdout validation, with marginal degradation at low $λ$ and significant degradation at high $λ$, but consistently improve model performance and reduce performance variability in leave-one-site-out validation. This suggests that physics constraints sacrifice in-distribution accuracy for out-of-distribution robustness, anchoring the model toward biogeochemically plausible behavior on unfamiliar soil conditions --- though cross-site generalization remains challenging, with negative R$^2$ across all seeds and $λ$ values on our geographically distinct held-out site.

AI.tldr: 本文探索了物理信息神经网络（PINN）在农业N₂O排放预测中的应用，基于DayCent模型构建物理残差，实验表明物理约束会牺牲分布内精度但提升分布外鲁棒性，跨站点泛化仍具挑战。
AI.motivation: N₂O是21世纪主要的臭氧消耗物质和第三大人为温室气体，超过70%来自农业过程。现有方法（DayCent、Cycles、经典AI）存在局限，PINN在该领域的应用几乎空白，亟需探索。
AI.method: 基于DayCent过程模型的机理方程构建可追溯的物理残差，设计MLP架构的PINN模型，在美国四个农业站点数据集上训练，调整物理损失权重超参数λ进行对比实验。
AI.result: PINN在所有λ下均显著优于未校准的Cycles模拟（R²=0.01），MLP基线平均R²=0.411。物理约束在留出验证中降低性能（低λ轻微下降，高λ严重下降），但在留一站点验证中提升性能并降低波动性。
AI.conclusion: 物理约束以分布内精度换取分布外鲁棒性，使模型在不熟悉土壤条件下保持生物地球化学合理性，但跨站点泛化仍然困难，所有种子和λ值在留出站点上R²为负。

title: H$_1$-ISS Analysis and Boundary Control Design for Coupled Linear ODEs and Hyperbolic PDEs
summary: This paper considers the general problem of the design of boundary controllers for distributed parameter systems. The control objectives are the asymptotic stability of the closed-loop system, as well as the disturbance attenuation of exogenous disturbances affecting the measurements and boundary conditions. More specifically, this work studies input-to-state stability (ISS) and stabilization for systems governed by coupled linear ordinary differential equations (ODEs) and homogeneous linear hyperbolic partial differential equations (PDEs), where actuation, sensing, and disturbance inputs are located at the system boundaries. First, we extend a previously established Lyapunov-based ISS condition for a similar class of systems to the H$_1$ setting under mild assumptions on the disturbance inputs. This extension not only ensures that the H$_1$-norm of the system states driven by non-vanishing disturbances and compatible initial conditions are bounded, but also provides an upper bound on the system H$_1$-norm. Subsequently, these theoretical results are applied to derive stability analysis and control design conditions expressed in terms of linear matrix inequalities. Numerical examples are provided to illustrate the effectiveness and potential of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了由线性常微分方程(ODE)和齐次线性双曲偏微分方程(PDE)耦合系统的边界控制器设计问题，将Lyapunov-based ISS条件扩展到H1设置，并推导了以线性矩阵不等式(LMI)形式表达的稳定性分析与控制设计条件，通过数值算例验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 解决分布式参数系统中边界控制器的设计问题，实现闭环系统的渐近稳定性和对外部扰动的衰减（输入-状态稳定性，ISS），特别是针对ODE与双曲PDE耦合的边界控制系统。
AI.method: 1) 将已有的Lyapunov-based ISS条件扩展到H1范数框架下；2) 对非消失扰动和相容初始条件下的系统状态H1范数给出上界；3) 将理论结果转化为线性矩阵不等式(LMI)形式的控制设计条件。
AI.result: 成功建立了H1设置下的ISS条件，确保系统状态H1范数有界，并推导了LMI形式的稳定性分析与控制器设计条件。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法能够有效实现ODE-双曲PDE耦合系统的边界控制器设计，同时保证闭环系统稳定性和扰动抑制能力。

title: Tokengeist: Multi-Turn Attribution Tracing in Agentic Conversations
summary: When a language model produces a response in a multi-turn conversation, which tokens from prior turns shaped that answer, and how did those dependencies propagate across prior turns? Existing context attribution methods process the full context in a single pass, recovering surface-level dependencies but missing the layered, non-linear structure of real-world dialogues and multi-step reasoning tasks. We introduce multi-turn context attribution (MTCA): given a target span in a model response, the task of tracing attribution backward across turns to identify not only which prior turns were directly relevant, but also how those turns themselves depended on earlier context. We propose Tokengeist, an attribution-method-agnostic and scalable framework that recovers full dependency paths by casting attribution as a recursive traversal of a directed acyclic graph (DAG) over conversation turns. We will release MTCABench, a benchmark of 3,845 target spans across 665 multi-turn conversations, annotated with gold provenance graphs reaching depths of up to 14, across four dependency types. Across four open-weight models, flat attribution methods fail to recover multi-hop dependencies, achieving under 20% source recall, while Tokengeist reaches 90%. Our results reveal systematic failure modes of single-pass attribution -- which we term provenance collapse -- and motivate attribution methods that reason recursively across turns.

AI.tldr: 提出多轮对话上下文归因任务(MTCA)和Tokengeist框架，通过递归遍历有向无环图追踪跨轮次依赖路径。单轮归因方法源召回率<20%，Tokengeist达90%。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文归因方法仅能恢复表层依赖关系，无法捕捉多轮对话和复杂推理任务中分层、非线性的依赖结构。
AI.method: 提出MTCA任务范式，及Tokengeist框架：将归因转化为在对话轮次有向无环图上的递归遍历，实现跨轮次依赖路径的完整恢复。
AI.result: 在4个开源模型上，单轮归因方法源召回率低于20%，Tokengeist达到90%。构建MTCABench基准（665个多轮对话、3845个目标span）。
AI.conclusion: 揭示单轮归因的系统性失败模式（"来源坍塌"），证明需要跨轮次递归推理的归因方法。

title: An empirical investigation into the properties of standard word embeddings
comment: African Institute for Mathematical Sciences (AIMS) - South Africa, University of the Western Cape
summary:
The embedding of word sequences into continuous vector spaces has been one of the most important developments in Natural Language Processing in the recent past. Such embeddings have found application in areas such as Automatic Speech Recognition, Machine Translation, Sentiment Analysis and many more. This essay reviews the various mechanisms that have been proposed for the calculation of word embeddings, investigates popular toolkits and embedding matrices that are available in the public domain, and experiments with one or more selected implementations to better understand their characteristics.
  La représentation vectorielle continue de mots a été l'un des développements les plus importants dans le domaine du traitement automatique du langage naturel au cours des dernières années. Ces représentations ont trouvé application dans des domaines tels que la reconnaissance vocale, la traduction automatique, l'analyse des sentiments, etc. Ce travail passe en revue les différents mécanismes proposés pour le calcul de ces vecteurs de mots, étudie les kits d'outils populaires et les matrices disponibles publiquement en ligne, et expérimente avec une ou plusieurs implémentations sélectionnées pour mieux comprendre leurs caractéristiques.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了词嵌入的各种计算方法，调研了公开的工具包和嵌入矩阵，并通过实验分析了选定的实现方案的特征。
AI.motivation: 词序列的连续向量嵌入是NLP领域近年最重要的进展之一，已在语音识别、机器翻译、情感分析等多个任务中广泛应用，因此有必要对现有方法进行系统回顾和比较。
AI.method: 本文采用综述与实验相结合的方法：首先回顾了各种词嵌入计算机制，然后调研了公开可用的工具包和嵌入矩阵，最后选择了若干实现进行实验以探究其特性。
AI.result: 通过实验更好地理解了所选词嵌入实现的特征和性能表现，并对现有词嵌入工具和资源进行了系统性梳理。
AI.conclusion: 词嵌入技术对NLP领域影响深远，不同计算方法各有优劣，选择合适的工具和实现需结合具体应用场景。

title: Feedback stopping rules in path-dependent controller-stopper games
summary:
We investigate finite-horizon, zero-sum controller-stopper games in which the stopper observes the state process and implements a feedback stopping rule. Building on a nonlinear Snell envelope representation for a related game established in a companion paper, we prove that our game admits a value by extending the associated first-contact principle. Our approach is purely probabilistic and yields an optimal feedback stopping rule for path-dependent systems while allowing for degeneracy in the underlying stochastic differential equation (SDE).
  As an application, we consider nonzero-sum controller-stopper games and show that the optimal feedback stopping rule for a zero-sum game appears as a component of a $\varepsilon$-Nash equilibrium for every $\varepsilon>0$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了有限时域、零和的控制器-停时者博弈，证明了该博弈存在值函数，并给出了路径依赖系统下的最优反馈停时规则。
AI.motivation: 解决有限时域下零和控制器-停时者博弈的值函数存在性问题，并建立纯概率方法以处理路径依赖及退化SDE的情况。
AI.method: 基于非线性Snell包络表示和首次接触原则的推广，采用纯概率方法进行推导。
AI.result: 证明了该博弈存在值函数，并得到了路径依赖系统下的最优反馈停时规则，且该规则可作为非零和博弈的ε-纳什均衡组成部分。
AI.conclusion: 零和博弈的最优反馈停时规则可用于构造非零和博弈的近似纳什均衡，具有广泛的应用前景。

title: Decentralized Granular Access Control for Agentic AI Systems in Critical Infrastructure
summary: The deployment of autonomous AI agents in production infrastructure introduces fundamental security challenges that traditional role-based access control (RBAC) models cannot address. Unlike deterministic automation, AI agents exhibit stochastic behavior, making conventional trust models insufficient for governing their access to critical systems. This paper presents a decentralized, multi-layered access control architecture designed specifically for agentic AI systems operating in critical cloud infrastructure. Our framework introduces four key innovations: (1) a compound identity model that binds agent actions to delegated human authority, (2) a hierarchical permission system spanning five granularity levels from global platform access to per-parameter constraints, (3) a decentralized policy ownership model where tool teams independently govern their authorization boundaries, and (4) progressive trust escalation with safety interlocks that prevent autonomous agents from executing high-risk operations. We ground our design in the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (2025) threat taxonomy and demonstrate how each architectural decision mitigates specific attack vectors. Deployed in production at a major cloud provider managing network infrastructure across hundreds of datacenters, the system enforces granular access control for 20+ specialized AI agents and 60+ deterministic playbooks processing thousands of operations daily while maintaining zero unauthorized write operations over eight months of production deployment. We present empirical data on access pattern distributions, denial rates, and the effectiveness of layered authorization in preventing privilege escalation by non-deterministic actors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向自治AI代理的分布式多层访问控制架构，包含复合身份模型、五级权限体系、去中心化策略所有权和渐进信任升级四大创新。在实际云生产环境中部署8个月，管理20+AI代理和60+确定性playbook，实现了零未授权写操作。
AI.motivation: 传统基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）无法应对AI代理的随机行为特性，现有信任模型不足以管控AI代理对关键系统的访问，亟需专门针对代理型AI系统的新型访问控制架构。
AI.method: 提出四层创新设计：(1) 复合身份模型，将代理行为绑定到人类授权；(2) 五级权限体系（全局平台级到单参数级）；(3) 去中心化策略所有权，工具团队自主管理授权边界；(4) 渐进信任升级与安全互锁机制。设计基于OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications (2025)威胁分类学。
AI.result: 在大型云提供商的生产环境中部署8个月，管理20+专用AI代理和60+确定性playbook，每日处理数千次操作，实现了零未授权写操作。提供了访问模式分布、拒绝率和分层授权防御特权升级的有效性等实证数据。
AI.conclusion: 提出的分布式多层访问控制架构能有效解决AI代理在关键基础设施中的安全挑战，通过层次化授权和渐进信任机制可防止非确定性实体的特权升级，保障生产环境的安全运行。

title: Label-free Industrial Fault Detection via Adversarial Inverse Reinforcement Learning: A System for Run-to-Failure Prognostics
summary: Machinery fault detection (MFD) remains heavily reliant on supervised learning, which struggles with the scarcity of fault labels in real-world settings. While reinforcement learning (RL) offers a framework to model the sequential nature of degradation, current ``RL-based'' MFD methods reduce the problem to a static contextual bandit (CB) formulation: by ignoring state transitions and discarding the temporal discount factor, they collapse to standard supervised classification. We propose an adversarial inverse reinforcement learning (AIRL) framework that treats MFD as an offline IRL problem. Unlike reconstruction-based approaches that rely on static error margins, or CBs that ignore dynamics, our method recovers an intrinsic "health" reward directly from observational state transitions, requiring neither manual reward engineering nor fault labels. On three run-to-failure benchmarks (HUMS2023, IMS, XJTU-SY), AIRL is the only method achieving non-saturated post-detection consistency across all datasets, while CB baselines fail to detect gradual degradation and reconstruction models collapse into always-anomalous states. Code and data: https://github.com/dhirajneupane/AIRL-MFD-DN.

AI.tldr: 本文提出对抗逆强化学习（AIRL）框架，将机械故障检测视为离线逆强化学习问题，无需故障标签即可从状态转移中恢复内在健康奖励，在三个基准数据集上优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 现有MFD方法依赖监督学习，面临故障标签稀缺问题；而所谓的强化学习方法实际上退化为静态上下文赌博机，忽略了状态转移与时序折扣因子，本质上仍是分类任务。
AI.method: 将MFD建模为离线逆强化学习问题，通过对抗逆强化学习框架直接从观测状态转移中恢复内在的"健康"奖励函数，无需手工设计奖励或故障标签。
AI.result: 在HUMS2023、IMS、XJTU-SY三个全生命周期基准测试中，AIRL是唯一在所有数据集上实现非饱和检测后一致性的方法，而CB基线无法检测渐进退化，重建模型陷入全异常状态。
AI.conclusion: AIRL框架有效解决了MFD中的标签稀缺和动态建模问题，为无需标签的机械故障检测提供了新范式。

title: Formally Verified Synthesizable Floating-Point Data Types in ARCH HDL
summary: We report the design and end-to-end verification of first-class IEEE-754 binary32 (FP32) and bfloat16 (BF16) arithmetic for ARCH, a hardware description language intended to be generated by language models. Every operator - comparisons, conversions, add, sub, mul, and fused multiply-add (FMA) - is described once against a single bit-vector IR and rendered three ways from one source: synthesizable SystemVerilog, an SMT-LIB model, and a Lean 4 proof model. The three artifacts cannot drift apart structurally, and the residual per-node printer correspondence is machine-checked: a Yosys-to-SMT miter proves the emitted SystemVerilog equivalent to the SMT model for all 24 operators. Verification splits at the solver-tractability frontier: multiplier-free operators (comparisons, add/sub over all 2^64 inputs, conversions, and all binary BF16 arithmetic) are proved exhaustively equivalent to the SMT-LIB FloatingPoint theory; the SAT-hard multiplier-bearing operators (FP32 mul and FMA) are proved correctly rounded in Lean, sorry-free, against a value-level round-to-nearest-even specification over exact dyadic values. Physical characterization exposed the FMA as the timing outlier: its exact-wide 470-bit datapath does not pipeline in our flow. We reimplemented it as a bounded 98-bit guard/round/sticky datapath that pipelines to 268 MHz on Nangate45, and proved, in Lean and over all 2^96 inputs, that it is bit-identical to the exact-wide reference, so it inherits the reference's proven correct rounding. The equivalence is tractable precisely because the shared multiplier appears on both sides and cancels: neither a SAT solver nor the proof ever solves a multiplier equivalence. (The BF16 FMA is deliberately an FP32-accumulating fusion, characterized as exactly that.) All machine-checked claims are pinned to a tagged open-source release.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了ARCH硬件描述语言中IEEE-754 FP32和BF16算术运算的设计与端到端形式化验证。所有算子的单一源描述可同时生成可综合SystemVerilog、SMT-LIB模型和Lean 4证明模型，三者结构不可分离。通过Yosys-to-SMT等价性检查、穷举验证（无乘法器算子）和Lean证明（含乘法器算子）实现完整验证。FMA算子通过98-bit guard/round/sticky流水线实现，并在Lean中证明与精确宽参考等价。
AI.motivation: 为LLM生成的硬件描述语言ARCH提供可信任的浮点算术原语，确保从单一描述自动生成的多种工件（综合实现、SMT模型、形式化证明）之间不会产生语义漂移，实现端到端的机器可检查的正确性保证。
AI.method: 单一bit-vector IR描述24个算子，通过三种后端渲染为SystemVerilog、SMT-LIB和Lean模型；使用Yosys-to-SMT miter检查SystemVerilog与SMT等价性；无乘法器算子穷举验证2^64输入空间；FP32乘法/FMA在Lean中通过精确dyadic值的round-to-nearest-even规范证明；FMA通过98-bit GRS流水线设计并证明与470-bit精确参考位级等价。
AI.result: 所有无乘法器算子（比较、加/减、转换、BF16算术）完成2^64输入穷举验证；FP32乘法与FMA在Lean中无sorry证明正确舍入；FMA流水线实现达268MHz，且2^96输入下证明与精确参考位相同。所有机器检查断言已绑定至开源发布版本。
AI.conclusion: 成功实现LLM生成硬件描述语言的端到端形式化验证框架，证明了在单一源描述下综合实现、SMT模型与形式化证明三者的一致性是可机械检查的，并在复杂算子（FMA）上通过巧妙的等价性证明规避了SAT求解器难以处理的乘法器等价问题。

title: Curvature Recycling Douglas-Rachford Splitting: Transported Quasi-Newton Models for Expensive Smooth Proximal Subproblems
summary:
We consider \[
  \min_x f(x)+g(x), \] where $f$ is smooth but its value and gradient are expensive, while $g$ is nonsmooth and has a cheap proximal map. Douglas--Rachford splitting (DRS) then requires a sequence of smooth proximal solves. These solves have different centers but share the same nonlinear curvature.
  We introduce curvature-recycling DRS (CR-DRS). The method transports an old exact residual to the new proximal center, reuses a quasi-Newton model, and moves the old proximal state before the first new gradient is evaluated. We give paired direct and inverse BFGS and safeguarded symmetric-rank-one realizations. A certified variant accepts a transported quasi-Newton step only when it passes descent and residual tests; otherwise it uses a fixed number of safe gradient steps. Under strong convexity and smoothness, a small-gain condition gives global linear convergence with a constant number of new gradients per outer iteration. A transported Dennis--Moré condition gives local superlinear reduction of the new proximal error. We show that this condition is not automatic, derive full-model and active-subspace sufficient conditions, and relate the active subspace to the local DRS dynamics induced by the nonsmooth proximal map.
  Experiments on $\ell_1$- and total-variation-regularized problems show large reductions in expensive-gradient calls relative to restarted and curvature-only quasi-Newton proximal solves. For directly proximal $\ell_1$ models, we also compare with FISTA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出曲率回收Douglas-Rachford分裂（CR-DRS）方法，通过复用旧精确残差、拟牛顿模型和传输近端状态，在保持全局线性收敛的同时大幅减少昂贵梯度调用次数，并在ℓ1和全变分正则化问题上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 在求解光滑+非光滑组合优化问题时，Douglas-Rachford分裂需要多次求解光滑近端子问题，每次求解需计算昂贵梯度。现有方法未充分利用子问题之间共享的非线性曲率信息，导致梯度计算效率低下。
AI.method: 提出CR-DRS框架：(1) 将旧精确残差传输到新近端中心；(2) 复用拟牛顿模型（直接/逆BFGS及安全对称秩一更新）；(3) 在新梯度评估前移动旧近端状态。包含认证变体：通过下降检验和残差检验确保传输步质量，失败时执行固定步数安全梯度步。
AI.result: 在强凸性和光滑性假设下，通过小增益条件证明全局线性收敛（每外迭代使用常数个新梯度）。导出的Dennis-Moré条件给出局部超线性收敛率。实验表明，相较于重启拟牛顿和仅曲率拟牛顿方法，CR-DRS在ℓ1和全变分正则化问题上大幅减少昂贵梯度调用；与FISTA对比也具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: CR-DRS有效利用DRS子问题间的共享曲率信息，实现了理论保证下的高效求解。该框架为减少昂贵梯度计算提供了新范式，尤其适用于Fisher-Bures正则化等实际问题。

title: DynaResize: Runtime GPU Reallocation for Disaggregated LLM Post-Training
summary: RL-based LLM post-training increasingly disaggregates Rollout and Training across separate GPU resources, but static GPU partitioning suffers from severe pipeline bubbles under long-tail rollout latency. We present DynaResize, a runtime GPU reallocation system that dynamically switches GPUs between Rollout and Training to balance stage execution times without changing RL semantics. DynaResize decomposes resizing into fine-grained operations and removes non-startup-critical work from the critical path through communicator reuse, bounded state staging, and hysteresis-based resizing. Experimental results show that DynaResize can improve end-to-end throughput by 66.5% and reduce total execution time by 33% over the optimal static configuration, while hiding 27% of role-switching overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出DynaResize系统，通过在RL训练中动态重新分配GPU资源，解决静态分区导致的流水线气泡问题，实验显示吞吐量提升66.5%，执行时间减少33%。
AI.motivation: 基于RL的LLM后训练中，Rollout和Training使用分离的GPU资源，但静态GPU分区在长尾延迟下会产生严重的流水线气泡，导致资源利用率低下。
AI.method: DynaResize将GPU重新分配分解为细粒度操作，通过通信器复用、有界状态暂存和滞后重分配技术，将非启动关键工作移出关键路径，在不改变RL语义的前提下动态平衡各阶段执行时间。
AI.result: 相比最优静态配置，端到端吞吐量提升66.5%，总执行时间减少33%，角色切换开销隐藏27%。
AI.conclusion: 动态GPU重分配可以有效解决静态分区带来的流水线气泡问题，显著提升RL-based LLM后训练的效率。

title: Recycling computational processes of dynamic programming for combinatorial optimization problems: a reservoir computing approach
summary: Reusing previously computed results is a long-standing principle for reducing computational cost, but such reuse has largely been confined to a single problem's computation. Sharing computational processes across multiple simultaneously solved problems remains possible in principle, yet designing algorithms that exploit nontrivial cross-task relationships is difficult to do manually. Here, we use machine learning to discover such algorithms automatically. Specifically, based on reservoir computing, we propose a method that uses computation results recorded by dynamic programming for combinatorial optimization problems as features for linear regression, leveraging them to assist other combinatorial optimization computations. We validate the approach on the traveling salesman and subset sum problems. Multiplexing the dynamic programming process improves approximation accuracy over generic features and reduces computation time compared with independent solutions. These results suggest a new form of computation, distinct from conventional computational design, in which multiple processes efficiently share and recycle intermediate results and states.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于机器学习的方法，利用动态规划的计算结果作为特征，通过线性回归辅助解决多个组合优化问题，实现跨任务的计算资源共享与复用。
AI.motivation: 传统计算复用局限于单一问题内部，跨任务的计算资源共享在理论上可行但难以手动设计算法。本文旨在利用机器学习自动发现跨任务关联，实现计算过程的高效共享。
AI.method: 基于水库计算（reservoir computing），将动态规划过程中记录的计算结果作为线性回归的特征，利用这些特征辅助其他组合优化问题的求解，在旅行商问题和子集和问题上进行验证。
AI.result: 复用动态规划过程相比使用通用特征提高了近似精度，并且相比独立求解减少了计算时间。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种新的计算范式，多个计算过程可以高效共享和回收中间结果与状态，区别于传统的计算设计方式。

title: Zing: Social Mind for LLMs
summary: As large language models move from isolated task solving toward long-term service in human environments, they require social intelligence: the ability to infer mental states, track social relations, reason over norms, and adapt behavior under context. This report presents Zhijing, an integrated framework for measuring, internalizing, and grounding social intelligence. For measurement, we introduce SoMBench, a psychology-grounded benchmark spanning 3 primary dimensions, 17 secondary dimensions, and 71 task paradigms. It controls question format, narrative perspective, and context length across 284 shared scenarios and 3,481 expert-verified instances. Evaluation of 20 representative LLMs reveals substantial headroom: the best model achieves only 72.08% overall accuracy, and none of the 17 secondary dimensions reaches the 90% near-ceiling band. For internalization, we develop Zing, a diagnosis-driven training recipe combining supervised fine-tuning, on-policy distillation, and rubric-based reinforcement learning. Across five social-cognition benchmarks, Zing consistently outperforms its base models, with Zing-27B-Stage2 achieving the best average score and Zing-32B-Stage2 remaining competitive with DeepSeek-V4-Pro. For deployment-time grounding, we build Actio, a harness-controlled inference architecture that routes four typed supports into reasoning: PRISM for procedural guidance, Starling for runtime mental-state representation, SAGE for reusable experience, and gated RAG for external social and normative knowledge. Across five base models and three benchmarks, the full harness improves 14 of 15 model-benchmark pairs and is best or tied for best in 8, demonstrating the effectiveness of typed runtime support. Together, these results show that socially intelligent LLMs require coordinated advances in evaluation, parametric internalization, and deployment-time grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Zhijing框架，通过SoMBench基准测量、Zing训练方法内化、Actio推理架构接地三个维度，系统提升大语言模型的社交智能。最佳模型在SoMBench上仅达72.08%准确率，Zing-27B-Stage2在多个基准上表现最优，Actio架构在15个模型-基准对中改进了14个。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型需要从孤立任务求解转向长期人类服务环境，因此必须具备社交智能（推断心理状态、追踪社会关系、规范推理、上下文行为适应）。现有研究缺乏一个整合的评估、内化和部署接地框架。
AI.method: 提出三组件框架：1) SoMBench：心理学接地基准（3主维度、17次维度、71任务范式，284场景，3481实例）；2) Zing：诊断驱动的训练方法（SFT+on-policy蒸馏+基于rubric的强化学习）；3) Actio：推理架构（PRISM程序指导、Starling运行时心理状态、SAGE经验、gated RAG外部知识）。
AI.result: SoMBench上最佳模型仅72.08%准确率，无次维度达90%；Zing-27B-Stage2最佳平均分，Zing-32B-Stage2与DeepSeek-V4-Pro持平；Actio在15对中改进14对，8对最佳/并列最佳。
AI.conclusion: 社交智能LLM需要在评估、参数内化和部署接地三方面协同进步。

title: Nesterov acceleration in optimizing over probability measures
summary:
Optimization over probability measures has become an increasingly important paradigm in modern machine learning, scientific computing, and uncertainty quantification. Motivated by Nesterov's accelerated gradient method in Euclidean space, we develop Heavy-ball and Nesterov acceleration methods over the probability measure space $\mathcal{P}_2$ and establish non-asymptotic convergence guarantees that match their Euclidean counterparts. In particular, we derive convergence rates with respect to both the number of iterations and the number of particles used to represent the underlying probability distributions.
  Extending accelerated optimization from Euclidean space to probability measures is challenging. The natural notion of momentum requires concepts such as tangent bundles of the set of probability space and they are hard to operate numerically. To overcome these difficulties, we introduce two complementary lifting procedures. The first lifts probability measures to phase space through a Hamiltonian formulation, introducing momentum variables into the dynamics. The second lifts probability measures to a common Hilbert space, restoring the linear structure required for convergence analysis while simultaneously yielding executable particle dynamics. Together, these two complementary lifting procedures provide a systematic methodology for designing, analyzing, and implementing momentum-based accelerated optimization methods over probability measure spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出概率测度空间上的Heavy-ball和Nesterov加速方法，通过两种互补的提升策略（相空间提升和Hilbert空间提升），实现了与欧几里得空间匹配的非渐近收敛保证。
AI.motivation: 概率测度上的优化在机器学习、科学计算等领域日益重要，但缺乏类似Nesterov加速的动量方法；欧几里得空间中的动量概念（如切丛）在概率测度空间上难以数值实现。
AI.method: 提出两种互补的提升策略：1) 相空间提升：通过哈密顿形式引入动量变量；2) Hilbert空间提升：将概率测度提升到公共Hilbert空间以恢复线性结构，从而设计可执行的粒子动力学算法。
AI.result: 推导了与欧几里得空间匹配的迭代次数和粒子数收敛率，建立了非渐近收敛保证。
AI.conclusion: 两种提升策略为概率测度空间上的加速优化方法的设计、分析和实现提供了系统方法论。

title: Opti-Q: A Constraint-Based Optimization Framework for Multi-LLM Question Planning
summary: While large language models (LLMs) enable strong question answering (QA), budgeted deployment is complicated by nondeterminism and heterogeneous resource profiles (cost, latency, and energy). We present OPTI-Q, a database-inspired, cost-based optimizer that implements a plan-before-execute paradigm for multi-LLM orchestration. OPTI-Q models LLM invocations as physical operators in an execution DAG and, for each question, searches for plans that optimize answer quality (QoA) while trading off financial cost, latency, and energy under user-specified resource constraints. Plans can include sequential operators that pass intermediate answers as context and parallel/blend operators that run models concurrently and merge their outputs. To search this space without executing each candidate plan, OPTI-Q uses PERFDB, a statistics catalog populated and refreshed from benchmarks and execution traces, to estimate the QoA and resource costs of both individual operators and composed subplans. Using these estimates, OPTI-Q performs Pareto-frontier search and selects a final plan based on user preferences. On MMLU-Pro and SimpleQA under user-specified budgets, OPTI-Q improves average QoA by ~58% and ~41% over baselines at comparable cost, demonstrating that database-style planning yields better quality-resource trade-offs for multi-LLM QA.

AI.tldr: OPTI-Q 是一个受数据库启发的成本优化器，通过"先规划后执行"的范式，在多个大语言模型间进行编排，根据用户指定的资源约束（成本、延迟、能耗）优化问答质量。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽然能实现强大的问答能力，但其预算化部署受到非确定性和异构资源需求（成本、延迟、能耗）的困扰。
AI.method: 将LLM调用建模为执行DAG中的物理算子，利用PERFDB统计目录估算算子和子计划的质量与资源成本，进行帕累托前沿搜索，根据用户偏好选择最终执行计划。
AI.result: 在MMLU-Pro和SimpleQA上，在用户指定预算下，OPTI-Q相比基线在相当成本下分别提升约58%和41%的平均问答质量。
AI.conclusion: 数据库风格的规划能够为多LLM问答场景实现更好的质量-资源权衡。

title: Mini-batch Noise Lowers Sharpness via Dominant-Subspace Fluctuations
summary: During SGD training, the gradients often align strongly with the dominant subspace spanned by the top-$k$ eigenvectors of the Hessian of the loss. While this seems to naturally imply that loss reduction mainly occurs within this space, prior work has shown that updates within this dominant subspace make no meaningful progress in reducing the loss. In this work, we argue that the dominant subspace is better understood not as the main space for loss reduction, but as a key subspace for explaining the sharpness dynamics of mini-batch SGD. To explain the role of the dominant subspace in reducing top-$k$ sharpness, we show how the averaged gradient over fluctuations in the dominant directions produces a sharpness correction term, and derive a sharpness correction term induced by mini-batch noise in the dominant directions. Experimental results show that adding the derived correction term to GD brings the sharpness evolution of GD closer to that of SGD.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视了SGD训练中梯度与Hessian矩阵主导特征子空间对齐的现象，提出该子空间主要解释SGD的锐度动力学（sharpness dynamics），而非损失降低的主要空间，并通过推导锐度修正项来验证这一观点。
AI.motivation: 先前研究观察到SGD梯度与Hessian主导子空间强对齐，但令人困惑的是该子空间内的更新对损失降低贡献甚微。本文旨在解决这一矛盾，重新解释主导子空间的真正作用。
AI.method: 1) 理论推导：证明主导子空间中的梯度波动平均产生锐度修正项；2) 分析mini-batch噪声在主导方向上诱导的锐度修正项；3) 实验验证：将推导的修正项加入GD，使GD的锐度演化更接近SGD。
AI.result: 加入推导的锐度修正项后，GD的锐度演化与SGD更加一致，证实了主导子空间在锐度动力学中的关键作用。
AI.conclusion: Hessian主导子空间的主要作用是解释SGD的锐度动力学（特别是top-k锐度降低），而非直接负责损失降低。这种重新理解有助于揭示SGD的泛化优势机制。

title: How Context Attribution Handles What the Model Already Knows
summary: Context attribution methods for large language models (LLMs) identify which input context contributes to the model response. Recent works show the initial success in attributing the con- tributive score of the contexts. However, we observe that when the context overlaps with the training data, these methods can- not disentangle in-context from in-weight (IW) contributions, producing unreliable scores. Based on this observation, in this work, we introduce: 1) an evaluation protocol that relies on four new metrics (base-model context attribution score (BCS), cross-model context attribution consistency (CAC), attribution preservation score (APS), source separation pre- cision (SSP)) and 2) a benchmark dataset (WMDP-Cyber++) with ground-truth provenance labels to systematically assess attribution under IW overlap. In our experiments across four well-known context attribution methods, we demonstrate that they provide unfaithful attribution when the knowledge from the context also exists in the weights. Finally, we adapt these methods for source separation (IW vs. in-context learning (ICL)) and show that they cannot do the disentanglement based on the contributive score

AI.tldr: 本文发现现有LLM上下文归因方法在上下文与训练数据重叠时无法区分上下文贡献与权重贡献，提出了包含四个新指标和基准数据集WMDP-Cyber++的评估协议，实验表明现有方法在此场景下归因不可靠，且无法基于贡献分数实现源分离。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文归因方法在上下文与训练数据（权重）存在知识重叠时，无法区分上下文贡献（ICL）和权重贡献（IW），导致归因分数不可靠，而这一问题尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 提出了一个评估协议，包含四个新指标：BCS（基础模型上下文归因分数）、CAC（跨模型上下文归因一致性）、APS（归因保持分数）、SSP（源分离精度），并构建了带有真实来源标签的基准数据集WMDP-Cyber++，以此系统评估在IW重叠下的归因方法性能。
AI.result: 对四种主流上下文归因方法的实验表明，当上下文知识也存在于模型权重中时，这些方法提供的归因分数不可靠；进一步将这些方法适配用于源分离（IW vs ICL）后，发现它们无法基于贡献分数实现有效的解耦。
AI.conclusion: 现有上下文归因方法在知识重叠场景下存在根本性局限，无法区分上下文和权重的贡献，需要新的方法设计来解决这一源分离问题。

title: Output Regulation for Linear Parabolic Systems Using Finite-Dimensional Tracking-Error-Based Control
summary: This paper addresses the output regulation problem for 1-D diffusion-reaction system, where both the disturbance and reference signals are generated by an unstable exosystem. We propose a constructive approach to the design of a finite-dimensional tracking error-based regulator for this class of possibly unstable systems. Based on the regulator equations, a combined plant is derived, converting the output regulation problem into a partial stabilization problem for the combined system. Using the modal decomposition method, the observability of the truncated modes is characterized under appropriate transmission zeros and observability conditions. For the controller design, unlike in the standard stabilization case, where the observer gain is dependent on the unstable modes only, the observer gain here has full order due to the coupling introduced by the exosystem. We prove that the observer gain can be designed such that its norm remains uniformly bounded with respect to the dimension of the observer. LMI-based conditions are provided for determining the observer dimension, and it is shown that the LMI is feasible for a sufficiently large dimension. Finally, the output regulation problem in the presence of unknown time-varying measurement delays is analyzed. Numerical examples are provided to validate the theoretical results.

AI.tldr: 本文针对一维扩散-反应系统的输出调节问题，提出了一种基于有限维跟踪误差的控制器设计方法，通过模态分解和LMI条件，解决了不稳定外部系统产生的干扰和参考信号下的输出调节问题，并分析了未知时变测量时延的影响。
AI.motivation: 解决一维扩散-反应系统在不稳定外部系统（同时产生干扰和参考信号）下的输出调节问题，这类系统可能本身不稳定，且现有方法存在局限性。
AI.method: 基于调节方程推导组合系统，将输出调节问题转化为部分镇定问题；采用模态分解方法，在传递零点与可观性条件下刻画截断模态的可观性；设计全阶观测器增益（由于外部系统的耦合，观测器增益需为全阶而非仅针对不稳定模态）；通过LMI条件确定观测器维度并证明可行性；进一步分析了未知时变测量时延下的输出调节问题。
AI.result: 证明了观测器增益的范数可设计为关于观测器维数一致有界；给出了确定观测器维数的LMI条件，并证明对于足够大的维数LMI可行；数值实验验证了理论结果的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文为不稳定外部系统驱动的扩散-反应系统提供了一种构造性的输出调节方法，观测器设计具有全阶特性但增益有界，且能处理时变测量时延，拓展了该类系统的控制理论。

title: CHS-SQL: A Text-to-SQL approach based on Confidence-Guided Heuristic Search Schema Linking process
summary: Recently, there have been several works in the Text-to-SQL domain that utilize Small Language Models (SLMs) for training. These approaches achieve performance close to that of large models in generating SQL, using only the computational power of a single NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU, while also ensuring data security. Most existing methods filter out redundant tables and columns during Schema Linking to improve Text-to-SQL accuracy. However, they do not consider the precision-recall trade-off when selecting the candidate schema subset. Our research found that both the precision and recall of Schema Linking directly affect the final SQL accuracy. Therefore, we propose a novel framework for efficiently fine-tuning SLMs on Text-to-SQL tasks, CHS-SQL, that not only balances precision and recall but also improves overall performance on Text-to-SQL tasks. Its main innovation lies in the Schema Linking phase, where a heuristic search combined with model internal confidence is employed to achieve an optimal precision-recall trade-off. This elaborated mechanism maximizes the precision of relevant schema candidates for the generated SQL queries while suppressing irrelevant noise. The same strategy is further applied during SQL generation to refine candidate queries while helping the SLM to avoid trapping in a local optimum. Our method achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results on Text-to-SQL tasks via SLMs.

AI.tldr: 提出CHS-SQL框架，通过启发式搜索与模型置信度结合优化Schema Linking的精确率-召回率权衡，在仅用单张RTX 4090训练的条件下，使小语言模型在Text-to-SQL任务上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-SQL方法在Schema Linking阶段过滤冗余表和列时，未充分考虑精确率（Precision）与召回率（Recall）的权衡问题，而研究发现两者直接影响最终SQL生成准确率。
AI.method: 提出CHS-SQL框架：在Schema Linking阶段采用启发式搜索结合模型内部置信度，实现精确率-召回率的最优平衡；在SQL生成阶段应用相同策略细化候选查询，避免小模型陷入局部最优。
AI.result: 在仅使用单块NVIDIA RTX 4090 GPU训练的条件下，SLM在Text-to-SQL任务上达到了SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: CHS-SQL通过精细化的Schema Linking策略有效平衡了精确率与召回率，使小语言模型能以较低计算成本达到接近大模型的SQL生成性能，同时保障数据安全。

title: All in One: Generative Modeling as Mean-Field Game Design
summary: Mean-field games (MFGs) offer a unifying lens on continuous-time generative modeling: a cost tuple recovering twelve prominent models---Continuous Normalizing Flows, OT-Flow, Score-based Models, Schrödinger Bridges, and more---as special cases of one variational problem. Yet two dimensions of this space remain entirely unexplored: the interaction term $\mathcal{I}$ is set to zero in many existing models, and the rich family of MFG solvers has never been applied to generative modeling. We address both gaps with MFGLab an open-source PyTorch library whose primary API is the cost tuple: all twelve models are specified by four composable cost functions, and the training loop, log-Jacobian, and reverse-ODE sampler are shared automatically. We additionally propose DI-Flow, a novel cost design that uses a differentiable entropy functional to encourage mode coverage, and provide learning-based MFG solvers that substantially outperform neural training on stochastic-dynamics rows. Experiments on two 2-D benchmarks confirm that the unified API is lossless relative to hand-coded implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MFGLab库，通过均场博弈（MFG）的统一视角将12种生成模型简化为4个可组合成本函数，并引入DI-Flow新方法和学习型MFG求解器，在2D基准上验证了API无损性。
AI.motivation: 现有连续时间生成模型（如CNF、得分匹配、薛定谔桥等）虽可统一为MFG框架，但两个维度未被探索：交互项$\mathcal{I}$在多数模型中为零，且MFG求解器从未应用于生成建模。
AI.method: 开发MFGLab开源库，以成本元组（四个可组合成本函数）作为核心API，自动共享训练循环、log-Jacobian计算和反向ODE采样器；提出DI-Flow方法，使用可微熵函数鼓励模式覆盖；引入学习型MFG求解器。
AI.result: 在2D基准实验上，统一API相对于手动编码实现是无损的，且学习型MFG求解器在随机动力学行上显著优于神经训练方法。
AI.conclusion: MFG统一视角可有效整合多种生成模型，DI-Flow和MFG求解器为进一步改进生成建模提供了新方向。

title: A Frozen 12B Beats Frontier Models on Verified Work: 100% Accuracy, 0 Tokens, Bit-Exact, Forever
comment: Industry experience report. 14 pages, 8 figures. Public testbench: https://corbenic-galahad-bench.hf.space; companion repository with SHA-256 provenance manifest: https://github.com/corbenicai/galahad-bench
summary: Improving a language model today means retraining it: enormous compute, a new opaque model each cycle, non-deterministic output. We take the opposite path: the model stays frozen, and a persistent memory of verified solutions grows beside it. Once a problem family is solved and has passed an independent verification step that never consults the answer key, every new instance of that family is answered at zero generation tokens, bit-exact, deterministically. Across 180 fresh instances spanning nine problem families, four architectures from four vendors - dense and mixture-of-experts - each score 180/180 at zero generation tokens per answer: execution-bound capability decoupled from parameter scaling. A negative control attributes the capability fully to the memory: emptied, it solves nothing. The same verify-before-store contract holds for open-ended reasoning: 88/88 consistency-gated acceptances across all four models, machine-checked formal proof, and reasoning-method transfer at 77/80. Memory selection takes 1.4 microseconds; a full reuse completes in 6-23 ms at 36 mWh. Approximate similarity retrieval selects the wrong item 94.3% of the time on a 4,500-item verified store where exact addressing makes zero errors. The store also serves as working context at a scale no shipped engine matches: a 6,000,000-token movable window on a single 46 GB GPU at flat memory, where vLLM stops at 30,399 tokens and SGLang silently truncates past 32,000. On published benchmarks, frontier models remain far ahead of any 12B at raw from-scratch reasoning; on everything this system has solved and verified, the comparison inverts: a frontier API call pays a fresh generation pass on every query, forever, while verified reuse costs zero tokens and returns the identical bits every time. A public testbench with free, rate-limited access accompanies this report: https://corbenic-galahad-bench.hf.space

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种"冻结模型+持续验证记忆"的范式：模型参数固定不变，通过独立验证的解决方案记忆库实现零生成tokens、确定性的精确回答。在180个新实例上，四种不同架构的模型均获得180/180满分，验证了执行能力与参数规模解耦的理念。
AI.motivation: 当前语言模型每次改进都需要重新训练，计算消耗巨大、模型不透明、输出非确定性。作者希望打破这一范式，让模型保持不变，通过积累已验证的解决方案记忆来实现高效、确定性的推理。
AI.method: 核心方法是"验证后存储"（verify-before-store）合约：模型冻结，构建一个持续增长的持久化记忆库，存储经过独立验证（不参考答案）的解决方案。新问题通过精确寻址（而非近似相似检索）从记忆库中检索已验证的答案，实现零生成tokens的输出。
AI.result: 在9个问题族、180个新实例上，四种架构（含密集和混合专家模型）均获得180/180满分，零生成tokens。记忆清空后系统无法解决任何问题。记忆选择仅需1.4微秒，完整复用6-23ms、36mWh。精确寻址零错误，而近似检索错误率达94.3%。记忆库可作为6百万tokens的可移动上下文窗口。
AI.conclusion: 验证后存储范式将执行能力与参数规模解耦，在已解决和已验证的问题上，零tokens的确定性复用完胜每次查询都需要重新生成的前沿模型。但注意：在未经解决的基准测试上，前沿模型仍远胜12B模型。

title: Optimization of Kinetic--Stoichiometric Growth Bounds over Autocatalytic Subnetworks
summary: Autocatalytic subnetworks govern sustained production and balanced growth in chemical reaction systems and can be naturally represented as directed multihypergraphs that jointly encode stoichiometric structure and reaction kinetics. Existing optimization approaches identify such subnetworks by maximizing their structural amplification, typically measured through the Maximum Amplification Factor (MAF). However, structural amplification alone does not determine growth potential, since highly amplifying subnetworks may be kinetically inefficient. Motivated by recent kinetic--stoichiometric bounds on balanced growth under scalable dynamics, we study the problem of selecting the autocatalytic subnetwork maximizing the growth bound $(α^*-1)\|\mathbb{S}|_{\mathcal A'}\|_κ$, where $α^*$ is the MAF and $\|\mathbb{S}|_{\mathcal A'}\|_κ$ is a kinetic consumption norm. We formulate the problem as a mixed-integer bilinear optimization model combining hypergraph selection with generalized fractional amplification constraints. Exploiting the discrete structure of the kinetic norm, we develop an exact parametric algorithm in which each subproblem reduces to MAF maximization and is solved through a Dinkelbach-type generalized fractional programming method. Finite convergence and global optimality are established. Applications to the Oregonator, the formose reaction, carbon-fixation cycles, and synthetic benchmark networks show when maximizing the kinetic--stoichiometric bound differs from maximizing the MAF alone, revealing the interplay between stoichiometric amplification, reaction kinetics, and balanced growth. The proposed framework provides an exact optimization methodology for identifying reaction subnetworks with the highest theoretical growth potential.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在化学反应系统中，如何选择最大化生长界(α*-1)||S|_A'||_κ的自催化子网络，提出了一种结合混合整数双线性优化与Dinkelbach型广义分数规划方法的精确参数算法，并在多个基准网络验证了该方法与单纯最大化结构放大因子(MAF)的差异。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通过最大化结构放大因子(MAF)来识别自催化子网络，但结构放大本身不能决定生长潜力——高放大的子网络可能在动力学上低效。因此需要结合动力学-化学计量界限来寻找具有最高理论生长潜力的子网络。
AI.method: 1. 将问题建模为混合整数双线性优化模型，结合超图选择与广义分数放大约束；2. 利用动力学范数的离散结构，设计精确参数算法；3. 每个子问题简化为MAF最大化，通过Dinkelbach型广义分数规划方法求解；4. 证明了有限收敛性和全局最优性。
AI.result: 在Oregonator、formose反应、碳固定循环及合成基准网络上的应用表明，最大化动力学-化学计量界与单纯最大化MAF结果不同，揭示了化学计量放大、反应动力学与平衡生长之间的相互作用。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一种精确的优化方法，用于识别具有最高理论生长潜力的反应子网络，并强调了在自催化子网络筛选中同时考虑结构放大与动力学效率的重要性。

title: TokenMem: Faithful Knowledge Injection for Frozen LLMs
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) enhances large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge, but suffers from knowledge conflicts: when retrieved information contradicts parametric memory, the shared self-attention pathway produces unpredictable outputs. We present TokenMem, a lightweight memory system that injects knowledge into frozen LLMs through a dedicated cross-attention channel, bypassing competition with parametric memory in the residual stream. TokenMem trains only a thin gating adapter ($\sim$3-7M parameters) via a two-phase curriculum: first learning general knowledge utilization, then strengthening faithful compliance under counterfactual knowledge. In controlled experiments on five models spanning three families (Qwen3-4B/8B/14B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, OLMo-3-7B), TokenMem achieves 69-70% Knowledge Compliance (KC) on counterfactual benchmarks, compared to 20-52% for vanilla RAG, a gap of up to 49 percentage points. Ablation studies show that the two-phase curriculum is critical: removing Phase 2 collapses KC to near-zero. Mechanistic analysis reveals that the gate adapter learns a conflict-aware, layer-specific injection strategy without explicit supervision.

AI.tldr: TokenMem通过专用交叉注意力通道向冻结的LLM注入知识，避免了与参数记忆的竞争，在反事实基准上实现69-70%的知识遵从率，相比普通RAG提升高达49个百分点。
AI.motivation: 解决RAG中检索信息与LLM参数记忆冲突时，共享自注意力路径产生不可预测输出的问题。
AI.method: 提出TokenMem轻量记忆系统：通过专用交叉注意力通道注入知识；仅训练薄门控适配器（~3-7M参数）；两阶段课程学习（先学通用知识利用，再在反事实知识下强化忠实遵从）。
AI.result: 在五个模型上，反事实基准中KC达69-70%（普通RAG仅20-52%）；移除第二阶段训练后KC骤降至近乎零。
AI.conclusion: TokenMem有效消除RAG中的知识冲突问题，门控适配器可学习冲突感知的逐层注入策略，无需显式监督。

title: Multi-Agent Privacy Game in Federated Learning: A Unified Mean-Field View
summary: Federated learning enables collaborative model training across distributed clients without centralising their data, yet privacy remains a persistent concern because the shared model updates can leak information about local datasets. Existing privacy-preserving methods either inject calibrated noise into client updates, limiting their composition guarantees, or formulate client privacy choices as a multi-agent game whose Nash equilibrium becomes intractable as the number of clients grows. We bridge these two lines of work by formulating privacy-preserving federated learning as a mean-field privacy game: each client strategically chooses its own privacy budget while interacting with the population only through a single mean-field statistic. The mean-field limit yields a tractable equilibrium for arbitrarily many clients, accommodates heterogeneous client preferences, and inherits an exponentially decaying privacy guarantee through a log-Sobolev contraction. The framework recovers the entropic privacy baseline as the homogeneous special case and the multi-agent privacy game as the finite-population case. Experiments on quadratic regression, logistic regression, and MNIST demonstrate that the proposed framework attains the privacy-utility trade-off of the entropic baseline while delivering a personalized privacy guarantee that the homogeneous baseline cannot express.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将隐私保护联邦学习建模为平均场隐私博弈，每个客户端策略性选择隐私预算，通过平均场统计量实现大规模客户端下的可解均衡，同时具备指数衰减隐私保证，在多项任务上达到与熵基线相当的隐私-效用权衡并提供个性化隐私保护。
AI.motivation: 现有隐私保护方法面临两难：添加噪声的方法受限于组合保证，而多智能体博弈方法在大规模客户端下纳什均衡难以求解。本文旨在桥接两种思路，提出可扩展且可解的隐私保护联邦学习框架。
AI.method: 将隐私保护联邦学习形式化为平均场隐私博弈，每个客户端策略性选择隐私预算，仅通过单个平均场统计量与整体交互。利用平均场极限在任意多客户端下获得可解均衡，并通过log-Sobolev压缩实现指数衰减隐私保证。
AI.result: 在二次回归、逻辑回归和MNIST数据集上的实验表明，所提框架达到了与熵基线相当的隐私-效用权衡，同时提供了同质基线无法表达的个性化隐私保证。该框架将熵隐私基线作为同质特例，将多智能体隐私博弈作为有限种群特例。
AI.conclusion: 平均场隐私博弈框架有效解决了大规模联邦学习中隐私保护的扩展性问题，在保持良好隐私-效用权衡的同时支持客户端的异构隐私偏好，为联邦学习个性化隐私保护提供了新的理论工具。

title: Indic DiarBench: A Multilingual Joint Diarization and ASR Benchmark for Indian Languages
summary: In this work, we introduce Indic DiarBench, a speaker diarization and ASR benchmark dataset spanning all 22 scheduled languages of India. This corpus comprises approximately 108 hours of natural multi-speaker audio from near-field meetings, far-field recordings, and in-the-wild audios. All annotations are human-corrected with time-aligned speaker attributed transcriptions. The dataset captures conversational nuance prevalent in Indian speech, such as English code-mixing, dialectal variation, and frequent speaker overlap. To establish a baseline for joint ASR and diarization capabilities we evaluate leading systems including commercial speech APIs and multimodal large language models. Indic DiarBench is released as an open-access resource to advance inclusive, multilingual speech technology research for Indian languages.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Indic DiarBench，一个涵盖印度全部22种官方语言的说话人日记化与ASR基准数据集，包含约108小时的多说话人语音数据，并评估了领先的语音系统性能。
AI.motivation: 印度拥有22种官方语言，但缺乏覆盖全面、标注高质量的多说话人语音基准数据集，现有研究难以评估和推动印度语言的包容性语音技术发展。
AI.method: 构建了涵盖近场会议、远场录音和野外音频的多场景数据集，使用人工校正的时间对齐说话人标注转录，并评估了商业语音API和多模态大语言模型在联合ASR和说话人日记化任务上的表现。
AI.result: 建立了印度22种语言在多说话人场景下的联合ASR与说话人日记化基准，揭示了商业系统在处理英语代码混合、方言变化和高频说话人重叠等印度语音特有现象时的能力与局限。
AI.conclusion: Indic DiarBench作为开放资源发布，有望推动面向印度语言的包容性、多语言语音技术研究。

title: A Novel Optimization Model for Solving the Timetabling Problem at Finnish Universities
comment: 26 pages, a more detailed version to be submitted to JORS
summary: We study a timetabling problem faced by Finnish universities, where the challenge is to balance the preferences of three key stakeholders: the university, teachers, and students. Educational timetabling is an essential task that ensures that everything runs effortlessly and collaboratively. Its efficiency significantly impacts the smooth operation of the institution's educational programs and its financial success. As universities have evolved and competition among them has intensified, the features of the university timetabling problem have changed. This paper describes an ongoing optimization project with three Finnish universities and a leading provider of educational management systems for universities. The main goal of this cooperation is not merely to streamline the creation of timetables, but to enable an entirely new approach to manage the entire planning process. The project consists of three six-month phases: the feasibility study, the preparation phase, and the implementation. During the feasibility study, several research-related gaps and novel practical goals were identified. To address these gaps and goals, this paper presents a unique CRONOPT model for tackling three targets simultaneously: effective use of university resources, teacher workload and well-being, and smooth progression of students' studies. The optimization solution developed through the project integrates directly with the market-leading educational management system for Finnish universities.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个与芬兰三所大学及教育管理系统供应商合作的持续优化项目，提出了CRONOPT模型，旨在同时优化大学资源利用、教师工作负荷与福祉、学生学习进度三大目标，项目分可行性研究、准备和实施三个阶段进行。
AI.motivation: 芬兰大学面临日益激烈的竞争和教育需求变化，传统排课方式难以同时兼顾大学（资源效率）、教师（工作负荷与福祉）和学生（学业顺利推进）三方的利益平衡，亟需一种全新的规划管理方法。
AI.method: 采用为期三个半年阶段的合作项目框架（可行性研究、准备、实施），并提出CRONOPT优化模型，该模型能够同时处理三个目标：有效利用大学资源、教师工作负荷与福祉、学生学业顺利推进。优化方案直接集成到芬兰大学市场领先的教育管理系统中。
AI.result: 在可行性研究阶段识别出了多个研究空白和新的实践目标，并成功构建了CRONOPT模型，能够同时平衡三方利益相关者的需求。
AI.conclusion: 该项目不仅旨在简化排课流程，更致力于实现整个规划过程的全新管理方式，通过CRONOPT模型为芬兰大学排课问题提供了三方利益平衡的优化解决方案。

title: Masked Distillation: Internalizing the Chain-of-Thought in Language Models
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) produce long, explicit chains of intermediate steps before generating a final answer at inference time. These intermediate traces dominate latency, memory usage, and serving cost, even though the final answer correctness is not causally related to the trace correctness and the trace length is not a reliable indicator of the problem complexity. This raises a natural question: can the computation expressed in these intermediate tokens be internalized into the parameters of a language model, enabling it to produce answers directly (or with much shorter intermediate traces)? We introduce \textit{masked distillation}, a knowledge-distillation framework in which a student LLM is trained to predict only the solution tokens conditioned on the question, while a reasoning teacher provides feedback on the student's responses after conditioning on the question and its own CoT trace. We instantiate this framework in two settings: (i) a \textit{self-distillation} setting, in which the same model serves as the teacher in thinking mode and as the student in non-thinking mode, and (ii) a \textit{dual-model} setting, in which a larger reasoning teacher supervises a separate smaller non-thinking student over the solution tokens. By treating intermediate tokens as a scaffold which reasoning models use to fit over the solution tokens, We additionally vary the length of intermediate-token scaffolding the student is supervised on, interpolating between full internalization (the student emits only the solution) and no internalization (the student emits the full trace before the answer). We evaluate the framework through controlled experiments on two reasoning domains: GSM8K (grade-school arithmetic) and Countdown (a number-puzzle search task).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"掩码蒸馏"的知识蒸馏框架，让学生语言模型在仅预测答案时，借助推理教师的思维链反馈进行训练，从而将推理过程中的中间计算内化到模型参数中。实验在GSM8K和Countdown两个推理任务上验证了该方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型在推理时产生大量中间token，这些token主导了延迟、显存和推理成本，但最终答案的正确性与中间推理链的正确性并无因果关系，且推理链长度也不能可靠反映问题复杂度。因此，作者希望将中间计算过程内化到模型参数中，使模型能直接输出答案或显著缩短中间推理链。
AI.method: 提出掩码蒸馏框架：学生LLM仅在给定问题条件下预测答案（屏蔽中间推理token），而推理教师则在给定问题及其思维链条件下对学生响应提供反馈。框架有两个设置：（1）自蒸馏：同一模型在思考模式下作为教师，非思考模式下作为学生；（2）双模型：较大推理教师监督较小的非思考学生。此外还通过控制中间token监督长度，在全内化（仅输出答案）和未内化（输出完整推理链）之间插值。
AI.result: 在GSM8K（小学数学）和Countdown（数字拼图搜索）两个推理领域的受控实验表明，该方法可以有效将推理过程内化到模型参数中。
AI.conclusion: 通过掩码蒸馏，可以将推理模型的中间计算内化到学生模型参数中，减少甚至消除推理时的中间token输出，从而降低延迟和计算成本，同时保持答案正确性。

title: Online Policy Evaluation for MDPs with Dynamic UBSR Measures
summary: Developing efficient function-approximation methods for policy evaluation is a fundamental challenge in risk-aware reinforcement learning. Existing approaches either focus on restrictive classes of risk measures or rely on access to a simulator, limiting their applicability in fully online settings. In this work, we propose computationally efficient online learning algorithms for policy evaluation in Markov decision processes (MDPs) with dynamic utility-based shortfall risk (UBSR) measures under linear function approximation. Specifically, we introduce the UBSR-TD algorithm, establish conditions under which it converges almost surely, and develop several variants designed to accelerate convergence. Our formulation shows that existing policy evaluation algorithms for risk-neutral MDPs can be readily adapted to dynamic UBSR settings by incorporating a loss function into the temporal-difference error. Numerical experiments support our theoretical findings, and an application to a perishable inventory management problem with shelf-life uncertainty demonstrates the practical effectiveness of the proposed methods.

AI.tldr: 本文针对风险感知强化学习中的策略评估问题，提出了基于动态效用型短fall风险（UBSR）度量且支持线性函数逼近的高效在线学习算法UBSR-TD，证明了其几乎必然收敛性，并开发了多种加速变体。实验验证了方法在库存管理等实际任务中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有风险感知强化学习的策略评估方法要么局限于风险度量的限制性类别，要么依赖模拟器访问，无法在完全在线场景中有效应用。因此需要一种计算高效、适用于动态UBSR度量的在线策略评估方法。
AI.method: 提出UBSR-TD算法，通过将损失函数纳入时序差分误差中，将风险中性MDP的策略评估方法适配到动态UBSR设置下；建立算法几乎必然收敛的条件，并设计多种加速收敛的变体。
AI.result: 理论证明了UBSR-TD算法的几乎必然收敛性；数值实验支持理论发现；在带有保质期不确定性的易腐库存管理问题中验证了方法的实际有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文表明通过简单的损失函数嵌入，风险中性MDP的策略评估算法可直接迁移至动态UBSR风险场景，为在线风险敏感强化学习提供了实用且理论坚实的工具。

title: Earnings25: A Comprehensive 500-Hour Speech Benchmark for Finance
summary: We introduce Earnings25, a finance-domain benchmark for evaluating automatic speech recognition (ASR) on English-language earnings calls under realistic conditions. Earnings25 comprises two complementary test sets: (i) testset-full, 498 hours of full English-language S&P 500 earnings calls from Q4 2025, and (ii) testset-segmented, a 46-hour industry-balanced set of 290 segments sampled from English-language U.S. earnings calls in 2025. The benchmark provides aligned transcripts and structured metadata, including speaker roles, industry labels, and call structure, enabling speaker- and industry-aware evaluation beyond aggregate word error rate (WER). We report reproducible baselines for Whisper and Parakeet-TDT using standardized scoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Earnings25，一个针对财报电话会议的真实场景英语ASR评测基准，包含498小时完整电话会议和46小时分段数据，并提供对齐文本与结构化元数据，支持超越传统WER的细粒度评估。
AI.motivation: 现有ASR基准缺乏针对金融领域财报电话会议这一真实且具有挑战性场景的标准化评测，无法支持说话人、行业等细粒度分析。
AI.method: 构建两个互补测试集：testset-full（498小时完整会议）和testset-segmented（46小时290段行业均衡样本），提供对齐转录、说话人角色、行业标签及会议结构等元数据。
AI.result: 基于Whisper和Parakeet-TDT的标准化基线结果，支持说话人与行业感知的ASR性能评估。
AI.conclusion: Earnings25为财报电话会议的ASR研究提供了标准化基准，推动了从单一WER向多维细粒度评估的转变。

title: KAYROS: An Anytime and Exact Open-Source Solver for Duration-Minimization Time-Dependent Vehicle Routing. A Technical Report and a Case Study in Human-AI Engineering
comment: 30 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Technical report accompanying the KAYROS solver and Poryos2026 benchmark family
summary: KAYROS is an open-source solver for duration-minimization time-dependent vehicle routing problems, with or without time windows (TDVRPTW, TDVRP). In these variants, travel times change with departure time, and each route's dispatch time is a decision. To the best of the author's knowledge, it is the first openly available solver that is both anytime, streaming improving solutions from the first seconds, and exact, proving optimality with publicly verifiable certificates, for these problems over rich piecewise-linear travel- time functions rather than a time discretization. It has no proprietary dependency and installs with one command. It builds on the state of the art for time-dependent function composition and exact solving, extending the open-source branch-price-and-cut solver of Lera-Romero, Miranda Bront and Soulignac (2020) with an open LP backend, anytime and warm- start behavior, checker-exact pricing, and exact treatment of stepwise travel times. On the MAMUT-routing benchmark collection, KAYROS stands behind 468 published optimality certificates, each requiring agreement among four independent solves, and five certificates strictly improve published reference values. The report also introduces Poryos2026, a benchmark family designed and generated by the author from real OpenStreetMap city road networks. Its 1,080 paired CVRP, VRPTW, TDVRP and TDVRPTW instances combine real road geometries with controlled synthetic demands, time windows and congestion. Every instance carries a checker-validated best-known solution. This report presents the solver, its certification protocol, the benchmark's generation and feasibility guarantees, and their experimental connection for a broad technical audience. It is also a case study in the intensive human-AI collaboration that made this body of work feasible while keeping its claims independently verifiable.

AI.tldr: KAYROS是一个开源、任意时刻可用且精确求解时间依赖车辆路径问题（TDVRPTD/VRP）的求解器，能够处理分段线性旅行时间函数而非时间离散化。它基于MAMUT-routing基准集产生了468个最优性证明，并引入了Poryos2026基准家族。本文还展示了人-AI协作的研究范式。
AI.motivation: 现有时间依赖车辆路径问题求解器缺乏同时满足"任意时刻可用"（anytime）和"精确证明最优性"（exact）的能力，且通常依赖时间离散化或有商业依赖。作者旨在填补这一空白，提供一个开源、可验证、易于部署的求解方案。
AI.method: 在开源分支定价切割求解器基础上进行扩展，包括：开放LP后端、任意时刻与热启动行为、校验器精确定价、对阶跃旅行时间的精确处理。此外，基于真实OpenStreetMap路网生成Poryos2026基准集，并设计了验证协议（需要四次独立求解达成一致）。
AI.result: KAYROS在MAMUT-routing基准集上产生了468个最优性证明，其中5个严格改进了已发表参考值；引入了含1,080个实例的Poryos2026基准家族，每个实例都附带校验器验证的最优已知解。
AI.conclusion: KAYROS是首个同时支持任意时刻输出和精确最优性证明的时间依赖VRP开源求解器，其基准集和验证协议为领域提供了可复现、可验证的研究基础设施。本文也是密集人-AI协作完成可验证科学研究的一个案例研究。

title: VlogReward: Learning Multi-Dimensional Evaluation for Vlog Editing
summary: The rapid rise of vlogs as a personalized storytelling medium has created a demand for automated systems to evaluate and refine vlog editing plans. However, vlog assessment is highly subjective and remains challenging due to a lack of standardized criteria, dataset and benchmark, and effective reward models. To address these challenges, we define a comprehensive vlog evaluation framework guided by professional vlog creators and product managers, establishing a taxonomy of six key dimensions, i.e., Creativity, Consistency, Concept Design, Cinematography, Narration, and Pacing. Subsequently, we curate a large-scale dataset of 100k vlog edits and a dedicated benchmark, VRMBench, to evaluate the vlog rewarding capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Finally, we present VlogReward, a robust vlog reward model that can provide both fine-grained multi-dimensional scores and actionable feedback for iterative refinement. Technically, we enhance the Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) framework by introducing an adjustable inter-group comparison reward, which mitigates the "direction blindness" issue of standard GRPO and enables the model to better distinguish varied-quality edits. VlogReward achieves state-of-the-art results that significantly outperform existing MLLMs, including GPT-5 and Gemini-3-Pro. We hope that our study can help vlog creators and foster automated vlog evaluation and refinement systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个全面的Vlog评估框架，构建了包含10万条编辑数据的VRMBench基准数据集，并开发了VlogReward奖励模型。通过改进的GRPO算法（引入组间对比奖励），该模型在六维度评估上显著超越了GPT-5和Gemini-3-Pro等现有MLLM模型。
AI.motivation: Vlog作为个性化叙事媒介的迅速崛起，催生了自动化评估和优化Vlog编辑计划的需求。然而，Vlog评估高度主观，且缺乏标准化准则、数据集、基准以及有效的奖励模型。
AI.method: 1) 与专业Vlog创作者和产品经理合作，建立包含创意性、一致性、概念设计、摄影、叙事和节奏六个关键维度的评估分类体系。2) 构建10万条Vlog编辑的大规模数据集VRMBench。3) 提出VlogReward模型，通过引入可调节的组间对比奖励来改进GRPO框架，解决标准GRPO的"方向盲视"问题。
AI.result: VlogReward在六维度评估上取得了最先进的结果，显著优于现有MLLM模型，包括GPT-5和Gemini-3-Pro。
AI.conclusion: 该研究可以帮助Vlog创作者，并促进自动化Vlog评估和优化系统的发展。

title: MixQuant: Adaptive Mixed-Precision Quantization for Large Language Models
summary: Mixed-precision quantization improves the accuracy of post-training quantization by allocating higher bitwidths to sensitive layers, but existing methods solve the allocation for a single fixed memory budget. In practice the budget varies across deployments and is unknown at calibration time. Adaptive quantization addresses this with one offline calibration that serves any budget, yet current methods score layer sensitivity in a manner that does not consider its dependency on quantization levels of other layers. We show that a layer's sensitivity depends strongly on the bitwidths of its upstream layers and that this dependence shifts the resulting preferred bit allocation. We propose MixQuant, a technique-agnostic adaptive framework that wraps any base quantizer. MixQuant marginalizes each layer's distortion over random quantized upstream configurations to obtain budget-agnostic scores, calibrates the quantizer's parameters on plans the allocator itself produces, and penalizes allocations that leave layers at the lowest bitwidths. A single greedy pass then serves any budget at deployment. Across Llama-3.2-3B, Llama-2-7B, and Mistral-7B under AWQ and GPTQ, MixQuant outperforms adaptive and mixed-precision baselines in every setting, improving average accuracy by up to 8 points and reducing perplexity from 12.43 to 10.70 at the tightest budget, while matching an ILP solver at negligible deployment cost.

AI.tldr: MixQuant是一种与具体技术无关的自适应量化框架，通过边缘化各层对随机量化上游配置的失真来获得预算无关的评分，再用单次贪心遍历服务于任何部署预算，在多个模型和量化方法下显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有混合精度量化方法针对单一固定内存预算求解分配方案，而实际部署中预算会变化且在标定时未知；当前自适应量化方法评分层敏感性时未考虑其与其他层量化水平的依赖关系。
AI.method: 1) 通过边缘化各层对随机量化上游配置的失真，得到预算无关的敏感性评分；2) 在分配器自身产生的方案上校准量化器参数；3) 惩罚将层置于最低比特宽度的分配；4) 单次贪心遍历即可服务于任意的部署预算。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.2-3B、Llama-2-7B和Mistral-7B上，基于AWQ和GPTQ，MixQuant在所有设置下均优于自适应和混合精度基线。平均准确率提升最高达8个百分点，在最紧预算下困惑度从12.43降至10.70，且在部署成本可忽略的情况下匹配ILP求解器性能。
AI.conclusion: MixQuant有效解决了层敏感性受上游量化水平影响的问题，通过预算无关的自适应框架实现了灵活的部署，同时保持高性能和低部署成本。

title: Understanding Tone-Dependent Inference Cost in Large Language Models
summary: We examine how prompt tone affects both accuracy of the LLM answers and inference cost as reflected in output-token consumption. Experiments were performed to understand the trade-offs between accuracy and inference cost on a 570 Question MMLU dataset for LLM models prompted in seven different tones from sycophantic to threatening. Our results show that the output-token-length variation substantially exceeded accuracy variation across all models. Output-token consumption varied by up to 44.3% across tone conditions. We also analyzed the tradeoff between the accuracy of the answers and the average output token length in the reasoning process. For the ChatGPT models 4o and 5-nano, the rude tone is quite dominant. For the Gemini models 2.5 Flash and 2.5 Flash Lite, the rude and neutral tones are dominant on the Pareto-optimal frontier. We find that prompt tone influences not only answer quality but also the amount of billable inference resources consumed by modern LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了提示语气对LLM回答准确性和推理成本（输出token消耗）的影响。在570题MMLU数据集上，使用7种不同语气（从谄媚到威胁）对多种LLM模型进行实验。结果显示，输出token长度的变化（高达44.3%）远超准确率变化。对于ChatGPT模型，粗鲁语气占优；对于Gemini模型，粗鲁和中性语气处于帕累托最优前沿。
AI.motivation: 探究提示语气如何同时影响LLM的答案质量和推理成本（以输出token消耗衡量），寻找准确性与推理成本之间的权衡关系。
AI.method: 在570道MMLU数据集上，对多种LLM模型（ChatGPT 4o、5-nano；Gemini 2.5 Flash、2.5 Flash Lite）采用7种不同语气（从谄媚到威胁）进行提示，测量准确率和输出token长度，并进行帕累托最优分析。
AI.result: 输出token长度变化（最高44.3%）远超准确率变化；ChatGPT模型中粗鲁语气占优；Gemini模型中粗鲁和中性语气处于帕累托最优前沿。
