AI.conclusion: 去中心化的张量分发与复制策略能有效解决LLM推理中的KV缓存访问瓶颈，为长上下文LLM推理提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: ParasGB: A Graph Benchmark Suite for Parasitic Estimation on AMS Circuits
comment: Published at ICCAD2026. Full appendix version
summary: As chip manufacturing processes advance to deep submicron nodes, parasitic interconnect effects increasingly dominate the performance of analog and mixed-signal (AMS) circuits and often lead to costly layout iterations. This makes early-stage estimation of parasitic capacitance and resistance important for parasitic-aware design exploration before full physical implementation. However, progress on GNN-based parasitic modeling has been hindered by the lack of public, high-fidelity RC benchmarks that support reproducible evaluation. To address this gap, we introduce ParasGB, the first open-source benchmark suite for pre-layout parasitic parameter prediction on circuit graphs. ParasGB provides large-scale, heterogeneous RC networks extracted with commercial EDA tools from tape-out-proven designs, together with a unified evaluation protocol covering node-level ground capacitance, edge-level resistance, and edge-level coupling capacitance. Within this framework, we benchmark diverse GNN architectures using a standardized training pipeline and expose challenges such as extreme label imbalance, long-tailed parasitic distributions, and strong structural heterogeneity. By establishing a physically grounded and standardized benchmark for early-stage parasitic prediction, ParasGB provides an open platform for reproducible research on circuit graph learning and parasitic-aware model development. All datasets, preprocessing scripts, and configurations are publicly available in our code repository https://github.com/ShenShan123/ParasGB.git.

AI.tldr: ParasGB是首个开源的预布局寄生参数预测基准套件，提供由商用EDA工具从真实流片设计中提取的大规模异构RC网络，并标准化了节点地电容、边电阻和边耦合电容的评估协议，为GNN寄生建模提供可复现的研究平台。
AI.motivation: 随着芯片制造进入深亚微米节点，互连寄生效应日益主导模拟/混合信号电路性能且常导致昂贵的版图迭代，而现有GNN寄生建模研究因缺乏公开高保真RC基准而进展受限。
AI.method: 构建了首个开源基准套件ParasGB，包含从流片验证设计中提取的大规模异构RC网络，提供统一的评估协议（节点地电容、边电阻、边耦合电容），并标准化了GNN训练流程。
AI.result: 在统一框架下评测了多种GNN架构，揭示了标签极度不平衡、长尾寄生分布和强结构异构性等挑战。
AI.conclusion: ParasGB为早期寄生预测建立了物理可解释的标准化基准，为电路图学习和寄生感知模型开发提供了可复现的开源平台。

title: CAGE: Cognitive Attribution Graphs for Faithful Inline Citation Generation in Long-Form Question Answering
summary: Long-form question answering increasingly relies on retrieved evidence to make LLM outputs verifiable, with inline citations tracing claims to source documents. However, existing systems often attach citations that are topically related but insufficient to support their claims. We identify attribution ambiguity as a structural challenge: end-to-end generation must implicitly resolve combinatorial claim--document assignments, obscuring evidential boundaries and increasing the risk of evidence-boundary overrun, where claims exceed cited support. To address this challenge, we propose CAGE (Cognitive Attribution Graphs for Citation Generation), a two-stage framework that introduces an explicit cognitive attribution map before answer generation. CAGE first trains a plug-and-play Cognitive Map Induction Model to construct answer-centered support subgraphs, aligning each semantic answer unit with supporting documents through explicit relations. A Structured Citation Reasoning Model then realizes these units as sentence-level claims with map-aligned citations. Experiments on ASQA, ELI5, and ExpertQA show that CAGE achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating the effectiveness of attribution-space contraction and map-guided citation generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAGE框架，通过引入显式的认知归因图（Cognitive Attribution Map）来解耦引用生成过程，先构建答案-文档支持子图，再生成带引用的句子，有效解决了长文本问答中的归因模糊性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有长文本问答系统生成的引用常存在“主题相关但证据不足”的问题，其根本在于端到端生成隐式地处理了组合性的声明-文档分配，导致证据边界模糊（evidence-boundary overrun），即声明超出了引用所能支持的范围。
AI.method: CAGE采用两阶段框架：1）训练一个即插即用的认知图归纳模型（Cognitive Map Induction Model），构建以答案为中心的文档支持子图，将每个语义答案单元与支持文档显式对齐；2）结构化引用推理模型（Structured Citation Reasoning Model）将这些单元实现为句子级声明，并生成与归因图对齐的引用。
AI.result: 在ASQA、ELI5和ExpertQA三个数据集上，CAGE达到了最先进水平，验证了归因空间收缩（attribution-space contraction）和地图引导的引用生成的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将引用生成解耦为“归因图构建”和“结构化引用推理”两个阶段，CAGE有效解决了归因模糊性问题，为长文本问答的可验证引用生成提供了新范式。

title: A Homogeneous Tensor Framework for High-Order Trust-Region and Spherical Polynomial Optimization
summary: High-order methods can improve worst-case evaluation complexity, but for orders $p\geq3$ their Taylor subproblems are nonconvex polynomial optimization problems and are generally difficult to solve. We develop a radius-controlled boundary approach based on homogeneous tensor representations. By augmenting the step with a constant coordinate, any $p$th-order Taylor polynomial can be represented exactly as an order-$p$ homogeneous tensor form; at a prescribed radius, the boundary model is a spherical polynomial optimization problem. The representation applies to arbitrary $p$, while the algorithmic development focuses on the cubic case $p=3$. For an inhomogeneous cubic on the sphere, we introduce a quadratic shift and prove, under an explicit shift bound, equivalence with a three-block multilinear formulation at global optimality. This motivates a proximal alternating minimization (PAM) method with closed-form block updates; its objective values decrease and every accumulation point is stationary. We embed the boundary-step mechanism in an Adaptive Homogeneous Tensor Method (Ada--HTM). Under explicit smoothness, safeguarded-decrease, weak-curvature nondegeneracy, and local-refinement conditions, Ada--HTM attains the adaptive-regularization-type (AR$p$-type) evaluation complexity $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-(p+1)/p})$ for first-order stationarity. Numerically, PAM matches order-$2$ moment--sum-of-squares (SOS) certificates on the structured cubic instances for which certification is tractable, scales particularly well for low-rank tensors, and makes Ada--HTM competitive with trust-region and cubic-regularization methods, with its largest gains on ill-conditioned and badly-scaled problems.

AI.tldr: 本文针对高阶优化方法中泰勒子问题（非凸多项式优化）难以求解的挑战，提出基于齐次张量表示的半径控制边界方法。通过常数坐标增广将任意p阶泰勒多项式表示为齐次张量形式，并聚焦三次情形（p=3）发展了一种近端交替最小化（PAM）方法，将其嵌入自适应齐次张量方法（Ada-HTM）中，在特定条件下达到ARp型评价复杂度O(ε^{-(p+1)/p})。数值实验表明PAM在结构化三次实例上表现优异，尤其适用于病态和不良缩放问题。
AI.motivation: 高阶方法可改善最坏情况评估复杂度，但p≥3时泰勒子问题为非凸多项式优化问题，难以求解。现有方法在处理高阶多项式优化时缺乏高效且可扩展的求解策略。
AI.method: 1) 通过常数坐标增广将任意p阶泰勒多项式表示为齐次张量形式；2) 针对三次情形，引入二次移位并证明在显式移位界下与三块多线性形式的全局最优等价性；3) 提出具有闭式块更新的近端交替最小化（PAM）方法；4) 将边界步机制嵌入自适应齐次张量方法（Ada-HTM）。
AI.result: 在显式光滑性、保护性下降、弱曲率非退化及局部精化条件下，Ada-HTM达到ARp型评估复杂度O(ε^{-(p+1)/p})。数值上，PAM在结构化三次实例上匹配二阶矩-SOS证书，对低秩张量扩展性良好，Ada-HTM在病态和不良缩放问题上优于信赖域和三次正则化方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于齐次张量表示的边界方法有效解决了高阶泰勒子问题的求解困难，PAM方法与Ada-HTM框架在理论和数值上均展现竞争力，为高阶非凸优化提供了新的可行途径。

title: STAIF: A Stage-wise Optimization for Complex Instruction Following
summary: Following complex instructions with multiple explicit constraints remains a fundamental challenge for large language models (LLMs). Existing alignment methods, such as DPO, optimize holistic reward signals that often underemphasize strict satisfaction of individual constraints, particularly under out-of-distribution or multi-constraint settings. In this paper, we propose STAIF, a stage-wise optimization framework that decouples the alignment of subjective (soft) constraints from the optimization of objectively verifiable (hard) constraints. Stage 1 applies preference optimization with multiple negative samples to sharpen sensitivity to soft constraints, while Stage 2 applies Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to enforce strict compliance with hard constraints. To support this method, we construct STAINSTRUCT, a high-quality bilingual (English, Chinese) dataset of approximately 31,000 complex multi-constraint instructions. Extensive analyses validate the design of STAIF and show state-of-the-art performance on representative benchmarks against strong baselines, as well as genuine generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出STAIF分阶段优化框架，先通过偏好优化提升软约束敏感度，再利用RLVR强制执行硬约束，配合新数据集STAINSTRUCT，在多约束指令遵循任务上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐方法（如DPO）在优化整体奖励信号时忽视了对单个约束的严格满足，尤其在多约束或分布外场景下表现不佳。
AI.method: 将约束解耦为软约束和硬约束两阶段优化：Stage 1用多负样本偏好优化提升软约束敏感性；Stage 2用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）强制执行硬约束。同时构建了约3.1万条双语多约束指令数据集STAINSTRUCT。
AI.result: 在代表性基准上取得SOTA性能，超越强基线方法，并展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: STAIF通过分阶段解耦优化策略有效提升了大语言模型在多约束复杂指令遵循上的表现，验证了软硬约束分开优化的有效性。

title: From Score Learning to Discretized Sampling: An End-to-End Generalization Analysis of Diffusion Models
summary: Despite the empirical success of score-based diffusion models, a complete theoretical understanding of how finite-sample learning, network parameterization, and numerical discretization jointly dictate generative quality remains underdeveloped. Existing sampling analyses often evaluate the generative performance conditional on an oracle score or a pre-specified error threshold. In this work, we establish a unified convergence and generalization framework for score-based diffusion models parameterized by practical ResNet-type architectures. We analyze the generalization and convergence properties from the practical finite-sample, discrete-time learning problem of the score function to the ideal continuous-time, population-level objective. Based on the generalization result of the learning problem of score function, we analyze the sampling process induced by the learned score function and provide an end-to-end total variation distance estimate for the generated terminal distribution. This estimate explicitly decomposes the overall generative error into four interpretable components: the truncation error of the forward process, the reverse-time discretization error, the generalization error incorporating both finite data and forward-time discretization, and the training optimization gap. Our results quantitatively characterize how the training sample size, temporal discretization grids, and optimization accuracy jointly control the final fidelity of samples generated by diffusion models.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了基于ResNet架构的分数扩散模型统一收敛与泛化框架，将生成误差分解为截断误差、离散化误差、泛化误差和优化差距四个可解释部分，并定量刻画了样本量、离散化网格和优化精度对生成质量的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型的理论分析通常假设oracle分数或预设误差阈值，缺乏对有限样本学习、网络参数化和数值离散化三者如何共同决定生成质量的完整理论理解。
AI.method: 从有限样本、离散时间的实际学习问题出发，建立到理想连续时间、群体水平目标的泛化与收敛分析框架；基于分数函数的学习泛化结果，分析由此产生的采样过程，并给出端到端的总变差距离估计。
AI.result: 将总体生成误差分解为四个可解释组成部分：前向过程的截断误差、反向时间离散化误差、包含有限数据和前向离散化的泛化误差、以及训练优化差距。
AI.conclusion: 定量刻画了训练样本量、时间离散化网格和优化精度如何共同控制扩散模型生成样本的最终保真度，为理解扩散模型在实际场景中的表现提供了理论支撑。

title: Accuracy Hides How Language Models Fail: Measuring Failure States Under Matched Output Budgets
summary: Language-model benchmarks collapse two distinct measurement questions into a single accuracy score: whether a response reached an evaluable state, and whether its answer was judged correct. We introduce a two-layer evaluation framework that separates scorer-independent execution evidence, including termination, answer exposure, parseability, and completion length, from scorer-dependent correctness. Across 2,550 outputs from five fixed Qwen and DeepSeek configurations on MATH and ARC-Challenge, matched 2,048-token limits produce sharply different execution mixtures: 49 of 450 Qwen MATH outputs terminate without a final answer, compared with 5 of 300 DeepSeek MATH outputs and none of the 750 ARC outputs. Among the same 300 DeepSeek MATH question-model pairs, no missing-final length termination is observed at 8,192 tokens. A coverage-audited targeted verification study further shows that candidate-selection and aggregation policies can substantially alter comparative accuracy estimates. These results demonstrate that accuracy conflates execution case mix with verification policy. Evaluations of test-time methods should therefore report pre-intervention execution states, verification coverage, and scorer provenance alongside accuracy.

AI.tldr: 现有语言模型基准将"输出是否可评估"和"答案是否正确"混淆为单一准确率分数。本文提出双层评估框架分离执行证据与正确性，发现不同模型和设置下执行状态分布差异显著，且评估政策会改变准确率估计。
AI.motivation: 语言模型基准的准确率分数同时混杂了"输出是否达到可评估状态"和"答案是否正确"两个不同维度的问题，导致评估结果不准确。
AI.method: 提出双层评估框架：第一层为与评分者无关的执行证据（终止状态、答案暴露、可解析性、完成长度），第二层为与评分者相关的正确性判断。在MATH和ARC-Challenge上对2550个输出进行实验，并引入覆盖审核的目标验证研究。
AI.result: 不同模型和token限制下执行状态分布差异显著：450个Qwen MATH输出中49个未终止但有最终答案，而300个DeepSeek MATH输出中仅5个。候选选择和聚合策略会实质性地改变准确率估计。
AI.conclusion: 准确率混淆了执行案例分布与验证策略。评估测试时方法应报告干预前的执行状态、验证覆盖率和评分者来源。

title: Stochastic Control of Addiction with State-Dependent Jump Relapse
summary: We study a continuous-time rational addiction model where addiction capital follows a piecewise deterministic Markov process with state-dependent jumps capturing relapse and recovery. The instantaneous utility combines consumption and addiction capital via a power specification, leading to Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equations with nonlocal jump terms. In the capped, bounded-control case we obtain a unique bounded viscosity solution and prove that optimal policies are bang-bang, switching between minimal and maximal consumption, while in the uncapped case we derive explicit linear feedback controls and closed-form value functions in several parameter regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个连续时间理性成瘾模型，其中成瘾资本遵循带有状态依赖跳跃的分段确定马尔可夫过程，刻画了复发和恢复。在带上限的有界控制情形下，获得了唯一的有界粘性解，并证明最优策略为bang-bang形式；在无上限情形下，推导了显式线性反馈控制和闭式价值函数。
AI.motivation: 现有成瘾模型多以离散时间或连续时间但跳跃结构简单为主，难以捕捉成瘾行为中复发与恢复的随机跳跃特征。本文引入分段确定马尔可夫过程，旨在更真实地刻画成瘾资本的动态演化，并分析最优消费策略。
AI.method: 将成瘾资本建模为带状态依赖跳跃的PDMP，采用幂函数形式的瞬时效用，推导含非局部跳跃项的HJB方程。在有界控制情形下利用粘性解理论证明唯一性并分析bang-bang结构；在无界情形下通过待定函数法求解显式反馈控制。
AI.result: 有界控制情形：得到唯一有界粘性解，最优策略为bang-bang（在最小和最大消费间切换）。无界控制情形：在多个参数区间得到显式线性反馈控制和闭式价值函数。
AI.conclusion: 该模型为理性成瘾行为提供了可解析处理的分析框架，揭示了复发/恢复跳跃对最优消费策略的关键影响，未来可推广至多状态或非幂函数效用情形。

title: ARdena: Scenario-driven control of real-time LLM agents
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled increasingly capable conversational agents, but reliably controlling their behavior in real-time interactive environments remains a significant challenge. Existing approaches often rely on model fine-tuning or alignment procedures that are difficult to adapt to changing interaction requirements. This paper introduces layered scenario-driven LLM control, a framework that enables runtime behavior control through structured prompting. By combining persistent context with scenario-specific constraints, the approach allows agent behavior to be modified during interaction without changing the underlying model. The framework is implemented in ARDena, a real-time multimodal embodied agent that integrates speech interaction, visual perception, tool use, and avatar-based response generation. The proposed approach is evaluated with respect to control effectiveness, response latency, and operational stability. The results demonstrate that scenario definitions alone can produce substantially different interaction behaviors while maintaining stable real-time operation, highlighting the effectiveness of scenario-driven prompting for controlling LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于分层场景驱动的LLM控制框架，通过结构化提示在运行时控制对话代理行为，无需重新训练模型。在实时多模态具身代理ARDena上验证了该方法在控制效果、响应延迟和操作稳定性方面的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖模型微调或对齐流程，难以适应实时交互中不断变化的需求，亟需一种无需修改底层模型即可动态控制代理行为的轻量级方法。
AI.method: 提出分层场景驱动的LLM控制框架，结合持久化上下文与场景特定约束，通过结构化提示实现运行时行为控制。在ARDena多模态具身代理中集成语音交互、视觉感知、工具使用和虚拟人响应生成。
AI.result: 实验表明，仅靠场景定义即可产生显著不同的交互行为，同时保持稳定的实时运行。
AI.conclusion: 场景驱动的提示方法能有效控制LLM代理行为，为无需重新训练模型的动态行为调控提供了可行路径。

title: Context-Aware Concept Distillation for Trustworthy Flood Prediction
comment: to be published in IJCAI 2026 proceedings
summary: Effective flood risk management relies on accurate forecasting, yet the "black box" nature of stateof-the-art Deep Learning models creates a barrier to trust and accountability in high-stakes public safety decisions. While existing Explainable AI (XAI) methods offer local attributions, they fail to provide the verifiable, operationally meaningful causal narratives required by disaster response authorities. To address this societal challenge, we propose Context-Aware Concept Distillation (CACD), a framework developed in collaboration with domain experts to distill opaque LSTMs into interpretable, hydrology-aware surrogate models. We introduce an unsupervised pipeline to discover a "Hydrological Language" and a Residual Hypernetwork that dynamically modulates these concepts based on static basin characteristics. Evaluated on 5,203 basins globally, our model achieves high fidelity (Median NSE 0.70), significantly outperforming black-box baselines (e.g., Multi Layer Perceptrons) on unseen future data. By demonstrating that human-interpretable concepts are sufficient to reconstruct flood dynamics, this work balances AI accuracy with the transparency required for responsible environmental decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出上下文感知概念蒸馏（CACD）框架，将不透明的LSTM洪水预测模型转化为可解释的、水文学感知的替代模型，通过在5232个全球流域的评估（中位数NSE=0.70）证明了可解释概念足以重构洪水动态，实现了AI精度与透明度的平衡。
AI.motivation: 洪水风险管理的"黑箱"深度学习模型在公共安全决策中缺乏信任和问责机制，现有可解释AI方法仅提供局部归因，无法提供灾害响应机构所需的可验证、具有操作意义的因果叙事。
AI.method: 提出CACD框架：(1) 与领域专家协作，设计无监督管道发现"水文语言"（可解释概念）；(2) 引入残差超网络（Residual Hypernetwork），基于静态流域特征动态调控这些概念；(3) 将不透明LSTM蒸馏为可解释的水文替代模型。
AI.result: 在全球5,203个流域上，CACD模型达到中位数NSE 0.70的保真度，在未见未来数据上显著优于多层感知器等黑箱基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 人类可解释的概念足以重构洪水动态，该工作实现了AI精度与负责任环境决策所需透明度之间的平衡，为高风险的公共安全应用提供了可信赖的AI方案。

title: INS-ActBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Assessing Professional Actuarial Capability of Large Language Models
comment: 18 pages, including appendices; 11 figures and 12 tables
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong potential in financial reasoning, but existing benchmarks often evaluate domain knowledge, numerical reasoning, long-context understanding, and tool use in separate settings. This limits their ability to assess realistic professional workflows that require auditable, context-grounded, and tool-executable decisions. We introduce \textbf{INS-ActBench}, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating professional actuarial capability in LLMs. INS-ActBench contains 12,050 Q\&A pairs from public exams and sample questions released by 16 actuarial associations. It covers three subsets: \textbf{INS-Act-Know} for standardized actuarial knowledge, \textbf{INS-Act-Case} for long-context insurance case reasoning, and \textbf{INS-Act-Practice} for spreadsheet and R-code tasks with verifiable numerical outputs. Experiments on nine representative LLMs and human actuarial experts reveal a clear capability boundary: frontier LLMs perform strongly on standardized knowledge, but remain much weaker in case reasoning, tool-based workflows, and jurisdiction-sensitive practice. INS-ActBench provides a reproducible foundation for developing actuarial LLMs toward reliable professional assistance. The code is available at https://github.com/FDU-INS/INS-ActBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出INS-ActBench，一个涵盖12,050道精算专业QA的综合基准，包含知识、案例和实践三个子集，用于评估LLM在真实精算工作流中的能力。实验发现前沿LLM在标准化知识上表现强劲，但在案例推理、工具使用和司法敏感任务上远弱于人类专家。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM金融推理基准将领域知识、数值推理、长上下文理解和工具使用分开评估，无法反映需要可审计、上下文接地和工具可执行决策的真实专业工作流。因此需要构建一个综合性的精算能力评估基准。
AI.method: 构建包含12,050个QA对的INS-ActBench，数据来自16个精算协会的公开考试和样题。分为三个子集：INS-Act-Know（标准化知识）、INS-Act-Case（长上下文案例推理）、INS-Act-Practice（电子表格和R代码任务，输出可验证）。在9个代表性LLM和人类精算专家上进行比较评估。
AI.result: 前沿LLM在标准化知识测试上表现强劲，但在案例推理、基于工具的工作流和司法敏感实践中表现明显较弱，与人类精算专家存在清晰的能力边界。
AI.conclusion: INS-ActBench为开发精算领域LLM提供了可复现的基础，有助于推动LLM在精算专业领域的可靠辅助应用。

title: Optimal Control with Expectation Constraint in a Smooth Boundary Case
summary: As in Bouchard et al. (2010) and Bouchard and Nutz (2014), we study a utility maximization problem with expectation constraint. We first consider a uniformly elliptic case in which the endogenous state boundary associated with the constraint in expectation is proved to be smooth. This allows one to derive a proper Dirichlet condition for the value function of the optimal control problem on this boundary. We then propose a new truncation argument in the martingale representation of the expectation constraint. This leads to an approximating sequence of auxiliary systems of PDEs for which comparison holds. Convergence to the initial optimal control problem is proved. In the degenerate case, we propose another approximation which consists in adding a small noise term to recover uniformly ellipticity. Convergence is also proved. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first time that a full analysis is performed for such control problems, so as to open the doors to the use of numerical schemes. Numerical resolution in a toy example is performed using neural networks. It is complemented by an estimation of the numerical error, also performed by using a neural network approach.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带期望约束的效用最大化问题，通过证明均匀椭圆情形下边界光滑性、提出截断论证以及退化情形下的噪声扰动，首次给出该控制问题的完整分析，并利用神经网络进行数值求解与误差估计。
AI.motivation: 解决带期望约束的随机控制问题中，由于内生状态边界非光滑导致的偏微分方程边值条件难以定义的困难，为数值方法的应用铺平道路。
AI.method: 1) 在均匀椭圆情形下证明内生边界的光滑性，导出恰当的Dirichlet条件；2) 提出新的截断论证，构造逼近的PDE辅助系统；3) 退化情形下加入小噪声恢复均匀椭圆性，证明收敛性；4) 利用神经网络进行数值求解并估计误差。
AI.result: 首次给出了带期望约束控制问题的完整理论分析，包括边界光滑性、逼近序列收敛性，并通过神经网络在玩具示例上实现了数值求解与误差估计。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为带期望约束的随机控制问题提供了完整的理论框架和可行的数值方案，神经网络方法在数值实现中表现有效。

title: KG2Code: Bridging Knowledge Graphs and Large Language Models via Executable Code for Question Answering
summary: Recent research has explored the integration of knowledge graphs (KGs) with large language models (LLMs) to enhance their performance on downstream knowledge-intensive tasks, particularly knowledge graph question answering (KGQA). Existing approaches primarily combine LLMs with KGs through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-based, agent-based, and SPARQL-based methods. Although these methods have achieved notable success, they still suffer from several limitations, including structural information loss, unfaithful reasoning, and limited flexibility and generalization. To address these challenges, this paper proposes KG2Code, a novel approach that transforms knowledge graphs into a code-based representation, preserving structural semantics while naturally aligning with the code-aware pretraining of modern LLMs. Based on KG2Code, KG2Code-QA is further introduced as a KGQA framework that formulates KGQA as a code generation task. This formulation enables the generation of verifiable reasoning traces and executable code, thereby substantially mitigating the impact of hallucinations. In addition, an automated pipeline is developed to construct a large-scale, high-quality code corpus for effectively training open-source LLMs on KG2Code-QA. After training, LLMs are able to perform KGQA in zero-shot scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach significantly outperforms existing KG-enhanced LLM methods for KGQA, while exhibiting strong generalization to unseen KGs. The code and data are available at Github.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KG2Code方法，将知识图谱转换为代码表示，并基于此构建KG2Code-QA框架，将知识图谱问答转化为代码生成任务，有效缓解幻觉问题，在多个基准测试中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有KG+LLM方法（RAG、Agent、SPARQL）存在结构信息丢失、推理不忠实、灵活性和泛化性有限等问题，亟需一种能保留图结构语义且与LLM代码预训练能力对齐的新方法。
AI.method: 提出KG2Code将KG转换为代码表示保留结构语义；构建KG2Code-QA框架将KGQA转化为代码生成任务；设计自动化流水线构建大规模高质量代码语料用于训练开源LLM。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法显著优于现有KG增强LLM方法，在零样本场景下表现优异，且对未见过的KG具有强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将KG转化为代码表示是一种有效增强LLM知识推理能力的方式，生成的推理轨迹可验证、可执行，能显著缓解幻觉问题，且具有良好的泛化性。

title: StageGuard: Physiologically Constrained Sleep Staging
comment: 12 pages. Accepted at KDD 2026 (32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference), AI for Sciences track
summary: Automated sleep staging is increasingly used in large-scale studies to derive sleep-architecture endpoints: total sleep time, REM latency, sleep efficiency, and bout-duration statistics. Deep learning models achieve epoch-level accuracy approaching inter-rater agreement, yet often produce hypnograms that violate physiological invariants, such as rare transitions (e.g., direct Wake -> REM) or excessively fragmented sequences. Such violations can bias downstream sleep metrics, regardless of overall accuracy. We propose StageGuard, a plug-and-play, backbone-agnostic structured-inference framework that wraps any neural sleep-staging backbone with physiology-informed priors. StageGuard combines (1) a differentiable soft transition penalty that discourages physiologically rare transitions during training, and (2) a semi-Markov constrained decoder with a duration-augmented state space that jointly enforces transition penalties and minimum bout durations at inference. Unlike hard-prohibition methods, it admits rare transitions when emission evidence is overwhelming, leaving informative pathological events recoverable rather than blocked. StageGuard constrains staging outputs to satisfy known physiological priors rather than modeling sleep generatively. We quantify the validity gap using transition-violation rate (TVR) and fragmentation index (FI) and demonstrate that, across six backbones and four datasets, StageGuard reduces TVR to physiologically plausible levels and lowers FI by 56-62%, while maintaining or slightly improving classification accuracy. Crucially, improved constraint satisfaction translates into 59-79% lower error on derived sleep-architecture statistics not directly optimized by the method, and recovers the direction and effect size of expert-defined subgroup differences (OSA severity, age) more faithfully than the unconstrained baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出StageGuard框架，通过生理约束（可微过渡惩罚+半马尔可夫解码器）修正深度睡眠分期模型产生的生理违规（如罕见转换、过度碎片化），在六个骨干网络和四个数据集上将转换违规率降至生理合理水平，碎片化指数降低56-62%，并使下游睡眠架构统计误差降低59-79%。
AI.motivation: 深度学习睡眠分期模型虽在逐时段准确率上接近人类水平，但生成的分期图常违反生理学不变性（如罕见直接Wake→REM转换、过度碎片化序列），这些违规会偏向下游睡眠指标（如总睡眠时间、REM潜伏期等），即使总体准确率很高。
AI.method: 提出StageGuard框架：1）可微软过渡惩罚项，在训练阶段抑制生理罕见转换；2）半马尔可夫约束解码器，结合持续时间增强状态空间，在推理阶段同时强制执行过渡惩罚和最小时段持续时间。框架为即插即用、与骨干网络无关，允许在发射证据强烈时保留罕见转换。
AI.result: 在六个骨干网络和四个数据集上，StageGuard将TVR降至生理合理水平，FI降低56-62%，同时保持或略微提升分类准确率。约束改善使下游睡眠架构统计误差降低59-79%，且比无约束基线更忠实地恢复专家定义的亚组差异（OSA严重程度、年龄）。
AI.conclusion: 通过生理先验约束而非硬性禁止，StageGuard能有效修正深度睡眠分期模型的生理违规，提升下游睡眠指标的可靠性和临床相关差异的恢复能力，且不牺牲分类性能。

title: The Tokenizer Tax: Quantifying and Explaining the Cross-Lingual Cost of Subword Tokenization for Indian Languages
summary: Large language models (LLMs) process text through subword tokenizers rather than directly reading characters or words. Because these tokenizers are trained predominantly on English-centric corpora, they introduce a systematic and often overlooked disadvantage for many non-English languages. In this work, we quantify this tokenizer tax for Indian languages using the FLORES-200 parallel corpus, measuring tokenization fertility across six widely used tokenizers and fourteen languages. Under cl100k_base (used by GPT-3.5 and GPT-4), Indian languages experience an average 8.0x tokenization tax relative to English, reaching 13.0x for Malayalam, reducing the effective context window to as little as 12% of that available to English users for equivalent semantic content. We identify the primary mechanism behind this disparity: failed byte-pair merges that leave text fragmented into single-byte tokens, with merge failure strongly correlating with tokenizer tax (Pearson r = 0.89). We further show that this phenomenon is not an inherent property of Indic scripts but a consequence of tokenizer design. Multilingual tokenizers such as XLM-R and OpenAI's o200k_base reduce the average Indic tokenizer tax by 73%, demonstrating that the disparity is largely remediable. Beyond token statistics, we quantify a practical consequence by showing that, under fixed context budgets, Indian-language documents preserve substantially less original content than equivalent English documents. Finally, we examine the relationship between tokenizer fertility and reading comprehension performance on the Belebele benchmark, finding that the apparent correlation is largely explained by language resource availability rather than tokenizer behavior alone.

AI.tldr: 该论文量化了大型语言模型在印度语言中的分词器税（tokenizer tax），发现英语中心的分词器导致印度语言平均8.0倍的标记化开销（马来语高达13.0倍），有效上下文窗口仅为英语用户的12%。研究识别出主要机制是字节对合并失败，并证明多语言分词器可将此税降低73%。同时发现，标记化开销与阅读理解性能之间的表观相关性主要由语言资源可用性而非分词器行为解释。
AI.motivation: LLM通过子词分词器处理文本，而这些分词器主要基于英语语料训练，对非英语语言造成系统性劣势。作者旨在量化这种"分词器税"对印度语言的影响，并探究其深层机制和实际后果。
AI.method: 使用FLORES-200平行语料库，测量6种广泛使用的分词器对14种印度语言的标记化生育率（tokenization fertility），分析字节对合并失败模式，并通过Belebele基准评估阅读理解性能的相关性，控制语言资源可用性变量。
AI.result: 1) cl100k_base下印度语言平均8.0x分词税，马来语达13.0x；2) 主要机制是字节对合并失败（Pearson r=0.89）；3) 多语言分词器可降低73%的税；4) 固定上下文预算下印度语言文档保留的原始内容显著减少；5) 分词器生育率与阅读理解的相关性主要由语言资源可用性解释。
AI.conclusion: 印度语言在LLM中面临严重的分词器歧视，但这种歧视并非印地语文字本身的固有属性，而是分词器设计的可修复问题。多语言分词器能大幅缓解该问题，但分词器优化需要与语言资源建设相结合。

title: On the hardness of deterministic second-order optimization of functions with Lipschitz gradients
summary: We show that no deterministic zero-respecting algorithm (resp., (general) deterministic algorithm) can compute Goldstein approximate second-order stationary points of functions with Lipschitz continuous gradients within a finite number of (resp., no more than $n-3$ with $n$ being the input dimension) second-order oracle calls. This, among other consequences, shows that deterministic second-order weakly convex optimization is intractable.

AI.tldr: 本文证明确定性零尊重算法无法在有限次二阶黑盒调用内计算Goldstein近似二阶驻点，而一般确定性算法在n-3次调用内也无法完成，表明确定性二阶弱凸优化是难解的。
AI.motivation: 探究确定性算法在计算Goldstein近似二阶驻点时的查询复杂度下界，揭示弱凸优化中二阶方法的理论局限性。
AI.method: 通过构造反例和复杂度下界论证，证明零尊重算法和一般确定性算法在有限或指定次数内无法达到目标。
AI.result: 零尊重算法无法有限步终止；一般确定性算法在n-3次调用内不可能成功。
AI.conclusion: 确定性二阶弱凸优化在标准意义下是难解的（intractable）。

title: Do Language Models Converge to Themselves? Recursive Self-Refinement as Textual Relaxation
summary:
Large language models are increasingly used in recursive refinement workflows, where an initial draft is repeatedly revised by the same model. Despite their growing use, the long-term dynamics of such workflows remain poorly understood. Does repeated refinement continue to improve outputs indefinitely, or does it converge toward a stable textual form?
  We study recursive self-refinement as a dynamical process in which repeated LLM revision drives text toward a model-preferred soft fixed-point region. Using GPT-5.5, we generate 10-step refinement trajectories for 50 ICML 2025 abstracts under both default-temperature and deterministic decoding, and additionally evaluate 15 ICML 2020 abstracts. We analyze normalized edit distance, exact and approximate fixed points, word-count stability, exponential relaxation, and external LLM-as-a-judge evaluation.
  Across all settings, refinement trajectories rapidly saturate. Most edits occur within the first few iterations, after which trajectories enter a soft fixed-point region with only minor surface-level changes. Deterministic decoding reaches exact fixed points earlier and exhibits smaller residual fluctuations than default-temperature decoding, while both achieve universal approximate convergence. The average edit magnitude follows a consistent exponential relaxation pattern, suggesting convergence toward a model-preferred textual equilibrium rather than open-ended optimization. External evaluation indicates that converged abstracts improve clarity, conciseness, and scientific style while preserving technical meaning.
  These findings support a dynamical-systems view of LLM self-refinement and motivate practical stopping criteria based on edit-magnitude saturation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM在递归自精炼中的动力学特性，发现文本会快速收敛到模型偏好的软不动点区域，编辑幅度呈指数衰减，而非无限优化。
AI.motivation: 递归自精炼工作流日益普及，但其长期动态特性尚不明确——重复精炼会无限优化输出还是收敛到稳定形式？
AI.method: 使用GPT-5.5对50篇ICML 2025摘要和15篇ICML 2020摘要进行10步递归精炼轨迹分析，涵盖默认温度和确定性解码两种设置；分析归一化编辑距离、不动点、词数稳定性、指数松弛和外部LLM评估。
AI.result: 精炼轨迹快速饱和，多数编辑在前几步完成；确定性解码比默认温度解码更早达到精确不动点且残差波动更小；编辑幅度呈一致指数衰减模式；收敛后的摘要在清晰度、简洁性和科学性上有所提升。
AI.conclusion: LLM自精炼可用动力系统视角理解，文本收敛到模型偏好的文本均衡而非开放优化；可基于编辑幅度饱和设计实用停止准则。

title: FILLER: Feature Imputation via Latent Location Exploration and Retrieval
summary: In real-world machine learning applications, incomplete observations create a fundamental challenge. Researchers have come up with several ideas to address this crucial problem. However, current models still face challenges in balancing scalability and structural consistency. This study proposes a feature imputation method, called FILLER, that deliberately searches the two-dimensional latent space produced by a generative model and fills the missing values with appropriate entries. The generative model is trained on fully observed data to generate samples from the latent space, and FILLER uses this trained model to impute the values missing in the corrupted test samples. In this study, G-NeuroDAVIS serves the purpose of the generative model. This work also presents a mathematical proof on the convergence of the iterative search. Finally, FILLER has been evaluated on several image datasets under random and structured missingness patterns with varying levels of imputation complexities. In order to justify the efficacy of FILLER, it has been compared against existing state-of-the-art solution strategies in terms of RMSE, PSNR, and SSIM. In addition, Wilcoxon signed-rank test has been carried out to validate statistical significance. Moreover, downstream analyses (classification and clustering) have also established the quality of imputation in terms of standard metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FILLER方法，利用生成模型（G-NeuroDAVIS）在二维潜空间中迭代搜索以填补缺失特征，在多个图像数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现实机器学习中常遇不完整观测数据，现有方法在可扩展性与结构一致性之间难以平衡，亟需一种兼顾两者的特征填补方法。
AI.method: 基于生成模型（G-NeuroDAVIS）构建二维潜空间，对完全观测数据训练后，通过迭代搜索为缺失值寻找合适的潜空间条目进行填补，并提供了迭代收敛的数学证明。
AI.result: 在多个图像数据集上，针对随机与结构化缺失模式进行评估，与现有方法相比在RMSE、PSNR、SSIM指标上表现更优，并通过Wilcoxon符号秩检验验证统计显著性。
AI.conclusion: FILLER能有效平衡可扩展性与结构一致性，下游任务（分类与聚类）也验证了其填补质量，表明该方法具有实际应用价值。

title: Self-Authored Verification Is Unreliable in Heuristic Self-Improving Agents
summary: Self-improving agents accumulate capability by repeatedly rewriting procedural policies, controllers, or heuristic rules. They typically rely on self-authored tests or metrics to decide whether to accept subsequent edits. The agent controls both the optimized object and its verifier. As a result, self-assigned scores can remain near perfect while real deployment performance degrades or stays low. We study this problem through the verifier--deployment gap. This gap refers to the discrepancy between an agent's self-authored verification signal and a sealed deployment evaluation that the agent cannot observe or access. We ask how self-authored verification fails under iterative policy-and-test rewriting, how the failure changes with capability, and how little exogenous trust is sufficient to prevent real regressions from being deployed. To address this problem, we introduce a Sealed Exogenous Acceptance Loop (SEAL). SEAL retains self-authored tests but compares each candidate with the incumbent through a fixed harness-side audit. The agent cannot author or inspect the audit, receives only accept/reject, and the whole incumbent state is retained after a clear regression. Our experiments show that this problem often appears in heuristic learning settings. These settings require trial-and-error discovery of the target objective. We further find that failures of self-written verification are stratified by capability. Weaker agents tend to damage previously acquired strategies behind easy self-tests. Stronger agents are more stable, but they still mismeasure the deployment distribution. Standard self-written constraints do not reliably close this gap. In contrast, SEAL outperforms unprotected baselines across six models and three random seeds. Reliable self-improvement need not abandon self-verification, but it requires at least one deployment-acceptance signal outside the agent's control.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自我改进智能体在迭代重写策略和验证器时出现的“验证器-部署差距”问题，并提出SEAL方法，通过引入固定审计信号来防止真实性能退化。
AI.motivation: 自我改进智能体同时控制优化目标和验证器，导致自评分数近乎完美而实际部署性能下降或停滞，需要研究这种验证失效的机制及解决方法。
AI.method: 提出密封外生验收循环（SEAL）：保留自编测试，但通过固定的外挂审计比较候选策略与现有策略，智能体无法编写或查看审计，仅接收接受/拒绝信号，发生明显退化时保留原有策略。
AI.result: 验证失效随能力分层：弱智能体会破坏已有策略，强智能体更稳定但仍会误测部署分布；标准自编约束无法可靠缩小差距；SEAL在六个模型和三个随机种子上优于未保护基线。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的自我改进不必放弃自我验证，但至少需要一个超出智能体控制的部署接受信号。

title: On computing Goldstein approximate second-order stationary points of structured nonsmooth nonconvex programs
summary: In this paper, we exhibit a randomized first-order algorithm to compute Goldstein approximate second-order stationary points of $L$-smooth functions, using tools from randomized smoothing. The algorithm has oracle complexity $\widetilde{O}({ n^2}/{\varepsilon^9}+{ n^3}/{\varepsilon^7})$, where $n=1,2,\ldots$ is the input dimension and $\varepsilon>0$ is the (common) tolerance. We also present extensions to weakly convex functions and applications to bilevel optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于随机平滑的随机一阶算法，用于计算L-光滑函数的Goldstein近似二阶稳定点，其oracle复杂度为$\widetilde{O}({ n^2}/{\varepsilon^9}+{ n^3}/{\varepsilon^7})$，并扩展到弱凸函数及双层优化应用。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在计算Goldstein近似二阶稳定点时，要么依赖二阶信息导致计算成本高，要么一阶方法的复杂度不理想。本文旨在利用随机平滑工具设计更高效的随机一阶算法。
AI.method: 采用随机平滑（randomized smoothing）技术，将原始非光滑目标函数平滑化，进而设计随机一阶算法来迭代逼近Goldstein近似二阶稳定点。
AI.result: 算法达到$\widetilde{O}({ n^2}/{\varepsilon^9}+{ n^3}/{\varepsilon^7})$的oracle复杂度，并成功推广至弱凸函数情形和双层优化问题。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了随机平滑在非凸优化中求解二阶稳定点的有效性，为相关问题的算法设计提供了新思路。

title: MINT-V2X: A Mobility-Integrated Network Trajectory Dataset for Predictive Resource Management
summary: Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication systems are based on datasets that not only contain vehicle trajectory data but also wireless network parameters with a realistic level of fidelity, enabling the creation of prediction and optimization models. There is a very critical research infrastructure gap today, and publicly available datasets are likely to be limited to one of the two: mobility or network parameters, and rarely provide a single, integrated view that combines both. This paper introduces MINT-V2X, a comprehensive dataset generated by coupling SUMO traffic dynamics with OMNeT++/Simu5G network simulation. The validation framework is composed of 14 standardized tests based on 3GPP Release 14 (C-V2X), ETSI standards and Shannon capacity theory. The resulting dataset contains 9.87 million synchronized data points from 1,386 vehicles from 15 roadside units (RSUs) during 3 hours of urban traffic simulation. We demonstrate strict algorithmic consistency through network metric correlations (CQI-SINR: 0.993; SINR-PDR: 0.946). Finally, we demonstrate the value of the dataset by conducting an RSU load prediction case study, showing that using trajectory data yields better predictive performance than network-history-only baselines. The dataset, experiments, and complete SUMO configuration files are available in the GitHub repository to facilitate reproduction on alternative simulation stacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MINT-V2X，一个结合交通动力学与网络仿真的综合V2X数据集，包含987万条同步数据点，并通过标准化测试验证了其一致性，最后通过RSU负载预测案例展示了轨迹数据对预测性能的提升价值。
AI.motivation: 当前V2X研究存在关键基础设施缺口：现有公开数据集要么只包含车辆轨迹（mobility），要么只包含网络参数，极少提供两者结合的集成视图，限制了预测与优化模型的构建能力。
AI.method: 将SUMO交通动力学仿真与OMNeT++/Simu5G网络仿真耦合，生成同步数据；基于3GPP Release 14 (C-V2X)、ETSI标准和香农容量理论设计了14项标准化测试验证框架。
AI.result: 生成了包含987万同步数据点的数据集，涵盖1386辆车、15个RSU的3小时城市交通仿真。网络指标相关性高（CQI-SINR: 0.993; SINR-PDR: 0.946）。RSU负载预测案例表明，使用轨迹数据的预测性能优于仅基于网络历史数据的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: MINT-V2X填补了V2X领域缺乏 mobility-network 综合数据集的空白，且通过开源配置支持复现，为后续研究提供了高保真度、标准一致的基准数据资源。

title: AlloBench: Measuring Online Tool Allocation Capability in LLM Agents
summary: Creating a reusable tool is an investment: an agent pays a fixed cost now in exchange for the potential of future reuse. Therefore, a user should prefer an agent that creates a small number of highly reusable tools, rather than many one-offs. We introduce a paired benchmark that tests whether LLM agents exhibit conscious allocation behavior under a fixed budget in two contexts: an abstract text-based formulation and a code-construction task. We find that every frontier model we test---Claude Haiku, Claude Opus, GPT-5.4-mini, and GPT-5.6 Sol---acts near-optimally in the abstract framing but fails to transfer this ability to script-writing. Through further experiments, we identify the particular failure modes for each model. Notably, the first three models fail even when the scripts are not evaluated, while GPT-5.6 Sol stays selective under that weaker manipulation and collapses only at full construction. Furthermore, an open-source Qwen model policy-trained for abstract allocation generalizes this ability across held-out lexical variations, but sees no improvement at script allocation. Together, these results establish online tool allocation as a significant capability boundary, even for modern frontier models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了LLM代理在固定预算下是否具备有意识的工具分配能力，发现前沿模型在抽象框架中表现近乎最优，但无法将此能力迁移到脚本编写任务中。
AI.motivation: 创建可复用工具是一种投资行为，用户更希望代理创建少量高复用性工具而非大量一次性工具。作者希望测试LLM代理是否具备这种有意识的资源分配能力。
AI.method: 设计了一个配对基准测试，包含抽象文本框架和代码构建任务两种场景，测试多种前沿模型（Claude Haiku、Claude Opus、GPT-5.4-mini、GPT-5.6 Sol）在固定预算下的工具分配行为，并进一步通过消融实验识别各模型的失败模式。
AI.result: 所有前沿模型在抽象框架中表现近乎最优，但在脚本编写任务中无法迁移该能力。GPT-5.6 Sol在部分限制下能保持选择性，但在完整构建条件下崩溃。开源的Qwen模型通过策略训练能在抽象分配上泛化，但对脚本分配无改善。
AI.conclusion: 在线工具分配能力是当前前沿模型的一个重要能力边界，即使是最先进的模型也无法将抽象环境中的优化分配策略迁移到更实际的编码任务中。

title: Rethinking the Generation Order of Block Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models enable flexible arbitrary-order generation, but existing sampling methods are mostly designed for early masked diffusion models (MDMs). In this work, we study sampling for recent block diffusion language models (BDLMs). We show empirically and analytically that these models are naturally more aligned with left-to-right decoding than MDMs. Based on this observation, we propose Parallel Autoregressive Decoding (PARD), a simple training-free sampling method that preserves left-to-right unmasking structure while allowing parallel token commitment. Extensive experiments show that PARD consistently outperforms existing parallel samplers in generation quality, while achieving substantial speedups over pure AR decoding with only a small quality gap.

AI.tldr: 提出PARD方法，针对块扩散语言模型实现并行自回归解码，在保持生成质量的同时加速推理。
AI.motivation: 现有采样方法主要面向早期掩码扩散模型，而新提出的块扩散语言模型更契合自左向右的解码方式，需要针对性的采样策略。
AI.method: 提出Parallel Autoregressive Decoding (PARD)，一种无需训练、保持自左向右去掩码结构并支持并行token提交的采样方法。
AI.result: PARD在生成质量上持续优于现有并行采样器，相比纯自回归解码实现显著加速，且质量差距很小。
AI.conclusion: 块扩散语言模型天然适合自左向右解码，PARD方法有效兼顾了并行效率与生成质量。

title: Optimal Rank Selection for Nonnegative Matrix Factorization via $\ell_{2,0}$-Norm Regularization
summary: Determining the optimal factorization rank is a fundamental yet notoriously challenging problem in Nonnegative Matrix Factorization, conventionally relying on heuristic thresholds or computationally expensive cross-validation. We introduce column $\ell_{2,0}$-norm regularization on both factor matrices to promote rank reduction. Starting from an overestimated factorization dimension, a warm-started $λ$-path is employed to progressively eliminate redundant components and produce a data-driven rank estimate. For the resulting nonconvex and discontinuous optimization problem, we develop an inertial Proximal Alternating Linearized Minimization method, its scale-balanced variant, and a Proximal Active-Set Method based on P-stationarity. The scale-balancing strategy controls numerical imbalance between paired factor columns while preserving the reconstructed matrix. We establish conditions under which the proposed model recovers the underlying nonnegative rank and provide a Kurdyka--Łojasiewicz-based convergence analysis showing that, under the stated algorithmic conditions, the entire sequences generated by the proposed methods converge to critical points. Numerical experiments on synthetic and benchmark datasets, together with comparisons against Singular Value Hard Thresholding and cross-validation, show that the proposed framework provides favorable rank-estimation accuracy and computational efficiency in the tested settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出列ℓ_{2,0}范数正则化方法实现非负矩阵分解的自动秩选择，通过λ路径逐步消除冗余成分，并开发了惯性邻近交替线性化最小化方法等算法，理论证明可恢复真实非负秩且算法收敛到临界点。
AI.motivation: 非负矩阵分解中最优秩的选择是基础但极具挑战的问题，传统方法依赖启发式阈值或计算昂贵的交叉验证，缺乏数据驱动的高效方案。
AI.method: 在两个因子矩阵上引入列ℓ_{2,0}范数正则化促进秩降低；从过估计的分解维数出发，采用热启动的λ路径逐步消除冗余成分；开发了惯性邻近交替线性化最小化方法、尺度平衡变体以及基于P-稳定性的邻近有效集方法；尺度平衡策略控制因子列间的数值不平衡同时保持重构矩阵。
AI.result: 建立了模型恢复真实非负秩的条件；基于Kurdyka--Łojasiewicz的收敛性分析证明了整个序列收敛到临界点；在合成和基准数据集上，与奇异值硬阈值和交叉验证相比，所提框架在秩估计精度和计算效率上表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 本文为NMF提供了数据驱动的自动秩选择框架，兼具理论保证和实际计算效率，在测试场景中优于现有方法。

title: EventOD: Event-Aware OD Flow Generation via LLM-Guided Semantic Modulation
summary: Estimating origin-destination (OD) flows under disruptive events is important for disaster response and urban resilience. Existing deep OD models trained on routine mobility often degrade when extreme events abruptly alter regional functions and population activities, while retraining a new generator for each event is impractical under limited event-time supervision. We propose EventOD, an event-adaptive OD generation framework that steers a pretrained OD generator using structured event semantics. EventOD first uses a large language model to infer region-level functional and demographic control vectors from coarse event observations. It then learns two lightweight adaptation modules, AlphaNet and BetaNet, to calibrate the magnitude of these semantic shifts, and further introduces a retrieval-augmented fallback pathway for scenarios with sparse supervision. The resulting event-conditioned features are injected into a pretrained graph diffusion OD model through input-level modulation, enabling event-aware adaptation without updating generator parameters. Experiments on hurricane- and pandemic-induced mobility across U.S. counties show that EventOD consistently improves both reconstruction accuracy and distributional fidelity over strong baselines. Source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/EventOD-5C11/.

AI.tldr: 提出EventOD框架，利用大语言模型和轻量级适配模块，使预训练的OD生成模型能自适应极端事件，无需重新训练。
AI.motivation: 现有深度OD模型在极端事件（如飓风、疫情）下性能大幅下降，而事件发生时重新训练模型不现实，因为事件期间的监督数据极其有限。
AI.method: 先用LLM从粗粒度事件观测推断区域功能和人口统计的控制向量；再通过AlphaNet和BetaNet两个轻量适配模块校准语义偏移幅度；引入检索增强的备用路径处理稀疏监督场景；最后通过输入级调制将事件条件特征注入预训练的图扩散OD模型。
AI.result: 在美国县级的飓风和疫情导致的出行数据实验中，EventOD在重建精度和分布保真度上均持续优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种事件自适应的OD生成框架，通过语义引导和轻量适配实现零/少样本的事件迁移，有效提升了模型在突发事件下的鲁棒性。

title: Training with (Swap) Regret Loss in a Single-Layer Self-Attention Model: A Case Study on the Probability Simplex
summary: We revisit the regret loss framework introduced in Park et al. (2025), which uses decision-theoretic regret as a direct loss function for training models to make better decisions, through the lens of probability-simplex policies. Our first result shows that a single-layer self-attention model trained with regret loss admits a stationary point whose forward-pass exactly matches smoothed fictitious play with the appropriate stepsize that ensures no-regret behavior-i.e., for any given policy input, the model outputs the same update that smoothed fictitious play would produce. In parallel, we also newly introduce a swap-regret loss function, which extends the regret-loss framework beyond external regret and enables models to directly optimize for swap-deviation robustness. We further show that this swap-regret loss admits a stationary point whose forward pass implements the corresponding swap-regret update induced by classical Blum-Mansour no-pass implementation algorithm, with each head implementing an external-regret update via smoothed fictitious play. Together, these results show that regret-trained attention can realize differentiable mechanisms whose deployment induces equilibrium behavior in games: external-regret dynamics lead to coarse correlated equilibrium, while swap-regret dynamics lead to correlated equilibrium. Thus, regret-based objectives steer minimal attention architectures toward online-learning dynamics with game-theoretic guarantees, without supervised traces of those algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，用遗憾损失函数训练的单层自注意力模型，其前向传播恰好等价于平滑虚拟博弈（外部遗憾）或Blum-Mansour算法（交换遗憾），从而无需监督即可实现博弈论中的均衡行为。
AI.motivation: 将决策理论中的遗憾作为直接损失函数训练模型，以提升模型决策能力，并探索该框架在概率单纯形策略下的理论性质。
AI.method: 1. 重新审视Park等人(2025)的遗憾损失框架，在概率单纯形策略视角下分析；2. 证明单层自注意力模型在遗憾损失下的稳定点前向传播等价于平滑虚拟博弈；3. 引入交换遗憾损失函数，证明其稳定点实现Blum-Mansour算法。
AI.result: 遗憾损失训练的自注意力模型可以自动实现在线学习动力学：外部遗憾导向粗关联均衡，交换遗憾导向关联均衡，无需算法监督痕迹。
AI.conclusion: 基于遗憾的目标函数能够引导最小注意力架构获得具有博弈论保证的在线学习动力学，为将经典博弈算法嵌入神经网络提供了理论桥梁。

title: CONSISTRE: A Unified Consistency-Aware Framework for Document-Level Relation Extraction with Large Language Models
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures. Submitted to IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing
summary: Document-level relation extraction (DocRE) aims to extract relations among multiple entities across extended contexts while maintaining consistency across predicted triples. Although large language models (LLMs) show remarkable reasoning capabilities in information extraction, their predictions are typically generated independently for each candidate triple and may violate fundamental relational constraints such as transitivity, symmetry, and functional uniqueness, leading to contradictory and unreliable outputs. We propose CONSISTRE, a unified consistency-aware framework for DocRE that addresses this limitation through two complementary tracks. The first operates at inference time for black-box LLMs, combining constraint-aware prompting, constraint-based verification, and iterative self-reflection to refine predictions without task-specific fine-tuning. The second injects consistency knowledge into smaller open-source models via a knowledge distillation and reinforcement learning pipeline: reasoning traces from a powerful teacher are distilled into a student via supervised fine-tuning, followed by GRPO alignment using a composite reward that jointly optimizes extraction performance and relational consistency. Together, the two tracks cover both API-accessible and locally deployable scenarios under a unified consistency formulation. Experiments on DocRED show that both tracks outperform their baselines, with the inference-time track achieving competitive F1 using off-the-shelf black-box LLMs and the training-time track substantially narrowing the gap between 7--8B open-source models and state-of-the-art proprietary LLMs at a fraction of their inference cost. Ablation studies confirm that explicit consistency modeling mitigates relational contradictions and enhances the reliability of LLM-based DocRE across both deployment paradigms.

AI.tldr: 提出CONSISTRE框架，通过推理时约束提示+自反思和训练时知识蒸馏+GRPO对齐两种途径，增强文档级关系抽取中的一致性（如传递性、对称性、功能唯一性），在DocRED上提升性能并减少矛盾预测。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在DocRE中独立预测每个候选三元组，忽略了关系约束（传递性、对称性、功能唯一性），导致预测矛盾且不可靠。
AI.method: 双轨一致性框架：1）推理时：约束感知提示+验证+迭代自反思，无需微调；2）训练时：教师模型推理轨迹蒸馏到学生模型（SFT），再用GRPO对齐，优化提取性能和关系一致性。
AI.result: DocRED上两轨均超越基线，推理轨用黑盒LLM达到有竞争力F1，训练轨让7-8B开源模型接近专有LLM且推理成本更低。
AI.conclusion: 显式一致性建模能缓解关系矛盾，增强LLM在DocRE中的可靠性，适用于API和本地部署两种场景。

title: StanceBench: A Benchmark for Audio LLM-Based Interpersonal Stance Evaluation from Speech
summary: Speech-to-speech dialogue models increasingly depend on prosody and interactional nuance to convey social intent, yet benchmarks for these cues remain limited. We introduce StanceBench, a benchmark for measuring interpersonal stance in conversational speech and evaluating audio-capable LLMs as automated judges. Using the Seamless Interaction corpus, StanceBench (1) specifies 9 stance dimensions via role-prompt poles, (2) standardizes single-speaker and interaction-based evaluations, and (3) reports LLM-as-a-judge robustness, bias, and stance inference. Across evaluated stances, empathy and politeness are the easiest. Warmth and assertiveness are moderately separable with positivity skew/asymmetry. Honesty is the hardest and shows high prompt order bias, consistent with needing cross-turn evidence. Attentiveness is separable but aligns weakly with humans. Interaction stances are more context-sensitive, with threshold gaps and high variance, especially conflict regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了StanceBench基准，用于评估对话语音中的人际立场，包括9个维度，并检验了LLM作为自动评判者的能力，发现共情和礼貌最容易评估，而诚实最难，互动立场具有更高的上下文敏感性。
AI.motivation: 现有的语音对话模型越来越依赖韵律和交互细节来传达社交意图，但缺乏针对这些线索的基准评估方法。
AI.method: 基于Seamless Interaction语料库，定义了9个立场维度（通过角色提示对立面），标准化了单说话人和基于交互的评估，并报告了LLM作为评判者的鲁棒性、偏见和立场推断能力。
AI.result: 共情和礼貌最容易评估；温暖和自信中等可区分但存在正向偏差；诚实最难评估且提示顺序偏差高；专注度可区分但与人类一致性弱；交互立场更具上下文敏感性，尤其是在冲突调节方面。
AI.conclusion: StanceBench为评估语音对话中的社交立场提供了系统化基准，揭示了不同立场维度的难度差异以及LLM评判的局限性。

title: Neural operator discovery from heterogeneous trajectories
summary: Neural operators provide data-driven mappings for modeling dynamical systems. Extending them to families of systems typically requires explicit conditioning variables such as physical parameters, geometries, or boundary conditions. In many real-world settings, these quantities are unobserved. Here, we formulate neural operator discovery (NOD) as the problem of learning both shared solution operators and system-specific variation directly from heterogeneous trajectories without access to labeled governing factors. We introduce a factorized latent-conditioning formulation that jointly learns a neural operator and a low-dimensional latent representation through factorized prediction, trajectory-decoupled sampling, and dimension selection. Across diverse systems, the learned latent representation captures the intrinsic dimensionality of system variation and organizes system instances in a smooth and approximately invertible latent structure aligned with the underlying governing factors. This organization enables generalization to previously unseen system instances, including zero-shot extrapolation across regimes and stable long-horizon prediction. These results establish an interpretable paradigm for operator learning in the absence of explicit factor supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经算子发现（NOD）方法，无需显式条件变量，仅从异构轨迹数据中联合学习共享解算子与系统特定变体的低维潜在表征，实现跨系统的泛化与零样本外推。
AI.motivation: 现有神经算子扩展到多系统时需要显式条件变量（如物理参数、几何形状等），但实际场景中这些量往往无法观测，因此需要一种无需标签监督即可发现系统间变异结构的方法。
AI.method: 提出因式分解潜在条件公式，通过因式分解预测、轨迹解耦采样和维度选择，联合学习神经算子与低维潜在表征，使潜在空间自动捕获系统变异的本质维度。
AI.result: 潜在表征能捕捉系统变异的固有维度，形成光滑、近似可逆的潜在结构，对齐真实控制因素。实现零样本跨模态外推和稳定的长期预测。
AI.conclusion: 建立了一种无需显式因子监督的可解释算子学习范式，为无标签场景下的动力学建模提供了新路径。

title: Cross-Attention Calibrated Deduplication for Retrieval-Augmented Generation System
summary: Common chunking strategies in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems often create redundant chunks. These redundant chunks make the vector database bigger and slow down retrieval. A common fix is cosine-similarity thresholding. This method reduces each chunk to a single vector, then compares vectors using a similarity score. But a single vector can lose the fine-grained, token-level detail needed to tell a true duplicate apart from a chunk that just shares the same topic. We propose Cross-Attention Calibrated Deduplication (CACD). CACD checks each new chunk against an in-memory pool of chunks already kept, using a cross-encoder instead of a single pooled vector. This keeps token-level detail all the way to the final comparison. CACD combines three parts: the cross-encoder comparison itself, a New Information Score (NIS) that measures how much of a chunk is not explained by a candidate already kept, and a majority vote across several candidates rather than a single best match. NIS is calculated from the attention entropy of the cross-encoder. We tested CACD against five existing filtering methods, nine chunking strategies, and 18 configurations, all on the full SQuAD 1.1 validation set. In our experiments, CACD removes 9.75% of chunks on average. This drop rate is close to other semantic-level methods, and much higher than exact-match filters, which barely remove anything. In these experiments, CACD also processes each configuration in 51.0 seconds on average, about 27% faster than the strongest baseline, NERExact (69.6s), and about 7x faster than cosine-similarity filtering (356.7s). These results come from a single dataset, so we present them as an early comparison, not a general claim. Code for the baseline evaluation and for CACD is available at https://github.com/lehuyphuong/rag_bench and https://github.com/lehuyphuong/cacd_dedup.

AI.tldr: 提出CACD方法，用交叉编码器替代余弦相似度进行RAG系统去重，在保持去重率的同时比最强基线快27%。
AI.motivation: RAG系统中常见的分块策略会产生大量冗余块，导致向量数据库膨胀和检索变慢。现有余弦相似度阈值方法将每个块压缩为单一向量，丢失了区分真正重复与仅主题相似所需的token级细节信息。
AI.method: CACD由三部分组成：1) 使用交叉编码器（cross-encoder）对新块与内存池中已有块进行逐token比较；2) 新信息分数（NIS），基于交叉编码器的注意力熵计算，衡量当前块有多少内容未被已有候选块覆盖；3) 对多个候选块进行多数投票，而非仅取最佳匹配。
AI.result: 在SQuAD 1.1完整验证集上，CACD平均移除9.75%的块，去重率接近其他语义级方法，远高于精确匹配过滤器。处理每个配置平均耗时51.0秒，比最强基线NERExact快约27%，比余弦相似度过滤快约7倍。
AI.conclusion: CACD通过交叉编码器保留了token级细节，在保持有效去重的同时显著提升处理速度。但结果仅基于单一数据集，属于初步比较，尚需更多验证。

title: Optimal Convex Optimization with Inexact Second-Order Oracles
summary: In this paper, we present a novel second-order method called Accelerated Inexact Newton Extragradient (AINE) for convex optimization using $δ$-inexact Hessians. We show that AINE can find an $ε$-solution in the inexact second-order oracle (ISO) complexity of $\mathcal{O}( (δ/ε)^{1/2} + (L_2/ε)^{2/7} )$ when the Hessian is $L_2$-Lipschitz continuous, and a better complexity of $\mathcal{O}( (δ/ε)^{1/2} + (L_3/ε)^{1/5} )$ when the third-order derivative is $L_3$-Lipschitz continuous. Notably, each iteration of our method can be conducted in the same running time as matrix multiplication up to logarithmic factors. In addition, we also establish matching oracle complexity lower bounds for both setups, demonstrating the optimality of our methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了加速非精确牛顿外梯度法（AINE），一种利用δ-非精确Hessian的二阶凸优化方法，在两种光滑性假设下均实现了最优的次优二阶oracle复杂度，且每轮迭代时间与矩阵乘法相当。
AI.motivation: 现有二阶优化方法在非精确Hessian场景下的复杂度分析尚不充分，且缺乏匹配的下界来证明最优性。作者希望设计一种高效且理论上最优的二阶方法。
AI.method: 提出加速非精确牛顿外梯度法（AINE），利用δ-非精确Hessian信息进行加速迭代。算法结合了外梯度格式与牛顿型步长，并可在每次迭代中实现与矩阵乘法同阶的计算时间（对数因子内）。
AI.result: 当Hessian L₂-Lipschitz连续时，ISO复杂度为O((δ/ε)^{1/2} + (L₂/ε)^{2/7})；当三阶导数L₃-Lipschitz连续时，复杂度提升至O((δ/ε)^{1/2} + (L₃/ε)^{1/5})。同时建立了两种设置下的匹配oracle复杂度下界。
AI.conclusion: AINE方法在两种常见光滑性假设下均达到了最优的oracle复杂度，且计算效率高，为二阶凸优化在非精确Hessian场景下提供了理论最优解。

title: TRE: Training-Free Hallucination Detection for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (D-LLMs) have recently gained increasing attention, yet their reliability is significantly hindered by the hallucination problem. Existing hallucination detection approaches for D-LLMs mainly follow a training-based paradigm, relying on data-driven training to optimize the detector. Such reliance not only limits their generalizability across domains models but also incurs additional training cost and deployment overhead. To address these limitations, we propose TRE, a training-free hallucination detection metric for D-LLMs. TRE is a parameter-free and single-run metric that estimates hallucination risk directly from the entropy signals of a single generation, without requiring any detector training or repeated sampling. TRE extracts entropy signals within the D-LLM decoding process along both the spatial and temporal dimensions. From a token-level spatial perspective, we focus on revealing tokens as the most informative carriers of uncertainty, capturing where uncertainty is actively committed. From a diffusion step-level temporal perspective, we empirically identify the dominance of late-step entropy and hence aggregate these signals with a simple linear weighting scheme to obtain TRE. Extensive experiments on multiple D-LLMs and QA datasets demonstrate that TRE achieves competitive performance, while enjoying strong generalizability, efficiency, and robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出TRE，一种无需训练的扩散大语言模型幻觉检测指标，通过单次生成中的熵信号评估幻觉风险，无需训练或重复采样。
AI.motivation: 现有D-LLM幻觉检测方法依赖训练，泛化性差且成本高，亟需无需训练的高效检测方案。
AI.method: 从空间（token级关注揭示令牌）和时间（扩散步级关注后期步熵）两个维度提取熵信号，通过线性加权聚合得到TRE指标。
AI.result: 在多个D-LLM和QA数据集上，TRE达到与训练方法相当的检测性能，同时具有强泛化性、高效性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: TRE是一种无需训练、参数自由、单次运行的幻觉检测方法，有效解决现有方法的泛化性和成本问题。

title: Does Graph Compression Preserve Signal Propagation?
summary: Graph compression reduces the computational cost of graph learning, but its effect on signal propagation remains largely underexplored. Existing work evaluates compression through downstream task performance or structural preservation, neither of which directly captures how propagation dynamics change after compression. We study two fundamental compression paradigms, coarsening and sparsification, and ask whether they preserve the propagation behavior of the original graph. Across five datasets, varying compression rates, and propagation depths, we measure signal behavior through three complementary metrics. Our results reveal a consistent tension between the two compression families. Sparsification retains higher signal diversity and mitigates oversmoothing, but its propagation trajectory progressively diverges from that of the original graph. Coarsening more faithfully preserves propagation behavior, but at the cost of stronger smoothing and rank collapse. These findings demonstrate that two propagation-centric objectives, preserving signal diversity and preserving propagation fidelity, are distinct and empirically at odds under graph compression, highlighting the need for evaluation protocols that jointly consider both dimensions. The code and results are available at: https://github.com/KawshikBanerjee/Compression-Propagation-Duality

AI.tldr: 本文研究了图压缩（粗化和稀疏化）对信号传播的影响。实验发现：稀疏化保留信号多样性、缓解过平滑，但传播轨迹偏离原始图；粗化更忠实保持传播行为，但导致过度平滑和秩坍塌。两者在传播保真度和信号多样性目标上存在根本性矛盾。
AI.motivation: 现有图压缩评估仅关注下游任务性能或结构保留，忽略了压缩对图信号传播动力学的直接影响，而传播行为对图学习至关重要。
AI.method: 在五个数据集上，对粗化和稀疏化两种压缩范式，通过三种互补指标（信号多样性、传播保真度等）在不同压缩率和传播深度下系统测量信号行为。
AI.result: 稀疏化保留更高信号多样性并缓解过平滑，但传播轨迹逐步偏离原始图；粗化更忠实保留传播行为，但代价是更强的平滑效应和秩坍塌。
AI.conclusion: 信号多样性和传播保真度是两个不同且在实际中相互矛盾的目标，图压缩评估应同时考虑这两个维度。

title: Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models as Components of Cognitive Computing architecture for Regulatory Knowledge Management
summary: The aim of this article is to verify whether integrating large language models (LLMs) with the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture enables their transformation from standalone generative models into components of cognitive computing infrastructure with enhanced epistemic reliability. The study proposes an architectural approach based on locally deployed LLMs operating in on-premises environments without high-end GPU accelerators and examines their applicability in supporting regulatory management processes requiring continuous analysis and interpretation of legal acts. The proposed solution combines local LLMs with external knowledge repositories, creating a hybrid cognitive architecture in which the language model performs semantic interpretation while the RAG layer provides controlled knowledge retrieval, contextualization, and traceability of information sources. The implementation was validated using the Ollama and LM Studio execution environments together with the Polish language models Bielik and PLLuM running on consumer-class hardware. The results demonstrate that augmenting LLMs with RAG significantly improves the factual consistency, domain specificity and normative precision of generated texts while reducing the risk of unsupported content generation. Furthermore, the study shows that integrating RAG introduces auditability, controlled knowledge management and dynamic updating of regulatory information without retraining the language model. The findings indicate that locally deployed LLMs enhanced with RAG should be regarded not merely as text generation tools but as semantic processing modules within cognitive computing infrastructures supporting regulatory compliance and organizational decision-making in environments characterized by high legal and informational volatility.

AI.tldr: 本文验证了将大语言模型与检索增强生成架构结合，可在无高端GPU的本地环境中提升事实一致性与规范准确性，使LLM从生成工具转变为支持法规合规管理的认知计算语义处理模块。
AI.motivation: 探索LLM在本地低算力环境下能否通过RAG架构获得更高的认知可靠性，以支持需要持续分析法规文件的高度动态且信息复杂的监管管理流程。
AI.method: 提出混合认知架构：本地部署LLM（Bielik、PLLuM）作为语义解释模块，RAG层负责受控知识检索、上下文化与来源可追溯；在Ollama和LM Studio环境中于消费级硬件上实现，使用波兰语模型进行验证。
AI.result: RAG增强显著提升了文本的事实一致性、领域特异性和规范精确性，降低了无依据内容生成的风险；同时实现了可审计性、知识受控管理以及在无需重训练条件下的法规信息动态更新。
AI.conclusion: 本地部署的LLM经RAG增强后不应仅被视为文本生成工具，而应作为认知计算基础设施中的语义处理模块，适用于高法律与信息波动性环境下的合规管理和组织决策。

title: Using Subproblem Objective Gaps in Inexact Augmented Lagrangian and ADMM Algorithms, with Applications to Stochastic Mixed Integer Programming
summary: Through a "partial strong convexity" lemma, this paper shows how bounds on subproblem objective value suboptimality can be used in inexact augmented Lagrangian methods and ADMM algorithms. The ADMM result uses a small but important refinement on a long-standing criterion for approximately solving subproblems. The results enable two new approaches to computing Lagrangian bounds on the optimal values of stochastic mixed-integer programming problems, with simpler convergence analysis than the prior state of the art. In each case, the subproblems are solved by variants of the classical Frank-Wolfe algorithm. However, as compared to prior methods of the same type, there is much more freedom in the choice of Frank-Wolfe variant.

AI.tldr: 本文通过“部分强凸性”引理，展示了如何在非精确增广拉格朗日方法和ADMM算法中利用子问题目标值次优性界限。ADMM结果对长期存在的子问题近似求解标准进行了重要改进。这些成果为随机混合整数规划问题提供了两种新的拉格朗日界限计算方法，收敛性分析更简洁，且在Frank-Wolfe算法变体选择上具有更大自由度。
AI.motivation: 现有非精确增广拉格朗日方法和ADMM算法在子问题求解精度与收敛性分析之间存在严格约束，特别是在随机混合整数规划中计算拉格朗日界限时，收敛性分析复杂且对子问题求解算法（如Frank-Wolfe）的选择限制较多。
AI.method: 提出“部分强凸性”引理，利用子问题目标值次优性界限来放松收敛条件；在ADMM中细化了长期使用的子问题近似求解准则；结合Frank-Wolfe算法变体求解子问题。
AI.result: 为随机混合整数规划问题提供了两种新的拉格朗日界限计算方法，收敛性分析比现有方法更简单，且Frank-Wolfe变体选择更加灵活。
AI.conclusion: 本文的理论贡献（部分强凸性引理及ADMM准则改进）有效简化了收敛分析，并显著提升了算法在实际应用中的灵活性和实用性。

title: CuraWeb: Joint Optimization of Quality, Redundancy, and Diversity for Web-Scale Pretraining Data
summary: Open-web corpora curated via highly selective filters, such as FineWeb-Edu and DCLM, constitute the core of LLM pretraining data and have significantly advanced LLM performance. However, these pipelines typically rely on singular optimization objectives, which inevitably narrows distributional diversity and marginalizes long-tail knowledge, thereby restricting data coverage and underutilizing the vast potential of the open web. To address this limitation, we propose a novel curation paradigm that shifts from linear pruning to the joint optimization of quality, redundancy, and diversity. This framework synergizes dual-track cleaning (rule-based and model-driven) with hybrid deduplication (n-gram and semantic), while employing a multi-objective sampler to balance informational quality with distributional breadth. Applying this framework to Common Crawl, we construct CuraWeb, a 2T-token English corpus. Unlike existing resources, CuraWeb establishes an industrial-grade standard for data curation by recovering a more holistic data distribution with enhanced diversity and minimal redundancy, achieving broader coverage of long-tail knowledge across diverse domains. Experimental evaluations at the 3B scale demonstrate that CuraWeb significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, yielding an average performance gain of 1.8\% across a wide range of benchmarks, particularly in knowledge-intensive and reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的数据策展范式CuraWeb，通过联合优化质量、冗余度和多样性来构建高质量预训练语料库，在Common Crawl上构建了2T token的英文语料，在3B规模实验中平均性能提升1.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有数据策展管线（如FineWeb-Edu、DCLM）通常采用单一优化目标（如质量筛选），虽然提升了LLM性能，但不可避免地窄化了数据分布的多样性，边缘化了长尾知识，未能充分利用开放网络的数据潜力。
AI.method: 提出从线性筛选转向质量、冗余度和多样性的联合优化范式。具体包括：（1）双轨清洗（基于规则和基于模型）；（2）混合去重（n-gram和语义）；（3）多目标采样器以平衡信息质量和分布广度。
AI.result: 在Common Crawl上构建了CuraWeb（2T token英文语料），在3B规模实验中平均性能提升1.8%，尤其在知识密集型和推理任务上表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化质量、冗余度和多样性的数据策展范式比单一质量筛选更有效，能够恢复更全面的数据分布，提升长尾知识覆盖，显著优于现有基线方法。

title: SPRKD: Effective Knowledge Distillation for Deep Neural Networks via Saddle Region Approximation
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. Code and reproduction scripts: https://github.com/thetechdude124/SADDLE-POINT-RECRUITMENT-FOR-KNOWLEDGE-DISTILLATION. Awarded 2nd Place in Mathematical and Cybersecurity Research (NSA) at Regeneron ISEF 2023 and an Outstanding Research Award at WAICY (World AI Competition for Youth) 2022
summary: Modern deep neural networks are potent catalysts for scientific and industrial impact, yet excessive parameter counts impede deployment in low-compute settings such as hospital equipment and energy infrastructure. Predominant knowledge distillation (KD) methods favor replication: smaller students mimic teacher output logits, yet empirically yield low task performance, hamper convergence, and act merely as regularization rather than substantive knowledge transfer. We propose Saddle Point Recruitment for Knowledge Distillation (SPRKD), reframing distillation from replication to employing teachers as optimization-curvature and domain proxies, characterizing saddle points as regions of strong further-descent potential via embedding and basin-fractal properties. Using Hessian eigenvalue spectral density (ESD), SPRKD identifies low-loss saddle regions for student re-exploration; weak-teacher ensembles are aggregated into an Approximated Saddle Region (ASR), re-parameterized into the student via Transfer Learning by Injection, and approached with exponentially decaying Euclidean transformations, Negative Hessian Eigensteps, and Gaussian perturbations. On malaria blood smear classification with a 6,430-parameter CNN distilled from a weak 25,546-parameter teacher, SPRKD reaches 94.8% validation accuracy, outperforming Response KD by 24.70 percentage points (McNemar p = 6.3e-87) and matching scratch-trained baselines of the same architecture to statistical equivalence (p = 1.0). Across MNIST, CIFAR-100, and TinyImageNet, SPRKD exceeds scratch-trained baselines by up to 8 percentage points on preliminary benchmarks. Hessian ESD and 2-D loss landscape analysis show convergence to wider minima with substantially smaller Hessian trace and spectral radius than Response KD and control students, indicating smoother descent and greater noise robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出SPRKD知识蒸馏方法，将教师网络视为优化曲率与领域代理而非简单复制，通过鞍点招募机制让学生网络重新探索低损鞍区，在极低参数量（6430参数）CNN上达到94.8%验证准确率，超越Response KD 24.70个百分点。
AI.motivation: 传统知识蒸馏（KD）让学生模仿教师输出logits，仅起到正则化作用而非实质性知识迁移，导致任务性能低、收敛困难。作者希望将蒸馏从"复制"重新定义为"利用教师作为优化曲率和领域代理"。
AI.method: SPRKD：1) 利用Hessian特征值谱密度识别低损鞍点区域；2) 将弱教师集聚合为近似鞍区；3) 通过注入式迁移学习重新参数化到学生网络；4) 采用指数衰减欧氏变换、负Hessian特征步和高斯扰动向鞍区逼近。
AI.result: 在疟疾血涂片分类任务中，6430参数CNN从25546参数教师蒸馏，达94.8%验证准确率，比Response KD高24.70个百分点；在MNIST、CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet上超越从头训练基线最多8个百分点；收敛到更宽极小值，Hessian迹和谱半径显著更小。
AI.conclusion: SPRKD证明了将教师视为优化曲率代理的有效性，尤其在极低计算资源场景下表现卓越，为知识蒸馏提供了全新范式——从模仿转向鞍点招募与再探索。

title: Keep It InMind: Benchmarking the Implicit-Association Blind Spot in Agent Memory
summary: Long-term memory systems store what a user says in an external store and retrieve it when a related query arrives. This interface rests on an assumption so natural that it is rarely stated: a memory that is needed will resemble the query that needs it. World knowledge breaks the assumption. A tree-nut allergy should change the answer to a macaron request through their almond-flour ingredient, yet the two texts share no cue a retriever can see. We call this failure mode the implicit-association blind spot and introduce InMind, a 125-task, expert-verified benchmark spanning ten life domains, with 113 tasks grounded in citable public sources. Its paired controls separate three explanations that existing evaluations conflate: the fact was never stored, the model lacks the bridging knowledge, or the fact was stored and never surfaced. The verdict is clean. With the decisive memory placed in context, the backbone answers 84.0 percent of indirect queries; when the same memory must be retrieved, six vector, graph, and agentic memory systems reach at most 14.4 percent, even though they recall the same facts on demand at up to 100 percent. An embedding with eight times the dimensionality raises answer-blind target recall for every system yet leaves the gap essentially intact. A minimal diagnostic probe that keeps memory visible before the query arrives recovers most of the gap, locating the failure in the query-conditioned interface itself and pointing to routing, deciding which facts must stay visible, as the open problem InMind is built to score.

AI.tldr: 本文指出长期记忆系统依赖“相似查询才能检索到相关记忆”的假设存在致命缺陷（隐式关联盲点），并构建了包含125个任务的InMind基准测试，证明现有向量、图、智能体记忆系统在间接查询中准确率仅14.4%，而将记忆直接放入上下文可达84.0%，揭示了查询条件化接口本身的根本问题。
AI.motivation: 现有长期记忆系统假设“需要的记忆会与查询相似”，但世界知识（如杏仁过敏与马卡龙请求的关联）打破了这一假设。已有评估混淆了三种解释（事实从未存储、模型缺乏桥接知识、事实存储但未能浮出），缺乏分离这些因素的精细基准。
AI.method: 构建InMind基准：125个任务覆盖10个生活领域，113个任务基于可引用的公开来源，配对被控组分离三种失败解释。测试6种主流记忆系统（向量、图、智能体），并将记忆直接放入上下文作为上界对比。使用8倍维度嵌入和最小诊断探针（在查询前保持记忆可见）进行消融分析。
AI.result: 记忆放入上下文时模型回答间接查询准确率84.0%；6种记忆系统检索后仅达14.4%（即使直接回忆事实准确率100%）。8倍维度嵌入提升了盲目标召回率但未缩小性能差距。最小诊断探针恢复了大部分差距，定位失败根源在查询条件化接口本身。
AI.conclusion: 长期记忆系统的根本问题在于查询条件化的路由/决策接口——如何决定哪些事实必须保持可见性。InMind基准为这一开放问题提供了标准化评分平台。

title: Communication Security via Temporal Dependency
summary: Communication security has traditionally been built upon one of two external resources: shared secret keys or a communication advantage over the eavesdropper. However, many practical wireless scenarios, including infrastructure-less, emergency, and highly dynamic networks, cannot guarantee either resource, motivating the need for a new communication security principle. This paper introduces a new communication security paradigm that exploits temporal dependency as a security resource. Unlike conventional secrecy techniques that prevent an eavesdropper from recovering transmitted bits, the proposed paradigm allows packet decoding but prevents correct interpretation by making original and dummy packets computationally indistinguishable. Rather than protecting individual transmissions, successive transmissions are intentionally coupled so that future communication depends on correctly interpreting previous ones. As one realization, we develop a state-chained random linear network coding (RLNC) framework in which the synchronization state required to interpret each transmission block is embedded in the previous block. Therefore, synchronization failures propagate across future transmissions, resulting in persistent eavesdropper asynchronization. We analytically characterize the probability and persistence of eavesdropper asynchronization, together with the computational complexity of resynchronization, and develop transmission strategies based on transmit power and intentional-interference optimization. Numerical results demonstrate sub-second eavesdropper asynchronization under a worst- case adversarial model with no channel advantage, no secret assumptions, complete protocol knowledge, and an arbitrarily stronger eavesdropper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用时间依赖性作为安全资源的新型通信安全范式。通过状态链式随机线性网络编码（RLNC）框架，使同步状态在连续传输块之间相互耦合，导致窃听者一旦失步将持续失步。即使在无信道优势、无密钥假设、窃听者完全了解协议且更强大的最坏情况下，也能实现亚秒级窃听者失步。
AI.motivation: 传统通信安全依赖共享密钥或信道优势，但在基础设施缺失、紧急通信和高度动态网络中这两种资源都无法保证。因此需要一种不依赖这些外部资源的新型通信安全原则。
AI.method: 提出状态链式随机线性网络编码（RLNC）框架。将解释每个传输块所需的同步状态嵌入到前一个块中，使连续传输被有意耦合。后续通信的正确性依赖于对之前传输的正确解释，同步失败会在后续传输中传播，导致窃听者持续失步。
AI.result: 在窃听者无信道优势、无密钥假设、完全了解协议且算力更强的极端对抗模型下，仍能实现亚秒级窃听者失步。论文还分析了失步概率、失步持久性及重新同步的计算复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 时间依赖性可以作为一种新的安全资源，为无法保证传统安全资源的无线场景提供有效的通信安全保障。基于发射功率和有意干扰优化的传输策略可进一步增强安全性。

title: Beyond Block Boundaries: Multi-Block Editing for Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Block diffusion has emerged as the dominant paradigm for scaling discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs), because decoding text in fixed-size blocks preserves parallel generation within each block while keeping the quadratic attention cost tractable. However, this efficiency comes with a structural limitation: tokens near the end of a block are generated without access to future cross-block context, and once a block is finalized, its uncertain predictions become irreversible context for all subsequent blocks. This creates a block boundary problem, in which uncertainty accumulates toward block boundaries and early mistakes propagate throughout later generation. To address this issue, we propose Multi-Block Editing (MBE), to mitigate this problem by editing decoded tokens based on cross-block context. Following this principle, MBE first proposes a training-free decoding algorithm to edit the decoded tokens in previous blocks, which is achieved by re-opening a full-attention window over selected blocks. Given the mismatched attention mechanism between block diffusion training and MBE inference, MBE further introduces a supervised Fine-tuning strategy, which equips the model with bidirectional attention masks that progressively expands the editing span. Furthermore, it also extends SGLang with a multi-shape CUDA Graph pool and fine-grained KV cache control to make these variable-length editing passes efficient in practice. Experiments on LLaDA2.1-Mini across 13 benchmarks show that training-free MBE outperforms all existing decoding baselines while maintaining comparable throughput, and MBE SFT further brings a performance gain of 2.7. The largest improvements appear on tasks requiring strong long-range consistency, including +13.3 on AIME 2025 and +5.9 on ZebraLogic, demonstrating the effectiveness of MBE.

AI.tldr: 针对块扩散离散语言模型中的块边界问题（边界处不确定性累积及早前错误传播），提出多块编辑（MBE）方法，通过训练无关解码算法和微调策略，基于跨块上下文编辑已解码token，在13个基准上取得显著提升，尤其长距离一致性任务表现突出。
AI.motivation: 块扩散模型虽能实现并行生成和控制注意力开销，但存在结构性缺陷：块末尾token缺乏未来跨块上下文，且一旦块被确定，其不确定的预测将成为后续所有块的不可逆上下文，导致块边界处不确定性累积，早期错误不断传播。
AI.method: 提出MBE方法：1）训练无关解码算法，通过重新打开跨选定块的全注意力窗口来编辑先前块中的token；2）监督微调策略，使用逐步扩展编辑跨度的双向注意力掩码，使模型适配MBE推理；3）扩展SGLang引擎，引入多形状CUDA Graph池和细粒度KV缓存控制以实现高效变长编辑。
AI.result: 在LLaDA2.1-Mini上的13个基准实验中，训练无关MBE超越所有现有解码基线且保持可比吞吐量；MBE SFT额外带来2.7%的性能提升。在长距离一致性任务上改进最大：AIME 2025提升13.3，ZebraLogic提升5.9。
AI.conclusion: MBE有效缓解了块扩散模型的边界问题，通过基于跨块上下文的编辑机制显著提升生成质量，尤其在需要长距离语义一致性的任务上效果突出。

title: Closed-Loop Validation-Repair for Healthcare Interoperability: A Multi-Model Study of Schema Compliance in Clinical LLMs
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC 2026)
summary: Healthcare interoperability requires AI systems to produce structured outputs conforming to standardized schemas including ICD-10 for diagnostic coding, CPT for procedure billing, and HL7 FHIR for data exchange. While large language models demonstrate clinical reasoning capabilities, their integration into electronic health record systems faces a critical barrier: schema noncompliance. We evaluate three open-source models, Qwen2.5 7B, Llama 3.1 8B, and Gemma2 9B, via local deployment across 320 clinical scenarios spanning ten medical specialties, yielding 960 model-scenario pairs assessed under paired baseline and validation-repair conditions. First, schema noncompliance is consistent across the three model families, with baseline compliance rates ranging from 85.9 to 91.6 percent despite varying architectures and training data, suggesting shared gaps in medical training corpora rather than model-specific limitations. Second, 96 percent of validator-detected failures are representation-level format violations such as alternative medical abbreviations and code prefixes, indicating models follow clinical writing conventions but lack awareness of healthcare IT standards. Third, the validation-repair framework achieves 99.0 percent overall compliance, ranging from 98.4 to 99.4 percent across models, with most errors resolving within one or two iterations. Exact McNemar p-values below 0.001 and absolute improvements of 7.8 to 12.5 percentage points across model sizes confirm statistical significance. These results support closed-loop validation-repair as an effective system-level safeguard for healthcare interoperability, improving schema-level readiness for downstream clinical system integration.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了三种开源LLM在临床场景中的模式合规性，发现基线合规率85.9-91.6%，通过验证-修复框架可将合规率提升至99.0%，大多数错误在一到两次迭代中解决。
AI.motivation: 医疗互操作性需要AI系统生成符合ICD-10、CPT、HL7 FHIR等标准化模式的结构化输出，但LLM与电子健康记录系统集成面临模式不合规的关键障碍。
AI.method: 本地部署Qwen2.5 7B、Llama 3.1 8B、Gemma2 9B三种开源模型，在320个跨越10个医学专科的临床场景中评估，共960个模型-场景对，在基线和验证-修复条件下进行比较。
AI.result: 基线合规率85.9-91.6%；96%的失败是表示层格式违规；验证-修复框架实现99.0%总体合规率，错误在一到两次迭代内解决；统计检验显著（p<0.001），绝对提升7.8-12.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 闭环验证-修复作为有效的系统级保障措施可提升医疗互操作性的模式合规性，改善下游临床系统集成的模式就绪度。

title: Fixed-time stabilization of systems with nilpotent matrices in the presence of large unknown delays
summary: In this paper, we study state-feedback fixed-time stabilization of continuous-time perturbed linear systems with nilpotent matrices in the presence of unknown large constant input/measurement delays with known bounds.
