PANOPTICON thus emerges as the first benchmark dataset for studying PIAs over private corpora, providing a foundation for future LLM privacy research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PANOPTICON管道和数据集，利用Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型生成包含PII的提示数据，旨在为研究提示反转攻击（PIA）提供首个基准数据集，推动LLM隐私研究。
AI.motivation: LLM在完成任务时常需插入个人身份信息（PII），但缺乏公开的真实PII数据集，难以量化隐私风险。伦理问题阻碍了真实PII数据集的构建，因此需要合成数据集来研究隐私问题。
AI.method: 利用Meta的Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型生成67,718条提示，基于9,674个公开可用的合成用户档案构建PII跨度；通过词汇多样性和S-BERT多样性评估数据集 realism。
AI.result: 生成了一个包含67,718条提示的数据集，词汇多样性和S-BERT多样性评估表明数据集具有一定真实性；通过提示反转攻击案例研究展示了数据集的实用性。
AI.conclusion: PANOPTICON是首个用于研究私有语料库上提示反转攻击的基准数据集，为未来LLM隐私研究奠定了基础。

title: Learning to Optimize: Joint Routing and Flow Allocation on Sparse Non-Euclidean Networks
summary: We study an integrated pickup-and-delivery problem on sparse, non-Euclidean networks that jointly optimizes cyclic routing, cargo flow allocation, and cross-cycle service. The tight coupling of these operational constraints creates a complex discrete-continuous decision space with highly restricted feasible regions. To overcome these computational challenges, we propose Double-Channel Graph Attention (DCGA), an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework. DCGA isolates network reachability and demand-service logic into separate graph channels and constructs valid routes using a simulator-coupled, constraint-informed decoder. Experiments on LinerLib benchmarks demonstrate that DCGA achieves seconds-level inference and delivers state-of-the-art solution quality on instances beyond a specific scale, with its advantage over existing baselines widening significantly as problem size increases. Supported by extensive stability and ablation analyses, our results demonstrate that this structure-aware learning approach provides an effective, low-latency engine for realistic routing-and-flow optimization.

AI.tldr: 针对稀疏非欧网络上的联合取送货问题，提出双通道图注意力（DCGA）端到端强化学习框架，将网络可达性与需求服务逻辑分离为双图通道，结合仿真耦合解码器生成有效路径，在LinerLib基准上实现秒级推理，在大规模问题上显著超越现有基线。
AI.motivation: 稀疏非欧网络中联合优化循环路径、货流分配与跨周期服务存在紧密耦合的离散-连续决策空间及高度受限的可行域，传统方法计算困难，亟需高效低延迟的求解方案。
AI.method: 提出DCGA端到端强化学习框架：双通道图注意力机制分别编码网络可达性与需求服务约束，采用模拟器耦合的约束感知解码器构建可行路径。
AI.result: 在LinerLib基准上实现秒级推理；特定规模以上实例取得最优解质量；随问题规模增大，相比现有基线优势显著扩大；稳定性与消融实验验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 这种结构感知的学习方法为实际路由与流量优化提供了高效、低延迟的求解引擎。

title: Test-Time Coverage: Test-Conditioned Data Curation for Deployment-Aware Learning
summary: Deployed AI systems are often trained from broad candidate data pools, necessitating data curation towards the deployment test distribution. However, standard data curation methods score training-side criteria rather than directly optimizing deployment match. We introduce TTCov (Test-Time Coverage), a data-level test-conditioned curation method that uses test-side information before training instead of updating model weights at inference. TTCov decomposes deployment-conditioned curation into coverage and distribution. To represent coverage, it builds a task Atlas, a collection of LLM-based atomic propositions (APs) describing deployment-relevant concepts, seeded from open task knowledge and expanded with unmatched APs extracted from unlabeled deployment samples. To represent distribution, it instantiates the matched deployment APs with their frequencies, yielding a Knowledge Atlas (K-Atlas) that operationalizes the deployment distribution as a curation target. TTCov then selects a budgeted training set whose deployment APs distribution approximates this target. We apply TTCov towards autonomous driving (AD), keeping adaptation off the inference path while selecting data with greater deployment-relevant coverage, closer K-Atlas matching, and stronger downstream end-to-end driving performance than data-curation baselines, including seamless adaptability to novel domains via city-to-city expansion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TTCov方法，在训练前利用测试侧信息进行数据筛选，提升部署分布匹配度，在自动驾驶领域表现优于传统数据筛选方法。
AI.motivation: 现有数据筛选方法仅基于训练侧标准评分，未能直接优化数据与部署测试分布的匹配度，导致模型在部署时性能受限。
AI.method: TTCov将部署条件数据筛选分解为覆盖度和分布两部分。通过构建任务Atlas（基于LLM的原子命题集合）表示覆盖度，再结合部署样本频率生成K-Atlas作为筛选目标，最后选择训练子集使其K-Atlas分布逼近目标分布。
AI.result: 在自动驾驶任务中，TTCov筛选的数据具有更高的部署相关覆盖度、更接近的K-Atlas匹配度，以及更强的端到端驾驶性能，且能通过城市间扩展无缝适应新领域。
AI.conclusion: TTCov通过训练前利用测试信息进行数据筛选，在不增加推理负担的前提下有效提升了模型与部署分布的匹配度，为数据筛选提供了新范式。

title: Sparse Gaussian-Mixture-Model Q-Functions via Hadamard Overparametrization for Online Reinforcement Learning
comment: This work has been submitted to the Elsevier for possible publication
summary: This paper develops an online, off-policy policy-iteration framework for reinforcement learning (RL), based on sparse Gaussian-mixture-model Q-functions (S-GMM-QFs). The framework reconciles streaming, non-stationary data with the Riemannian structure of the parameter space while handling distributional mismatch through experience replay. S-GMM-QFs are introduced via Hadamard overparametrization, enabling interpretable sparsification through smooth regularization that facilitates Riemannian-based optimization. Overparametrization allows the framework to adaptively identify meaningful components from a large initial pool, yielding sparse models where interpretability emerges naturally from geometry: each component's parameters (means and covariances) explicitly encode its geometric role in the ambient state-action space. These geometric roles are learned through online gradient descent on a smooth objective over a (Cartesian-product) Riemannian manifold. Numerical tests demonstrate that S-GMM-QFs match or exceed deep RL methods while using substantially fewer parameters and achieving faster improvement per observed transition. Notably, parameter efficiency and interpretability combine to maintain strong generalization in low-parameter regimes where sparsified deep RL approaches degrade.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于稀疏高斯混合模型Q函数（S-GMM-QFs）的在线离线策略迭代强化学习框架，通过Hadamard过参数化和黎曼流形优化，在保持参数效率和可解释性的同时达到或超越深度RL方法性能。
AI.motivation: 现有深度RL方法参数冗余、可解释性差，且在低参数稀疏化场景下性能退化严重；同时离线策略学习中的分布不匹配问题需要有效处理。
AI.method: 采用Hadamard过参数化构建S-GMM-QFs，通过光滑正则化实现可解释的稀疏化；在黎曼流形上进行在线梯度下降优化；结合经验回放处理非平稳数据和分布不匹配问题。
AI.result: 数值实验表明S-GMM-QFs在参数更少的情况下达到或超越深度RL方法，且每步转换的改进速度更快；在低参数区间，稀疏化深度RL方法性能退化时S-GMM-QFs仍保持强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 参数效率与可解释性的结合使得S-GMM-QFs在低参数场景下具有显著优势，组件的几何角色自然编码了状态-动作空间的结构信息。

title: Similarity All The Way Up: Multilingual Generalization in LLMs Relies on Language-Level Similarity Structures
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) grow more capable across diverse tasks, their (in)ability to generalize remains difficult to quantify and poorly understood beyond limited domains. In particular, LLMs are known to struggle generalizing multilingually, to languages outside of English, and that are poorly attested in their training data. To understand why this may be, and what enables some models to perform better than others, we turn to a long history of work across the cognitive sciences, arguing that successful generalization derives from appropriate representations in similarity space. We look at how well LLMs' representations capture the hierarchical similarity structure between distinct languages. Strikingly, we show LLMs' latent representations largely recover the hierarchical structure of the Indo-European language family tree -- grouping languages that are members of the same subfamily closely together in representation space. Furthermore, we show that the degree to which models reflect the similarity structure of languages correlates with their performance on XNLI, a multilingual natural language inference benchmark. This extends classic work on similarity-driven generalization at scale, showing how models that represent similar languages similarly generalize better from one language to another.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型多语言泛化能力与表征空间中语言相似性结构之间的关系，发现模型能恢复印欧语系层级结构，且这种结构与跨语言推理任务性能正相关。
AI.motivation: 探索大语言模型在多语言任务上泛化能力差异的原因，理解为何有些模型在非英语语言上表现更好，以及模型表征空间的语言相似性结构如何影响跨语言泛化。
AI.method: 借鉴认知科学中相似性驱动的泛化理论，分析LLM隐层表征是否捕捉到语言间的层级相似性结构（如印欧语系树状结构），并通过XNLI基准测试评估表征结构与跨语言性能的相关性。
AI.result: LLM的隐层表征在很大程度上恢复了印欧语系家族树的层级结构（同一子族的语言在表征空间中紧密相邻）；模型反映语言相似性结构的程度与XNLI上的性能呈正相关。
AI.conclusion: 将经典的相似性驱动泛化理论扩展到大规模场景，表明能够将相似语言表征得相似的模型，跨语言泛化能力更强。

title: RoleMix: Unifying Sequential and Non-Sequential Features via Semantic Tokenization for Post-Click Conversion Rate Prediction
summary: Post-click conversion rate (PCVR) prediction is central to industrial recommendation, but remains challenged by the structural mismatch between sparse, unordered multi-field features and long, domain-specific behavior histories. Existing models often process these signals through separate pathways and fuse them late, weakening semantic roles and limiting cross-signal refinement. We propose RoleMix, a unified interaction architecture that represents sequential and non-sequential evidence through a shared, role-preserving token interface. Non-sequential fields are converted into explicit semantic tokens that preserve user, item, pairwise, dense, contextual, and cross-feature roles, while long behavior domains are compressed into item- and context-aware sequence-query tokens through two-stage hierarchical window attention. The resulting global, semantic, and sequence-query tokens are jointly refined by stacked UniMixing-Lite blocks for PCVR prediction. On the large-scale KDD Cup 2026 Tencent UniRec Challenge, RoleMix achieves 83.648% online AUC, outperforming the official industrial baseline by 1.953%. Ablation studies show that semantic tokenization yields the largest isolated gain, highlighting a key principle for large-scale PCVR modeling: preserving field semantics at the token-interface level is as important as scaling the interaction backbone.

AI.tldr: RoleMix提出统一交互架构，通过角色保留的令牌接口融合非序列化多字段特征与长序列行为历史，在KDD Cup 2026数据集上实现83.648%在线AUC，超越基线1.953%。
AI.motivation: 现有PCVR预测模型将稀疏多字段特征与长行为历史通过分离路径处理并晚期融合，导致语义角色弱化且跨信号精炼受限。
AI.method: 设计共享角色保留令牌接口：非序列字段转换为语义令牌（用户/物品/成对/密集/上下文/交叉特征），长行为域通过两阶段分层窗口注意力压缩为物品感知和上下文感知的序列查询令牌，三者经UniMixing-Lite块联合精炼。
AI.result: 在KDD Cup 2026 Tencent UniRec Challenge上达到83.648%在线AUC，超越工业基线1.953%；消融实验显示语义令牌化贡献最大增益。
AI.conclusion: 在大规模PCVR建模中，在令牌接口层面保留字段语义与扩展交互骨干同等重要。

title: Charging Phase Health Indicators for Battery State-of-Health Estimation: A Systematic Comparison of CC, CV, and Combined Approaches under Cross-Battery Validation
comment: This paper has been published in Eksploatacja i Niezawodnosc. Please cite the published version
summary: Accurate State-of-Health estimation is essential for safe battery operation and cost-effective maintenance. Although numerous health indicators have been derived from constant-current (CC) and constant-voltage (CV) charging phases, their effectiveness under realistic cross-battery validation remains insufficiently studied. This work addresses this gap through a systematic comparison of CC-only, CV-only, and combined indicator sets using rigorous Leave-One-Battery-Out (LOBO) validation on the NASA battery aging dataset. Four CV-phase indicators and CC phase duration are evaluated individually and in combination. Results show that the combined CC+CV approach achieves the best performance (R2 = 0.874), confirming that CC and CV phases capture complementary degradation information. Moreover, a 119% performance gap is observed between standard 5-fold cross-validation and LOBO validation, indicating that conventional evaluation overestimates practical accuracy. Based on these findings, practical guidelines are provided for indicator selection under data and computational constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了恒流（CC）和恒压（CV）充电阶段的健康指标在跨电池验证中的效果，发现CC+CV组合指标效果最佳（R²=0.874），且传统5折交叉验证相比留一电池法（LOBO）高估了119%的性能，据此提出了实际应用中的指标选择指南。
AI.motivation: 针对现有研究对CC和CV充电阶段健康指标在跨电池验证（LOBO）下的有效性缺乏系统评估的空白，本文旨在填补该研究缺口。
AI.method: 在NASA电池老化数据集上，采用严格的留一电池法（LOBO）验证，系统比较了仅CC、仅CV以及CC+CV组合指标集的效果，评估了四个CV阶段指标和CC阶段时长。
AI.result: CC+CV组合方法表现最佳（R²=0.874）；标准5折交叉验证与LOBO验证之间存在119%的性能差距，表明传统评估方法高估了实际精度。
AI.conclusion: CC和CV阶段捕捉了互补的退化信息，组合使用效果更优；传统交叉验证会显著高估模型在实际跨电池场景中的表现；基于发现提供了数据与计算资源受限下的指标选择实用指南。

title: MPR-CiteG: Enhancing RAG with Multi-Portfolio Retrieval and Citation-Grounded Generation
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables. The 1st International Workshop on Retrieval-Driven Generative AI & ScienceON AI Challenge 2025@CIKM
summary: This paper presents the MPR-CiteG framework, which achieved second place in the ScienceON AI Challenge by addressing two fundamental challenges in generative AI: inefficient retrieval and the absence of source verification. We propose a dual-component system, termed MPR-CiteG, in which the Multi-Portfolio Retriever (MPR) efficiently retrieves diverse and relevant information, while the Citation-Grounded Generation (CiteG) module ensures that every generated output remains factually consistent and explicitly attributed to its source. MPR-CiteG represents a significant step toward building more trustworthy and accurate LLMs that are not only capable of generating information but also of grounding their responses in reliable evidence, thereby mitigating common issues like model hallucination. Extensive experiments on the challenge dataset validate the effectiveness and reliability of our approach. Our code is available at https://github.com/2noweyh/MPR-citeG.

AI.tldr: MPR-CiteG框架通过双组件系统（多组合检索器+引用生成模块）在ScienceON AI挑战赛中获得第二名，解决了生成式AI中的检索低效和源验证缺失问题。
AI.motivation: 解决生成式AI中的两个核心挑战：检索效率低下以及生成内容缺乏来源验证，旨在缓解模型幻觉问题。
AI.method: 提出双组件系统：Multi-Portfolio Retriever (MPR)负责高效检索多样化相关信息，Citation-Grounded Generation (CiteG)模块确保生成内容事实一致且明确标注来源。
AI.result: 在ScienceON AI挑战赛数据集上通过大量实验验证了方法的有效性和可靠性，获得第二名。
AI.conclusion: MPR-CiteG是构建更可信、更准确的LLM的重要一步，能够将生成内容锚定在可靠证据上，缓解模型幻觉。

title: An adaptive multi-fuzzy logic model for diagnosing transformer faults using dynamic weight optimization
comment: This paper has been published in e-Prime - Advances in Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Energy. Please cite the published version
summary: Dissolved gas analysis (DGA) is crucial for diagnosing early power transformer failures. Traditional DGA interpretation methods like Duval Triangle, IEC ratio, Roger ratio, Doernenburg ratio and Key Gas are inconsistent and vary in accuracy, especially for multiple fault conditions. We propose an Adaptive Multi-Fuzzy Logic (AMFL) model integrating multiple DGA methods with fuzzy logic and a dynamic weight adjustment mechanism. Unlike existing approaches with fixed weights, this system iteratively evaluates each method's diagnostic performance, identifies multiple fault types, and adjusts weights based on fault prediction accuracy. A feedback-based optimization recalibrates weights after each cycle to ensure optimal solution convergence. The model, implemented in MATLAB/Simulink, is validated against DGA datasets with known error conditions. Results show the AMFL model significantly improves diagnostic accuracy, especially in complex error scenarios, and enhances adaptability to new datasets. Comparative analysis demonstrates the proposed method outperforms traditional fixed weight multi-fuzzy systems in accuracy, consistency, and reliability of error detection. This work provides a robust, flexible diagnostic tool for transformer condition monitoring and supports more accurate asset management decisions.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种自适应多模糊逻辑（AMFL）模型，通过动态权重调整机制融合多种DGA方法，在变压器故障诊断中显著提高了准确性和适应性，优于传统固定权重方法。
AI.motivation: 传统DGA解释方法（如Duval三角、IEC比率、Roger比率等）在多故障条件下存在不一致性和精度不足的问题，亟需更可靠、自适应的诊断模型。
AI.method: 提出AMFL模型，将多种DGA方法与模糊逻辑结合，并引入动态权重调整机制。通过迭代评估各方法诊断性能、识别多故障类型，并基于反馈优化循环调整权重以达到最优解收敛。
AI.result: 在MATLAB/Simulink中实现，并使用已知误差条件的DGA数据集验证。AMFL模型在复杂故障场景下显著提升了诊断精度，且对新数据集具有更好的适应性。
AI.conclusion: AMFL模型在准确率、一致性和错误检测可靠性方面均优于传统固定权重多模糊系统，为变压器状态监测提供了鲁棒、灵活的诊断工具。

title: SEGRA: Structured Experience-Guided Graph Reasoning Agent for Gremlin Based Question Answering
summary: Enterprise IT support knowledge graphs capture rich relationships among cases, users, devices, symptoms, taxonomic categories, root causes, and historical resolutions. Yet querying them in Gremlin requires knowledge of graph schemas, traversal semantics, edge directionality, and property-graph-specific constraints, making them difficult for non-expert operators to use. We introduce SEGRA, an experience-guided agent for enterprise text-to-Gremlin question answering. SEGRA integrates intent routing, schema- and taxonomy-grounded query generation, multi-shot decomposition, execution-aware verification, and a curriculum-bootstrapped skill library that reuses verified query patterns. On an enterprise IT support benchmark, SEGRA achieves a $7.0\times$ higher mean judge score than backbone-only chain-of-thought prompting. Its skill library further reduces LLM calls by $20\%$ and dollar cost by $18\%$ relative to SEGRA without skills, while preserving answer quality. These results show that schema-grounded agent design and reusable execution experience improve both accuracy and efficiency for enterprise graph QA.

AI.tldr: SEGRA是一个面向企业IT支持知识图谱的文本转Gremlin问答代理，通过意图路由、模式引导查询生成、多步分解、执行验证和课程引导技能库，在基准测试上相比基线方法提升7倍评分，同时技能库减少20%LLM调用和18%成本。
AI.motivation: 企业IT支持知识图谱包含丰富的实体关系，但非专家用户难以通过Gremlin语言进行查询，因为需要理解图模式、遍历语义、边方向性和属性图约束。
AI.method: SEGRA集成了意图路由、模式与分类学引导的查询生成、多步分解、执行感知验证以及课程引导的技能库（复用已验证的查询模式）。
AI.result: 在企业IT支持基准上，SEGRA的平均评判分数比基线思维链提示高7倍；技能库相比无技能的SEGRA减少了20%的LLM调用和18%的成本，同时保持答案质量。
AI.conclusion: 模式引导的代理设计和可复用的执行经验能同时提高企业图问答的准确性和效率。

title: Learning Sampling Parameters for Diffusion Models
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models expose many inference-time sampling parameters, including prompts, negative prompts, classifier-free guidance scales, and noise schedules. These parameters are typically manually chosen once and then held fixed across prompts and denoising timesteps, even though different prompts and stages of generation can benefit from different parameter values. We introduce LeSAMP, a framework for learning prompt-conditioned, timestep-varying sampling parameters. We formulate parameter selection as a reinforcement learning problem: Given a user prompt, a large language model is trained to emit schedules for the chosen sampling parameters. We optimize our model using rewards from human preference models and VLM-as-a-judge. We evaluate our model on Flux.1 [dev] and Stable Diffusion 3.5, and find that compared to baselines, LeSAMP has a win rate of up to 68.12% using human preference scores and 73.37% using VLM-as-a-judge. These gains are validated in a user study where we achieve win rates of up to 59.46% over previous baselines. Our results suggest that learned sampling-parameter policies provide a complementary approach to existing post-training methods for improving diffusion model outputs.

AI.tldr: 提出LeSAMP框架，利用强化学习让大语言模型为扩散模型学习随提示变化、随时间步变化的采样参数调度，在Flux.1和SD3.5上相比基线最高提升68.12%（偏好分数）和73.37%（VLM评判），用户研究胜率达59.46%。
AI.motivation: 现有文生图扩散模型的采样参数（如提示词、引导尺度、噪声调度等）在推理时通常手动固定不变，而不同提示和不同生成阶段可能受益于不同的参数值，缺乏自动化、自适应的参数选择方法。
AI.method: 将参数选择建模为强化学习问题：使用大语言模型（LLM）根据用户提示生成随时间去变化的采样参数调度，通过人类偏好模型和VLM评判器提供的奖励信号来优化LLM策略。
AI.result: 在Flux.1 [dev]和Stable Diffusion 3.5上，LeSAMP相比基线在人类偏好评分上胜率最高达68.12%，在VLM评判器上胜率最高达73.37%；用户研究中胜率达59.46%。
AI.conclusion: 学习采样参数的策略可以作为现有后训练方法的补充，进一步提升扩散模型的输出质量，且验证了让采样参数随提示和时间自适应变化的有效性。

title: Spatial Reasoning in LLM Game Agents: Impact of Causal Context and Multi-Step Planning
summary: LLM-based game agents often perform poorly on more complex tasks. This work examines whether these failures are linked to limited spatial reasoning and evaluates whether causal prompt augmentation and multi-step planning can improve win-rates while managing response latency. Using the open-source Qwen3 model family, we conduct experiments across varying model scales, reasoning modes, and planning horizons. We further introduce a focused GVGAI benchmark consisting of three custom games with five difficulty levels to isolate spatial navigation. The evaluation follows two paradigms: an initial ``positioning experiment'' to test an agent's ability to find its exact coordinates, and a study of game-play success. Our results show that while larger models with an enabled thinking mode identify their positions more accurately, overall performance in coordinate matching remains limited for smaller models. Win rates decrease as game levels and layout complexity increase, validating the benchmark's difficulty scaling. Integrating causal context into the prompts tends to improve the agents' success rates, particularly for bigger models. While enabling thinking mode and longer planning horizons significantly improve performance, multi-step planning further reduces mean per-step response times, offering a practical trade-off between reasoning depth and execution speed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM游戏代理在复杂任务中表现不佳的原因，发现空间推理能力是关键瓶颈。通过Qwen3模型实验，引入因果提示增强和多步规划策略，在自定义GVGAI基准测试中验证了这些方法能提升胜率并管理响应延迟。结果表明：大模型+思考模式能更准确定位，因果上下文提示提升成功率，多步规划在提升性能的同时还降低了每步响应时间。
AI.motivation: LLM-based游戏代理在处理复杂任务时表现不佳，作者怀疑这与有限的空间推理能力有关，因此希望通过实验验证这一假设并探索改进方法。
AI.method: 使用开源Qwen3模型家族，在不同模型规模、推理模式和规划视野下进行实验。设计了三个自定义GVGAI游戏（五个难度等级）作为基准，进行定位实验和游戏任务成功率研究，并引入因果提示增强和多步规划策略。
AI.result: 大模型在启用思考模式时定位更准确，但小模型坐标匹配能力有限。胜率随关卡和布局复杂度增加而下降。因果上下文提示可提升成功率（尤其对大模型）。启用思考模式和更长的规划视野显著提升性能，多步规划进一步降低了平均每步响应时间。
AI.conclusion: 空间推理能力是LLM游戏代理的关键瓶颈；因果提示增强和多步规划是有效的改进手段，能在推理深度和执行速度之间取得实际折衷。

title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Discovering Periodic Orbits in the Gravitational Three-Body Problem
summary: Locating periodic solutions of chaotic dynamical systems normally requires an initial guess close enough to the target orbit for numerical continuation or gradient-based search to converge. We show that Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) trained on sparse, noisy observations \emph{without} initial conditions recover periodic orbits of the gravitational three-body problem, including orbit families absent from the training data. The method rests on a second-order ODE formulation, fixed-frequency Fourier features, percentile-based adaptive refinement, and a trainable scaling parameter, each validated on forward problems. Across two 100-seed ensembles, $23$--$25\%$ of runs converge to families not present in the training data. We then ask what determines which family emerges. Two $χ^2$ tests give a consistent answer: changing the training data source significantly shifts the distribution of recovered families ($p < 0.001$, Cramér's $V = 0.339$), whereas switching between the two initialization distributions tested does not ($p = 0.620$, $V = 0.094$). The random seed selects which family a given run recovers; the \emph{distribution} the weights are drawn from does not shift the aggregate frequencies, but the training data does. The evidence is empirical: we do not characterize the loss landscape analytically, and PINNs remain slower than conventional integrators on well-posed initial-value problems. What the experiments establish is that the recovered orbits are verifiable rather than merely plausible: the identified ones refine to genuine periodic solutions, a network trained on Lagrange data recovers the figure-eight choreography (Li--Liao class I.A.1, matched to seven significant digits in $T^*$), and one trained on figure-eight data recovers a Broucke--Hadjidemetriou--Hénon orbit closing to $δ_T < 10^{-9}$.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了无需初始条件，仅使用物理信息神经网络（PINNs）在稀疏含噪观测数据上训练，即可恢复三体问题的周期轨道，包括训练数据中未出现的轨道族。
AI.motivation: 传统方法求解混沌动力系统周期轨道需要接近目标轨道的初始猜测，而PINNs提供了一种无需初始猜测的新途径，但仍需验证其在混沌系统中的鲁棒性与泛化能力。
AI.method: 采用二阶ODE公式、固定频率傅里叶特征、基于百分位数的自适应细化以及可训练缩放参数；通过两组100次随机种子实验，结合χ²检验分析影响轨道族恢复的因素。
AI.result: 23%-25%的收敛运行恢复了训练数据中未出现的轨道族；训练数据源显著影响恢复轨道族的分布（p<0.001, V=0.339），而权重初始化分布无显著影响（p=0.620, V=0.094）；网络能从拉格朗日数据恢复figure-eight轨道，从figure-eight数据恢复Broucke-Hadjidemetriou-Hénon轨道，精度达10⁻⁹量级。
AI.conclusion: PINNs可无需初始猜测即可发现混沌系统的周期轨道，恢复的轨道可被验证为真实周期解。尽管相比传统积分器速度较慢，但提供了一个可替代的方法框架。

title: Commitment To Cooperation With Self-Negotiated Contracts
summary: As AI agents operate with increasing autonomy in a multi-agent world, they will need to learn to cooperate with other agents and with humans to generate mutual benefits. However, cooperation is a challenge because the costs of cooperation are often incurred early on, but the benefits are only realized later, creating an incentive to defect. How can AI agents cooperate with commitment? Here, we draw on inspiration from legal institutions and contracting that human societies have used to solve principal-agent problems of this kind. Contracts provide observable representations of agreements that enable credible commitments through the enforcement of terms. We study the role of contract-based cooperation using LLM-based agents in \CT, a spatial-temporal game that combines bargaining with navigation towards a goal. We study a suite of contract representations that range from formal contracts that compile to code to natural contracts that require reinterpretation. We evaluate agents with a range of LLM backbones using different sizes and providers. We find that self-negotiated contracts can improve cooperative outcomes beyond what is possible with regular trading.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何让AI代理通过合同机制实现可信合作。受人类法律契约启发，作者让基于LLM的代理在空间-时间博弈中自我协商合同（从形式化代码合同到自然语言合同），发现合同能显著提升合作效果，超越传统交易方式。
AI.motivation: AI代理在多智能体环境中需要学会合作以实现共同利益，但合作面临"早期成本-后期收益"的激励问题，容易导致背叛。现有方法缺乏让代理做出可信承诺的机制。
AI.method: 受人类法律契约制度启发，设计了一套合同表示方案（从编译为代码的形式化合同到需要重新解释的自然语言合同），让LLM代理在\CT博弈（结合讨价还价与导航的时空博弈）中自我协商并执行合同。
AI.result: 自我协商的合同显著提升了合作效果，超越了普通交易机制所能达到的水平。该结论在不同大小和提供商的LLM骨干模型上均成立。
AI.conclusion: 合同机制是解决AI代理间可信承诺问题的有效途径，能为多智能体系统带来更好的合作结果。

title: Impute On-Demand: Adaptive Correlated Time Series Imputation for Changing Environments
comment: 15 pages, 9 figures. Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering (IEEE TKDE)
summary: Internet of Things (IoT) applications generate vast amounts of Correlated Time Series (CTS) data that often contain missing values and require imputation. Existing methods emphasize accuracy but often lack adaptability to changing IoT environments: they are vulnerable to sensor failures, cannot selectively impute only incomplete sensors, and use static architectures that do not adapt to resource availability. To address these limitations, we propose AdaCTSi, an adaptive CTS imputer for changing environments. AdaCTSi combines a One-shot Temporal Convolutional Network with a Learned Time-Sensor Index Table to extract and decouple complex spatio-temporal features into sensor-wise embeddings, enabling adaptation to varying sensor subsets. Sparse Spatial Attention efficiently extracts dynamic spatial correlations, while Correlation-Weighted Sensor Selection selects informative sensors to provide sufficient spatial context. Experiments with twelve baseline methods, three adaptability scenarios, and five benchmark datasets covering traffic, air quality, and trajectory data show that AdaCTSi reduces MAE by an average of 33.1% relative to the strongest baseline on each dataset. A single trained model supports sensor-subset and resource-adaptive inference, and its modest memory footprint enables deployment on commodity computing devices, including MCUs.

AI.tldr: AdaCTSi是一种面向物联网相关时间序列数据的自适应缺失值填补方法，结合时间卷积网络与稀疏注意力机制，在五个基准数据集上平均MAE降低33.1%，并支持传感器子集自适应与资源受限设备部署。
AI.motivation: 现有CTS填补方法精度较高，但难以适应物联网动态环境：无法应对传感器故障、不能选择性填补、静态架构不适应资源变化。
AI.method: 提出AdaCTSi，包含One-shot时间卷积网络与学习型时间-传感器索引表提取解耦特征，稀疏空间注意力捕捉动态空间相关性，以及相关性加权传感器选择提供空间上下文。
AI.result: 在12种基线方法、3种适应性场景、5个基准数据集上，AdaCTSi相对最强基线平均降低MAE 33.1%，支持传感器子集与资源自适应推理，内存开销低可部署在MCU等设备上。
AI.conclusion: AdaCTSi在准确性与适应性上显著优于现有方法，并能部署于资源受限的物联网设备，具备实用价值。

title: Disentangling Multi-View Scanning in Mamba for Network Traffic Anomaly Detection
summary: Network Traffic Anomaly Detection (NTAD) is a critical task in cybersecurity, yet timely and accurate anomaly detection remains challenging. Mamba has emerged as a particularly promising backbone for NTAD due to its linear-time complexity for long-sequence modeling. It further incorporates a dedicated multi-view scanning mechanism to enhance detection precision through complementary contextual cues. However, we identify a previously overlooked structural deficiency in multi-view Mamba scanning for NTAD: redundancy accumulation. Specifically, distinct scanning branches capture substantial view-invariant information, which is repeatedly amplified during multi-view fusion; conversely, view-specific information is diluted or even suppressed, leading to representation homogenization and multi-view degradation. To address this problem, we propose DisenMamba, a novel disentangled multi-view Mamba framework. DisenMamba reformulates multi-view scanning as a two-stage disentangle-then-fuse process that explicitly separates view-invariant and view-specific components prior to fusion. This design prevents the invariant information accumulation while preserving complementary multi-view cues, yielding more discriminative representations for subtle traffic anomalies. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of DisenMamba, establishing a new disentangled multi-view Mamba paradigm. Code is available at https://github.com/ikun0124/DisenMamba.

AI.tldr: DisenMamba提出了一种解耦的多视图Mamba框架，通过先分离视图不变与视图特有信息再融合的方式，解决了传统多视图扫描中冗余累积导致表示同质化的问题，有效提升了网络流量异常检测的精度。
AI.motivation: 现有Mamba多视图扫描机制存在结构缺陷：不同扫描分支捕获大量视图不变信息，在多视图融合时被重复放大，而视图特有信息被稀释甚至抑制，导致表示同质化和多视图退化，影响异常检测的准确性。
AI.method: 提出DisenMamba框架，将多视图扫描重构为两阶段的"解耦-融合"过程：先显式分离视图不变成分和视图特有成分，再进行融合。这种设计防止了不变信息累积，同时保留了互补的多视图线索。
AI.result: 大量实验证明了DisenMamba的有效性，建立了一种新的解耦多视图Mamba范式。
AI.conclusion: DisenMamba通过解耦机制解决了多视图Mamba的冗余累积问题，为网络流量异常检测提供了一种更精准、更具判别力的方法。

title: Coordinated Networking for On-Device Agent-Augmented Real-Time Communication
summary: AI agents are enabling a new paradigm of agent-augmented real-time communication (RTC), where humans focus on high-level collaboration, while agents autonomously retrieve, analyze, and generate information in real time to support their interactions. These apps enable new experiences across various domains: for example, when corporate employees co-author a legal document, their agents can discuss and draft on their behalf, sparing them the burden of manually reviewing each other's work. As existing cloud-based agents suffer from privacy risks and unscalable server costs, on-device agent-augmented RTC offers a promising alternative. However, this on-device paradigm introduces a new networking challenge: contention between concurrent traffic flows generated by humans (for live video streaming) and agents (for sending context files for analysis). We design HFS, a framework to ensure both high live video quality and low agent response latency in agent-augmented RTC apps. We achieve the goal through an app-guided multi-flow transport approach, where a unified app-layer orchestrator jointly controls the sending rates of live video and agent context flows based on their heterogeneous app requirements. Our prototype built atop WebRTC and llama.cpp demonstrates that HAFS outperforms baselines, achieving 1.5x higher video quality while reducing agent response time by 31%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HFS框架，通过应用层统一调度器协同控制视频流与智能体上下文流的发送速率，在端侧智能体增强的实时通信中实现高视频质量与低智能体响应延迟的平衡。
AI.motivation: 云端智能体方案存在隐私风险且服务器成本不可扩展，而端侧智能体增强RTC面临人类视频流与智能体上下文流之间的网络竞争问题，现有方案无法同时保障两者需求。
AI.method: 设计HFS框架，采用应用引导的多流传输方法，通过统一的应用层编排器（orchestrator）联合控制实时视频流和智能体上下文流的发送速率，针对异构应用需求进行协同调度。
AI.result: 基于WebRTC和llama.cpp的原型系统实验表明，HFS相比基线方法视频质量提升1.5倍，智能体响应时间降低31%。
AI.conclusion: 端侧应用层协同调度能有效解决多流竞争问题，为隐私保护且可扩展的智能体增强实时通信提供了可行方案。

title: Chamaileon: Cross-Context Binder Design with Contextualized Modeling and Mixed Sampling
summary: The rapid evolution of generative models has unlocked new potentials in protein binder design, a pivotal task in structural biology, by facilitating end-to-end generation via joint sequence-structure modeling or hallucination. However, existing approaches are predominantly implemented under a single-target, single-state assumption, limiting their ability to model multi-target or multi-state interactions required for advanced function-oriented protein design. Here, we introduce Chamaileon, which unifies multi-target and multi-state binder design by formulating the problem as cross-context binding landscape modeling. The framework is underpinned by a training paradigm termed In-Context Complex Co-Design (I3CD) for context-aware sequence-structure co-modeling. During inference, we employ Mixture-of-Paths Sampling (MoPS), a scalable strategy that optimizes a single sequence across contexts while alleviating the scarcity of high-quality multi-conformational paired data. Extensive evaluation on our newly constructed benchmark, CROSS, demonstrates that Chamaileon effectively generates sequences adaptable to diverse conformational landscapes and multi-target requirements. The code is available on https://github.com/caohengyuan/Chamaileon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Chamaileon框架，通过跨上下文结合景观建模统一了多目标和多状态结合子设计，采用上下文内复合共设计（I3CD）训练范式和混合路径采样（MoPS）策略，在CROSS基准上验证了其生成适应多样化构象景观和多目标需求序列的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有蛋白质结合子设计方法多基于单目标、单状态假设，无法处理高级功能导向设计所需的多目标或多状态相互作用，存在局限性。
AI.method: 提出Chamaileon框架：1) 将问题形式化为跨上下文结合景观建模；2) 采用上下文内复合共设计（I3CD）训练范式实现上下文感知的序列-结构共建模；3) 推理时使用混合路径采样（MoPS）策略优化跨上下文序列，缓解高质量多构象配对数据稀缺问题。
AI.result: 在新构建的CROSS基准上，Chamaileon能够有效生成适应多样化构象景观和多目标需求的蛋白质序列。
AI.conclusion: Chamaileon成功将生成模型从单目标单状态扩展到多目标多状态结合子设计，为功能导向的蛋白质设计提供了统一框架。

title: What Can Be Enforced? A Theory of Certified Runtime Safety for Tool-Using Agents
comment: 26 pages, 8 figures. Extended version with complete proofs and additional experiments
summary: Runtime guardrails act before irreversible tool calls, but their guarantees depend on what policy state is representable, what a judge observes, and whether intervention changes future behavior. We separate three questions. First, relative to fixed oracle predicates, a deterministic gate enforces exactly the nonempty safety policies whose good prefixes its register model recognizes; policy nontriviality is undecidable with two decrementable counters but in PSPACE for a separable monotone fragment. Second, under a fixed exogenous law, Neyman-Pearson gives the exact false-block/miss frontier and conformal calibration gives a finite-sample marginal certificate, possibly via block-all. Third, once blocking changes future proposals, static scores and ungated trajectories need not identify the closed-loop frontier; a specified finite controlled model instead yields an occupancy program. Bounded representation attacks add a robustness margin, so benign calibration alone does not transfer. Experiments target these distinctions through static diagnostics, controlled-model enumeration, representation rewrites, and paired closed-loop reruns.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地分析了运行时护栏（runtime guardrails）在不可逆工具调用前的理论基础，区分了三个关键问题：策略表示与门控的可判定性、在固定外生规律下的最优阻断边界、以及门控改变未来行为后的闭环控制问题，并通过实验验证了这些区分。
AI.motivation: 现有运行时护栏的安全保证依赖于可表示的策略状态、裁判的观察能力以及干预是否改变未来行为，但这些前提条件尚未被严格分离和分析，导致护栏的保证边界不清晰。
AI.method: 本文通过理论分析分离三个问题：1) 确定性门控与寄存器模型的可判定性，证实在两个递减计数器下策略非平凡性不可判定，但在可分离单调片段中属于PSPACE；2) 利用Neyman-Pearson给出精确的误阻/漏放前沿，并用共形校准提供有限样本边际保证；3) 针对闭环场景，提出了占用程序（occupancy program）来建模受控模型下的安全边界。此外引入了有界表示攻击以增加鲁棒性裕度。
AI.result: 理论结果表明：确定性门控只能强制执行其寄存器模型能识别的good前缀对应的非空安全策略；在固定外生规律下可得到精确的误阻-漏放折衷边界；当阻断改变未来行为时，静态评分和未门控轨迹无法识别闭环前沿，需依赖受控模型下的占用程序。实验通过静态诊断、受控模型枚举、表示重写和配对闭环重运行验证了这些理论区分。
AI.conclusion: 运行时护栏的理论保证高度依赖于其底层假设（状态表示能力、观察完整性、行为反馈性），简单的共形校准方法在存在行为改变和对抗攻击时不足以提供稳健的安全保证，需要更细致的建模和验证。

title: Neonatal Hypoxic-ischaemic Encephalopathy Classification from the EEG and HRV Signals Using a Conformer based Masked Autoencoder
comment: Paper submits to IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
summary: In this paper, we propose the MAEConformer, a novel self-supervised learning framework that combines the Conformer architecture with the Masked Autoencoder (MAE) paradigm for large-scale representation learning from unlabelled electroencephalography (EEG) and heart rate variability (HRV) signals. By integrating convolutional operations with Transformer-based self-attention, MAEConformer effectively captures both local temporal patterns and long-range contextual dependencies in physiological time series. To enhance reconstruction fidelity and representation quality, a multi-resolution short-time Fourier transform (MR-STFT) loss is incorporated alongside the reconstruction objective, enabling the model to jointly learn temporal and spectral characteristics across multiple scales. Modality-specific EEG and HRV MAEConformer models were pretrained on 6,030h and 4,868h of unlabelled recordings, respectively, and subsequently transferred to expert-annotated downstream tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that the learned representations provide strong transferability and data efficiency. In EEG-based hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) severity classification, the pretrained MAE-EEG model achieved test AUCs of 97.19% and 96.56% for binary and four-class classification tasks, respectively, outperforming a range of state-of-the-art supervised and self-supervised baselines. On the HRV-based HIE severity classification task, MAE-HRV achieved a test AUC of 82.42%, surpassing both self-supervised Transformer-based and supervised convolutional baselines. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of MAEConformer for learning robust and transferable representations across multiple physiological modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAEConformer框架，结合Conformer架构与掩码自编码器范式，在6,030小时EEG和4,868小时HRV未标注数据上预训练，并在缺氧缺血性脑病严重程度分类任务中达到SOTA性能（EEG二分类AUC 97.19%，四分类96.56%，HRV二分类82.42%）。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG/HRV自监督学习方法难以同时捕捉生理信号中的局部时序模式和长程上下文依赖关系，且缺乏跨模态的通用预训练框架。
AI.method: 提出MAEConformer框架：1）结合卷积与Transformer自注意力的Conformer架构，捕获局部和全局特征；2）引入多分辨率短时傅里叶变换（MR-STFT）损失，联合学习时频特征；3）分别在EEG和HRV大规模未标注数据上预训练后迁移至下游任务。
AI.result: EEG-HIE二分类AUC 97.19%，四分类96.56%；HRV-HIE二分类AUC 82.42%，均超越现有监督和自监督基线方法。
AI.conclusion: MAEConformer能有效学习跨模态生理信号的鲁棒可迁移表示，具备强数据效率和泛化能力。

title: Physical AI Governance: From Theory to Practice Across Life Cycle
summary: With the emergence of Physical AI, artificial intelligence is extending beyond screen-based applications to embodied systems that perceive, interact with, and act in the physical world. Unlike traditional AI, Physical AI operates under real-time safety constraints, continuously interacts with dynamic environments, and coexists with humans, introducing governance challenges that existing AI governance frameworks do not explicitly address. This paper presents a comprehensive survey of Physical AI governance from both scientific and operational perspectives. We synthesize existing governance principles and organize them into a unified governance framework tailored to physical AI systems. Building on this foundation, we propose a five-stage Physical AI lifecycle comprising research, design, data, model development, and deployment, and demonstrate how governance can be operationalized across each stage through concrete implementation practices. By connecting governance principles with engineering workflows, this survey provides a structured reference for researchers, developers, and policymakers to build Physical AI systems that are safe, trustworthy, and aligned with societal values.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了Physical AI的治理问题，从科学和操作两个角度出发，提出了统一的治理框架，并围绕研究、设计、数据、模型开发和部署五个阶段，展示了如何将治理原则具体落地到工程实践中。
AI.motivation: Physical AI（实体人工智能）正从屏幕应用扩展到与环境交互的具身系统，其面临实时安全约束、动态环境和人机共存等独特挑战，而现有AI治理框架无法覆盖这些问题，因此亟需一个专门针对Physical AI的治理体系。
AI.method: 采用系统性综述方法，梳理现有治理原则并整合成统一框架，进而提出包含研究、设计、数据、模型开发和部署五个阶段的Physical AI生命周期，并为每个阶段提供具体的治理实践方案。
AI.result: 构建了一套面向Physical AI的统一治理框架，并给出了从研究到部署全生命周期的可操作治理实践，将治理原则与工程流程相衔接。
AI.conclusion: 该调查为研究人员、开发者和政策制定者提供了结构化的参考，帮助构建安全、可信且符合社会价值的Physical AI系统。

title: Random Forest-Based Prediction of Bone Volume Fraction and Fracture Position from S-Parameters
comment: 5 pages,6 figures,This is a summary report prepared by undergraduate students I supervised, formatted as a letter
summary: In this paper, we propose a method for predicting bone volume fraction (BVF) and fracture position by constructing a random forest model based on multichannel S-parameters. A nine-antenna microwave scanning system is designed and fabricated to acquire the multichannel S-parameter data. Bone-mimicking phantoms are developed, and corresponding experiments are conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. Both synthetic and experimental results demonstrate the validity of the method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于多通道S参数和随机森林模型预测骨体积分数（BVF）和骨折位置的方法，并设计九天线微波扫描系统及仿体实验验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在骨体积分数和骨折位置预测方面存在不足，需要一种高效、非侵入式的检测手段。
AI.method: 设计九天线微波扫描系统采集多通道S参数，构建随机森林模型进行预测，并通过骨仿体实验验证。
AI.result: 合成数据与实验数据均表明该方法有效。
AI.conclusion: 基于随机森林和多通道S参数的微波检测方法可用于BVF和骨折位置的预测。

title: How Well Can AI Generate Backlogs from App Mockups?
comment: Accepted at the AIRE Workshop, IEEE 34th International Requirements Engineering Conference (RE) 2026
summary: Creating sprint backlogs requires considerable effort, as items such as epics, user stories, and tasks can be missed or inconsistently specified. We propose a multimodal approach to support backlog generation from visual app mockups, an artifact available at early project stages. We evaluate three prompting strategies on GPT-4o: a zero-shot baseline, Compositional Chain-of-Thought (CCoT) for vision-language reasoning, and a persona-driven prompt. We study seven app development projects across two countries and interview developers about the results. Overall, we observed that the baseline prompt favours recall over precision, whereas CCoT is more balanced, achieving average F1 scores of 52-66% for epics and user stories. Tasks were more challenging to generate accurately. Precision gains were most consistent when adding architectural context, particularly for backend tasks (precision gains up to 35%). Interviews with developers revealed that up to 26% of false positives were still considered useful, reflecting the creative and open-ended nature of backlog creation. To capture this, we propose a new measure called Revised Recall, which complements ground-truth evaluation with developer assessments. Our findings suggest that hybrid prompting with architectural context can assist backlog generation from early mockups, though results vary by item type and developer oversight remains necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多模态方法，利用视觉APP原型通过GPT-4o自动生成Sprint待办列表（包括史诗、用户故事和任务）。研究比较了三种提示策略（零样本基线、组合思维链、角色驱动提示），发现组合思维链在史诗和用户故事上F1分数达到52-66%，而任务生成更具挑战性。添加架构上下文可提升后端任务精度最高达35%。开发人员访谈显示，26%的假阳性结果仍被认为有用，为此提出了修正召回率（Revised Recall）这一新指标。研究建议混合提示与架构上下文可辅助待办列表生成，但仍需开发人员监督。
AI.motivation: 创建Sprint待办列表（包括史诗、用户故事和任务）需要大量人工努力，且容易出现遗漏或不一致的问题。现有方法缺乏有效利用早期项目阶段已有的视觉APP原型来辅助自动化待办列表生成的手段。
AI.method: 采用多模态方法，以视觉APP原型作为输入，通过GPT-4o进行待办列表生成。评估三种提示策略：零样本基线、组合思维链（CCoT，用于视觉-语言推理）和角色驱动提示。在两国七个APP开发项目上进行研究，并通过开发人员访谈评估结果。
AI.result: 基线提示偏向召回率而非精确率；CCoT更平衡，史诗和用户故事平均F1分数达52-66%。任务生成更具挑战性。添加架构上下文后精确率提升最稳定，后端任务精确率提升高达35%。26%的假阳性结果在开发人员看来仍有用。
AI.conclusion: 混合提示策略结合架构上下文可辅助从早期原型生成待办列表，但效果因项目类型而异，且开发人员的监督仍然是必要的。提出了修正召回率（Revised Recall）这一新指标，以更真实地反映待办列表生成的开放性和创造性本质。

title: MS-GPT: Rethinking MS/MS De Novo Structure Elucidation as Spectrum-Induced Posterior Querying of a Molecule-Language Model
comment: 18 pages, 14 figures, and 9 tables, including appendices. Source code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/VIKI623/MS-GPT
summary: Molecular structure elucidation from tandem mass spectra (MS/MS) is a central inverse problem in analytical chemistry. Most existing approaches to MS/MS identification remain tied to reference libraries or predefined candidate sets, whereas de novo methods aim to generate structures directly from spectra. A common de novo route predicts a molecular fingerprint from the spectrum and then decodes structures from it, enabling decoder pretraining on large molecule-only corpora. However, this paradigm creates a training-inference mismatch: the decoder is trained on oracle fingerprints computed from molecules, but at inference it is queried with a noisy spectrum-induced fingerprint posterior that is typically collapsed to a single thresholded fingerprint. We introduce MS-GPT, which recasts fingerprint-mediated de novo elucidation as spectrum-induced posterior querying of a conditional molecule-language model. MS-GPT conditions a molecule-language model on fingerprints and formulas, then converts the spectrum-induced posterior into a band of fingerprint queries near the oracle-fingerprint manifold through active-bit density calibration. Candidates sampled across this band are pooled and ranked by generation-frequency consensus. A lightweight LoRA adapter further mitigates domain-specific posterior bias while preserving the pretrained molecular prior. On NPLIB1 and MassSpecGym, MS-GPT sets a new state of the art, reaching Top-1/Top-10 exact-match accuracy of 29.8\%/41.1\% and 23.9\%/28.7\%, respectively. Candidate-pool scaling shows that efficient autoregressive molecular generation continues to improve recall with a little additional inference cost. The source code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/VIKI623/MS-GPT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MS-GPT，通过将指纹中介的从头解析重新定义为谱诱导后验查询条件分子语言模型，解决了现有方法训练-推理不匹配的问题，在NPLIB1和MassSpecGym上达到了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有指纹中介的从头解析方法存在训练-推理不匹配：解码器基于oracle指纹训练，但推理时输入的是有噪声的谱诱导指纹后验（通常被坍缩为单个阈值化指纹），导致性能受限。
AI.method: 1) 将指纹中介的从头解析重构为谱诱导后验查询条件分子语言模型；2) 通过active-bit密度校准将谱后验转换为oracle指纹附近的指纹查询带；3) 对查询带采样，通过生成频率共识进行候选排序；4) 使用轻量LoRA适配器缓解域特定后验偏差。
AI.result: 在NPLIB1上Top-1/Top-10精确匹配率达29.8%/41.1%，在MassSpecGym上达23.9%/28.7%，均为新SOTA。候选池扩展表明高效自回归分子生成能以少量额外推理成本持续提升召回率。
AI.conclusion: MS-GPT通过桥接训练-推理差距，有效提升了质谱从头解析的准确性，方法具有可扩展性，代码已开源。

title: Agent Team Work Zone: An Automated, Persistent Workspace for Long-Lived Coding Agent Teams
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have significantly improved coding and programming workflows. Claude Code, in particular, is one of the most powerful LLM coding agents and is capable of conducting complex coding tasks. However, several drawbacks can undermine long-term agentic workflows. (1) Irrecoverable agent teams: The Agent Teams feature is powerful, but the working state accumulated by each teammate is lost and cannot be resumed once the process stops, for example, when a terminal is closed. (2) Compaction erodes working detail: Compaction condenses the conversation into a summary, causing an agent's working details to become vague. (3) Agentic "technical debt": Over time, a user's decisions and the agents' operations become trapped in compacted old chats, making the project increasingly difficult to maintain and review. (4) Heavy prompt writing: Assigning or handing off tasks requires users to repeatedly write long prompts to achieve the expected agentic performance. We propose ATWZ (Agent Team Work Zone), a filesystem-based operations layer built around Claude Code's native Agent Teams that addresses these problems. Its central design principle is to treat each agent and teammate as a human employee and preserve their important working state in files stored in a dedicated directory called a "workstation," together with the skills, hooks, and scripts that use and maintain these files. With ATWZ, an agent team can periodically back up its working state, allowing an agent's knowledge to be recovered after compaction. After a process ends, the team can be restored with a single command. These features also substantially mitigate the agentic "technical debt" described above. Moreover, within ATWZ, agent "employees" can send documents to one another, greatly reducing the effort required to write prompts.

AI.tldr: ATWZ是一个基于文件系统的操作层，通过将代理团队的工作状态持久化存储到"工作站"目录中，解决了Claude Code等LLM编码代理存在的状态丢失、细节模糊、技术债务和提示编写负担重等问题。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM编码代理（如Claude Code）存在四个主要问题：代理团队工作状态不可恢复、压缩导致工作细节模糊、代理"技术债务"积累、以及需要频繁编写冗长提示词，这些问题严重影响了长期代理工作流的效率和可维护性。
AI.method: ATWZ采用文件系统操作方法，将每个代理视为一个员工，把重要的工作状态、技能、钩子和脚本存储在专属的"工作站"目录中，支持周期性备份工作状态、单命令恢复团队、代理间文档传递等功能。
AI.result: ATWZ能够使代理团队在压缩后恢复知识、进程结束后单命令恢复团队、大幅减轻代理技术债务、并降低提示词编写的工作量。
AI.conclusion: ATWZ通过文件系统持久化代理团队状态，有效解决了LLM编码代理在长期工作流中的状态丢失和可维护性问题。

title: Restoration Flow Matching-Based Channel Refinement and Equalization Correction for MIMO Semantic Communications
summary: In multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) semantic communication, imperfect channel state information (CSI) and equalization mismatch can seriously degrade semantic reconstruction quality. To address this issue, we propose a unified restoration flow matching (RFM)-based framework for channel refinement and equalization correction. Specifically, the channel RFM (CRFM) module is developed to refine the coarse channel, thereby improving channel estimation accuracy. Based on the refined channel, the developed semantic RFM (SRFM) module is employed to correct the residual distortions in the post-equalization latent space. The key idea is to formulate the two cascaded inverse problems of channel estimation and equalization as the unified conditional restoration task, in which the learned conditional velocity field guides the perturbed distribution towards the target distribution. To enhance the robustness of these two modules under various distortion conditions, we develop a dual-anchor perturbation training strategy that jointly learns near-manifold refinement and large-error correction, and implement inference through a few-step deterministic ordinary differential equation (ODE) solver. Extensive experiments on MIMO channels and visual semantic transmission tasks demonstrate that the proposed scheme improves key metrics for channel estimation and semantic reconstruction quality. Moreover, compared with representative diffusion-based generative baselines, the proposed method requires fewer sampling steps.

AI.tldr: 本文针对MIMO语义通信中CSI不完美和均衡失配问题，提出基于恢复流匹配（RFM）的统一框架，包含信道RFM（CRFM）和语义RFM（SRFM）两个模块，通过条件恢复任务和双锚点扰动训练策略，实现信道精炼与均衡校正，在更少采样步数下提升信道估计和语义重建质量。
AI.motivation: MIMO语义通信中，不完美的信道状态信息（CSI）和均衡失配会严重降低语义重建质量，现有方法未能有效统一解决这两个级联的逆问题。
AI.method: 提出RFM框架，包含CRFM模块（精炼粗信道）和SRFM模块（校正均衡后潜在空间的残差失真），将信道估计和均衡两个级联逆问题统一为条件恢复任务；提出双锚点扰动训练策略，联合学习近流形精炼和大误差校正；通过少量步数的确定性ODE求解器实现推理。
AI.result: 在MIMO信道和视觉语义传输任务上的实验表明，该方法在信道估计和语义重建质量的关键指标上均有提升；相比代表性扩散生成基线，所需采样步数更少。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的RFM框架有效解决了MIMO语义通信中的信道和均衡失配问题，在性能和效率上均优于现有扩散模型方法。

title: SAGE: Safety-First Defense-in-Depth Guardrails for Verified Lifecycle Control of High-Impact Generative AI
summary:
High-impact generative AI makes catastrophic misuse a lifecycle-control problem, not merely a prompt-filtering problem. SAGE is a safety-first, authorization-separated architecture in which credible catastrophic-enablement risk constrains admissibility before utility, latency, or commercial objectives are considered. It combines signed release manifests, diverse detectors, robust risk envelopes, least-risk defaults, output checking, three-valued monitoring, protected audit chains, containment, and rollback. Formal results establish safety priority, conservative detector bounds, monotone release gating, tamper-evident records, and an authorization cut; two PRISM abstractions verify authorization separation and lifecycle invariants under explicit assumptions.
  A frozen, vendor-symmetric study sent 84 cases to each of four GPT, four Claude, and two Gemini snapshots: 840 calls yielded 794 target responses, 46 provider errors, and 449 successful judgments covering 375 responses. Eight snapshots had complete judged domain coverage. Harmful-compliance estimates were low; variation arose mainly from benign utility and safe redirection. Seven multiplicity-adjusted contrasts involving Claude, Gemini, or GPT-5 snapshots and the GPT-5 mini and GPT-5 nano snapshots were supported, while no tested contrast between the Claude or Gemini snapshots and GPT-5 or GPT-5.5 survived correction.
  The observed harmful-compliance range is a conservative, protocol-bound view from one generation per prompt with no tools, retrieval, history, or human adjudication; it is not an upper bound on operational assistance. A preregistered extension specifies how to test a wider best-worst gap using a locked split, repeated sampling, multi-turn and sandboxed-tool conditions, and domain-expert scoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAGE架构，将生成式AI的灾难性滥用问题视为全生命周期控制问题，通过授权分离、签名发布清单、多样检测器、最低风险默认等机制确保安全优先。实验对4个GPT、4个Claude、2个Gemini模型进行了840次调用测试，结果显示有害合规率较低，且模型间差异主要源于良性效用和安全重定向。扩展研究将进一步探索最佳-最差场景下的性能差距。
AI.motivation: 高影响力生成式AI的灾难性滥用无法仅通过提示过滤解决，需要在系统架构层面进行全生命周期管控，确保安全优先于效用、延迟或商业目标。
AI.method: 提出SAGE架构，包含签名发布清单、多样检测器、鲁棒风险包络、最低风险默认、输出检查、三值监控、受保护审计链、容器化和回滚机制。通过PRISM抽象验证授权分离和生命周期不变量。实验采用冻结的、供应商对称的设计，向多代模型发送84个案例进行测试。
AI.result: 840次调用获得794个目标响应、46个提供者错误、449个成功判断（覆盖375个响应）。8个快照覆盖完整领域。有害合规率估计较低，变异主要来自良性效用和安全重定向。Claude/Gemini与GPT-5/5.5之间的对比未通过多重性校正。
AI.conclusion: 当前观察的有害合规率是保守的协议绑定视图，不代表操作辅助的上限。需要扩展研究，在锁定分割、重复采样、多轮和沙盒工具条件下测试最佳-最差差距。

title: Design Theater: A Benchmark for Generative UI
summary: Generative UI tools promise to democratize UI design by turning natural language descriptions into complete interfaces. Alongside the interface, these tools generate user-facing design rationales that explain their layout, accessibility, and design choices. However, it remains unclear whether these stated rationales are actually reflected in the interfaces they produce. We call this disconnect ``Design Theater'': plausible and confident design rationales that have little relationship to the actual implementation. To study this phenomenon, we introduce a benchmark and three metrics for measuring Design Theater. The benchmark includes 24 UI generation tasks spanning structural, styling, and functional design requirements. Using this benchmark, we evaluate 120 interfaces created by five generative UI tools. On average, over 25\% of user-facing design rationales are not implemented in the generated interface, and the implementation failure increases to 34\% for functional requirements. Tools recognize roughly half of the UX principles embedded in prompts (mean = 0.54), with four of five tools implementing 6\% or fewer functional principles. We also measure interface similarity across tools and find convergence in visual appearance and layout organization, with greater variation in color choices. Overall, we contribute: 1) the concept of Design Theater; 2) a benchmark with metrics for assessing whether the stated reasoning of generative UI tools is reflected in their implementations; 3) and findings from a systematic evaluation of these tools. We discuss what these findings mean for the design and evaluation of generative UI tools.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"设计剧场"概念，指生成式UI工具产生的设计理由与实现结果不一致的现象。通过24个任务和120个界面评估发现，平均25%以上的设计理由未在界面中实现，功能需求失败率达34%。
AI.motivation: 生成式UI工具声称能解释其设计决策，但实际生成的理由与实现之间存在严重脱节。作者希望系统性地量化这一现象，揭示工具的可信度问题。
AI.method: 构建包含24个UI生成任务的基准测试，涵盖结构、样式和功能三类设计需求；使用五个生成式UI工具生成120个界面；提出三项评估指标（理由实现率、UX原则识别率、界面相似度）进行量化分析。
AI.result: 25%以上的设计理由未实现；功能需求失败率达34%；工具平均识别54%的UX原则；四个工具仅实现6%或更少的功能性原则；各工具在视觉布局上趋同，颜色选择上差异较大。
AI.conclusion: 生成式UI工具普遍存在"设计剧场"问题，设计声明与实际实现严重脱节，尤其在功能需求方面表现最差。这呼吁对生成式UI工具的设计和评估方式进行反思。

title: Variational-Ising-Attention (VIA):TailoredAttentionMattersfor Science
summary: Attention enables context modeling via query-key scoring with softmax normalization. Driven by industrial long-context demands, mainstream research has converged toward sparsity and efficiency--yet softmax's independence assumption persists. For scientific tasks unburdened by long-token constraints, however, richer structured coupling may often be essential, making tailored attention both viable and more appropriate. To this end, we propose Variational-Ising-Attention (VIA), which augments softmax normalization with an interacting Ising model; attention patterns emerge from learnable pairwise couplings via variational mean-field inference, redefining attention from a ranking over isolated items to a collective state over interacting entities. We instantiate VIA on retrosynthesis reaction center prediction, a task inherently governed by cooperative bond-breaking constraints. Comprehensive experiments across model variants, coupled with mechanistic analyses, demonstrate that VIA consistently and substantially outperforms standard softmax attention. More broadly, our findings suggest that for scientific problems, the optimal solution is not general-purpose efficiency, but appropriately tailored attention aligned with intrinsic domain structure. This work provides a theoretically grounded and empirically validated instantiation of this paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出变分伊辛注意力（VIA），通过伊辛模型增强softmax归一化，利用变分平均场推断学习可学习成对耦合，使注意力从独立项排序转变为交互实体的集体状态，并在逆合成反应中心预测任务上显著优于标准softmax注意力。
AI.motivation: 现有注意力机制（softmax）假设查询-键之间相互独立，这种独立性假设对需要丰富结构化耦合的科学任务（如反应中心预测）不适用。工业界过度追求长上下文的稀疏高效，忽略了科学任务对结构化交互的本质需求。
AI.method: 提出变分伊辛注意力（VIA），在标准softmax归一化基础上引入伊辛交互模型，通过变分平均场推断学习可学习的成对耦合参数，使注意力模式从独立项的排序转变为交互实体的集体状态。
AI.result: 在逆合成反应中心预测任务上，VIA在多种模型变体上均一致且显著优于标准softmax注意力，并通过机制分析验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 对于科学问题，最优解不是通用高效性，而是根据领域内在结构定制的注意力机制。本文从理论和实证两个层面验证了这一范式。

title: Let AI Agents Translate Networks, Not Reason About Them
summary:
A formal model enables verifying reachability, localizing an outage, or anticipating the blast radius of a change. Yet, virtually no production network has one, since writing a model by hand demands rare expertise and is hard to keep current as the network changes frequently. At its core, network modeling is a typographical exercise: it translates network artifacts (e.g., configurations, topology, and routing state) into rules in formal logic. Translation of this kind is what large language models (LLMs) nowadays do well. Unlike free-form AI reasoning, such translation can be formally verified.
  Once modeling is no longer the bottleneck, trusting AI to reason over large, complex networks no longer makes sense. Our position therefore cuts against the prevailing race to put autonomous AI agents in charge end-to-end. We instead confine AI to translation and rely on a solver for reliable long-horizon reasoning, building a reusable formal model of general network behavior that can then be specialized to specific tasks, e.g., root-cause analysis (RCA). We build TypoNet that constructs and validates a symbolic model of an emulated production-scale WAN from the network's own artifacts. Our preliminary evaluation shows TypoNet helps in two ways. On its own, TypoNet answers operational questions (e.g., reachability verification and change-impact analysis) faster, more cheaply, and more reliably than an LLM. As a tool for an AI agent, TypoNet boosts fault localization at lower cost. The result makes the case for AI that builds verifiable network models and relies on a solver for reliable long-horizon reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TypoNet，利用LLM将网络配置自动翻译为形式化模型，再由求解器进行可靠推理，避免让AI直接端到端控制网络。初步实验表明该方法在可达性验证、变更影响分析和故障定位上比纯LLM方法更快、更便宜、更可靠。
AI.motivation: 生产网络中几乎没有形式化模型，因为手工编写模型需要罕见专业知识且难以随网络频繁变化而更新；而LLM擅长翻译类型的任务，且翻译结果可被形式化验证。
AI.method: TypoNet：利用LLM将网络工件（配置、拓扑、路由状态）翻译为形式逻辑规则，构建可复用的通用网络行为符号模型，再针对具体任务（如根因分析）进行特化，最后用求解器进行可靠的长程推理。
AI.result: TypoNet独自回答运维问题（可达性验证、变更影响分析）比LLM更快、更便宜、更可靠；作为AI Agent的工具时，以更低成本提升故障定位效果。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张将AI限定在翻译环节，依赖求解器进行可靠推理，反对让AI Agent端到端自治。构建可验证的网络模型是更务实的路径。

title: CALMRec: Causally Aligned Language Memory for Long-Horizon Recommendation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can summarize heterogeneous user evidence in natural language, but current LLM recommenders often collapse enduring preferences, transient intent, and exposure-induced behavior into one profile. This makes recommendation vulnerable to feedback loops: repeated exposure is mistaken for preference, immediate clicks dominate delayed satisfaction, and fluent explanations need not reflect the ranking decision. We propose our method, a model-agnostic framework for long-horizon recommendation. Our method uses a frozen multimodal language model to convert item content and feedback into evidence-grounded semantic atoms, then maintains separate short-term, long-term, and exposure memories. Propensity-weighted updates reduce policy-induced exposure bias, while a conservative offline critic reranks candidates for delayed satisfaction under a behavior-support constraint. Explanations use only influential evidence atoms and are checked by counterfactual deletion. We provide an identification result and evaluate the framework in e-commerce-like, news-like, and short-video-like environments. Across ten seeds, our method improves discounted long-term value over the strongest alternative by 6.1%, 7.6%, and 6.7%, respectively. Twenty-seed paired ablations show significant value drops after removing propensity correction (0.739 +/- 0.191) or conservative support regularization (0.523 +/- 0.234). A frozen instruction language model also more than doubles semantic-atom NDCG over TF-IDF on a held-out paraphrase benchmark.

AI.tldr: 提出一种模型无关的长期推荐框架，通过冻结多模态语言模型将用户证据转化为语义原子，分别维护短期、长期和曝光记忆，采用倾向性加权更新减少曝光偏差，并用保守离线评论家进行重排序，在多种推荐环境中显著提升了折现长期价值。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM推荐系统将持久偏好、瞬时意图和曝光行为混为一谈，导致反馈循环问题：重复曝光被误认为偏好、即时点击主导长期满意度、流畅解释未必反映实际排序决策。
AI.method: 使用冻结多模态语言模型将物品内容和反馈转化为基于证据的语义原子；分别维护短期、长期和曝光记忆；采用倾向性加权更新减少策略诱导的曝光偏差；使用保守离线评论家（带行为支持约束）重排序以优化延迟满意度；解释仅使用有影响力的证据原子并通过反事实删除检验。
AI.result: 在电商类、新闻类和短视频类环境中，相比最强基线分别提升了6.1%、7.6%和6.7%的折现长期价值；消融实验显示去除倾向性校正或保守支持正则化后价值显著下降；冻结指令语言模型在语义原子NDCG上比TF-IDF提升超过两倍。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过分离不同类型记忆和引入偏差校正机制，有效解决了LLM推荐中的反馈循环和曝光偏差问题，在长期推荐质量上取得了显著且稳健的提升。

title: DP-IVON-Gradsq: Differentially Private Squared-Gradient Improved Variational Online Newton
comment: Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Machine Unlearning and Privacy Preservation (WIPE-OUT 2), held in conjunction with ECML PKDD 2026
summary: Differential privacy provides formal privacy guarantees for training neural networks on sensitive data, while Bayesian deep learning offers a principled framework for uncertainty-aware prediction. Combining these two objectives remains challenging, as privacy noise can interact with the stochasticity introduced by Bayesian posterior sampling. In this work, we investigate differentially private variational Bayesian learning through the Improved Variational Online Newton (IVON) optimizer. We introduce DP-IVON-Gradsq, a private variant of IVON. The proposed method constructs its curvature estimate from the privatized gradient using a noise-corrected squared-gradient estimator, reducing the direct interaction between posterior-sampling noise and privacy noise while preserving the Adam-like computational efficiency of IVON. We evaluate DP-IVON-Gradsq on CIFAR-10 against the standard private optimizers DP-SGD and DP-Adam over a range of privacy budgets. The results show that DP-IVON-Gradsq is competitive under weak-to-moderate privacy constraints, i.e., large-to-moderate values of $\varepsilon$, while degrading under strong privacy. Code is available at https://github.com/NourJamoussi/DP-IVON-Gradsq.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DP-IVON-Gradsq，一种将差分隐私与贝叶斯变分学习结合的优化器，通过噪声校正的平方梯度估计器减少后验采样噪声与隐私噪声的交互，在弱到中等隐私预算下表现良好。
AI.motivation: 差分隐私与贝叶斯深度学习结合时，隐私噪声会与贝叶斯后验采样的随机性相互干扰，现有方法难以同时保证隐私保护和不确定性量化。
AI.method: 基于改进变分在线牛顿(IVON)优化器，提出DP-IVON-Gradsq。利用私有化梯度通过噪声校正的平方梯度估计器构建曲率估计，减少后验采样噪声与隐私噪声的直接交互，同时保持Adam级计算效率。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10上对比DP-SGD和DP-Adam，DP-IVON-Gradsq在弱到中等隐私约束（ε较大到中等）下具有竞争力，但在强隐私约束下性能退化。
AI.conclusion: DP-IVON-Gradsq在中等隐私预算下是有效的差分隐私贝叶斯学习方案，但强隐私保护场景仍需进一步改进。

title: ConsistencyGate: Preventing Memory Contamination in LLM Agents via Self-Consistency Admission Control
comment: 24 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables, 1 algorithm; includes appendices
summary: LLM agents that operate over many turns accumulate facts in an external memory store and reuse them as premises for downstream reasoning. A hallucinated fact written at one step therefore persists as a false premise for every subsequent step, a failure mode we call memory contamination. Existing memory management addresses retrieval and capacity but not write-time correctness; this admission problem cannot be solved by utility- or recency-based criteria, and uncontrolled contamination compounds across long trajectories. We propose ConsistencyGate, a write-time admission gate that, before committing a candidate fact m extracted from context c, queries the LLM K times for a soft support score and admits m only when the average exceeds a threshold. The mechanism is model-agnostic, requires no fine-tuning, and reduces to a single forward pass in a log-probability variant for latency-sensitive deployments. To measure the effect on natural data, we construct two real-conversation benchmarks (LoCoMo-Contam and MSC-Contam) by planting controlled single-detail corruptions in long-term conversations from LoCoMo and MSC, and complement them with a structured synthetic corpus (MemContam) that isolates a near-oracle upper bound. Across four LLM backbones, ConsistencyGate reduces contamination on every benchmark relative to a write-everything baseline, with the cost concentrated on facts that are stated only implicitly in the source context. We release all three benchmarks together with the gate implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ConsistencyGate，一种在写入记忆前通过多次LLM查询验证事实一致性的机制，有效防止记忆污染，无需微调且模型无关。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体在长对话中会将幻觉事实写入外部记忆并作为后续推理的错误前提（记忆污染），而现有记忆管理只关注检索和容量，无法解决写入时的正确性问题。
AI.method: 提出ConsistencyGate写入准入机制：在将候选事实写入记忆前，多次查询LLM获取软支持分数，仅当平均分超过阈值时才允许写入。支持log-probability变体以降低延迟。
AI.result: 在四个LLM骨干网络、三个基准（LoCoMo-Contam、MSC-Contam、MemContam）上，ConsistencyGate相比直接写入基线均降低了记忆污染，代价是对隐含陈述的事实敏感。
AI.conclusion: ConsistencyGate有效解决了记忆写入阶段的污染问题，是一种轻量、通用、无需训练的解决方案。

title: Reason Popper-ly: Patching In-Context Reasoning with Inductive Logic Programming
comment: Accepted at the 20th Conference on Neurosymbolic Learning and Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting enables large language models (LLMs) to tackle multi-step reasoning tasks, yet the generated intermediate steps are not guaranteed to be logically sound. We present Reason Popper-ly, a neurosymbolic framework that uses inductive logic programming (ILP) to learn relation composition rules from reasoning traces and deploys them as an online verifier for step-level correction. Given an LLM-generated trace, the method checks each inferred step against the learned rule table, diagnoses the violation type, rewrites incorrect steps with symbolically derived repairs, and regenerates the remaining suffix so that the model can produce its final answer conditioned on a verified trace. We evaluate on CLUTRR, a multi-hop kinship reasoning benchmark, using five language models over reasoning chains of 2 to 10 hops. Across all models, Reason Popper-ly consistently improves terminal accuracy over standard CoT, with gains of up to 48 percentage points for small models and 15 points for frontier models on the longest chains. Compared with a fully exogenous symbolic pipeline, our method performs better on harder instances by preserving the model's successful grounding while correcting only verifiable reasoning failures. In addition, step-level ILP verification yields a fine-grained error taxonomy that provides diagnostic insight beyond final-answer accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出Reason Popper-ly框架，结合归纳逻辑编程（ILP）与链式思维提示（CoT），学习关系组合规则作为在线验证器，在推理过程中逐步骤检测并修正LLM生成的不合逻辑推理步，提升多步推理任务的准确性。
AI.motivation: 链式思维提示虽能引导LLM进行多步推理，但生成的中间步骤在逻辑上可能不成立，缺乏可靠的验证与纠正机制。
AI.method: 使用归纳逻辑编程从推理轨迹中学习关系组合规则，构建规则表作为在线验证器；对LLM生成的推理轨迹逐步骤检查，诊断违规类型，用符号推导的修复重写错误步骤，并重新生成后续步骤，使最终答案基于已验证的轨迹。
AI.result: 在CLUTRR多跳亲属推理基准上，使用5种语言模型在2-10跳推理链上测试，Reason Popper-ly一致优于标准CoT；小模型在最长链上提升高达48个百分点，前沿模型提升15个百分点；相比完全外源符号流水线，在困难实例上表现更好。
AI.conclusion: 神经符号结合的逐步骤ILP验证方法能有效纠正LLM推理中的逻辑错误，保留模型成功的接地能力，同时提供细粒度错误分类，超越仅关注最终答案准确率的评估方式。

title: Extreme Volatility Warning under Label Scarcity via Multi-Source Anomaly Fusion
summary: Early warning of extreme market volatility is central to financial risk management, but actionable events are rare, nonstationary, and often triggered by exogenous information shocks. In our CSI~300 setting, only $\sim$80 positive samples are observed across 791 training days, making heavily supervised multi-source models unstable. We first analyze a 100K-parameter hierarchical text-signal fusion model (HTSF) and find that added parameterization hurts in this low-label regime. Motivated by this failure, we propose \textbf{AAMSF} (Anomaly-Augmented Multi-Signal Fusion), a semisupervised framework that combines Isolation Forest anomaly scores over market indicators, GDELT events, Chinese financial news, and English media with lightweight Ridge score fusion. We further introduce \textbf{T-AAMSF}, a temporal extension for multi-day anomaly accumulation. On CSI~300 (2018--2023), AAMSF achieves test AUC-ROC \textbf{0.680}, outperforming the strongest unsupervised baseline (0.630) and neural baseline (0.588), while T-AAMSF improves PR-AUC to 0.291. Ablations reveal strong source asymmetry: GDELT and domestic financial news provide complementary risk signals, whereas English media consistently reduces performance, and learned weighting is unreliable under validation noise. These results suggest an empirical design principle for label-scarce financial risk warning: robust anomaly geometry and source reliability can matter more than supervised representation capacity.

AI.tldr: 针对极端市场波动预警中标签稀缺问题，本文提出AAMSF半监督框架：利用孤立森林异常评分融合多源信号（市场指标、GDELT事件、中英文新闻），并用轻量级Ridge回归融合。在CSI 300上AUC-ROC达0.680，优于监督神经网络（0.588）和无监督基线（0.630）。研究表明：标签稀缺场景下，稳健异常几何与源可靠性比监督表征能力更重要。
AI.motivation: 极端市场波动预警样本稀缺（CSI 300仅约80个正样本/791天）、非平稳且受外生冲击触发，导致强监督多源模型不稳定。现有监督模型（如HTSF）在低标签场景下参数化反而有害。
AI.method: 提出AAMSF半监督框架：1) 使用孤立森林（Isolation Forest）对市场指标、GDELT事件、中国金融新闻、英文媒体分别计算异常分数；2) 用轻量级Ridge回归融合各源异常评分。T-AAMSF引入时间维度累积多日异常。与HTSF（10万参数层级文本信号融合模型）对比。
AI.result: CSI 300（2018-2023）上：AAMSF AUC-ROC达0.680，优于最强无监督基线（0.630）和神经基线（0.588）；T-AAMSF将PR-AUC提升至0.291。消融实验表明：GDELT与国内财经新闻互补，英文媒体持续降低性能，学习权重在验证噪声下不可靠。
AI.conclusion: 标签稀缺的金融风险预警中，经验设计原则为：稳健的异常几何结构与源可靠性比监督表征能力更重要。GDELT与国内新闻是互补信号，英文媒体引入噪声。

title: AgentOmnia: Scaling Agentic Models for Full-Scenario Applications
summary: Large language model agents have advanced rapidly, yet progress remains fragmented across domains, capabilities, task difficulty, and interaction settings. We frame this as full-scenario agentic scaling and present AgentOmnia, a framework coordinating task-space definition, data synthesis, post-training, evaluation, and improvement across To-Consumer (ToC), To-Business (ToB), and To-Employee (ToE) applications. An extensible Domain x Capability x Atomic Difficulty taxonomy aligns these stages and enables fine-grained diagnosis with OmniaBench. AgentOmnia combines bidirectional environment-task synthesis with tool-dependency, program-structured, and solver-based pipelines, constructing 5,018 stateful environments with 255,375 tools and 52,361 tasks. Programs, solvers, and verifiers provide correctness signals, while supervised fine-tuning, online agentic reinforcement learning, and a rollback curriculum support post-training. Evaluation failures translate into Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) for targeted self-evolution. Starting from Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507, AgentOmnia raises the pass rate on the OmniaBench challenging subset from 9.16% to 37.11% and the macro-average across OmniaBench, $τ^2$-Bench, DeepPlanning, and VitaBench from 22.86% to 41.69%. Under a unified protocol,it leads the evaluated agentic post-trained baselines on OmniaBench and retains the highest four-benchmark macro-average. It also surpasses Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 on all four benchmarks and exceeds Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on the macro-average. Gains span three application splits, ten capability dimensions, eight atomic-difficulty factors, and 76 of 90 level-1 domains, indicating broad rather than category-specific improvement. A one-round study provides initial evidence for PRD-guided self-evolution, motivating validation at larger scales and in industrial settings.

AI.tldr: AgentOmnia 提出了一个覆盖 ToC/ToB/ToE 全场景的智能体框架，通过统一的领域-能力-难度分类、双向环境-任务合成、后训练（SFT + 在线强化学习 + 回滚课程）和 PRD 驱动的自进化，在多基准测试上将平均通过率从 22.86% 提升至 41.69%，并超越更大规模模型。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体在不同领域、能力、任务难度和交互设置上进展碎片化，缺乏一个覆盖全场景（ToC/ToB/ToE）的统一框架来协调数据合成、后训练、评估与自我改进。
AI.method: 提出 AgentOmnia 框架，核心包括：(1) 领域×能力×原子难度的可扩展分类学，用于对齐各阶段；(2) 双向环境-任务合成，包含工具依赖、程序结构和求解器三种流水线，构建 5,018 个状态环境、255,375 个工具和 52,361 个任务；(3) 后训练结合 SFT、在线智能体强化学习和回滚课程；(4) 评估失败转化为 PRD 文档，驱动自我进化。
AI.result: 基于 Qwen3-30B-A3B，AgentOmnia 将 OmniaBench 困难子集通过率从 9.16% 提升至 37.11%，四个基准宏观平均从 22.86% 提升至 41.69%，超越 Qwen3-235B-A22B 和 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B，改进覆盖 76/90 个一级领域。
AI.conclusion: AgentOmnia 证明了一个统一的、全场景的智能体框架能够实现广泛且显著的性能提升，PRD 驱动的自进化在单轮实验中展现了初步潜力，未来需在更大规模和工业场景中验证。

title: Stress-testing large language model agents in a robotic chemistry laboratory
summary: AI is evaluated through knowledge, reasoning and plan generation, yet scientific agency requires reliable physical action and adaptation to evidence. Here, we use a robotic chemistry laboratory as a physical-world testbed to make scientific agency measurable. Its 45 modular workstations exposed as machine-readable skills enabled 4,608 trials. Only 3.3% of trials produced expert-assessed executable workflows under laboratory constraints; even the best system achieved 28.1%. Long-horizon planning remained a challenge: only three executable workflows exceeded 30 operations, although the longest contained 44. Across five rounds, experimental feedback prompted local adjustments but no workflow-level replanning or analytical-method redesign. By making physical executability and evidence-driven replanning measurable, our study provides an evidence-based assessment of deployment readiness and a diagnostic framework to guide closed-loop improvements towards physically grounded autonomous research.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过机器人化学实验室的45个模块化工作站进行4608次试验，评估AI在物理世界中的科学代理能力。结果显示仅3.3%的试验产生可执行工作流，最佳系统也仅达28.1%，且缺乏工作流级重规划和分析方法重新设计的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有AI评估侧重于知识、推理和计划生成，但科学代理需要可靠的物理行动和基于证据的适应能力，目前缺乏衡量标准。
AI.method: 使用45个模块化机器人化学工作站作为物理测试平台，将其暴露为机器可读技能，进行4608次试验，由专家评估工作流的可执行性。
AI.result: 仅3.3%的试验产生专家认可的可执行工作流，最佳系统达28.1%；仅3个可执行工作流超过30个操作（最长44个）；反馈仅引发局部调整，无全局重规划。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过量化物理可执行性和基于证据的重规划能力，提供了AI部署就绪度的评估框架，指导闭环改进以实现物理自主研究。

title: SymStep: Symbolic Step Verification for Logical Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting can fail severely on constraint-dense logical reasoning tasks, where unverified errors accumulate silently across steps. We introduce SymStep: an LLM makes one atomic claim at a time (DEDUCE: Alice, pet, Cat), then a lightweight constraint propagator checks the claim for consistency with prior accepted deductions, rejects contradictions, and cascades implied facts automatically. SymStep+G additionally provides MRV guidance after each accepted step, directing the LLM toward the most constrained unresolved variable. On a 35-puzzle retained subset of ZebraLogicBench, a benchmark of 1,000 Einstein-style logic puzzles, Direct and CoT both achieve 0%, while SymStep+G reaches 97%. On AR-LSAT analytical reasoning problems, SymStep achieves 100% vs. CoT's 87%. On LGP-14, SymStep+G achieves 100% vs. 0% for CoT and Logic-LM, the strongest prior symbolic+LLM baseline we compare against. Ablation studies reveal that MRV guidance is a key mechanism for reducing directionless cycling, while consistency checking provides a safety net against explicit contradictions. Across six benchmarks spanning five task domains, SymStep variants match or exceed every baseline on constraint-dense and arithmetic tasks. Experiments on AQUA-RAT algebra confirm the advantage is constraint-density-specific.

AI.tldr: SymStep是一种结合逐步推理与轻量级约束传播的方法，通过原子化声明和一致性检查，在约束密集型逻辑推理任务上显著优于CoT和传统符号+LLM基线，在ZebraLogicBench等基准上达到97%-100%准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有CoT推理在约束密集型逻辑任务中容易累积未经验证的错误，导致严重失败，需要一种能确保推理一致性的方法。
AI.method: LLM每次只声明一个原子事实（DEDUCE），轻量级约束传播器检查该声明与已有接受事实的一致性，拒绝矛盾并自动级联隐含事实。SymStep+G额外提供MRV（最小剩余值）启发式引导，指引LLM选择最受约束的未解决变量。
AI.result: ZebraLogicBench：Direct和CoT均为0%，SymStep+G达97%；AR-LSAT：SymStep 100% vs CoT 87%；LGP-14：SymStep+G 100% vs CoT和Logic-LM 0%。消融实验表明MRV引导是减少无方向循环的关键，一致性检查提供防矛盾安全网。
AI.conclusion: SymStep系列在约束密集型和算术任务上匹配或超越所有基线，在AQUA-RAT代数实验上确认其优势具有约束密度特异性。

title: Outcome-Confounded Local Supervision in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own trajectories while a teacher supplies dense token-level likelihoods at student-visited prefixes. These likelihoods are often read locally: agreement appears safe to imitate, whereas disagreement appears to identify an error. We show that both readings are confounded by the outcome of the completed trajectory. We introduce an outcome-resolved diagnostic that crosses pointwise teacher-student divergence with final-answer correctness, separating safe imitation, productive divergence, harmful divergence, and agreement-on-failure. In an eight-seed mathematical-reasoning study with a Qwen3-8B student and Qwen3-32B teacher, agreement-on-failure constitutes 67.84% of pooled response-token mass; with a Qwen2.5-7B/32B pair it remains 67.68%. The result persists across threshold, sequence-level, format, and truncation audits. Even on prompts that the Qwen3 teacher solves in all four independent attempts, student accuracy rises to 86.91% but agreement-on-failure remains 14.76%. We then run three matched training probes that use the available signals to imitate, mask, or contrast whole trajectories; none consistently reduces agreement-on-failure. The result points to a localization limitation: local divergence paired with a trajectory-level outcome does not identify where a failed trajectory became unrecoverable. Addressing this limitation requires additional positional information, such as process labels, teacher continuations from student prefixes, or token-level alignment across rollouts. Our contribution is therefore diagnostic rather than a new training method.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，在策略蒸馏（OPD）中，局部师生分歧与最终答案正确性的交叉诊断揭示了大量“失败上的共识”（agreement-on-failure）现象（占响应token的67%以上），且现有基于信号（模仿、掩码、对比）的训练方法无法有效减少该现象，表明需要额外位置信息来定位轨迹失败点。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为师生在局部上一致是安全的模仿、不一致则暗示错误，但作者指出这两种解读都受到完成轨迹结果的混杂影响，因此需要引入结果分辨的诊断方法。
AI.method: 提出将逐点师生分歧与最终答案正确性交叉的诊断框架，划分出安全模仿、生产性分歧、有害分歧和失败上的共识四类。在数学推理任务上使用Qwen3-8B学生与Qwen3-32B教师进行8种子实验，并进行阈值、序列级、格式和截断审计。最后设计了三组基于可用信号的训练探针（模仿、掩码、对比完整轨迹）。
AI.result: 1) 失败上的共识占响应token的67.84%（Qwen3对）和67.68%（Qwen2.5对）；2) 即使教师四次独立求解都成功的提示上，失败上的共识仍有14.76%；3) 三种训练探针均无法一致减少失败上的共识。
AI.conclusion: 局部分歧结合轨迹级结果无法定位轨迹何时变得不可恢复，存在定位局限。需要额外位置信息（如过程标签、学生前缀上的教师延续或跨rollout的token级对齐）。本文贡献在于诊断而非提出新训练方法。

title: Structure over Depth: A Single-Block Spatio-Temporal Transformer for Multi-Entity Reasoning
summary: Modeling multi-entity temporal data requires capturing dependencies across entities, time, and their interactions. Transformer-based approaches perform well but often rely on deep stacks of layers to learn these heterogeneous dependencies implicitly, increasing computational cost. We revisit this problem from a structural perspective and decompose multi-entity temporal dynamics into three interaction types: spatial interactions among entities, temporal interactions across time, and cross interactions coupling the two domains. We propose a structured spatio-temporal transformer block that explicitly models all three within a single stage. It uses parallel spatial and temporal self-attention, followed by bidirectional cross-attention, and combines the outputs through learnable gated fusion. By directly encoding these complementary views, the model reduces the need for deep stacking. We evaluate the approach on video-based group activity recognition, skeleton-based human interaction analysis, and wearable sensor-based activity recognition. Despite its simplicity, the single structured Transformer block matches or outperforms deeper architectures with only 1.76M parameters. The results suggest that depth in prior models partly compensates for implicit and entangled interaction modeling, whereas explicit factorization offers a more efficient and transparent alternative. More broadly, this work supports a structure-first design principle: expressive multi-entity temporal reasoning can emerge by exposing interaction structure rather than relying on depth.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结构化的时空Transformer块，通过显式分解空间、时间和交叉三种交互类型，用单个模块替代深层堆叠，在多项时序任务中以仅1.76M参数达到或超越更深架构的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer方法处理多实体时序数据时，依赖深层堆叠隐式学习异构依赖关系，计算成本高且不够透明。作者希望从结构角度出发，显式分解交互类型，减少对深度的依赖。
AI.method: 提出结构化时空Transformer块：并行计算空间自注意力和时间自注意力，然后通过双向交叉注意力耦合两个域，最后用可学习的门控融合机制整合输出，在一个阶段内显式建模三种交互类型。
AI.result: 在视频群体活动识别、骨架人体交互分析和可穿戴传感器活动识别三个任务上，仅1.76M参数的单个结构化块匹配或超越了更深架构的性能。
AI.conclusion: 先前模型中的深度部分是为了补偿隐式且纠缠的交互建模，而显式分解交互结构是一种更高效、更透明的替代方案。支持"结构优先"的设计原则：通过暴露交互结构而非依赖深度来实现多实体时序推理。

title: Source-Free Controlled Adaptation of Teachers for Continual Test-Time Adaptation
